questions.stem: What do we learn from the news report about the egg price in the U.S.?

options.label: A
options.text: It has gone up sharply.

options.label: B
options.text: It has been fluctuating.

options.label: C
options.text: It has risen because of bird flu.

options.label: D
options.text: It has been consumers' concern.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） It has gone up sharply.
【定位】The U.S. average price for a dozen large eggs last month hit $4.25. That's more than double
their $1.78 price in December, 2023.
上个月美国一打大号鸡蛋的平均价格达到了 4.25 美元，这比 2023 年 12 月的 1.78 美元还
高出一倍多。
【信号】数字对比+more than double。答案句的信号是数字加比较：hit $4.25 与 more than
double their $1.78 price——从 1.78 涨到 4.25、还『翻了不止一倍』，是明确的大幅上
涨。新闻里出现两个价格数字相比较，往往就是答案句。
【替换】more than double their $1.78 price ↔ gone up sharply
倍数=大幅
【排除】B) 未提及
It has been fluctuating. 说价格『来回波动』，但录音只给了从 1.78 到 4.25 的单向上
涨，没有任何下跌或反复，方向不符。
C) 原词陷阱
It has risen because of bird flu. 把上涨原因归给禽流感。录音确实念到 bird flu，但那是
解释 The Department of Agriculture banned eggs from Mexico（为何禁止从墨西哥带
蛋）的原因，不是涨价的原因——盗用了原词却接错了因果。
借用原文：This was due to the risk of bird flu.
D) 未提及
It has been consumers' concern. 说蛋价成了消费者的担忧。录音通篇没提消费者的态度
或担忧，只客观报了价格数字，属无中生有。

questions.stem: What does the news report say about most people arriving at American borders with eggs?

options.label: A
options.text: They don't want to abandon their eggs.

options.label: B
options.text: They don't know they will be heavily fined.

options.label: C
options.text: They don't know they are forbidden to bring eggs.

options.label: D
options.text: They don't declare their eggs during the inspection.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） They don't know they are forbidden to bring eggs.
【定位】Officials said most people arriving at international borders with eggs are truthful about their
purchases. They simply don't know bringing eggs is not allowed.
官员说，多数带着鸡蛋到达国际边境的人对自己买的东西是如实交代的。他们只是不知道带
鸡蛋是不被允许的。
【信号】题干同词组+紧跟解释句。答案句信号是题干原词组在录音里复现：most people arriving
at international borders with eggs 几乎照搬了题干，它后面紧跟的 They simply don't
know bringing eggs is not allowed 就是对这群人的正面交代，正是答案落点。
【替换】They simply don't know bringing eggs is not allowed ↔
They don't know they are forbidden to bring eggs.
not allowed=forbidden
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
They don't want to abandon their eggs. 说他们不愿放弃鸡蛋。录音里确有 abandon
the eggs 这个词，但原文是说『在第一次检查时申报、然后可以无后果地放弃鸡蛋』，根
本没说他们『不愿放弃』——盗用 abandon 一词，意思却恰相反。
借用原文：Then the person can abandon the eggs without consequence
B) 偷换概念
They don't know they will be heavily fined. 说他们不知会被重罚。录音里 risk fines of
up to $10,000、a $300 penalty 确实提到罚款，但原文说这群人不知道的是『带蛋被禁
止』，不是『不知会被罚款』——把『不知禁令』偷换成了『不知罚款』。
借用原文：Those bringing eggs into the U.S. risk fines of up to $10,000.
D) 与原文相反
They don't declare their eggs during the inspection. 说他们检查时不申报。录音里
declared during the first inspection 确实有 declare 和 inspection，但原文是说『物品
一般会在第一次检查时被申报』，即多数人是申报的，与选项的『不申报』正好相反。
借用原文：Generally, the items are declared during the first inspection.
Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.
1 Nettie's House, a restaurant in America, has been hit with criticism after announcing on the website
that children under the age of 10 are no longer welcome.
美国一家名为Nettie's House的餐厅在其网站上宣布不再欢迎10岁以下儿童后遭到批评。
2 Among the reasons given for the decision, the restaurant cited "noise levels, lack of space for high
chairs, cleaning up crazy messes, and the liability of kids running around the restaurant". They decided
that it was time to take control. The decision wasn't made lightly, but some recent events pushed them to
implement this new policy.
餐厅给出的决定理由包括"噪音水平、高脚椅空间不足、清理混乱不堪的场面以及孩子在餐厅跑来跑去的
责任问题"。他们决定是时候采取管控措施了。这个决定并非轻率做出,但最近发生的一些事件促使他们实
施这项新政策。
3 Responding to the post, one person commented that "It is messed up beyond another level. Children
are children. Mums are tired and don't have time to cook. Not welcoming children under 10 is a
complete slap in the face to families." He felt so disappointed in the establishment.
针对这篇帖子,有人评论说"这简直乱得不成样子。孩子就是孩子。妈妈们很累,没有时间做饭。不欢迎10岁
以下儿童完全是对家庭的一记耳光。"他对这家餐厅感到非常失望。
4 There are others, however, who showed support for the restaurant's decision. They said it has the right
to implement any rules it wants.
然而,也有其他人对餐厅的决定表示支持。他们说餐厅有权实施任何它想要的规定。

questions.stem: What do we learn from the news report about the restaurant Nettie's House?

options.label: A
options.text: It is no longer critical of younger customers.

options.label: B
options.text: It has banned kids under 10 from dining there.

options.label: C
options.text: It is no longer as noisy and crowded as before.

options.label: D
options.text: It has implemented a decision to expand business.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） It has banned kids under 10 from dining there.
【定位】Nettie's House, a restaurant in America, has been hit with criticism after announcing on the
website that children under the age of 10 are no longer welcome.
美国一家名叫 Nettie's House 的餐厅在网站上宣布不再欢迎 10 岁以下儿童后，遭到了
批评。
【信号】新闻首句点题，机构名后紧跟核心事件。短篇新闻第一句通常就把核心事件说清。这里店名
之后紧跟 announcing on the website that children under the age of 10 are no longer
welcome，这正是"该餐厅做了什么"的答案句，顺着开头第一句就能抓到。
【替换】children under the age of 10 are no longer welcome ↔ banned kids under 10 from dining there
"不再欢迎"="禁止用餐"的同义改写
【排除】A) 与原文相反
It is no longer critical of younger customers. 借了原文"针对低龄顾客"这层意思，却说餐
厅"不再挑剔年轻顾客"——恰恰相反，餐厅是收紧了对儿童的限制；而且 no longer
critical 的是公众对餐厅的批评，不是餐厅对顾客的态度，方向反了。
借用原文：children under the age of 10 are no longer welcome
C) 原词陷阱
It is no longer as noisy and crowded as before. 抓住了原文提到的 noise levels（吵闹）
来勾人，但原文只是把吵闹列为出台新规的"理由"，从没说餐厅现在已经变得不吵不挤了。
听到 noise 就选 C 就中了原词陷阱。
借用原文：noise levels
D) 原词陷阱
It has implemented a decision to expand business. 蹭了原文里 implement this new
policy 的 implement 一词，但原文实施的是"谢绝儿童"的新政策，根本没提扩张生意，
expand business 是无中生有。
借用原文：implement this new policy

questions.stem: What do supporters say in response to the restaurant's new policy?

options.label: A
options.text: It is fully aware of frequent customers' feelings.

options.label: B
options.text: It caters to the tastes of different customers.

options.label: C
options.text: It is entitled to adopt any rules it wants.

options.label: D
options.text: It should announce its decisions online.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （态度观点题） It is entitled to adopt any rules it wants.
【定位】There are others, however, who showed support for the restaurant's decision. They said it has
the right to implement any rules it wants.
不过也有另一些人对餐厅的决定表示支持。他们说餐厅有权实施它想要的任何规定。
【信号】转折 however 引出支持方，应答句紧随。第4段以 There are others, however, who
showed support 用转折词 however 把镜头从前文反对者切到支持者，紧接着 They said
it has the right to implement any rules it wants 就是支持者的原话——题问
supporters，落点正是这句应答。
【替换】it has the right to implement any rules it wants ↔ It is entitled to adopt any rules it wants
has the right=is entitled，implement=adopt
【排除】A) 未提及
It is fully aware of frequent customers' feelings. 说餐厅"充分了解常客的感受"，但支持
者原话只讲"餐厅有权定规矩"，从没提常客（frequent customers）也没说店家了解谁的感
受，这层意思原文整个没出现。
B) 原词陷阱
It caters to the tastes of different customers. 蹭了全篇反复出现的 customers 一词，但
支持者说的是"店家有权定规矩"，不是说它"迎合不同顾客的口味"——caters to tastes 在
原文没有依据，是借熟词编的好听话。
借用原文：Children are children
D) 原词陷阱
It should announce its decisions online. 蹭了原文 announcing on the website 的"网上
宣布"，但那只是叙述餐厅当初怎么发的公告，支持者根本没说"店家应该在网上公布决定"，
且 should 是建议口吻、与本题问的支持表态不符。
借用原文：announcing on the website

questions.stem: What does the report say security officers were searching for?

options.label: A
options.text: A missing pet.

options.label: B
options.text: A grown-up snake.

options.label: C
options.text: A huge animal skin.

options.label: D
options.text: A snake specialist.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） A grown-up snake.
【定位】Security officers were searching a suburb in Australia where an adult snake was believed to
be wandering after the discovery of a huge, "freshly shed" snake skin.
安保人员正在搜查澳大利亚的一处郊区，据信有一条成年蛇在那里游荡，此前那里发现了一
张巨大的、刚蜕下的蛇皮。
【信号】搜寻主语句直接点对象。答案句是新闻第一句，把『谁在搜+搜什么』一并说清：an adult
snake was believed to be wandering（一条成年蛇据信在游荡），这才是被搜寻的活物；
蛇皮 snake skin 只是引出搜寻的线索，不是搜寻目标。
【替换】an adult snake ↔ A grown-up snake.
adult=grown-up 同义改写
【排除】C) 原词陷阱
选项盗用了录音里真实出现的 a huge, "freshly shed" snake skin（巨大的刚蜕的蛇皮），
听到 huge 和 skin 很想选 A huge animal skin.。但蛇皮只是引发搜寻的线索，搜寻的对象
是活蛇本身，故 C 答非所问。
借用原文：a huge, "freshly shed" snake skin
A) 未提及
录音通篇说的是一条野生大蛇，从未提到这是谁走失的宠物。A missing pet. 在原文中没有
依据，属凭常识臆测（『蛇会不会是谁养的跑了』），录音没说就不能选。
D) 张冠李戴
A snake specialist.（捕蛇/治蛇专家）盗用了录音后文 a licensed snake catcher 与 a
specialist animal doctor 的概念，但这些人是抓到蛇之后才会请的，不是此刻搜寻的对
象。把『搜寻蛇』偷换成『搜寻专家』，张冠李戴。
借用原文：a specialist animal doctor

questions.stem: Where does the report say the discovery was made?

options.label: A
options.text: In a government office.

options.label: B
options.text: In a deserted house.

options.label: C
options.text: At a local zoo.

options.label: D
options.text: At a construction site.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） At a construction site.
【定位】The skin was found at a construction site, and the government wrote to residents to
warn them.
那张蛇皮是在一处建筑工地发现的，政府随后致信居民提醒他们。
【信号】地点状语 at 直接给地点。答案句里 The skin was found at a construction site 的 at a
construction site 是典型的地点状语，正面回答了『发现在哪』。问 where 就抓这种 at/in
+ 场所的结构。
【替换】found at a construction site ↔ At a construction site.
地点词原样对应
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项盗用了同句里的 the government 一词，听到 government 就想选 In a government
office.。但录音里政府是『写信提醒居民』的施动方，并非发现蛇皮的地点，二者无关，属
答非所问。
借用原文：the government wrote to residents
B) 未提及
In a deserted house.（废弃房屋）录音从未提到，可能是考生凭『蛇出没=破旧荒地』的
常识脑补出来的。原文只说工地，没说废屋，无依据。
C) 未提及
At a local zoo.（本地动物园）也是常识联想（『蛇=动物=动物园』），录音里完全没有出
现 zoo。原文发现地是工地，不是动物园，排除。

questions.stem: What did the government say would be done if security officers found what they were searching for?

options.label: A
options.text: Figuring out where it came from.

options.label: B
options.text: Curing it of any possible diseases.

options.label: C
options.text: Protecting its babies against harm.

options.label: D
options.text: Determining how to catch it safely.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Figuring out where it came from.
【定位】If caught, the snake would be examined to determine where it came from, how long it had
been in the area, what it had been eating, whether it was carrying any diseases of concern and
whether it had produced babies.
一旦抓获，这条蛇将接受检查，以确定它从哪里来、在该区域待了多久、一直在吃什么、是
否携带值得关注的疾病，以及是否已经产下幼蛇。
【信号】If caught 引出后续措施。答案句以 If caught（一旦抓获）开头，正对题干的 if…found 假
设条件，后面 would be examined to determine where it came from 列出抓到后要做的
事，是本题答案落点。
【替换】examined to determine where it came from ↔ Figuring out where it came from.
determine=figure out 同义
【排除】B) 偷换概念
选项盗用了录音 whether it was carrying any diseases of concern 里的 diseases 一词，
听到『病』就想选 Curing it of any possible diseases.。但原文只是『检查它是否携带疾
病』，并非『治好它的病』，把『检查』偷换成『治疗』，故错。
借用原文：whether it was carrying any diseases of concern
C) 偷换概念
选项盗用了 whether it had produced babies 里的 babies，让人误选 Protecting its
babies against harm.。但原文是『查清它是否产过幼蛇』，根本不是『保护幼蛇不受伤
害』，方向完全不同，属偷换概念。
借用原文：whether it had produced babies
D) 原词陷阱
Determining how to catch it safely. 盗用了 catch（抓）。录音里抓蛇是 employ a
licensed snake catcher to catch it（雇持证捕蛇人去抓），是直接安排人去抓，并不是
『研究怎样安全地抓』，故 D 答非所问。
借用原文：employ a licensed snake catcher to catch it

questions.stem: Why does the woman say she swears it?

options.label: A
options.text: The man doesn't agree Hannah is poor.

options.label: B
options.text: The man doesn't believe what she says.

options.label: C
options.text: The man doesn't think she can be a millionaire.

options.label: D
options.text: The man doesn't consider her to be trustworthy.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （推断题） The man doesn't believe what she says.
【定位】M: I can't believe it. You're really not joking, are you?
男：我真不敢相信。你真的不是在开玩笑吧？
【信号】发誓是对男士『不信』的回应。女士反复发誓的触发点，是男士这句 I can't believe it.
You're really not joking, are you?——男士先表态不信、追问是否开玩笑，女士才被迫发
誓。这句男士的怀疑就是答案信号，前面 No way. That's incredible. Are you kidding? 也
铺垫了同样的不信。
【替换】I can't believe it. ↔ doesn't believe what she says
I can't believe=doesn't believe
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 The man doesn't agree Hannah is poor. 借了录音开头 Poor Hannah! 的 poor 来勾
人，但男士从没就『Hannah 穷不穷』表过态，他不信的是『中了大奖』这件事，与穷不穷
无关。
借用原文：Poor Hannah!
C) 偷换概念
选项 The man doesn't think she can be a millionaire. 抓了录音 became a millionaire
overnight 里的 millionaire，但男士震惊的是『这事是不是真的』，并非质疑『她有没有能
力成为富翁』——把『不信事实』偷换成了『不信她的能力』。
借用原文：became a millionaire overnight
D) 过度推断
选项 The man doesn't consider her to be trustworthy. 听着和『不信』近似，但
trustworthy 指『这个人不可信、人品有问题』，男士只是惊讶于消息太离奇、问对方是否
开玩笑，并没有否定女士的人品，属过度引申。

questions.stem: What do we learn about Hannah from the conversation?

options.label: A
options.text: She no longer has any money left.

options.label: B
options.text: She has been betrayed by her family.

options.label: C
options.text: She can no longer hold on to her job.

options.label: D
options.text: She has been robbed of 5 million Euros.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） She no longer has any money left.
【定位】W: Well, it turns out that she's spent it all already.
女：嗯，原来她已经把钱全花光了。
【信号】转折后交代真实结局。前文一直在讲 Hannah 中了大奖、好运连连，直到女士这句 it turns
out that she's spent it all already 才点出真相——钱花光了。it turns out(原来)是语气转
折信号，转折之后才是这道题要的事实。she ran out of money 再次确认了这一点。
【替换】she's spent it all already ↔ no longer has any money left
全花光=不再有钱
【排除】B) 未提及
选项 She has been betrayed by her family. 在录音里找不到任何依据——对话提到她给家
人买房，是付出而非被背叛，『被家人背叛』纯属编造。
C) 与原文相反
选项 She can no longer hold on to her job. 抓了录音 quit the job she hates 里的 job，
但录音是说她原想辞掉讨厌的工作却辞不成、只能继续干，恰恰是『保得住/必须保住』工
作，选项却说成『保不住』，把意思反了。
借用原文：she was planning to quit the job she hates and retire early. But now that she ran out of
money, she can't
D) 原词陷阱
选项 She has been robbed of 5 million Euros. 用了录音里真念到的钱数 maybe five
million Euros after tax 来制造熟悉感，但钱是她自己花光的(买房买车)，不是被人抢走，
robbed 完全没有依据。
借用原文：maybe five million Euros after tax

questions.stem: What does the man think really matters to people?

options.label: A
options.text: Fortune.

options.label: B
options.text: Family.

options.label: C
options.text: Harmony.

options.label: D
options.text: Happiness.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Happiness.
【定位】M: Wow. Are they all happy? Because that's what matters, isn't it?
男：哇，他们都开心吗？因为那才是最要紧的，不是吗？
【信号】matters 原词点名 + 反问强调。男士直接说 that's what matters, isn't it?，其中 matters
与题干 really matters 对得上；而 that 指的正是前半句的 Are they all happy?——所以他
认为最要紧的是『开心/幸福』。反问句 isn't it 是加重语气的强调信号。
【替换】Are they all happy? ↔ Happiness.
happy→Happiness 形转名
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 Fortune. 和整段『中大奖、五百万』的话题最贴，最易顺手误选，但通篇没有任何人
说『财富才是最要紧的』，男士点名的是开心，不是钱。
借用原文：maybe five million Euros after tax
B) 原词陷阱
选项 Family. 借了录音里反复出现的家人(给 her parents、四个兄弟姐妹买房)，但男士说
『要紧』时指的是大家开不开心，不是『家庭』这个概念本身。
借用原文：a house for her parents, and then a house for each of her four brothers and sisters
C) 未提及
选项 Harmony.(和睦)看似和『家人开心』沾点边，但录音里既没念到 harmony 这个词，
也没人表达『和睦才最重要』，纯属凭话题臆造。

questions.stem: What does Hannah's husband say he'll do if she sells the new car?

options.label: A
options.text: Divorce her.

options.label: B
options.text: Leave home.

options.label: C
options.text: Buy her a more expensive model.

options.label: D
options.text: Let the best thing happen to them.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Divorce her.
【定位】W: She wants to, but her husband refuses to get rid of it. He says the car is the best thing that
has ever happened to him, and if she sells it, he will divorce her.
女：她想卖，但她丈夫拒绝处理掉它。他说这辆车是他这辈子遇到的最好的东西，如果她卖
了，他就跟她离婚。
【信号】if…he will… 条件句直给答案。答案句就是 if she sells it, he will divorce her——题干的
条件 if she sells 在这里原样出现，紧跟的主句 he will divorce her 就是丈夫扬言要做的
事。if 引导的条件主句是这道题的答案信号。
【替换】he will divorce her ↔ Divorce her.
原句动作直接照搬
【排除】B) 偷换概念
选项 Leave home. 听着和『离婚』情绪相近，但录音里丈夫说的是 divorce(离婚)，从没提
『离家出走』，属凭联想替换。
C) 原词陷阱
选项 Buy her a more expensive model. 抓了录音 a ridiculously expensive sports car
的 expensive，但录音里丈夫是『拒绝卖掉现有的车』，根本不是要再买更贵的，方向相
反。
借用原文：a ridiculously expensive sports car
D) 原词陷阱
选项 Let the best thing happen to them. 改自录音 the car is the best thing that has
ever happened to him，但那是丈夫形容车好、是已经发生的事，并非他在『卖车后要做
的动作』，把一句描述硬塞成了答案。
借用原文：the car is the best thing that has ever happened to him

questions.stem: What does the man say about Jake?

options.label: A
options.text: He is not outstanding in Science and Math.

options.label: B
options.text: He does not have a strong academic record.

options.label: C
options.text: He is not yet mature enough to live on his own.

options.label: D
options.text: He does not like Westwood Elementary School.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） He is not yet mature enough to live on his own.
【定位】I admit that their academic record is very strong with many outstanding awards for
achievements in Science and Math, but he is just not mature enough to live on his own at
this point.
我承认他们的学术成绩很强，在科学和数学方面拿过很多杰出的奖项，但他现在还不够成
熟，没法独立生活。
【信号】转折 but 之后才是男方真意。这句前半是 I admit…让步夸学校，真正的态度落在 but he is
just not mature enough to live on his own at this point 之后。听力里 but 之后才是落
点，前半的赞扬是铺垫，不能当答案。
【替换】he is just not mature enough to live on his own ↔
He is not yet mature enough to live on his own.
几乎原句，just→yet 同义
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项说 not outstanding in Science and Math，而录音 outstanding awards for
achievements in Science and Math 恰恰是说学校在科学数学上很突出。它盗用了原词
Science and Math，却把"突出"反说成"不突出"。
借用原文：outstanding awards for achievements in Science and Math
B) 偷换概念
录音明说 their academic record is very strong，指的还是学校的学术记录强；选项 He
does not have a strong academic record. 既把对象从学校换成 Jake，又把"强"反成"不
强"。
借用原文：their academic record is very strong
D) 未提及
Westwood 是女方想送的 boarding school，男方的顾虑是孩子"不够成熟"，全程没说
Jake 喜不喜欢这所学校，He does not like Westwood Elementary School. 属凭空添加。

questions.stem: Why does the woman feel uncomfortable about sending Jake to Lakeview School?

options.label: A
options.text: It is too far away.

options.label: B
options.text: It is newly opened.

options.label: C
options.text: It lacks outdoor sports facilities.

options.label: D
options.text: It has too few first-class teachers.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） It is newly opened.
【定位】They did just open, though, so I don't think I feel comfortable having our son in the first class
of a brand-new school.
不过他们才刚开学，所以我不太放心让我们的儿子去一所全新学校的第一届。
【信号】though 转折 + 不安的直接陈述。前文女方先夸 Lakeview 校园好、空气好，though 一转
才道出顾虑，紧接 I don't think I feel comfortable having our son in the first class of a
brand-new school，与题干 feel uncomfortable 直接呼应，是答案句。
【替换】They did just open ↔ It is newly opened.
did just open = newly opened
the first class of a brand-new school ↔ It is newly opened.
brand-new school 印证"新开"
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
It is too far away. 谈的是距离，但女方对 Lakeview 的顾虑是"太新"，文中没说 Lakeview
远；"近"反而是后面本地学校的优点。距离话题被张冠李戴到了 Lakeview 头上。
借用原文：Being practically next door
C) 与原文相反
录音说 Lakeview a great outdoor campus where he could finally learn all those
outdoor sports，户外运动是它的优点；选项 It lacks outdoor sports facilities. 把"有大
操场练户外运动"反说成"缺户外运动设施"。
借用原文：a great outdoor campus where he could finally learn all those outdoor sports
D) 未提及
It has too few first-class teachers. 谈师资，但整段讲 Lakeview 只提了校园、空气、刚开
学，从没提教师数量或质量，属凭空添加。

questions.stem: What does the man say about their local school?

options.label: A
options.text: It has a beautiful campus.

options.label: B
options.text: It is within walking distance.

options.label: C
options.text: It has a wonderful arts program.

options.label: D
options.text: It is helpful to Jake's breathing problems.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） It has a wonderful arts program.
【定位】What about our local school then? They have a wonderful arts program that would really
challenge Jake in terms of creativity and imagination.
那我们本地的学校呢？他们有一个很棒的艺术项目，能在创造力和想象力方面真正挑
战 Jake。
【信号】男方主动提议本校时主推的卖点。男方用 What about our local school then? 把话题转
到本地学校，紧接给出的第一条理由 a wonderful arts program 就是他主推的卖点，是答
案句。
【替换】a wonderful arts program ↔ It has a wonderful arts program.
几乎原句复现
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
It has a beautiful campus. 谈校园，但漂亮校园说的是 Lakeview（a great outdoor
campus、so much greenery and fresh air），不是本地学校，属张冠李戴。
借用原文：a great outdoor campus
B) 原词陷阱
本地学校确实近，Being practically next door，但题干问 man 关于本校"说了什么"，他
主推的是艺术项目；It is within walking distance. 虽是事实细节，却非他强调的卖点，且
与正解只能取其一时，原文用 wonderful 着重的是 arts program。
借用原文：Being practically next door
D) 张冠李戴
It is helpful to Jake's breathing problems. 谈呼吸，但能改善呼吸的是 Lakeview 的清新
空气（his current breathing problems would probably disappear），与本地学校无
关，属张冠李戴。
借用原文：his current breathing problems would probably disappear

questions.stem: What does the woman suggest at the end of the conversation?

options.label: A
options.text: Asking Jake which school he himself prefers to enroll in.

options.label: B
options.text: Thinking twice about what is best for Jake's education next year.

options.label: C
options.text: Consulting her mother about which school Jake is to attend.

options.label: D
options.text: Sending Jake to the school near the home of the man's mother.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Sending Jake to the school near the home of the man's mother.
【定位】What if we send him to the place near your mother's house?
要不我们把他送到你妈妈家附近的那所学校怎么样？
【信号】建议句式 What if 在结尾出现。对话最后一句 What if we send him to the place near
your mother's house? 用 What if 提出新方案，是女方对男方说的，your mother 指男方
的母亲，正是结尾建议，为答案句。
【替换】the place near your mother's house ↔
Sending Jake to the school near the home of the man's mother.
your mother = the man's mother
send him to the place ↔ Sending Jake to the school
send him = sending Jake，place=school
【排除】A) 未提及
Asking Jake which school he himself prefers to enroll in. 让 Jake 自己选，但结尾女方
提的是送到男方母亲家附近，全程没说征求 Jake 意愿，属凭空添加。
B) 答非所问
Thinking twice about what is best for Jake's education next year. 把 what exactly we
are going to do for Jake's education next year 这句开头的话改写过来，但那是对话开端
女方提出讨论的引子，不是结尾给出的具体建议。
借用原文：what exactly we are going to do for Jake's education next year
C) 张冠李戴
Consulting her mother about which school Jake is to attend. 盗用结尾的 mother，却
把人物彻底换了：原文是"送到你（男方）妈妈家附近的学校"，选项变成"去咨询她（女方）
自己的妈妈"，既改了是谁的母亲，又把"送去就读"换成"征求意见"。
借用原文：the place near your mother's house

questions.stem: What does the passage say is a major flaw of analytical decision-making?

options.label: A
options.text: It is time consuming.

options.label: B
options.text: It is unfit for crucial issues.

options.label: C
options.text: It relies too much on solid data.

options.label: D
options.text: It dulls a leader's sense of urgency.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） It is time consuming.
【定位】A key flaw with analytical decision-making is that it takes time.
分析型决策的一个关键缺陷是它很费时间。
【信号】关键词 key flaw 直接亮出缺点。录音第 2 段开头 A key flaw with analytical decision-
making is that it takes time 用 A key flaw 这个"明示缺点"信号词领出答案句——耳朵一
抓到 flaw 就该锁定其后内容，这正是预读时守的信号。
【替换】it takes time ↔ It is time consuming
takes time = time consuming 同义改写
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
录音说的是 it is problematic when time is crucial——"当时间紧迫时它才成问题"，B 却
把 crucial 搬来说成 It is unfit for crucial issues（不适合关键"问题"），把"时间紧迫"偷换
成"关键议题"，听到 crucial 就选会中招。
借用原文：it is problematic when time is crucial
C) 偷换概念
It relies too much on solid data 把"靠 solid data"说成缺点，但录音里 makes
important business decisions only with solid data 是在客观描述这种风格、第 4 段更
把"靠数据"算作优点，C 把中性/优点歪曲成缺陷，与题干问的 flaw 不符。
借用原文：makes important business decisions only with solid data
D) 过度推断
录音只说分析型决策者 struggle with deadlines and a sense of urgency（应付不来紧迫
感），并未说它"钝化/削弱"领导的紧迫感；D 的 dulls a leader's sense of urgency 是借
urgency 一词反向引申，原文无此意。
借用原文：struggle with deadlines and a sense of urgency

questions.stem: What does a leader tend to do when they are committed to analytical decision-making?

options.label: A
options.text: Depend on digital technology.

options.label: B
options.text: Make assumptions and guesses.

options.label: C
options.text: Ignore others' thoughts and ideas.

options.label: D
options.text: Lay emphasis on thinking flexibly.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Ignore others' thoughts and ideas.
【定位】Inflexibility causes you to ignore or avoid listening to the thoughts and ideas of others.
这种僵化会使你忽视或回避去倾听他人的想法和主意。
【信号】因果信号 causes 引出结果行为。录音第 3 段 Inflexibility causes you to ignore or avoid
listening to the thoughts and ideas of others 用因果词 causes 把"僵化"导向具体行
为"忽视他人想法"——因果信号后面的结果句往往就是"会去做什么"的答案。
【替换】ignore or avoid listening to the thoughts and ideas of others ↔ Ignore others' thoughts and ideas
原句压缩成短语，意思不变
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
Depend on digital technology 像是从第 4 段 Database technology enables business
leaders 摘来的——那是讲"优点"的语境，与第 17 题问的"僵化导致的行为"不是一回事，
且原文用的是 database technology 而非泛指的 digital technology。
借用原文：Database technology enables business leaders
B) 与原文相反
录音里 get away from the habit of making guesses 说的是分析型决策者"摆脱猜测"，B
的 Make assumptions and guesses 恰恰相反——这类人不会去做假设猜测，B 取了原词
guesses 却把极性反了。
借用原文：get away from the habit of making guesses
D) 与原文相反
录音明说 hinders the manager's flexibility、Inflexibility——这类领导是"妨碍灵活、僵
化"，D 的 Lay emphasis on thinking flexibly 把它说成"强调灵活思考"，与原文意思正好
相反。
借用原文：hinders the manager's flexibility

questions.stem: What is a key strength of analytical decision-making?

options.label: A
options.text: Maximizing the advantage of available resources.

options.label: B
options.text: Minimizing the possibility of a wrong decision.

options.label: C
options.text: Discovering new potential markets.

options.label: D
options.text: Perfecting promotional strategies.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Minimizing the possibility of a wrong decision.
【定位】By relying on facts and data, you minimize your potential for a wrong decision.
通过依靠事实和数据，你把做出错误决策的可能性降到最低。
【信号】段首 strengths 转好 + minimize 点优点。第 4 段以 does have several key strengths
由弊转利，紧接 you minimize your potential for a wrong decision 给出具体优点
——"转好"信号词 strengths 后面那句就是答案句。
【替换】minimize your potential for a wrong decision ↔ Minimizing the possibility of a wrong decision
potential ≈ possibility 近义替换
【排除】A) 未提及
Maximizing the advantage of available resources（最大化资源优势）听来很像个优点，
但录音讲优点处只说 minimize your potential for a wrong decision 和摆脱猜测，从未
提"资源优势"，属凭常识硬安。
C) 原词陷阱
录音第 4 段确有 markets：analyzing target markets and promotional strategies，但那
是说"用数据分析现有目标市场"，C 却说成 Discovering new potential markets（发现新
市场），听到 markets 就选会中招。
借用原文：analyzing target markets and promotional strategies
D) 原词陷阱
D 的 Perfecting promotional strategies 直接搬走录音里的 promotional strategies，但
原文是说"用数据去分析促销策略"，并非"完善促销策略"是它的优点，词对了、意思却错
了。
借用原文：analyzing target markets and promotional strategies

questions.stem: What do we learn about Branyas Morera?

options.label: A
options.text: She is one of the world's best-known pianists.

options.label: B
options.text: She celebrated her 110th birthday this April.

options.label: C
options.text: She moved to the U.S. at a young age.

options.label: D
options.text: She is the world's oldest individual.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） She is the world's oldest individual.
【定位】Branyas Morera is now 115 years and 320 days old. That means she's been alive longer than
any other living individual.
布兰亚斯·莫雷拉现在 115 岁零 320 天。这意味着她比任何其他在世的人都活得更久。
【信号】longer than 任何人即最年长。答案信号是比较结构 longer than any other living
individual——“比任何其他在世者都活得久”就等于“世上最年长”，这种“er than any
other”的极限表述是定位最高级类信息的标志。
【替换】longer than any other living individual ↔ the world's oldest individual
比较级换最高级
【排除】A) 过度推断
原文确实提到她弹钢琴，但只说弹琴是她长寿秘诀之一，从未说她是“世界知名钢琴家”；
one of the world's best-known pianists把“会弹琴”拔高成“知名钢琴家”，是过度推断。
借用原文：playing the piano from a young age
B) 原词陷阱
原文说她现在 115 years and 320 days old，是 115 岁，本选项却说她四月庆祝“110 岁生
日”；它盗用了原文真实存在的出生日期“April 4th”的月份与年龄数字来拼凑，数字被偷换，
听到“April”就选会中招。
借用原文：115 years and 320 days old
C) 与原文相反
原文说她出生在美国，后来 her family moved to Spain——是搬去西班牙；本选项却说她
“年幼时搬到美国”，把方向彻底说反了。它盗用“moved”“young child”等原词，只把目的地
颠倒，专坑没听清方向的人。
借用原文：her family moved to Spain

questions.stem: What is one of Branyas Morera's secrets to living a long life?

options.label: A
options.text: Being always active on social media.

options.label: B
options.text: Doing regular and vigorous exercise.

options.label: C
options.text: Playing the piano from a young age.

options.label: D
options.text: Following a specific diet every day.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Playing the piano from a young age.
【定位】She also shares some of her secrets to living so long. These include playing the piano from a
young age.
她还分享了一些自己长寿的秘诀。这些秘诀包括从小弹钢琴。
【信号】These include 引出秘诀清单。答案信号是列举句 These include playing the piano from
a young age——“These include”紧跟在“her secrets”之后，明确把弹琴列入秘诀清单，
这种“include/such as”的列举信号是细节题的金标定位点。
【替换】playing the piano from a young age ↔ Playing the piano from a young age
列举项原样对应
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
原文确实说她 active on social media，但这只是描述她的日常状态，紧接其后“These
include”列举秘诀时并没有把“活跃于社交媒体”列进去；本选项盗用“active on social
media”原词，却答非所问。
借用原文：active on social media
B) 偷换概念
原文只说她 led an active lifestyle（生活方式活跃），并没说她做“regular and vigorous
exercise（规律而剧烈的运动）”；本选项把“active lifestyle”偷换成程度更重的“vigorous
exercise”，程度被拔高。
借用原文：led an active lifestyle
D) 与原文相反
原文明确说她 has never followed a specific diet——从不遵循特定饮食；本选项却说她
“每天遵循特定饮食”，与原文相反。它盗用“specific diet”原词，把否定听成肯定就会误选。
借用原文：never followed a specific diet

questions.stem: What does Branyas Morera think also contributes to a long life?

options.label: A
options.text: Eating as little as one can possibly manage.

options.label: B
options.text: Having the ability to forget things selectively.

options.label: C
options.text: Figuring out the positive properties of each food item.

options.label: D
options.text: Knowing how to remember major events in one's life.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （态度观点题） Having the ability to forget things selectively.
【定位】She has also said that the secret to a long life is "knowing how to choose" what to forget.
她还说过，长寿的秘诀是“懂得选择”要忘掉什么。
【信号】she has also said 引出本人观点。答案信号是引述句 She has also said that the secret
to a long life is——“she has also said”直接标记这是她本人的另一条观点，加上“also”正
对应题干的“also contributes”，是态度观点题最可靠的定位信号。
【替换】knowing how to choose what to forget ↔ the ability to forget things selectively
选择遗忘换选择性遗忘
【排除】A) 过度推断
原文说她 always eaten little, but everything——吃得少但什么都吃；本选项却说“尽可能
少吃”，把“eaten little”拔高到极端，还丢了“但什么都吃”的另一半。它盗用“eaten little”原
词，制造“听到 little 就选”的诱惑。
借用原文：always eaten little, but everything
C) 偷换概念
原文说酸奶对身体有 an infinite number of positive properties，是夸酸奶本身；本选项
却说“弄清每种食物的有益属性”，把“酸奶有有益属性”偷换成“她认为要研究每种食物的属
性”。它盗用“positive properties”原词，所指对象被偷换。
借用原文：an infinite number of positive properties
D) 与原文相反
原文强调的是“懂得选择忘掉什么”，还说 Life would be impossible if we remembered
everything——记住一切反而不行；本选项却说“懂得记住人生大事”，方向与原文相反。它
盗用 remember/forget 同一话题词，把遗忘说成记忆。
借用原文：Life would be impossible if we remembered everything

questions.stem: What is of great importance to students according to the speaker?

options.label: A
options.text: The ability to learn.

options.label: B
options.text: The first day of school.

options.label: C
options.text: How teachers perceive them.

options.label: D
options.text: Where they sit in the classroom.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Where they sit in the classroom.
【定位】It does matter where you sit in your classroom, so choose and choose carefully. Studies report
that where you sit in the classroom can impact your ability to learn and the way your teacher
perceives you.
你坐在教室的哪个位置，确实有影响，所以要慎重选座。研究表明，你在教室里的座位会影
响你的学习能力以及老师对你的看法。
【信号】加重强调 It does matter。说话人先自问 Where do you sit? Does it matter? 紧接着用加
重语气的 It does matter where you sit in your classroom 自答，does 的强调正是答案信
号——被反复强调的"坐在哪"就是说话人认定的重点。
【替换】where you sit in your classroom ↔ Where they sit in the classroom.
人称转换，意思不变
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
原文确实念到 your ability to learn，但那是"座位"带来的"影响之一"，并非说话人说的"对
学生重要的东西"本身。把"被影响的结果"当成"重要的东西"，是典型的听到原词就想选。
借用原文：can impact your ability to learn
B) 原词陷阱
原文开头说 It's the first day of school，但那只是用来引出话题的场景背景，说话人从没
说"开学第一天"对学生重要，属于借开头原词设的陷阱。
借用原文：It's the first day of school
C) 答非所问
原文 the way your teacher perceives you 确被念到，但它和"学习能力"一样，是座位带来
的"影响"，不是说话人认定"重要"的那样东西，张冠李戴。
借用原文：the way your teacher perceives you

questions.stem: What did one study find about students seated in the middle of the classroom?

options.label: A
options.text: They often received close attention from the instructors.

options.label: B
options.text: They obtained the highest grade average in their class.

options.label: C
options.text: They actually wanted a clear vision of the blackboard.

options.label: D
options.text: They scored higher than students sitting behind them.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） They scored higher than students sitting behind them.
【定位】Get this. Students sitting in the middle of the classroom also outscored students sitting
behind them.
注意了：坐在教室中间的学生，成绩也超过了坐在他们后面的学生。
【信号】提示语 Get this 引出关键发现。说话人用 Get this（"注意听这个"）专门提醒，随后给出
Students sitting in the middle of the classroom also outscored students sitting
behind them，这种"提示语+发现"正是答案信号，直接对准"中间座位学生"的结论。
【替换】outscored students sitting behind them ↔ They scored higher than students sitting behind them.
outscore = scored higher than
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
原文 formed a better connection with the students who sat in front 讲的是"前排"学生
与老师的关系，受关注的是前排不是"中间"。把前排学生的待遇安到"中间座位学生"头上，
是张冠李戴。
借用原文：formed a better connection with the students who sat in front
B) 偷换概念
原文只说前排/中间学生 received a higher grade average（比后排更高），选项却说成
obtained the highest grade average in their class（全班最高），把"比较高"偷换成"最
高"，程度被夸大。
借用原文：received a higher grade average
C) 偷换概念
原文 students had a clearer vision of the blackboard 说的是前排中间学生"看黑板更清
楚"这一既成事实（成绩高的原因），并非选项所谓"他们其实想要看清黑板（wanted）"，
既改了意思又不是本题问的发现。
借用原文：students had a clearer vision of the blackboard

questions.stem: What can eye contact, visibility and more interaction probably bring about?

options.label: A
options.text: A higher grade average among all students of a class.

options.label: B
options.text: A better connection between instructors and students.

options.label: C
options.text: A stronger support for a student-centered teaching approach.

options.label: D
options.text: A more favorable atmosphere for effective classroom learning.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） A better connection between instructors and students.
【定位】The instructors said that they also formed a better connection with the students who
sat in front. Perhaps the connection is made because of eye contact and visibility and
more interaction.
老师们说，他们和坐在前排的学生还建立了更好的联系。也许这种联系正是因为眼神交流、
容易被看到以及更多的互动而形成的。
【信号】因果倒装 because of 揭示因果。原文先给结果 formed a better connection，再用
because of eye contact and visibility and more interaction 点出原因。题干把"因"列出
来反问"带来什么果"，沿 because of 这条因果线，对应的"果"正是"更好的联系"。
【替换】formed a better connection with the students who sat in front ↔
A better connection between instructors and students.
近乎原义概括，主体补全
【排除】A) 答非所问
a higher grade average 是上一段讲座位与成绩的内容，与本题问的"眼神交流等带来什
么"不是同一个因果；选项还把范围扩成 among all students of a class（全班所有人），
既答非所问又以偏概全。
借用原文：received a higher grade average
C) 未提及
A stronger support for a student-centered teaching approach. 里"以学生为中心的教学
法"原文从未提及，是凭"师生互动"硬联想出来的，属未提及。
D) 过度推断
A more favorable atmosphere for effective classroom learning. 听上去与"课堂学习"很
搭，但原文讲的是"师生联系（connection）"，从没说"更有利的课堂学习氛围"，属未提及
的合理推测项。

questions.stem: What do we learn about extremely shy students sitting in the front row of the classroom?

options.label: A
options.text: They may experience some unwanted stress.

options.label: B
options.text: They may try hard to show their preparedness.

options.label: C
options.text: They may receive extra attention from the instructor.

options.label: D
options.text: They may feel helpless when called on by the instructor.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） They may experience some unwanted stress.
【定位】So for students who are not prepared and for those who are extremely shy, the attention could
cause some unwanted stress.
所以，对于那些没准备好的学生以及那些极为害羞的学生来说，这种关注可能会带来一些不
想要的压力。
【信号】结尾 So 收束 + 转折隐含。前句还在说前排"被老师叫到更多"，结尾用 So for…those who
are extremely shy, the attention could cause some unwanted stress 笔锋一转点出负面
后果。So 引出的收束句正是针对"害羞学生"的答案落点。
【替换】the attention could cause some unwanted stress ↔ They may experience some unwanted stress.
cause→experience，因果换视角
【排除】B) 与原文相反
They may try hard to show their preparedness. 原文未提；原文恰恰说的是"没准备
好"的学生 students who are not prepared，与"努力表现自己准备好了"方向相反。
借用原文：students who are not prepared
C) 原词陷阱
the attention 确被念到，但原文说这关注对害羞学生造成的是"压力"；选项 They may
receive extra attention from the instructor. 只截取"被额外关注"这个中性事实，回避了问
的"后果"，是听到 attention 就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：you may be called on more by your teacher
D) 过度推断
原文说前排学生 may be called on more（更可能被点名），但只说会带来"压力"，并未说
他们"被点到时感到无助（feel helpless）"，是顺着"被点名"多推了一步。
借用原文：you may be called on more by your teacher

questions.stem: Where was the black cat found?

options.label: A
options.text: Outside the office of a charity foundation.

options.label: B
options.text: Inside the car of David King's neighbour.

options.label: C
options.text: Under the engine cover of a man's car.

options.label: D
options.text: At the gate of a grade school in Kent.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Under the engine cover of a man's car.
【定位】The black cat was found curled up under the engine cover of David King's car when he
decided to do an oil check after dropping his grandson off at school in Kent.
这只黑猫是在大卫·金送孙子上学后、决定检查机油时，被发现蜷缩在他汽车的引擎盖下
面的。
【信号】found ＋ 地点介词短语。答案句的信号是动词 found 紧跟一个表地点的介词短语 found
curled up under the engine cover of David King's car——题干问 Where… found，原
文恰好出现 found ＋『在哪儿』，这就是承载答案的那一句。
【替换】under the engine cover of David King's car ↔ Under the engine cover of a man's car.
人名换成泛称 a man
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项把后文出现的 UK charity Cats Protection 里的 charity 一词搬来，编成『慈善机构门
口』这个地点。可录音里 charity 只用来说明谁救的猫，从没说猫是在慈善机构门口被发现
的，属听到 charity 就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：Following a rescue by UK charity Cats Protection
B) 张冠李戴
选项把末段的 Mr King's neighbour（邻居）搬来，说猫是在『邻居的车里』被发现。但邻
居在录音里是猫的主人、出现在结局处，发现猫的车是金先生自己的车，把发现地点安到邻
居车上是张冠李戴。
借用原文：reunited with its owner, Mr King's neighbour
D) 原词陷阱
选项抓住原文的 school in Kent，把『学校门口』说成发现地点。可录音里 school 是金先
生送孙子去的地方、是事情发生前的背景，猫是他送完孙子、回来做机油检查时才在引擎盖
下被发现的，发现地不是学校门口。
借用原文：after dropping his grandson off at school in Kent

questions.stem: What do we learn about the cat at the end of the news report?

options.label: A
options.text: It got reunited with its owner.

options.label: B
options.text: It was injured during the rescue.

options.label: C
options.text: It became a pet of Mr King's grandson.

options.label: D
options.text: It was placed in the care of a UK charity.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） It got reunited with its owner.
【定位】Following a rescue by UK charity Cats Protection, the four-year-old cat was later reunited
with its owner, Mr King's neighbour.
在英国慈善机构『猫咪保护』救援之后，这只四岁的猫最终与它的主人——金先生的邻居
——团聚了。
【信号】末段＋later标结局。本句是录音最末一段、且含时间词 later，正对应题干的 at the end；
新闻的结果通常落在最后一句，later reunited 直接交代了猫的最终下场，是答案句。
【替换】reunited with its owner ↔ It got reunited with its owner.
近乎原句的同义重述
【排除】B) 未提及
选项说猫『在救援中受伤』，但录音从头到尾只字未提受伤，末段只说被救后团聚。它利用
第3段 terrified（受惊）、stuck（卡住）等词让人联想到猫很惨，进而脑补成『受伤』，实
属过度推断、原文未提。
C) 张冠李戴
选项把第1段的 grandson（孙子）搬来，说猫成了金先生孙子的宠物。可孙子只在『送孙
子上学』的背景里出现，录音末段明说猫团聚的对象是主人即邻居，不是被孙子养，属张冠
李戴。
借用原文：after dropping his grandson off at school in Kent
D) 原词陷阱
选项说猫『被交由英国一家慈善机构照管』，盗用了末段 UK charity Cats Protection 这个
真出现的机构。但录音里 charity 是负责『救援』的一方，救完之后猫是团聚而非留在机构
照管，把过程中的救援者说成最终归宿，差在结局。
借用原文：Following a rescue by UK charity Cats Protection
Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.
1 In less than a month, the Special Olympics Spring Games will make a return to Fayetteville.
The Games are coming back for the first time in five years. The event will take place at
Methodist University.
不到一个月后,特殊奥林匹克春季运动会将重返Fayetteville。这是该运动会五年来首次回归。活动将在
Methodist University举行。
2 Event organizer Benjamin Kowalczyk says he's excited that athletes will get a chance to come back
and demonstrate their abilities. Organizers expect about 100 athletes will come out to compete in
Fayetteville. They will have a variety of events to choose from, including running, throwing, and
jumping. There will also be a fun tent for children. Kowalczyk said it's rewarding to see athletes with
special needs triumph in the Games.
活动组织者Benjamin Kowalczyk表示,他很高兴运动员们将有机会回来展示他们的能力。组织者预计约有
100名运动员将来到Fayetteville参加比赛。他们将有多种项目可供选择,包括跑步、投掷和跳跃。现场还
将设有儿童趣味帐篷。Kowalczyk说,看到有特殊需求的运动员在运动会上取得胜利是很有意义的。
3 For anyone who wants to help make this year's Games a massive success, there are still opportunities
to volunteer for Fayetteville's Special Olympics. Organizers encourage them to visit the Games' website
to sign up.
对于任何想要帮助今年运动会取得巨大成功的人,仍有机会为Fayetteville特殊奥林匹克运动会做志愿者。
组织者鼓励他们访问运动会网站进行报名。

questions.stem: What will Fayetteville witness in less than a month?

options.label: A
options.text: The 100th anniversary celebration of Methodist University.

options.label: B
options.text: The first important political event in the next five years.

options.label: C
options.text: The opening of the Special Olympics Spring Games.

options.label: D
options.text: The reunion of this year's Olympic gold medalists.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） The opening of the Special Olympics Spring Games.
【定位】In less than a month, the Special Olympics Spring Games will make a return to Fayetteville.
不到一个月后，特殊奥林匹克运动会春季赛事将重返费耶特维尔。
【信号】题干时间词原样出现。录音开头 In less than a month 与题干 in less than a month 用词
完全一致，这种"题干时间状语在原文原样响起"就是最强的定位信号，听到它，紧跟其后的
主语就是答案所在。
【替换】the Special Olympics Spring Games will make a return ↔
The opening of the Special Olympics Spring Games.
重返即开赛
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音确实念到了 Methodist University（卫理公会大学），A 就把这个原词捡来编出 The
100th anniversary celebration of Methodist University."百年校庆"，但原文只说赛事在
该校举办，从没提任何校庆或"100th"，是典型听到地名就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：The event will take place at Methodist University.
B) 原词陷阱
录音说赛事是 coming back for the first time in five years（五年来首次回归），B 把
"five years" 这个原词改头换面成 The first important political event in the next five
years.，既把"赛事"偷换成"政治大事"，又把"过去五年"扭成"未来五年"，是盗用数字+偷换
概念的双重陷阱。
借用原文：The Games are coming back for the first time in five years.
D) 偷换概念
选项 The reunion of this year's Olympic gold medalists. 借了原文反复出现的
"Olympics" 来误导：原文是 Special Olympics（特殊奥林匹克/残障人士运动会），D 偷
偷掐掉 "Special" 变成普通"Olympic gold medalists 金牌选手聚会"，原文从未提金牌选手
聚会，属偷换概念。
借用原文：the Special Olympics Spring Games will make a return to Fayetteville

questions.stem: What did Benjamin Kowalczyk say is rewarding to see?

options.label: A
options.text: Volunteers visit the Games' website to sign up.

options.label: B
options.text: Athletes with special needs triumph in the Games.

options.label: C
options.text: Organizers devote their time and energy to the Games.

options.label: D
options.text: Children play in a fun tent and enjoy themselves fully.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Athletes with special needs triumph in the Games.
【定位】Kowalczyk said it's rewarding to see athletes with special needs triumph in the Games.
Kowalczyk 说，看到有特殊需求的运动员在赛事中取得胜利，是很有意义、很值得的。
【信号】题干rewarding原话再现。录音 Kowalczyk said it's rewarding to see 把题干里的人名和
评价词 "rewarding" 原样念出，这是"人物+评价词"双重信号，听到它就知道接下来 "to
see" 后面那件事正是答案承载句。
【替换】athletes with special needs triumph in the Games ↔
Athletes with special needs triumph in the Games.
评价词后内容直接对应
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音第三段确有 visit the Games' website to sign up，A 把这句原词整段搬来，但那是
给"想当志愿者的人"的报名指引，不是 Kowalczyk "觉得值得一看"的事，盗用原词却答非所
问。
借用原文：Organizers encourage them to visit the Games' website to sign up.
C) 张冠李戴
选项 Organizers devote their time and energy to the Games. 看似贴合主题，但原文
Kowalczyk 评"值得"的是运动员取胜，并没说"组织者投入时间精力"这件事值得看；原文只
说想帮忙的人可去志愿，把评价对象悄悄换成了组织者，属张冠李戴+未提及。
借用原文：it's rewarding to see athletes with special needs triumph in the Games
D) 原词陷阱
录音第二段确实念了 There will also be a fun tent for children.，D 把 "fun
tent/children" 这组原词捡来，但那只是顺带交代赛事设施，Kowalczyk 的 "rewarding"
评价根本没落在孩子玩耍上，是听到原词就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：There will also be a fun tent for children.

questions.stem: What has the German supermarket been ordered to do?

options.label: A
options.text: Destroy its imitation chocolate rabbits.

options.label: B
options.text: Change the wrapping of its commodities.

options.label: C
options.text: Compensate for the Swiss manufacturer's loss.

options.label: D
options.text: Defend itself in the country's commercial court.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Destroy its imitation chocolate rabbits.
【定位】A German supermarket has been ordered to destroy its chocolate rabbits after it lost a court
battle with a Swiss chocolate manufacturer.
一家德国超市在与一家瑞士巧克力制造商的官司中败诉后，被勒令销毁其巧克力兔子。
【信号】命令信号 ordered to。答案句的信号是 has been ordered to destroy，ordered to 正是
题干 been ordered to 的呼应，这种表命令、判决的短语就是答案落点，听到立刻锁定其
后的动作。
【替换】destroy its chocolate rabbits ↔ Destroy its imitation chocolate rabbits.
近乎同表述加补词
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
选项 Change the wrapping of its commodities. 借用了原文后文反复提到的 wrapper
（包装），但原文从没要求超市改包装，命令是销毁，属听到 wrapping 就想选的原词陷
阱。
借用原文：The colour of the wrapper is similar
C) 原词陷阱
选项 Compensate for the Swiss manufacturer's loss. 拼用了原文的 Swiss manufacturer
和 lost（败诉），但原文判的是销毁，从未提赔偿损失，是把熟词重组出的假动作。
借用原文：it lost a court battle with a Swiss chocolate manufacturer
D) 原词陷阱
选项 Defend itself in the country's commercial court. 借了原文的 commercial court，
但那是去年商业法院的旧判决场景，本题命令是销毁兔子，并非要超市去出庭辩护。
借用原文：overturned a ruling last year by the country's commercial court

questions.stem: What did Switzerland's highest court suggest about the chocolate in question?

options.label: A
options.text: It could be rewrapped and sold by the budget supermarket.

options.label: B
options.text: It could be reshaped into animals other than rabbits.

options.label: C
options.text: It could be resold cheaper to avoid waste.

options.label: D
options.text: It could be reused in other products.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） It could be reused in other products.
【定位】It ordered that all the imitation rabbits be destroyed, but suggested the chocolate needn't be
wasted. It could be melted for use in other products.
法院下令销毁所有仿制兔子，但建议巧克力不必浪费，可以熔化后用于其他产品。
【信号】转折 but 后是真意。答案句信号是转折词 but suggested the chocolate needn't be
wasted，but 前讲销毁、but 后才是对巧克力的建议，转折之后才是落点，这正呼应题干
的 suggest。
【替换】melted for use in other products ↔ It could be reused in other products.
熔化再用即重复使用
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 rewrapped and sold by the budget supermarket 搬来原文的 budget
supermarket，但原文建议是熔化再用，从没说重新包装由该超市出售，是熟词拼出的假处
置。
借用原文：a similar product sold by the budget supermarket
B) 原词陷阱
选项 reshaped into animals other than rabbits 借了原文 rabbits 一词臆造出改造成别的
动物，原文只说熔化用于其他产品，并未提改塑成动物。
借用原文：all the imitation rabbits be destroyed
C) 原词陷阱
选项 resold cheaper to avoid waste 借了原文 needn't be wasted 中的 waste 概念，但
原文是熔化再用以避免浪费，不是降价转售，处置动作被偷换。
借用原文：the chocolate needn't be wasted

questions.stem: Why did Switzerland's highest court overturn the commercial court's ruling?

options.label: A
options.text: To be fair to the German supermarkets.

options.label: B
options.text: To protect chocolate retailers' interests.

options.label: C
options.text: To boost the growth of the chocolate industry.

options.label: D
options.text: To prevent consumers' possible confusion.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） To prevent consumers' possible confusion.
【定位】It said even though there are some differences between the two products, there was still the
possibility of confusion for consumers.
法院表示，尽管两种产品之间存在一些差异，但仍有可能让消费者产生混淆。
【信号】让步转折露真因。答案句信号是让步结构 even though there are some
differences...there was still the possibility of confusion，even though 让一步、
but/still 后才是真正理由——担心消费者混淆，这就是推翻判决的原因。
【替换】the possibility of confusion for consumers ↔ To prevent consumers' possible confusion.
存在混淆即为防混淆
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 To be fair to the German supermarkets. 借了原文反复出现的 German
supermarket，但原文推翻原判恰恰对超市不利，目的是防混淆而非对超市公平，方向相
反。
借用原文：A German supermarket has been ordered to destroy
B) 偷换概念
选项 To protect chocolate retailers' interests. 把原文的 consumers（消费者）偷换成
retailers（零售商），原文明说担心的是消费者混淆，保护对象被换了一方。
借用原文：the possibility of confusion for consumers
C) 未提及
选项 To boost the growth of the chocolate industry. 借了反复出现的 chocolate，但原
文从未提推动巧克力行业发展这一目的，是凭熟词臆造的目的。

questions.stem: What does the man request the woman to do?

options.label: A
options.text: Return the handbook to him.

options.label: B
options.text: Make a vegetable dish.

options.label: C
options.text: Pass a book to him.

options.label: D
options.text: Meet his sister's boyfriend.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Pass a book to him.
【定位】Can you please hand me that book over there?
你能把那边那本书递给我吗？
【信号】请求句 Can you please...。答案句的信号是请求口吻 Can you please hand me that
book over there?，Can you please 一出，后面跟的动作 hand me that book 就是男的
请女的做的事，这正是"做什么"题要锁定的落点。
【替换】hand me that book ↔ Pass a book to him.
hand 与 pass 同义换词
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
A 的 Return the handbook to him. 用 handbook 蹭录音里的 hand me that book 的发
音（hand...book），听着像，但录音说的是 hand（递）+ book（书），不是 handbook
（手册），更没有 return（还）的意思。
借用原文：hand me that book
B) 答非所问
B 的 Make a vegetable dish. 用了录音 making a winter bean salad 里的做素菜原词，但
做菜是男的自己"I need to make"，不是请女的做，答非所问。
借用原文：I need to make a lot of vegetable dishes
D) 原词陷阱
D 的 Meet his sister's boyfriend. 取自录音 My sister's boyfriend is coming over for
dinner 的原词，但那只是交代背景（男友要来吃饭），并非男的请女的去见他。
借用原文：My sister's boyfriend is coming over for dinner

questions.stem: What does the woman say about eating vegetables only?

options.label: A
options.text: It doesn't seem to be a balanced diet.

options.label: B
options.text: It would reduce one's protein intake.

options.label: C
options.text: It would do harm to one's muscles.

options.label: D
options.text: It doesn't sound practical for her.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （态度观点题） It doesn't seem to be a balanced diet.
【定位】He only eats vegetables, no meat? That doesn't sound like a very balanced diet.
他只吃菜、不吃肉？那听起来不像是很均衡的饮食啊。
【信号】评价句 That doesn't sound like...。答案信号是女的抛出的总评价 That doesn't sound
like a very balanced diet，doesn't sound like 是直接表态，这是她对"只吃素"的核心判
断，后面 protein、muscles 都是她为这个判断补的理由。
【替换】That doesn't sound like a very balanced diet ↔ It doesn't seem to be a balanced diet.
sound like 换 seem to be
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
B 的 It would reduce one's protein intake. 蹭了录音 How can he get enough protein?
的 protein 原词，但女的只是反问"怎么获取足够蛋白质"来支撑她的判断，并没下"会减少蛋
白质摄入"的结论。
借用原文：How can he get enough protein?
C) 原词陷阱
C 的 It would do harm to one's muscles. 借用录音 strengthen his muscles 的 muscles
原词，但女的是问"他怎么练肌肉"，并没说"会伤肌肉"，属于无中生有地拔高。
借用原文：strengthen his muscles
D) 偷换概念
D 的 It doesn't sound practical for her. 套用了录音 sound 的口吻，但女的评价的是"这
饮食不均衡"，从没说"对她本人不实际"，把评判对象悄悄换成了"对她"。
借用原文：That doesn't sound like a very balanced diet

questions.stem: Why does the boyfriend of the man's sister choose to be a vegetarian?

options.label: A
options.text: To improve his health.

options.label: B
options.text: To protect animal rights.

options.label: C
options.text: To follow a trendy lifestyle.

options.label: D
options.text: To stick to his religious belief.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） To protect animal rights.
【定位】He's an animal activist. He's always been very sensitive and sympathizes with animals.
他是个动物保护活动者。他一向很敏感，对动物充满同情。
【信号】亮明身份句 He's an animal activist。答案信号是男的直接亮出男友的身份与立场 He's an
animal activist，紧接 sympathizes with animals。原因题里这种"He's a + 身份/立场"的
句子，往往就是动机所在——他吃素是因为他是动物保护者。
【替换】He's an animal activist ↔ To protect animal rights.
身份具体说法换成概括目的
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
A 的 To improve his health. 蹭了录音 health condition 的 health 原词，但那是女的列举
可能原因时随口提的选项之一，录音随后明确否掉、给出的真实原因是动物保护，不是健
康。
借用原文：Is it his religion, health condition, or lifestyle?
C) 原词陷阱
C 的 To follow a trendy lifestyle. 借用录音 lifestyle 原词，但这同样只是女的列举的待选
项之一，男的回答里根本没提"赶潮流"，是答非所问。
借用原文：Is it his religion, health condition, or lifestyle?
D) 原词陷阱
D 的 To stick to his religious belief. 用了录音 religion 原词，且"宗教吃素"最符合日常常
识，最易被默认选中；但录音明说原因是动物保护，宗教只是女的列举的可能性之一，并非
答案。
借用原文：Is it his religion, health condition, or lifestyle?

questions.stem: On what point does the man agree with the woman at the end of the conversation?

options.label: A
options.text: The torture and distress dolphins suffer in parks.

options.label: B
options.text: The necessity of having zoos and eating meat.

options.label: C
options.text: The gloomy environments animals are kept in.

options.label: D
options.text: The urgency of joining an animal rights group.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） The necessity of having zoos and eating meat.
【定位】W: Not all zoos and animal parks have the most favorable conditions, but without them it just
wouldn't be feasible to learn about animals and their environments. Besides, I don't think I
could ever give up a good hot dog at a baseball game. M: Honestly, I agree.
女：并不是所有动物园和动物公园条件都最理想，但要是没有它们，就没法了解动物和它们
的生存环境了。再说，我可舍不得放弃看棒球赛时来一根热狗。男：说实话，我同意。
【信号】赞同信号 Honestly, I agree。答案信号是男的结尾的明确赞同 Honestly, I agree，它指向
的是女的紧挨着说的两点——动物园有存在的必要 without them it just wouldn't be
feasible to learn about animals 和不愿放弃吃热狗（肉）I could ever give up a good
hot dog。赞同句认同的就是这两点合起来的立场。
【替换】without them it just wouldn't be feasible to learn about animals ↔
The necessity of having zoos and eating meat.
没了就不行 = 有必要
I don't think I could ever give up a good hot dog ↔ eating meat
舍不得放弃热狗 = 要吃肉
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
A 的 The torture and distress dolphins suffer in parks. 几乎照搬录音 the torture of
dolphins in sea parks 与 causes them great distress 的原词，但那是男友（动物活动
家）的立场，不是男女二人结尾达成的共识，张冠李戴。
借用原文：the torture of dolphins in sea parks
C) 原词陷阱
C 的 The gloomy environments animals are kept in. 蹭录音 That's a little gloomy 的
gloomy 原词，但 gloomy 是女的形容男友说法"有点令人沮丧"，并非两人一致认同"动物
处境阴郁"，答非所问。
借用原文：That's a little gloomy
D) 原词陷阱
D 的 The urgency of joining an animal rights group. 借用录音 his local animal rights
group 的 animal rights group 原词，但录音只是说男友是该组织发言人，根本没提"加入
组织的紧迫性"，属凭空编造。
借用原文：He's the spokesperson for his local animal rights group

questions.stem: What part of the TV program does the man say was interesting?

options.label: A
options.text: The part about getting over jetlag.

options.label: B
options.text: The part about air travel in the past.

options.label: C
options.text: The part about not eating on board the plane.

options.label: D
options.text: The part about avoiding sleeping on the plane.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） The part about getting over jetlag.
【定位】The part about overcoming jetlag was interesting.
关于克服时差的那一部分很有趣。
【信号】被问者男士的直接应答 + 评价词 interesting。本题问的是男士，男士开口的 The part
about overcoming jetlag was interesting. 就是被问者的直接应答，句中 interesting 与
题干 interesting 完全对应，是把这句锁成答案句的信号。
【替换】overcoming jetlag ↔ getting over jetlag
同义短语替换 overcome=get over
【排除】B) 未提及
The part about air travel in the past 里 air travel 是整段对话的大话题词，听着耳熟，但
男士说有趣的是克服时差那部分，"过去的航空旅行"录音并未作为有趣的一部分提到，属拿
大话题词凑出的诱选。
C) 原词陷阱
not eating on board the plane 盗用了录音 not eating for the entire journey 这个原词
内容，但那是男士转述"专家推荐"的建议、且他说的是"surprised（吃惊）"，并非回答"哪
部分有趣"。听到 not eating 就选即落陷阱。
借用原文：the expert recommended not eating for the entire journey
D) 原词陷阱
avoiding sleeping on the plane 盗用录音 avoiding sleeping on the plane 的原词，但
这与 C 一样属男士转述的专家建议、令他吃惊的内容，并不是他点名"有趣"的那部分（有趣
的是克服时差整块），属原词陷阱。
借用原文：avoiding sleeping on the plane

questions.stem: What does the man say he will do next time he flies a long distance?

options.label: A
options.text: Take a nap to adjust to a new time zone.

options.label: B
options.text: Have meals as usual to stay away from hunger.

options.label: C
options.text: Concentrate on reading articles recommended by experts.

options.label: D
options.text: Try following the advice given by the expert on the show.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Try following the advice given by the expert on the show.
【定位】the expert on the show did cite research supporting her recommendations, so I guess I'll give
it a try next time I fly a long distance.
节目里的那位专家确实引用了支持她建议的研究，所以我想下次长途飞行时我会试试看。
【信号】表打算的信号 I'll give it a try + 时间短语 next time。I guess I'll give it a try next time
I fly a long distance 里的 I'll give it a try 是典型"打算"信号，又带 next time I fly a long
distance 与题干时间完全吻合，是锁定答案句的双重信号。
【替换】give it a try ↔ Try following the advice
give it a try=try following，照建议试一试
the expert on the show did cite research supporting her recommendations ↔
the advice given by the expert on the show
her recommendations=the advice，同为专家建议
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
Take a nap to adjust to a new time zone 盗用了女士那句 taking a nap on the plane
was the best way to adjust to a new time zone 的原词，但那是女士转述"过去文章"的主
张，且专家恰恰建议"不要睡"，并非男士下次要做的事，属张冠李戴。
借用原文：taking a nap on the plane was the best way to adjust to a new time zone
B) 张冠李戴
Have meals as usual to stay away from hunger 对应女士读到的旧观点 it was
important not to miss meals，而男士打算照的是"专家建议"，专家主张是 not eating
——男士要做的恰与 B 相反，属张冠李戴兼与原文相反。
借用原文：it was important not to miss meals
C) 偷换概念
Concentrate on reading articles recommended by experts 把录音里的 expert 与 W 提
到的 an article on the subject 拼在一起，造出"读专家推荐的文章"，但男士说的是 give it
a try（照建议试做），并非去读文章，属偷换概念。
借用原文：I read an article on the subject in the past

questions.stem: Why does the woman think she is lucky?

options.label: A
options.text: She does not have any problem flying.

options.label: B
options.text: She can spend a lot of time vacationing.

options.label: C
options.text: She does not have to worry about jetlag.

options.label: D
options.text: She has been well treated when traveling.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） She does not have to worry about jetlag.
【定位】she did say that jetlag often becomes more of a problem after 40, so I guess I'm lucky that I
can still adjust to different time zones well.
她确实说过时差在 40 岁以后往往会变成更大的问题，所以我想我算幸运，因为我还能很好
地适应不同的时区。
【信号】标志词 I'm lucky + that 引出理由。I'm lucky that I can still adjust to different time
zones well 里 I'm lucky 直接对应题干 lucky，紧跟的 that 从句给出理由——这个"幸运 +
that 理由"结构就是答案句信号。
【替换】I can still adjust to different time zones well ↔ She does not have to worry about jetlag
能适应时区=不必担心时差，肯否定转换
【排除】A) 与原文相反
She does not have any problem flying 与原文相反：女士紧接着说 My problem is I'm
afraid to fly，明说自己有怕飞的问题，所以"飞行无问题"是反着说的，且她的幸运也不是指
这点。
借用原文：My problem is I'm afraid to fly
B) 未提及
She can spend a lot of time vacationing 里 vacation 蹭了后文男士提到的 our family
vacations，但那是男士讲自家度假方式，女士的幸运与"能度很多假"毫无关系，属未提及。
借用原文：our family vacations were always by car or train
D) 未提及
She has been well treated when traveling"旅行中受优待"在整段录音里没有任何对应内
容，与女士的幸运（能适应时区）也不搭，属凭空捏造。

questions.stem: Why does the woman think the problem of being afraid to fly deserves attention?

options.label: A
options.text: It has caused heavy losses to many airlines.

options.label: B
options.text: It impacts female travelers more seriously.

options.label: C
options.text: It has long been ignored by many experts.

options.label: D
options.text: It affects twenty-five percent of people.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） It affects twenty-five percent of people.
【定位】Actually, it was a quarter of people, so the problem really is widespread and
deserves attention.
其实是四分之一的人，所以这个问题确实很普遍，值得关注。
【信号】纠正信号 Actually + 数字 a quarter，且与题干 deserves attention 同词。女士用
Actually, it was a quarter of people 纠正男士先前说的数字，so the problem really is
widespread and deserves attention 里 deserves attention 与题干同词——Actually 的
纠正语气与同词回扣是双重信号。
【替换】a quarter of people ↔ twenty-five percent of people
a quarter=25%，分数与百分比换算
【排除】A) 未提及
It has caused heavy losses to many airlines 蹭了全篇的 air travel/航空话题，但"给航空
公司造成巨额亏损"录音从未提及，女士给的理由是比例之高，不是公司亏损，属未提及。
B) 未提及
It impacts female travelers more seriously 凭空加了"female travelers、more
seriously"的范围与程度，录音只说影响四分之一的人、并未区分性别，属无中生有地偷加
范围程度。
C) 与原文相反
It has long been ignored by many experts 借了对话反复出现的 expert 设原词诱惑，但
录音说的是这问题 deserves attention（值得关注），并未说"长期被专家忽视"，方向相
反，属与原文相反兼借词诱选。
借用原文：deserves attention

questions.stem: What does the speaker think is the best way to get started in user experience design?

options.label: A
options.text: Learning from skilled designers.

options.label: B
options.text: Obtaining real-world experience.

options.label: C
options.text: Joining a 6-month training camp.

options.label: D
options.text: Anticipating actual challenges.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Obtaining real-world experience.
【定位】The most common question I'm asked always centers around how to get started in user
experience design, to which my response is always that nothing can substitute real-
world experience.
别人最常问我的问题总是围绕怎么入门用户体验设计，对此我的回答始终是：没有什么能替
代真实世界的经验。
【信号】nothing can substitute抬高某项。答案信号是这句里的 nothing can substitute real-
world experience（没有什么能替代真实世界的经验）——nothing can substitute 是把
某一项捧到唯一、最高位置的强调说法，凡听到这种把别的全比下去的句式，那句就是答
案句。
【替换】nothing can substitute real-world experience ↔ Obtaining real-world experience.
唯一不可替代等于最佳
【排除】A) 未提及
Learning from skilled designers. 听起来很合理，但录音通篇没说过要向熟练的设计师
学，它是凭常识脑补的入门方式，原文无对应。
C) 原词陷阱
Joining a 6-month training camp. 盗用了录音第三段的原词 6-month training camp，
但原文是把训练营当成学不到适应力的反面例子来说的，并非入门的最佳方式，属于听到原
词就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：much less in a 6-month training camp
D) 原词陷阱
Anticipating actual challenges. 借用了第二段原词 actual challenges，但原文说的是高等
教育无法让你为真实挑战做好准备，并没说入门的最佳方式是去预判挑战，选项把原词搬过
来又改了意思。
借用原文：it will not prepare you for actual challenges you'll face

questions.stem: What does the speaker say being effective requires?

options.label: A
options.text: Core skills.

options.label: B
options.text: Higher education.

options.label: C
options.text: Adaptability.

options.label: D
options.text: Capability.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Adaptability.
【定位】Being effective requires adaptability — something you don't really learn in school, much less
in a 6-month training camp.
要做到有效就需要适应力——这是你在学校里学不太到的东西，在六个月的训练营里就更别
提了。
【信号】requires直接点出条件。答案信号就是题干原话在录音里几乎复现：Being effective
requires adaptability，requires 后面紧跟的 adaptability 就是被点名的条件。这种题干和
原文几乎同形、只差答案词的句子，是最直接的答案句信号。
【替换】Being effective requires adaptability ↔ Adaptability.
原词同形直接对应
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
Core skills. 盗用了第二段原词 core skills，但原文说的是高等教育能帮你装备一些核心技
能、随后却话锋一转说它不够，core skills 并不是 being effective 所需要的那样东西，属
听到原词就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：Higher education is a great way to equip yourself with some core skills
B) 原词陷阱
Higher education. 盗用第二段原词 Higher education，但原文说高等教育不能让你应对
真实挑战、是被往下压的一项，根本不是 being effective 所需，听到这个原词就选会掉
坑。
借用原文：but it will not prepare you for actual challenges
D) 未提及
Capability. 和正确项 Adaptability. 一样以 -ability 结尾、长得像，是专为只听个相似尾音
的考生设的形近干扰，但录音从没说 being effective 需要 capability。

questions.stem: What can people do as long as they know their end goal and strive for it?

options.label: A
options.text: Start anywhere.

options.label: B
options.text: Face challenges.

options.label: C
options.text: Pursue roles in teams.

options.label: D
options.text: Follow their own path.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Start anywhere.
【定位】You can start anywhere as long as you know your end goal and you commit to actively
pursuing opportunities to learn and grow along the way.
只要你清楚自己的终极目标，并且愿意一路上主动去追寻学习和成长的机会，你可以从任何
地方起步。
【信号】as long as条件句的主句。答案信号是这句的结构 You can start anywhere as long as
you know your end goal——as long as 是题干照搬的条件信号词，它前面的主句 You
can start anywhere 就是回答能做什么的部分，条件句的主句才是答案落点。
【替换】You can start anywhere ↔ Start anywhere.
主句原话浓缩为动词短语
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
Face challenges. 里的 challenges 来自前文（如第二段说的 actual challenges、第四段说
团队能 challenge me），但 as long as 那句答案句里说的是 start anywhere，不是面对
挑战，选项搬了别处的原词来凑。
借用原文：roles within teams that I knew could teach and challenge me
C) 张冠李戴
Pursue roles in teams. 盗用第四段原词 pursue roles within teams，但那是作者讲自己当
年的经历（他自己去团队里求角色），不是回答只要知道目标就能做什么，属张冠李戴式的
原词陷阱。
借用原文：to continue to pursue roles within teams that I knew could teach and challenge me
D) 与原文相反
Follow their own path. 借用第四段 my path 的说法，但原文是作者说我不认为自己这条
路是唯一的，恰恰是不主张人人照走他的路，选项却说去走自己的路，与原文倾向相反。
借用原文：That's not to say that I think my path is the only one.

questions.stem: Why did the school principal ask what needed to change?

options.label: A
options.text: To respond actively to students' requests.

options.label: B
options.text: To engage students more in their learning.

options.label: C
options.text: To enable teachers to interact more with their students.

options.label: D
options.text: To allow students more freedom in their academic work.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （目的题） To engage students more in their learning.
【定位】When planning for this year, our principal asked what needed to change to engage students
more in their learning.
在筹划今年的工作时，我们校长问需要改变什么，好让学生更投入到自己的学习中。
【信号】目的状语 to engage… 直接给出动机。句中 to engage students more in their learning
是"为了…"的目的状语，紧跟在校长发问之后，正是他发问的目的所在，是这句成为答案句
的信号。
【替换】to engage students more in their learning ↔ To engage students more in their learning.
几乎原句搬到选项
【排除】A) 未提及
选项说"主动回应学生的请求"，但录音里是校长主动发问、要让学生更投入，没有"回应学生
请求"一说，方向不符。
C) 原词陷阱
选项把焦点说成"让老师与学生更多互动"，盗用了录音反复出现的 teachers、students，但
校长的目的是让"学生"更投入学习，不是促进师生互动，偷换了主体与重点。
借用原文：to engage students more in their learning
D) 过度推断
选项说"给学生更多学业自由"，录音目的句只讲 engage（投入），从未提 freedom（自
由），是把投入度过度引申成自由度。

questions.stem: What has flexible seating meant at the speaker's school?

options.label: A
options.text: Using new furniture to create a comfortable environment.

options.label: B
options.text: Shifting from traditional teaching to task-based learning.

options.label: C
options.text: Adopting a variety of different seating options.

options.label: D
options.text: Rearranging most traditional chairs and desks.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Adopting a variety of different seating options.
【定位】For us, flexible seating has meant removing most of the traditional chairs and desks and
introducing a variety of different seating options to promote student engagement.
对我们来说，灵活座位意味着撤掉大部分传统桌椅，引入多种不同的座位选择，以促进学生
投入。
【信号】下定义信号 has meant。句中 flexible seating has meant 是"在本校它意味着什么"的下
定义信号，与题干 has meant 完全对应，定义内容紧随其后，是答案句的标志。
【替换】introducing a variety of different seating options ↔
Adopting a variety of different seating options.
introducing 与 Adopting 同义替换
【排除】A) 未提及
选项说"用新家具营造舒适环境"，录音定义句讲的是 promote student engagement（促
进投入），从未提 comfortable（舒适），属凭空添加。
B) 偷换概念
选项说"从传统教学转向任务式学习"，录音只说从 teacher-focused 转向 student-
focused，并未出现 task-based learning（任务式学习）这一说法，偷换了概念。
借用原文：a shift in practice from being teacher-focused to student-focused learning
D) 原词陷阱
选项"重排大部分传统桌椅"盗用了录音的 traditional chairs and desks，但录音是
removing（撤掉）这些桌椅再引入多样座位，不是 Rearranging（重排），只截了动作的
一半且改了动词。
借用原文：removing most of the traditional chairs and desks

questions.stem: What has flexible seating brought about at the speaker's school?

options.label: A
options.text: A win for all people involved.

options.label: B
options.text: A strengthened effect of its discipline.

options.label: C
options.text: A harmonious relationship among its students.

options.label: D
options.text: A change to teachers' opinion of their students.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） A win for all people involved.
【定位】From our experience so far, flexible seating enhances student ownership of space and
engagement in learning, while reducing rates of student disengagement and disciplinary
actions. It is a win for all concerned.
从我们目前的经验看，灵活座位增强了学生对空间的归属感和学习投入，同时降低了学生的
脱离感和纪律处分的发生率。这对所有相关方都是一种共赢。
【信号】结尾总结句 It is a win for all concerned。末段 It is a win for all concerned 是带总结
语气的收束句，把前面列举的好处一句话归纳为"对所有人都是共赢"，是结果题最该锁的
落点。
【替换】It is a win for all concerned ↔ A win for all people involved.
all concerned 与 all people involved 同义
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
选项说"纪律效果增强"，盗用录音的 disciplinary，但录音是 reducing…disciplinary
actions（减少纪律处分），方向相反；且只取纪律一项，丢了"共赢"的全面性。
借用原文：reducing rates of student disengagement and disciplinary actions
C) 原词陷阱
选项说"学生之间关系融洽"，盗用了高频词 students，但录音讲的是学生对空间的归属感与
投入，从未提学生彼此之间的 harmonious relationship（融洽关系）。
借用原文：enhances student ownership of space and engagement in learning
D) 未提及
选项说"改变了老师对学生的看法"，录音末段只讲对学生投入、纪律的成效与"共赢"，并未
提到老师对学生看法的任何改变。

questions.stem: Why were dozens of British students sent home on Tuesday?

options.label: A
options.text: They weren't informed of the school's updated rules.

options.label: B
options.text: They arrived late for their first day of school.

options.label: C
options.text: They answered their headteacher's email in an impolite way.

options.label: D
options.text: They didn't wear the shoes required by the school's new policy.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） They didn't wear the shoes required by the school's new policy.
【定位】About 30 students were turned away from Taverham High School in Norfolk, England.
Headteacher, Dr Roger Harris, confirmed that this was due to a change in the school's
uniform policy.
大约 30 名学生被英格兰诺福克的 Taverham 高中拒之门外。校长 Roger Harris 博士确
认，这是由于学校校服政策的一项变动。
【信号】因果信号 due to。答案句里 this was due to a change in the school's uniform policy
的 "due to" 是明确的因果信号，它后面跟的"校服政策变动"就是被送回家的原因，正是
Why 题要抓的落点。
【替换】a change in the school's uniform policy ↔ the shoes required by the school's new policy
概括换具体加同义改写
【排除】A)
选项说学生"没被告知更新的规定"，但录音里校长明确说 he notified parents of the
updated rules in an email in June——是已经通知过的，选项把"通知过"反说成"没被告
知"，方向相反。
借用原文：he notified parents of the updated rules in an email in June
B)
录音只说这天是 their first day of school on Tuesday，提到了"开学第一天"，但从未说学
生"迟到"；选项盗用了"first day"的时间背景，把原因编成"迟到"，原文没有依据。
C) 原词陷阱
录音提到校长是用 in an email in June 通知家长的，选项盗用"email"这个原词，编出"以
不礼貌方式回复校长邮件"；原文只说校长发邮件通知，根本没说学生回邮件、更没说态度
不礼貌。
借用原文：he notified parents of the updated rules in an email in June

questions.stem: What can the price of school uniforms spark among families in financial difficulty?

options.label: A
options.text: Riots.

options.label: B
options.text: Anger.

options.label: C
options.text: Disputes.

options.label: D
options.text: Panic.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Panic.
【定位】The price of school uniforms can spark panic among families struggling with the high cost
of living.
校服的价格会在那些在高生活成本中苦苦挣扎的家庭里激起恐慌。
【信号】题干原词 spark 几乎原句重现。答案句 The price of school uniforms can spark panic
among families 与题干用词高度重合（price/spark/families），spark 紧跟的那个词
panic 就是被引发的反应，是定位信号。
【替换】spark panic among families ↔ Panic.
原词直接对应
【排除】A)
Riots（骚乱）程度最重、最抓耳，但录音里从未出现"骚乱"；它是把"恐慌"夸大成"骚乱"的
诱饵，原文无依据。
B)
Anger（愤怒）听上去和"家长有意见"很搭，但原文 spark 后面接的是 panic 不是 anger；
anger 是个貌似合理却没被念到的情绪词。
C)
Disputes（争执/纠纷）也是一种貌似合理的负面反应，但原文激起的是 panic，并未提
到"争执"，属没被念到的干扰项。

questions.stem: What did the headteacher think of the school's new uniform rules?

options.label: A
options.text: They strengthened the school's discipline and order.

options.label: B
options.text: They improved student behavior and performance.

options.label: C
options.text: They enhanced the positive image of the school.

options.label: D
options.text: They rendered the school unique in the district.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （态度观点题） They improved student behavior and performance.
【定位】Harris held that strengthened rules around school uniforms improved student outcomes
and behavior.
Harris 认为，更严格的校服规定改善了学生的成绩和行为。
【信号】观点引导词 held that。答案句 Harris held that strengthened rules around school
uniforms improved student outcomes and behavior 里的 "held that"（认为）是明确
的观点信号，引出的正是校长本人的看法，是态度题的落点。
【替换】improved student outcomes and behavior ↔ improved student behavior and performance
同义词替换
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音里有 strengthened rules around school uniforms，"strengthened" 这个词真的念
到了；选项 strengthened the school's discipline and order 盗用 strengthened，但把
它的对象换成"纪律和秩序"——原文是"更严格的规定改善了成绩和行为"，strengthened
修饰的是 rules 而非 discipline，张冠李戴。
借用原文：strengthened rules around school uniforms improved student outcomes and behavior
C)
"提升学校的正面形象"（positive image）听起来是个合理好处，但校长说的是改善"成绩和
行为"，从未提到"形象"，原文无依据。
D)
录音第 4 段出现过 Private rental prices in Britain 等带 district/地区背景的经济描述（原
文用 households/Britain），选项 rendered the school unique in the district 借"地
区"这类背景感造出"让学校在本区独一无二"，但校长的观点里根本没说学校"独特"，属编
造。

questions.stem: What did Lucinda May have to do to buy her child the correct pair of shoes?

options.label: A
options.text: Turn to her parents for help.

options.label: B
options.text: Tighten her monthly budget.

options.label: C
options.text: Borrow £65 from her friend.

options.label: D
options.text: Postpone paying her other bills.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Turn to her parents for help.
【定位】Lucinda May, mum of a Taverham student, said that she had to ask her parents for £65 to buy
her child the correct pair of shoes.
Taverham 一名学生的母亲 Lucinda May 说，她不得不向自己的父母要 65 英镑，来给孩子
买那双符合要求的鞋。
【信号】被问者的直接动作 had to ask。答案句 she had to ask her parents for £65 to buy her
child the correct pair of shoes 里的 "had to ask" 正是题干问的"不得不做的动作"，her
parents 点明动作对象，是定位信号。
【替换】ask her parents for £65 ↔ Turn to her parents for help
同义短语 + 概括化
【排除】B)
"缩紧月度预算"和第 4 段 many households are on tight budgets 的 "tight budgets" 背
景相呼应，但那是说大环境下家庭预算紧，并非 May 本人"缩预算"这个动作；她的实际做
法是向父母要钱。
借用原文：many households are on tight budgets
C) 偷换概念
金额 £65 是原文真念到的（ask her parents for £65），选项 Borrow £65 from her
friend. 保住了对的金额却把对象从"her parents"偷换成"her friend"，动作也
从"ask"变"borrow"，对象错了。
借用原文：she had to ask her parents for £65
D)
"推迟支付其他账单"和第 4 段 Soaring energy bills have made things worse. 里的 bills
沾边，但原文只说能源账单让情况更糟，从没说 May"推迟付账单"；这是借 bills 一词编出
的动作。
