questions.stem: Why are families across the U.S. looking to this winter with fear?

options.label: A
options.text: They will see a 27% higher price to buy natural gas.

options.label: B
options.text: They will have insufficient heating oil to keep warm.

options.label: C
options.text: They will have a costly bill to pay to heat their homes.

options.label: D
options.text: They will experience the coldest winter in four decades.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） They will have a costly bill to pay to heat their homes.
【定位】U.S. families are looking to the winter with fear as energy costs soar. The Energy Department
projects heating bills will jump 28% this winter for those who rely on natural gas.
随着能源成本飙升，美国家庭对这个冬天满怀恐惧。能源部预计，对那些依赖天然气的家庭
来说，今冬取暖账单将上涨 28%。
【信号】as 引出发愁的直接原因。原文 looking to the winter with fear as energy costs soar 中
的 as 直接把‘发愁’与‘能源成本飙升’扣在一起，as 后面就是答案信号——发愁的原因是费用
涨，后文 heating bills will jump 28% 进一步坐实是‘取暖账单暴涨’。
【替换】heating bills will jump 28% ↔ a costly bill to pay to heat their homes
‘账单涨28%’概括为‘贵账单’
energy costs soar ↔ costly
soar 对应 costly
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
原文确实念了 27%，但 Heating oil is projected to be 27% higher 说的是‘取暖用油’涨
27%；选项 a 27% higher price to buy natural gas 把 27% 安到了天然气头上（天然气其
实是涨 28%），数字盗用且对错对象。
借用原文：Heating oil is projected to be 27% higher
B) 过度推断
原文有 supplies have been reduced（供应减少）和大量 heating oil 字样，选项
insufficient heating oil to keep warm 借这些词造出‘油不够保暖’的说法，但原文讲的是
‘费用贵’，从未说会‘缺油到取不了暖’。
借用原文：supplies have been reduced
D) 原词陷阱
原文 four decades 出现在 consumer prices growing 6.6%. That's the fastest pace in
four decades，说的是‘物价涨速四十年最快’；选项 the coldest winter in four decades
却把 four decades 挪去形容‘四十年最冷的冬天’，原文根本没谈天气冷暖。
借用原文：That's the fastest pace in four decades

questions.stem: What did the federal government do last month?

options.label: A
options.text: Provided additional funding to Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program.

options.label: B
options.text: Assured U.S. citizens of an increase in energy supplies by the end of this year.

options.label: C
options.text: Predicted a 10% jump in heating bills for most U.S. households this winter.

options.label: D
options.text: Decided on this year's energy assistance package of $8 billion in total.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题）
Provided additional funding to Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program.
【定位】Last month, the federal government added $1 billion in funding to Low Income Home Energy
Assistance Program, bringing the total to $4.8 billion.
上个月，联邦政府向‘低收入家庭能源援助项目’追加了 10 亿美元资金，使总额达到 48 亿
美元。
【信号】Last month 与题干同词定位。原文 Last month, the federal government added \$1
billion in funding 开头的 Last month 与题干 last month 完全对上，紧跟的动词 added
就是答案信号——政府上月‘追加了拨款’。
【替换】added \$1 billion in funding to Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program ↔
Provided additional funding to Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program
added funding=provided additional funding
【排除】B) 与原文相反
原文出现过 supplies have been reduced（供应减少），选项 Assured U.S. citizens of
an increase in energy supplies 反过来说政府‘保证能源供应会增加’，方向相反，原文也无
任何‘保证’动作。
借用原文：supplies have been reduced
C) 原词陷阱
原文 10% 出自 electricity 10% higher（电费涨 10%），且作预测的是能源部不是政府这
一动作主体；选项 Predicted a 10% jump in heating bills 把电费的 10% 改成‘取暖账
单’、又把‘预测’这一动作安给了政府上月的作为，数字与主体双错。
借用原文：electricity 10% higher
D) 原词陷阱
原文 a reduction from last year's energy assistance package of over \$8 billion 明说
80 亿是‘去年’援助方案、且今年比它‘减少’了；选项 Decided on this year's energy
assistance package of \$8 billion in total 把去年的 80 亿说成‘今年合计敲定 80 亿’，年
份与金额张冠李戴。
借用原文：last year's energy assistance package of over \$8 billion
Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.
1 Many Americans think they make healthy food choices, but they may be viewing their diet too
optimistically. That's the main finding of a new study by researchers at the U.S. Department of
Agriculture in Stoneville, Mississippi.
许多美国人认为自己做出了健康的食物选择，但他们可能对自己的饮食过于乐观了。这是美国农业部位于
密西西比州Stoneville的研究人员一项新研究的主要发现。
2 The study aimed to identify disconnects between how healthily Americans think they eat and how they
actually do. For the study, the researchers asked participants to rate their diet as excellent, very good,
good, fair or poor. Folks also completed 24-hour food questionnaires. Then, the researchers compared
answers to see how well responses to the two exercises matched up.
该研究旨在找出美国人认为自己吃得有多健康与实际情况之间的差距。在研究中，研究人员要求参与者将
自己的饮食评为优秀、非常好、好、一般或差。参与者还完成了24小时食物问卷。然后，研究人员比较了
答案，看两项调查的回答匹配程度如何。
3 Of more than 9,700 people, roughly 85 percent were off base when asked to rate the quality of their
diet, and almost all overestimated how healthy it was. Those who rated their diet as poor tended to be
far more accurate. Their rating matched that of the researchers more than nine times out of ten.
在9700多人中，大约85%的人在被要求评价自己的饮食质量时偏离了实际情况，而且几乎所有人都高估
了饮食的健康程度。那些将自己的饮食评为差的人往往准确得多。他们的评价在十次中有九次以上与研究
人员的评价相符。

questions.stem: What is the main finding of a new study about many Americans?

options.label: A
options.text: They care less about their diet now than before.

options.label: B
options.text: They may lack adequate knowledge of healthy food.

options.label: C
options.text: They may hold too optimistic a view about their diet.

options.label: D
options.text: They pay insufficient attention to their choice of food.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （主旨题） They may hold too optimistic a view about their diet.
【定位】Many Americans think they make healthy food choices, but they may be viewing their diet
too optimistically. That's the main finding of a new study by researchers at the U.S.
Department of Agriculture in Stoneville, Mississippi.
很多美国人以为自己在做健康的食物选择，但他们对自己饮食的看法可能太乐观了。这正是
美国农业部研究人员一项新研究的主要发现。
【信号】转折but+点题句That's the main finding。答案藏在转折之后：but they may be
viewing their diet too optimistically 才是真意，紧接着一句 That's the main finding
of a new study 直接盖章这就是"主要发现"，双重信号（but转折 + 点题句）锁定它是答
案句。
【替换】viewing their diet too optimistically ↔ hold too optimistic a view about their diet
副词转形容词的同义改写
【排除】A) 未提及
care less about their diet now than before 说"现在比从前更不在乎饮食"，录音通篇没
有"今昔对比"，更没说他们"不在乎"——恰恰相反，他们"以为"自己吃得健康。属凭空捏造
的对比。
B) 偷换概念
lack adequate knowledge of healthy food 把问题归为"缺乏健康饮食知识"，但录音说的
是他们"看得太乐观"（认知偏差），不是"不懂"。盗用了 healthy food 这一原词，却把病
因悄悄换掉。
借用原文：Many Americans think they make healthy food choices
D) 原词陷阱
pay insufficient attention to their choice of food 说他们"对选食不够上心"，但录音里他
们其实很在意、还自认 make healthy food choices，问题是"高估"而非"不上心"。盗用
choices 一词来制造"听到 food choices 就想选"的诱惑。
借用原文：make healthy food choices

questions.stem: Who tended to rate their diet more accurately in the survey?

options.label: A
options.text: Those who finished 24-hour food questionnaires.

options.label: B
options.text: Those who fully understood the rating scale.

options.label: C
options.text: Those who cared about food quality.

options.label: D
options.text: Those who rated their diet as poor.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Those who rated their diet as poor.
【定位】Those who rated their diet as poor tended to be far more accurate. Their rating matched that
of the researchers more than nine times out of ten.
那些把自己饮食评为"差"的人，往往要准确得多。他们的评分有十之九以上与研究人员的评
定相符。
【信号】题干词more accurate原句复现做信号。题干问 more accurately，录音里 tended to be
far more accurate 几乎原样出现，这处与题干高度重合的句子就是答案句；紧跟的 more
than nine times out of ten 用数字坐实其"更准"。
【替换】Those who rated their diet as poor ↔ Those who rated their diet as poor
主语整句几乎原词搬运
tended to be far more accurate ↔ 4D
谓语印证人群身份
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
Those who finished 24-hour food questionnaires. 搬来录音 completed 24-hour food
questionnaires，但那只是"所有参与者都做的一个环节"，录音从没说"填了这问卷的人评得
更准"。专骗听到 24-hour 这个醒目数字就选的人。
借用原文：Folks also completed 24-hour food questionnaires
B) 未提及
Those who fully understood the rating scale. 说"完全看懂评分表的人"，录音只让参与
者用 excellent, very good, good, fair or poor 评级，从没区分"谁更懂评分表"，更没说这
类人更准。属凭空添加。
C) 偷换概念
Those who cared about food quality. 盗用录音 rate the quality of their diet 里的
quality 一词，编出"在乎食物质量的人"，但录音问的是评级准不准，与"在不在乎质量"无
关，是借原词造的假分类。
借用原文：rate the quality of their diet

questions.stem: What does the report say dozens of Indians did last week?

options.label: A
options.text: They experienced a heartbreaking moment.

options.label: B
options.text: They gathered together to rescue an elephant.

options.label: C
options.text: They heard a noise from the bottom of a well.

options.label: D
options.text: They found an elephant wandering around a well.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） They gathered together to rescue an elephant.
【定位】It was a heartwarming moment that dozens of Indian rescuers rallied together to use a crane
in order to save an elephant trapped at the bottom of a 20-foot well.
那是一个暖心的时刻：数十名印度营救人员齐心协力，动用一台起重机去解救一头被困在
20 英尺深井底部的大象。
【信号】题干原话定位开头句。题干里的 dozens of Indians 直接对应录音首句 dozens of Indian
rescuers rallied together，新闻第一题答案多在开头，听到这群人"齐心协力去救大象"就
锁定此句。
【替换】dozens of Indian rescuers rallied together ↔ They gathered together
rallied=gathered 同义替换
to save an elephant ↔ to rescue an elephant
save=rescue 同义替换
【排除】A) 与原文相反
录音首句明明是 a heartwarming moment（暖心时刻），选项却写成 a heartbreaking
moment（令人心碎的时刻），盗用了高度相似的 heart- 开头词把情绪极性反了过来，听
到 heart 就选会中招。
借用原文：It was a heartwarming moment
C) 张冠李戴
"听到井里有声音"确实在录音里 The army officers heard a noise coming from the
well，但那是"军官"听到的，不是这群营救人员做的，选项把军官的动作安到了 dozens of
Indians 头上。
借用原文：The army officers heard a noise coming from the well
D) 偷换概念
录音说的是大象自己 wandered out of the jungle and fell into the well，是大象游荡，
不是这群印度人"发现一头在井边游荡的大象"，选项盗用 wander 和 well 拼出一个原文没
说的动作。
借用原文：The elephant wandered out of the jungle and fell into the well

questions.stem: Why did the army officers call the local forest department?

options.label: A
options.text: To borrow their crane.

options.label: B
options.text: To ask them for help.

options.label: C
options.text: To report the strange noise.

options.label: D
options.text: To get food for the elephant.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （目的题） To ask them for help.
【定位】The officers then threw in some food for the creature and called the local forest department
for help.
随后军官们往井里扔了些食物给这头大象，并打电话向当地林业部门求助。
【信号】for help 点出目的。答案信号是表目的的 called the local forest department for help 里
的 for help——"call ... for help"直接说明打电话就是"为了求助"，这是目的题的落点。
【替换】called the local forest department for help ↔ To ask them for help
for help=ask for help 同义
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
crane（起重机）确实在录音里出现过 use a crane，但那是后来营救时用的工具，录音从没
说打电话是"为了借起重机"，选项盗用 crane 这个原词制造"听到了就想选"的诱惑。
借用原文：to use a crane
C) 答非所问
"井里传来奇怪声音"在录音里是军官自己 heard a noise coming from the well，他们打电
话是去求助、不是"去报告这个声音"，选项把"听到声音"硬说成打电话的目的。
借用原文：The army officers heard a noise coming from the well
D) 原词陷阱
"给大象弄吃的"沾着录音里 threw in some food for the creature，但扔食物是军官自己做
的另一件事，不是打电话的目的，选项盗用 food 这个原词来误导。
借用原文：threw in some food for the creature

questions.stem: What does the news report say happened finally?

options.label: A
options.text: The elephant was able to return to the jungle.

options.label: B
options.text: The army officers were examined for injuries.

options.label: C
options.text: The army officers were rewarded for their rescue efforts.

options.label: D
options.text: The elephant was given medical treatment for many days.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） The elephant was able to return to the jungle.
【定位】The elephant was kept under close supervision for a few days before it was successfully
released back into the wild.
这头大象被严密看护了几天，之后才被成功放归野外。
【信号】尾句 released 收束结局。答案信号是录音最后一句的 successfully released back into
the wild——"成功放归野外"是整件事的收尾结局，新闻末题答案就在此。
【替换】released back into the wild ↔ return to the jungle
the wild=the jungle 同义
【排除】B) 张冠李戴
"检查伤情"在录音里有 for evaluation of any injuries，但被检查的是大象，不是"军官"，
选项把检查对象从大象偷换成 army officers，听到 injuries 就选会错。
借用原文：taken to an examining room for evaluation of any injuries
C) 未提及
录音通篇没有说军官因营救"受到奖励"，reward 是凭空添加的情节，属于原文根本没提到
的内容。
D) 偷换概念
录音说的是 kept under close supervision for a few days（看护了几天），选项却写成
given medical treatment for many days，把"几天看护"夸成"很多天的治疗"，且最终结
局是"放归"而非"治疗"，盗用 days 偷改了时长与重点。
借用原文：kept under close supervision for a few days

questions.stem: Why has the man stopped paying online for the last three months?

options.label: A
options.text: He found it had caused him much inconvenience.

options.label: B
options.text: It led him to spend more money than necessary.

options.label: C
options.text: It was much less secure than paying with cash.

options.label: D
options.text: He wanted to be less dependent on his phone.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） It led him to spend more money than necessary.
【定位】No, they are safe. But paying online is too convenient and I spent too much money on things I
didn't need.
不，线上付款是安全的。但线上付款太方便了，我在不需要的东西上花了太多钱。
【信号】转折 But 之后才是真因。男方先用 No, they are safe. 否掉"不安全"的猜测，再用 But 引
出真正理由 I spent too much money on things I didn't need——转折后那半句才是答
案句。
【替换】I spent too much money on things I didn't need ↔
It led him to spend more money than necessary.
"不需要的东西上多花钱"="花了多于必要的钱"
【排除】A) 与原文相反
录音说线上付款 too convenient（太方便了），选项却说 caused him much
inconvenience（带来很多不便）——A 盗了 convenient 这个原词却反着说，方向正相
反。
借用原文：paying online is too convenient
C) 与原文相反
选项 much less secure（不太安全）盗用了"安全"这一话题，但录音明确说 they are safe
——他恰恰否认了安全顾虑，C 取的是被否定的方向。
借用原文：No, they are safe
D) 未提及
less dependent on his phone（少依赖手机）听着合理，但录音通篇只说花钱失控，没有
一句提到"想摆脱对手机的依赖"，属凭常识硬补。

questions.stem: What problem does the woman say she may also have?

options.label: A
options.text: Living beyond her means.

options.label: B
options.text: Lack of budgeting strategies.

options.label: C
options.text: Fashion addiction.

options.label: D
options.text: Impulse purchasing.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Impulse purchasing.
【定位】Oh, impulse purchases can be an issue for me, too. I've definitely bought clothes and shoes I
didn't need because they were on sale.
哦，冲动购物对我来说也是个问题。我确实买过自己并不需要的衣服和鞋子，就因为它们在
打折。
【信号】for me, too 的自我承认。女方用 can be an issue for me, too（对我来说也是个问题）直
接认账，too 是"我也有"的信号，紧接着的 impulse purchases 就是她自陈的毛病。
【替换】impulse purchases can be an issue for me, too ↔ Impulse purchasing.
purchases=purchasing，几乎原义对应
【排除】A) 过度推断
Living beyond her means（花超过收入）听着像"花太多"，但女方只承认冲动购物，没说
自己入不敷出，是程度上的过度引申。
B) 未提及
Lack of budgeting strategies（缺预算策略）原文无对应；女方反而说自己有 review my
spending every night 的办法，谈不上缺策略。
C) 原词陷阱
录音里她提到 bought clothes and shoes，选项 Fashion addiction（迷恋时尚成瘾）借
这两个词把"偶尔冲动买"夸成"成瘾"，听到 clothes/shoes 就选会中招。
借用原文：bought clothes and shoes I didn't need

questions.stem: What does the man say he could do at the canteen?

options.label: A
options.text: Eat healthier food with less money.

options.label: B
options.text: Order food like burgers and chips.

options.label: C
options.text: Avoid getting addicted to junk food

options.label: D
options.text: Pay either in cash or with his phone.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Eat healthier food with less money.
【定位】I'd use my phone to order food, like burgers and other junk, instead of going to the canteen,
where I could get a healthier meal for half the price.
我会用手机点外卖，比如汉堡之类的垃圾食品，而不是去食堂——在食堂我能用一半的价钱
吃到更健康的一餐。
【信号】canteen 后的 where 从句给好处。答案就在 going to the canteen, where I could get a
healthier meal for half the price——canteen 后面的 where 从句直接说出在食堂能得到
什么，是答案句的落点。
【替换】a healthier meal for half the price ↔ Eat healthier food with less money.
half the price=less money，meal=food
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
Order food like burgers and chips 直接盗用录音的 burgers，但那是他用手机点的外
卖、是 instead of（而不是）去食堂的反面行为，根本不是"在食堂能做的"。
借用原文：order food, like burgers and other junk
C) 过度推断
录音有 other junk（垃圾食品），选项 Avoid getting addicted to junk food 借 junk 编
出"避免吃上瘾"，但原文只说食堂更健康便宜，没提"上瘾"或"避免上瘾"。
借用原文：burgers and other junk
D) 原词陷阱
Pay either in cash or with his phone 把前文的"现金/手机付款"搬来，但题问的是"在食堂
能做什么"，付款方式与此无关，是套用别处原词的干扰。
借用原文：use my phone to order food

questions.stem: What is now just a habit for the man?

options.label: A
options.text: Making a shopping list.

options.label: B
options.text: Sticking to his budget.

options.label: C
options.text: Withdrawing cash only once a month.

options.label: D
options.text: Thinking twice before buying something.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Sticking to his budget.
【定位】After that I refused to spend more than what I had budgeted, and by now it's just a habit.
在那之后我就拒绝花超过我预算的钱，到现在这已经成了一种习惯。
【信号】by now it's just a habit 收尾点题。by now it's just a habit 是收束信号，紧贴它前面的
refused to spend more than what I had budgeted 就是"成了习惯"的那件事——答案在
习惯标志词紧邻的前半句。
【替换】refused to spend more than what I had budgeted ↔ Sticking to his budget.
"不超预算花钱"="守住预算"
【排除】A) 未提及
Making a shopping list 是常见省钱招，但录音通篇没提"列清单"，是凭常识补的干扰。
C) 与原文相反
Withdrawing cash only once a month 借用前文取现的场景，但录音说他 go to the
bank once a week（每周一次）而非 once a month，频次被偷改，且这不是收尾点出
的"习惯"。
借用原文：I go to the bank once a week
D) 答非所问
Thinking twice before buying something 与"控制冲动"沾边，但男方收尾点出的习惯明
确是"不超预算"，没有说"买前三思"成了习惯，方向虽近却非他的原话。

questions.stem: Why is the woman opposed to their son joining a sport like soccer?

options.label: A
options.text: He does not enjoy any ball games.

options.label: B
options.text: He has to prepare for the future.

options.label: C
options.text: He has breathing problems.

options.label: D
options.text: He is not up to anything challenging.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） He has breathing problems.
【定位】W: Um, I don't think he should be doing something so challenging with all his
breathing issues.
女：嗯，我觉得他不该去做这么有挑战性的运动，他还有那一身呼吸方面的毛病呢。
【信号】反对句后跟出理由。女方先表态 I don't think he should be doing something so
challenging（反对做高强度运动），紧接着用 with 引出真正的缘由 with all his
breathing issues——"反对+because式补充"就是答案信号，落点在 with 之后的原因。
【替换】breathing issues ↔ breathing problems
issues=problems 同义换词
【排除】A) 未提及
He does not enjoy any ball games. 说他"不喜欢任何球类"，可女方通篇都在给儿子挑球
类（羽毛球、排球），根本没说他不喜欢球，属凭空捏造。
B) 原词陷阱
He has to prepare for the future. 里的"为将来做准备"确实在录音里出现过，但那是男方
even if it might prepare him for the future 说的、且是他要否定的东西，不是女方反对足
球的理由——典型的"听到原词就想选"。
借用原文：even if it might prepare him for the future
D) 偷换概念
He is not up to anything challenging.（应付不了有挑战的事）借用了原文 something
so challenging 里的 challenging，听着很顺，但女方反对的根子是"呼吸问题"，"高强
度"只是结果、不是原因——把原因偷换成了表象。
借用原文：something so challenging

questions.stem: What does the man suggest their son try in order to understand team spirit?

options.label: A
options.text: Soccer.

options.label: B
options.text: Badminton.

options.label: C
options.text: Volleyball.

options.label: D
options.text: Basketball.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Basketball.
【定位】M: He could try basketball since many of the courts are indoors now and it's a sport that
could help him understand team spirit while cooperating with others.
男：他可以试试篮球，现在很多球场都在室内了，而且这是一项能帮他在与人协作中理解团
队精神的运动。
【信号】建议词+目的吻合。男方用建议句 He could try basketball，并紧接着点出目的 could
help him understand team spirit，与题干"in order to understand team spirit"严丝合
缝——"建议句 + 目的状语命中题干限定"就是答案信号。
【替换】He could try basketball ↔ Basketball.
运动名原词对应
understand team spirit ↔ Basketball.
目的对上题干限定
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
Soccer. 确实被念到，但那是男方开头 like soccer 提的、并非"为理解团队精神"而提，不满
足题干限定，听到 soccer 就选会落坑。
借用原文：like soccer
B) 张冠李戴
Badminton. 是女方 like badminton 建议的室内运动，既不是男方提的、也与团队精神无
关，张冠李戴又跑题。
借用原文：like badminton
C) 原词陷阱
Volleyball. 是女方在第4段 what about volleyball 才提的，且理由是社交和奖学金，不是
男方、也不是为团队精神，纯属原词诱选。
借用原文：what about volleyball

questions.stem: What is one of the woman's considerations in choosing a sport for her son?

options.label: A
options.text: The possibilities of joining the school sports team.

options.label: B
options.text: The opportunities of winning some championships.

options.label: C
options.text: The chances of getting an athletic scholarship later on.

options.label: D
options.text: The odds of becoming a professional sportsman someday.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） The chances of getting an athletic scholarship later on.
【定位】W: It's not as popular as some sports, which means he has better odds of possibly getting an
athletic scholarship in the future.
女：它不像有些运动那么热门，这意味着他将来更有机会拿到体育奖学金。
【信号】which means引出考量。女方在介绍排球时用 which means he has better odds of
possibly getting an athletic scholarship in the future 道出她看重的好处——"which
means + 具体好处"就是她考量的落点，正是答案信号。
【替换】getting an athletic scholarship in the future ↔ getting an athletic scholarship later on
in the future=later on
better odds of possibly getting ↔ The chances of getting
odds=chances 同义
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
The possibilities of joining the school sports team. 对应的"加入校队"是男方在第3段
join the school basketball team 提的，且针对篮球，不是女方选排球的考量，说话人和项
目都错。
借用原文：join the school basketball team
B) 张冠李戴
The opportunities of winning some championships. 里的"赢冠军"出自男方第3段
winning a game or even a championship，是他讲团队运动好处时说的，与女方无关。
借用原文：winning a game or even a championship
D) 过度推断
The odds of becoming a professional sportsman someday. 盗用了女方原句里的
odds，又把"拿奖学金"夸大成"当职业运动员"，原文根本没说要走职业道路，是顺着 odds
往前多推了一步。
借用原文：better odds of possibly getting an athletic scholarship in the future

questions.stem: What does the man say about beach volleyball?

options.label: A
options.text: It differs entirely from indoor volleyball.

options.label: B
options.text: It appeals to both schoolgirls and schoolboys.

options.label: C
options.text: It is less popular than indoor sports in the country.

options.label: D
options.text: It is completely different from other outdoor games.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） It differs entirely from indoor volleyball.
【定位】M: As I've said many times before, beach volleyball and indoor volleyball are
completely different.
男：我之前说过很多次了，沙滩排球和室内排球是完全不一样的。
【信号】强调句直接表态。男方用 As I've said many times before（我说过很多遍了）加重语气，
再直给观点 beach volleyball and indoor volleyball are completely different——这
种"强调铺垫+直接表态"就是答案句，落点清清楚楚。
【替换】beach volleyball and indoor volleyball are completely different ↔
It differs entirely from indoor volleyball.
completely different=differs entirely
【排除】B) 张冠李戴
It appeals to both schoolgirls and schoolboys. 对应的"男女都参与"是女方第4段 he
could socialize with both girls and boys 说普通排球时讲的，既不是男方、也不是评沙滩
排球。
借用原文：he could socialize with both girls and boys
C) 张冠李戴
It is less popular than indoor sports in the country. 化用了女方 not as popular as
some sports，但那是女方评普通排球、且对比对象是"some sports"而非"室内运动"，说
话人和内容都对不上。
借用原文：not as popular as some sports
D) 偷换概念
It is completely different from other outdoor games. 几乎照搬男方的 completely
different 句式，唯独把比较对象从"indoor volleyball（室内排球）"偷换成"other
outdoor games（其他户外运动）"——男方比的是室内外排球，不是和别的户外项目比。
借用原文：beach volleyball and indoor volleyball are completely different

questions.stem: What do we learn from the passage about the lift-off of spacecraft?

options.label: A
options.text: It usually requires years of preparations.

options.label: B
options.text: It does a lot of harm to the environment.

options.label: C
options.text: It often burns over three hundred tonnes of refined fuel.

options.label: D
options.text: It proves to be the most complicated stage of space missions.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） It does a lot of harm to the environment.
【定位】Lift-off is usually the most environmentally harmful stage of any space mission, with vast
quantities of fuel burnt up in a matter of minutes.
发射升空通常是任何太空任务中对环境危害最大的阶段，几分钟内就有大量燃料被烧掉。
【信号】篇章首句即点题。这是第一段的开篇第一句，篇章独白常把核心论断放在段首；句中 the
most environmentally harmful stage"对环境危害最大的阶段"是一个带最高级的明确论
断，正是答案句信号。
【替换】the most environmentally harmful stage ↔ does a lot of harm to the environment
最高级换成动词短语
【排除】A)
It usually requires years of preparations. 说发射"通常需要数年准备"，原文通篇没提准备
时长，是凭"航天听起来很复杂"的常识臆造出来的。
C)
It often burns over three hundred tonnes of refined fuel. 看似与原文 112 tonnes of
refined fuel 对得上，但原文说的 112 吨是"精炼燃料"，336 吨是排放的 CO₂；选项把
over three hundred tonnes 安到了 refined fuel 头上，张冠李戴地偷换了数字。听到
three hundred 就选，正中陷阱。
借用原文：Falcon 9 gets through 112 tonnes of refined fuel, emitting about 336 tonnes of CO₂
D)
It proves to be the most complicated stage of space missions. 盗用了原文的最高级框
架 the most environmentally harmful stage，但把 harmful（有害）偷换成
complicated（复杂）。原文讲的是"危害最大"不是"最复杂"，听到 the most…stage 就
选，会被这个偷换骗到。
借用原文：the most environmentally harmful stage of any space mission

questions.stem: What happens traditionally to boosters, fuel tanks and other components in spaceflight?

options.label: A
options.text: They are burnt up in outer space.

options.label: B
options.text: They are guided back to Earth.

options.label: C
options.text: They are reused up to 100 times.

options.label: D
options.text: They are treated as expendable.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） They are treated as expendable.
【定位】Traditionally, boosters, fuel tanks and other components are treated as expendable.
传统上，助推器、燃料箱和其他部件都被当作用完即弃的消耗品。
【信号】限定词traditionally领出答案。句子以 Traditionally 开头，与题干里的 traditionally 完全
对应；这种"题干限定词在原文里原样出现"的句子就是答案句。注意紧随其后的 But
guiding them back to Earth 是转折后的新做法，问"传统"时不能抓那一句。
【替换】treated as expendable ↔ They are treated as expendable.
近乎原句照搬
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
They are burnt up in outer space. 说部件"在外太空被烧毁"。原文第一段确有 fuel burnt
up"燃料被烧掉"，但那是讲燃料、不是部件，更没说在外太空烧；这项盗用了 burnt up 的
印象来骗人。
借用原文：vast quantities of fuel burnt up in a matter of minutes
B)
They are guided back to Earth. 对应原文 But guiding them back to Earth，但这是 But
转折之后讲的"新可能"，是与"传统"相对的现在做法；题干问的是 traditionally，选 B 等于
把转折后的新情况当成了传统做法。
借用原文：But guiding them back to Earth in a controlled manner
C) 原词陷阱
They are reused up to 100 times. 直接搬了原文 can be reused up to 100 times，原
词、数字都对，极具迷惑性；但那同样是 But 转折之后的新做法，不是 traditionally 的传
统处理。听到 100 times 就选，正中原词陷阱。
借用原文：most components from the Falcon 9 can be reused up to 100 times

questions.stem: What does the passage say we already have regarding spaceflight?

options.label: A
options.text: New technologies for bringing back space vehicles for recycling.

options.label: B
options.text: The technology for meeting the needs of commercial space travel.

options.label: C
options.text: Many of the technologies to limit the impact of space travel on Earth.

options.label: D
options.text: The technology for effectively protecting ozone from being destroyed.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Many of the technologies to limit the impact of space travel on Earth.
【定位】But we already have many of the technologies needed to start limiting its impact on
our planet.
但我们已经拥有许多项所需的技术，可以开始限制太空旅行对地球的影响。
【信号】尾段转折收束句。这是全文最后一段的收尾句，以 But we already have 起头：前一句
说"真正环保的太空旅行还很遥远"，But 一转给出积极结论，转折之后才是文章真正落点，
正是答案句。
【替换】many of the technologies needed to start limiting its impact on our planet ↔
Many of the technologies to limit the impact of space travel on Earth.
保留核心仅压缩表述
【排除】A)
New technologies for bringing back space vehicles for recycling. 借用了第三段"回收
复用"的印象（guiding them back to Earth、reused），但原文尾句说的是"已经拥有的
many of the technologies"，不是 new technologies；且"带回回收"只是文中一个细节，
拿它冒充全文结论，以偏概全。
借用原文：guiding them back to Earth in a controlled manner
B) 原词陷阱
The technology for meeting the needs of commercial space travel. 盗用了原文
commercial spaceflight"商业航天"这个词，但原文提它是说"商业航天兴起让问题更紧
迫"，并非说"我们已有满足商业航天需求的技术"；这项把原词搬过来却换了说法，答非所
问。
借用原文：These issues are growing more pressing with the emergence of commercial spaceflight.
D) 过度推断
The technology for effectively protecting ozone from being destroyed. 盗用了原文
emit particles that destroy ozone 里的 ozone"臭氧"，但原文只是说火箭排放粒子"会破
坏臭氧"，根本没说我们"已有有效保护臭氧的技术"；这项把一个细节问题夸大成现成的单项
技术，无中生有。
借用原文：rocket engines emit particles that destroy ozone

questions.stem: What does research show about reading to a loyal and nonjudgmental companion?

options.label: A
options.text: It can help unskilled readers feel more secure.

options.label: B
options.text: It can encourage reluctant readers to read aloud.

options.label: C
options.text: It can strengthen children's confidence in others.

options.label: D
options.text: It can boost children's interest in communication.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） It can encourage reluctant readers to read aloud.
【定位】Research shows that reading to a loyal and nonjudgmental companion, such as a dog or cat,
can encourage reluctant readers to read aloud, which will in turn boost their self-confidence.
研究表明，读给一个忠诚且不加评判的伙伴（比如一只狗或猫）听，能鼓励那些不情愿读书
的孩子大声朗读，这反过来又会增强他们的自信。
【信号】题干原词复现处即答案句。录音里 Research shows that reading to a loyal and
nonjudgmental companion 与题干用词几乎一字不差，题干问的对象在录音里原样出现，
这句就是答案句；紧跟其后的 can encourage reluctant readers to read aloud 正是"研究
表明的结果"。
【替换】can encourage reluctant readers to read aloud ↔
It can encourage reluctant readers to read aloud.
近乎原句搬运
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
A 项 help unskilled readers feel more secure 里的 secure 来自录音后一句 help
children feel secure，但那句讲的是"有个伙伴倾诉感受"带来的安全感，不是"读给宠物
听"的研究结果；而且录音说的是 reluctant readers（不情愿的读者），A 偷换成 unskilled
readers（不熟练的读者）。
借用原文：can also help children feel secure and develop communication skills
C) 偷换概念
C 项 strengthen children's confidence in others 借用了录音的 confidence，但录音说的
是 boost their self-confidence（自信，对自己的信心），C 偷偷改成"对他人的信心
（confidence in others）"，方向反了。
借用原文：which will in turn boost their self-confidence
D) 原词陷阱
D 项 boost children's interest in communication 的 communication 来自录音末句
develop communication skills，但那是"有人倾诉感受"的好处，不是"读给宠物听"的研究
结果；而且录音说的是"发展沟通技能"，不是"提升沟通兴趣"。
借用原文：develop communication skills

questions.stem: How can parents make pets a fantastic subject for their children's research and learning?

options.label: A
options.text: By motivating children to find out about their favourite pets.

options.label: B
options.text: By taking children to the library to borrow books on animals.

options.label: C
options.text: By allowing children to surf the internet about pets by themselves.

options.label: D
options.text: By showing children how to acquire knowledge about healthy pets.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） By motivating children to find out about their favourite pets.
【定位】Parents can encourage their child to research their favourite pets at the library or during a
supervised internet search.
父母可以鼓励孩子在图书馆或在有人监督的网络搜索中，去研究他们最喜欢的宠物。
【信号】题干research落点处即答案句。题干问"research and learning"，录音第 3 段开头点题
Pets also provide a fantastic subject for research and learning，紧接着 Parents can
encourage their child to research their favourite pets 就是父母做法的答案句，subject
for research 与题干完全对应。
【替换】encourage their child to research their favourite pets ↔
motivating children to find out about their favourite pets
同义词替换encourage=motivate、research=find out
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
B 项 taking children to the library to borrow books on animals 盗用了录音的 library，
但录音说的是 research their favourite pets at the library（在图书馆研究宠物），是"去
图书馆查"，并非"带孩子去借书（borrow books）"，borrow books on animals 是录音
没说的。
借用原文：to research their favourite pets at the library
C) 与原文相反
C 项 allowing children to surf the internet about pets by themselves 借用了录音的
internet，但录音原文是 a supervised internet search（有人监督的网络搜索），C 把它
改成"让孩子自己（by themselves）上网"，恰恰与"有人监督"相反。
借用原文：during a supervised internet search
D) 偷换概念
D 项 showing children how to acquire knowledge about healthy pets 把录音里 their
favourite pets（最喜欢的宠物）偷换成 healthy pets（健康的宠物）；healthy 这个词出
自录音别处 keeping their pet happy and healthy，被挪到这里制造干扰，且"研究主
题"是 favourite pets 而非 healthy pets。
借用原文：to research their favourite pets

questions.stem: How can children still benefit even when their family doesn't have a pet?

options.label: A
options.text: By learning that raising pets can do much good.

options.label: B
options.text: By watching how healthy pets are brought up.

options.label: C
options.text: By hearing about their peers' passion for pets.

options.label: D
options.text: By visiting friends who have household pets.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） By visiting friends who have household pets.
【定位】And of course, if a child doesn't have a pet in their own household, they can still benefit from
all of the above when visiting a friend who does.
当然，如果一个孩子自己家里没有宠物，他们在拜访一位养宠物的朋友时，仍然能从上述所
有方面获益。
【信号】if加still的让步收尾句。录音末段用 if a child doesn't have a pet in their own
household, they can still benefit 这个"假设没有宠物 + still 仍能受益"的让步结构收尾，
正好对应题干的 even when…doesn't have a pet，是典型的答案信号句。
【替换】when visiting a friend who does ↔ By visiting friends who have household pets
代动词does=have a pet展开
【排除】A) 答非所问
A 项 learning that raising pets can do much good 把录音的 benefit 含义改头换面，说
成"懂得养宠物有好处"，但题干问的是"没养宠物时怎样仍能受益"，答案是"去拜访朋友"这
个动作，A 只是泛泛重复"养宠物有益"的大主旨，答非所问。
借用原文：a child can benefit greatly from involvement in bringing up a happy and healthy pet
B) 原词陷阱
B 项 watching how healthy pets are brought up 借了录音多处出现的 healthy pet /
bringing up，但录音从没说"观看（watching）宠物怎么养大"，这个动作是凭原词拼造出
来的，并非没宠物时的受益途径。
借用原文：bringing up a happy and healthy pet
C) 未提及
C 项 hearing about their peers' passion for pets 里的 passion 来自录音第 3 段 their
passion for learning flourishes，但那讲的是"孩子对学习的热情"，录音通篇没说"听同龄
人（peers）讲他们对宠物的热情"，这个途径属于无中生有。
借用原文：as their passion for learning flourishes

questions.stem: What would the new bill in the Ohio legislature require public colleges and universities to do?

options.label: A
options.text: Send would-be students a packet of information.

options.label: B
options.text: Update regularly all information on their websites.

options.label: C
options.text: Inform prospective students of their yearly enrollment.

options.label: D
options.text: Answer questions raised by applicants and their parents.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Send would-be students a packet of information.
【定位】A new bill in the Ohio legislature would require state public colleges and universities to send
prospective students a packet of information.
俄亥俄州议会的一项新法案将要求州立公立高校向准学生寄送一个信息包。
【信号】信号是首句直陈"require…to send"。答案句是第一段开门见山的一句 A new bill in the
Ohio legislature would require state public colleges and universities to send
prospective students a packet of information，require…to send 直接给出 "要求做的动
作"，篇章独白常在首句点题，这句即落点。
【替换】send prospective students a packet of information ↔
Send would-be students a packet of information.
prospective=would-be，几乎同义改写
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
Update regularly all information on their websites. 借了原文末段确有的 provide
similar information on their websites 里 websites、information 的影子，但法案要求的
是 "寄信息包"，不是 "定期更新网站"，听到 website 就选会中招。
借用原文：provide similar information on their websites
C) 未提及
Inform prospective students of their yearly enrollment. 借用了 prospective students
这个原词，但信息包里列的是 costs of college, grants and scholarships 等，根本没有
"年度招生人数（yearly enrollment）"，属凭空添加的内容。
D) 未提及
Answer questions raised by applicants and their parents. 听起来合理，但录音从头到尾
说的是学校 "主动寄信息包"，没有 "回答申请者和家长提问" 这一动作，是想当然的添加。

questions.stem: What can the state only do according to Adam Mathews?

options.label: A
options.text: Oversee private institutions directly.

options.label: B
options.text: Follow other states' example.

options.label: C
options.text: Supervise all schools consistently.

options.label: D
options.text: Regulate public institutions by law.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Regulate public institutions by law.
【定位】He notes that the state can only regulate public institutions in this way, but he hopes private
institutions in Ohio follow the lead of the state and post similar information.
他指出，州只能以这种方式监管公立院校，但他希望俄亥俄的私立院校效仿州的做法、也发
布类似信息。
【信号】信号是带only的限定句+but转折。答案句 the state can only regulate public
institutions in this way 自带 only 限定，正面回答 "只能做什么"；其后 but he hopes
private institutions…follow 用 but 把私立摘出去，反衬出 "只能管公立"，这种 only +
but 的结构就是答案信号。
【替换】the state can only regulate public institutions in this way ↔ Regulate public institutions by law.
"by a new bill"概括为"by law"
【排除】A) 与原文相反
Oversee private institutions directly. 抓的是 but 后面 private institutions in Ohio 这个
词，但原文是 "只能管公立、私立只是希望它效仿"，把 "管公立" 偷换成 "直接管私立"，方
向正好反。
借用原文：but he hopes private institutions in Ohio follow the lead
B) 张冠李戴
Follow other states' example. 里 follow…lead 听着像原文 follow the lead of the
state，但原文是 "私立效仿本州"，不是 "本州效仿别的州"，且主语张冠李戴。
借用原文：private institutions in Ohio follow the lead of the state
C) 偷换概念
Supervise all schools consistently. 用 all schools 把范围扩到所有学校，但答案句明确
can only regulate public institutions，only 把范围卡死在公立，all 与 only 直接矛盾。
借用原文：the state can only regulate public institutions

questions.stem: What do we learn about Ohio's schools from the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: They are resourceful.

options.label: B
options.text: They are competitive.

options.label: C
options.text: They provide the best opportunity to realize one's dream.

options.label: D
options.text: They appeal most to students from other states in the U.S.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） They are competitive.
【定位】Ohio's schools are already competitive. The state attracts more undergraduate students than it
sends to colleges out of state.
俄亥俄的学校已经很有竞争力了。该州吸引来的本科生比它送往外州读大学的还要多。
【信号】信号是直陈定性句"are already competitive"。答案句 Ohio's schools are already
competitive 是直接给学校下定义的一句，主系表把 competitive 这个定性词摆在明处；后
一句 attracts more undergraduate students than it sends 用数据印证它，这种 "先下结
论再举证" 的结构里，结论句即落点。
【替换】Ohio's schools are already competitive ↔ They are competitive.
competitive原词对应，仅换主语为They
【排除】A) 未提及
They are resourceful. 的 resourceful（资源丰富）听着像也是夸学校的好词，但录音夸学
校用的是 competitive，并没说 resourceful，是凭空换了个褒义词。
C) 原词陷阱
They provide the best opportunity to realize one's dream. 整句几乎照搬第二段 give
them the best opportunity to match their skills and their dreams，但原文那是议员说
"把信息摆给学生能给他们最好的机会"，主语是 "提供信息"，不是说学校本身就是 "实现梦
想的最佳机会"，且本题问的是 "了解到学校什么"。
借用原文：give them the best opportunity to match their skills and their dreams
D) 偷换概念
They appeal most to students from other states in the U.S. 借了第三段 attracts more
undergraduate students than it sends to colleges out of state，但原文说的是 "吸引来
的本科生比送出去的多"，并非 "对外州学生最有吸引力"，appeal most 是夸大且改了意
思。
借用原文：attracts more undergraduate students than it sends to colleges out of state

questions.stem: What is the problem with schools providing information on their websites?

options.label: A
options.text: Some students waste much time surfing the net.

options.label: B
options.text: Students may need to visit too many websites.

options.label: C
options.text: Students have to search for the information.

options.label: D
options.text: Some students may lack adequate access.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Students have to search for the information.
【定位】Many colleges and universities currently provide similar information on their websites.
This includes tuition, fees, graduation rates and more. But students need to search for
the information.
许多高校目前已在网站上提供类似信息，包括学费、各项收费、毕业率等等。但学生得自己
去搜索这些信息。
【信号】信号是But转折后的短板句。前面 Many colleges and universities currently provide
similar information on their websites 在夸网站信息已经很全，But students need to
search for the information 用 But 一转点出 "得自己找" 的短板——But 后面这句才是 "问
题" 所在，正是答案句。
【替换】students need to search for the information ↔ Students have to search for the information.
need to=have to，近乎原句
【排除】A) 未提及
Some students waste much time surfing the net. 借了 "网络" 的话题氛围，但原文只说
学生 "得自己搜"，没说 "浪费很多时间上网"，waste much time 是凭空添加的。
B) 原词陷阱
Students may need to visit too many websites. 抓住原文 on their websites 的
websites 一词，把 "得自己搜信息" 夸张成 "得访问太多网站"，原文从没说网站 too
many。
借用原文：provide similar information on their websites
D) 未提及
Some students may lack adequate access. 说学生 "缺少足够渠道"，但原文的问题是 "信
息在网上、得自己去搜"，并不是 "上不了网/没渠道"，access 这层意思原文没有。

questions.stem: What do we learn about Sherry Christian?

options.label: A
options.text: She is making a special effort to be recognized.

options.label: B
options.text: She has been living in Fayetteville for 25 years.

options.label: C
options.text: She has been driving a school bus ever since 2009.

options.label: D
options.text: She is the longest-serving bus driver in Fayetteville.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） She is the longest-serving bus driver in Fayetteville.
【定位】As part of the event, the city is celebrating its longest-serving driver on the force.
作为活动的一部分，该市正在表彰其在职时间最长的司机。
【信号】最高级 longest-serving 强调。答案句的信号是最高级 longest-serving driver on the
force——『在职最久的司机』。最高级是新闻强调『独一份身份』的标志，一旦听到 the
longest / the most，往往就是出题点，要立刻锁定。
【替换】the city is celebrating its longest-serving driver on the force ↔
She is the longest-serving bus driver in Fayetteville.
同身份的换说法
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
录音里 The City of Fayetteville is making a special effort to recognize its bus drivers
的主语是『城市』在努力表彰司机；选项 A 把它偷换成 She is making a special effort to
be recognized.——变成『她自己在努力争取被认可』。努力的人从城市换成了她本人，主
语张冠李戴。
借用原文：The City of Fayetteville is making a special effort to recognize its bus drivers
B) 原词陷阱
录音第 2 段说 Christian has been a driver for 25 years.——她当『司机』25 年；选项 B
把这个 25 年的数字盗来，安到 living in Fayetteville for 25 years『在 Fayetteville 住了
25 年』上。录音说的是开车 25 年、不是住了 25 年，听到 25 years 就选正中陷阱。
借用原文：Christian has been a driver for 25 years.
C) 原词陷阱
录音第 3 段 Transit Driver Appreciation Day has been celebrated across the country
as far back as 2009. 里的 2009，说的是『这个表彰日全国早在 2009 年就有了』，与她本
人无关；选项 C 把 2009 盗来，说成 driving a school bus ever since 2009『她从 2009
年起开校车』。年份对象被偷换，听到 2009 就选即中招。
借用原文：Transit Driver Appreciation Day has been celebrated across the country as far back
as 2009.

questions.stem: What did city officials of Fayetteville want bus drivers to be aware of?

options.label: A
options.text: The importance of their service to the city.

options.label: B
options.text: The number of riders they serve in the city.

options.label: C
options.text: The new proclamation issued early this week.

options.label: D
options.text: The significance of the event to take place March 18.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） The importance of their service to the city.
【定位】Officials said they want bus drivers to know how important they are to Fayetteville, serving
almost 1.6 million riders a year.
官员们说，他们想让公交司机知道，他们对 Fayetteville 有多么重要，每年服务近 160 万名
乘客。
【信号】官方表态 said they want…to know。答案句的信号是官方直接表态 Officials said they
want bus drivers to know how important they are——『官员说想让司机知道他们有多
重要』。said…want…to know 直接抛出他们要传达的内容，是答案句的明确路标。
【替换】how important they are to Fayetteville ↔ The importance of their service to the city.
形容词改名词
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
录音句尾 serving almost 1.6 million riders a year 确实念到了乘客数量，但它只是补充说
明司机为何重要的背景；选项 B 把这个数字盗来当成官方想让司机知道的内容 The number
of riders they serve in the city.。官方强调的是『重要性』，不是『乘客数量』这个数字本
身，听到 riders 就选即中招。
借用原文：serving almost 1.6 million riders a year
C) 答非所问
录音第 3 段 this week, the City of Fayetteville issued a proclamation 提到本周发了公
告，选项 C 把它说成 The new proclamation issued early this week.。公告是事件背景，
题目问的是『官方想让司机知道什么』，公告本身不是答案，属答非所问。
借用原文：this week, the City of Fayetteville issued a proclamation for the day
D) 原词陷阱
录音 for the day to take place March 18th 念到了活动日期 3 月 18 日，选项 D 把它说成
The significance of the event to take place March 18.。日期只是活动安排的细节，官方
想让司机知道的是『他们的重要性』而非『这个活动的意义』，听到 March 18 就选即被日
期带偏。
借用原文：for the day to take place March 18th
Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.
1 The Wilton School Board has proposed a 5.99% spending increase. If approved, it would be the
largest jump in at least eight budget cycles. The 5.99% request more than doubles the highest previous
year-over-year increase in the last eight years, which was 2.99% for the 2021-2022 school year. The
biggest driver of the $91.8 million proposed budget remains teacher salaries. These account for 64% of
the total request at $59 million. The $59 million is up from the $56.7 million budgeted for the current
school year.
Wilton学区委员会提议增加5.99%的支出。如果获得批准,这将是至少八个预算周期中最大的增幅。5.99%
的增幅请求是过去八年中最高年度增幅的两倍多,而此前最高增幅是2021-2022学年的2.99%。这份9180
万美元预算提案的最大驱动因素仍然是教师工资。教师工资占总请求金额的64%,为5900万美元。5900万
美元高于本学年预算的5670万美元。
2 There are some factors that could affect the budget moving forward. One of those is total enrollment.
The district will have a total enrollment of 3,742 students. Almost all of these students will be in
kindergarten through high school, but 66 will be in prekindergarten and other programs. This represents
47 fewer students than the current year. Fewer students mean less federal and state funding.
有一些因素可能会影响未来的预算。其中之一是总入学人数。该学区将有3742名学生入学。几乎所有这
些学生都将在幼儿园到高中阶段就读,但有66名学生将在学前班和其他项目中。这比本学年减少了47名学
生。学生人数减少意味着联邦和州拨款减少。

questions.stem: What does the news report say the Wilton School Board has done?

options.label: A
options.text: Budgeted $56.7 million for the coming school year.

options.label: B
options.text: Requested to raise teachers' salaries by 3 percent.

options.label: C
options.text: Proposed a spending increase by 5.99 percent.

options.label: D
options.text: Kept raising funds for at least 8 budget cycles.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Proposed a spending increase by 5.99 percent.
【定位】The Wilton School Board has proposed a 5.99% spending increase.
威尔顿学区校董会提出了一项 5.99% 的支出增长。
【信号】开篇首句直陈主体动作。新闻把核心事实放在开篇，第一句 The Wilton School Board has
proposed a 5.99% spending increase. 直接交代了校董会做的事，主体+动作+数字俱
全，正是答案句。
【替换】has proposed a 5.99% spending increase ↔ Proposed a spending increase by 5.99 percent.
原句几乎平移到选项
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
Budgeted $56.7 million for the coming school year. 借用了录音真实念到的数字 56.7
million，可录音说的是 up from the $56.7 million budgeted for the current school
year——这是『本学年』已编的旧预算、是被比较的基数，并非为『下一学年』新编的，听
到 56.7 million 就选会掉坑。
借用原文：up from the $56.7 million budgeted for the current school year
B) 原词陷阱
Requested to raise teachers' salaries by 3 percent. 看似与教师薪资相关，但录音只说薪
资占比 64% of the total request 与金额升至 59 million，从未说按 3% 加薪；3 percent
与录音里的 2.99% 近似，是用近似数字加上『加薪』这个貌似合理的动作拼出来的干扰。
借用原文：2.99% for the 2021-2022 school year
D) 原词陷阱
Kept raising funds for at least 8 budget cycles. 抓住了录音里的 at least eight budget
cycles，但录音原意是『这是至少八个预算周期以来最大的一次涨幅』，eight budget
cycles 是个时间比较范围，并非校董会『持续筹款八个周期』这个动作，属于把时间状语硬
读成动作。
借用原文：the largest jump in at least eight budget cycles

questions.stem: What will a decline in the total enrollment lead to?

options.label: A
options.text: Decrease in salaries for school administrators.

options.label: B
options.text: Reduction in federal and state funding.

options.label: C
options.text: Firing of less qualified faculty members.

options.label: D
options.text: Closing down of some less competitive schools.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Reduction in federal and state funding.
【定位】This represents 47 fewer students than the current year. Fewer students mean less federal and
state funding.
这意味着比本学年少了 47 名学生。学生减少意味着联邦和州的拨款减少。
【信号】因果词 mean 点出后果。录音用 Fewer students mean less federal and state funding
中的 mean 直接把『学生减少』和『拨款减少』连起来，mean 后面那一截就是题目要的后
果，是标准的因果信号句。
【替换】less federal and state funding ↔ Reduction in federal and state funding.
less 换成名词 Reduction
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
Decrease in salaries for school administrators. 里 salaries 一词录音确实出现过（教师薪
资升至 59 million），但录音只说薪资是上涨的、且针对的是教师而非行政人员，更没说招
生下降会让薪资下降，是把听过的 salaries 拿来嫁接的无中生有后果。
借用原文：teacher salaries. These account for 64% of the total request at $59 million
C) 未提及
Firing of less qualified faculty members. 听上去『钱少了就裁人』很合逻辑，但录音对学
生减少给出的唯一后果是拨款减少，从未提到裁教师，这是用常识脑补、原文未提。
D) 未提及
Closing down of some less competitive schools. 同样是凭常识想象的后果，录音谈的是
同一个学区内部的预算与拨款，根本没提到关停任何学校，属未提及。

questions.stem: What do we learn about thundersnows from the report?

options.label: A
options.text: They often take place in the Scottish highlands.

options.label: B
options.text: They usually happen in the middle of the night.

options.label: C
options.text: Their damage can be as serious as that of bombs.

options.label: D
options.text: Their loud claps can be confused with explosions.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Their loud claps can be confused with explosions.
【定位】The phenomenon happens when thunder and lightning mix with a heavy snowstorm—
sometimes causing loud claps that can be confused with explosions.
这一现象发生在雷电与强暴风雪交织之时——有时会造成响亮的轰鸣声，让人误以为是
爆炸。
【信号】定义句"The phenomenon happens when…"。信号是这句对现象下定义的结构 The
phenomenon happens when（这一现象发生在……之时），新闻在介绍一个陌生概念后，
紧跟的这种"定义/解释句"就是该现象特征的承载句，听到"The phenomenon…"就锁定它
后面的内容。
【替换】loud claps that can be confused with explosions ↔
Their loud claps can be confused with explosions.
原句换主语几乎平移
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音开头只说这次事件发生在苏格兰这一具体地点，并没说雷雪"往往发生在苏格兰高地"。
A 借"Scotland/highlands"这个地名营造熟悉感，把"这一次在苏格兰"偷换成"通常在高
地"，是个频率/范围被夸大的陷阱。
借用原文：A rare thundersnow event has taken place in Scotland.
B) 原词陷阱
录音里 woken up in the middle of the night 说的是"某个人这一次在半夜被吵醒"，并
非"雷雪通常发生在半夜"。B 把这个时间状语原词搬过来，又加上"usually"夸成惯例，听
到"middle of the night"就选 B 正中陷阱。
借用原文：Another person was woken up in the middle of the night
C) 偷换概念
录音说的是雷雪的"巨响"可被误当爆炸（声音层面），并没说它的"破坏力"和炸弹一样大。
C 借用"bombs"这个原词，把"声音像炸弹"偷换成"破坏力像炸弹"，听到 bombs 就选会掉
进去。
借用原文：loud claps that can be confused with explosions

questions.stem: What did the police do when they received the local residents' phone calls?

options.label: A
options.text: They sent out a message to calm them down.

options.label: B
options.text: They promised to stop the construction work.

options.label: C
options.text: They told them the military exercise was over.

options.label: D
options.text: They set off to inspect the site of the plane crash.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） They sent out a message to calm them down.
【定位】The police were flooded with many calls from the public. And they sent out a message asking
people to remain calm.
警方接到了公众打来的大量电话。随后他们发出一条消息，请大家保持冷静。
【信号】主语 the police 紧跟的动作句。信号是以警方为主语、紧接"接到大量电话"之后的那个动
作 they sent out a message asking people to remain calm。题目问"接到电话后做了什
么"，录音里"接到电话"这句的下一句就是答案落点，顺着叙事次序就能接住。
【替换】sent out a message asking people to remain calm ↔ They sent out a message to calm them down.
"请人保持冷静"="使其平静"
【排除】B) 未提及
录音只提到有人"以为是施工开工"，从没说警方"承诺停止施工"。B 借"construction"这个
画面把不存在的承诺安到警方头上，属凭空捏造的动作。
借用原文：what he thought was early construction work starting
C) 原词陷阱
录音是警方"向大家保证这只是雷电、不是军事演习"，并非"告诉大家军演结束了"。C 偷
来"military exercise"原词，把"不是军演"改成"军演已结束"——录音根本没有军演，何来
结束，听到 military exercise 就选 C 正中陷阱。
借用原文：it was just thunder and lightning rather than some military exercise
D) 原词陷阱
录音里"plane crash"只是某人形容声音"像飞机失事"的比喻，根本没有真飞机失事，警方更
没"前往勘查失事现场"。D 把这个比喻里的原词搬来，编出一个不存在的警方动作，听到
plane crash 就选会掉坑。
借用原文：described it as a loud boom, similar to a plane crash

questions.stem: What were people advised to do when traveling outside?

options.label: A
options.text: Keep warm.

options.label: B
options.text: Take caution.

options.label: C
options.text: Avoid driving.

options.label: D
options.text: Use rail service.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Take caution.
【定位】The weather was the coldest it had been for the season, so people were warned to be careful
when traveling outside.
天气是本季最冷的，因此人们被提醒外出时要小心。
【信号】提醒信号"were warned to be careful"。信号是 people were warned to be careful
when traveling outside 里的"were warned"（被提醒）这一提醒标志词，它后面紧跟的
be careful 就是"被建议做什么"的直接答案，听到 warned/advised 就锁后面的动作。
【替换】people were warned to be careful ↔ Take caution
"be careful"="take caution"
【排除】A) 过度推断
录音虽说"本季最冷"，但提醒的内容是"小心"，并没说让大家"保暖"。A 借"最冷天气"的语
境顺势推出"keep warm"，是录音没明说的过度延伸，听到 coldest 就联想到保暖会被带
偏。
借用原文：The weather was the coldest it had been for the season
C) 原词陷阱
录音说"结冰湿滑路面会给司机带来困难"，是提醒司机小心，并没说"别开车"。C
借"drivers"原词把"开车要当心"偷换成"避免开车"，比录音说得更绝对，听到 drivers 就选
C 会掉坑。
借用原文：dangerous conditions such as icy roads or wet ground could cause difficulty for drivers
D) 与原文相反
录音说"铁路服务也宣布列车可能因大雪受扰"，是说火车也受影响、不可靠，绝非建议大
家"改坐火车"。D 偷来"rail service"原词，把"火车受影响"反着说成"用火车出行"，听到 rail
service 就选 D 正中反向陷阱。
借用原文：The rail service also announced potential disruptions to trains due to the deep snow.

questions.stem: What does the woman say she was actually wondering about?

options.label: A
options.text: Why the man is so anxious to buy a new phone.

options.label: B
options.text: How the man could possibly afford a new phone.

options.label: C
options.text: How the man got into the habit of being wasteful.

options.label: D
options.text: Why the man is so fond of using his credit card.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） How the man could possibly afford a new phone.
【定位】No, actually, I was wondering how you could possibly afford a new phone.
不，其实我是在想，你到底怎么买得起一部新手机。
【信号】actually 纠偏后的真意。女方先用 No 否定男方的猜测，再用 actually 引出自己真正在想
的事——"actually"后面才是她的本意，这正是答案信号：纠正/转折之后的内容才是落点。
【替换】how you could possibly afford a new phone ↔ How the man could possibly afford a new phone.
几乎原句搬运，仅换人称
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音确有男方 I'm going to the city centre to buy a new phone today. 这种"今天就去
买"的急切感，A 借此造"为何这么急"的诱惑；但女方明说在想的是"怎么买得起"，不是"为
何急"。
借用原文：I'm going to the city centre to buy a new phone today.
C) 原词陷阱
女方确实说了 getting another phone so soon is wasteful，C 盗这个 wasteful 来骗；但
这是她在 But now that you mention it 之后补的评价，题干问的是她"actually was
wondering"的那件事，那件事是"如何负担"，不是"如何变浪费"。
借用原文：getting another phone so soon is wasteful
D) 张冠李戴
录音后文男方说 I just got a credit card，D 借"信用卡"造"为何爱用卡"的问题；但这是男
方的话、且在女方发问之后，女方"在想"的内容里根本没有它。
借用原文：I just got a credit card

questions.stem: Why is the man a little embarrassed by the phone he's using now?

options.label: A
options.text: It is not in fashion any more.

options.label: B
options.text: It goes out of order frequently.

options.label: C
options.text: It is not as fancy as his colleagues'.

options.label: D
options.text: It lacks functions office work requires.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） It is not as fancy as his colleagues'.
【定位】Maybe you're right, but the thing is, everyone at the office has a nice, expensive phone, and
I'm a little embarrassed by mine.
也许你说得对，但问题是，办公室里每个人都有一部又好又贵的手机，我对自己这部有点难
为情。
【信号】the thing is 引出真正缘由。男方用 but the thing is 转入正题，紧接着给出难为情的原因
——"大家都有又好又贵的手机"。"the thing is"是"我接下来说的才是要点"的提示，正是答
案信号。
【替换】everyone at the office has a nice, expensive phone ↔ It is not as fancy as his colleagues'.
正话反说＋同义改写
I'm a little embarrassed by mine ↔ It is not as fancy as his colleagues'.
难为情对应的正是"比不上"
【排除】A) 未提及
男方只说自己手机比不上同事、并非"不再时髦"。in fashion 这层意思录音从未出现，是
凭"旧手机"常识硬加的。
B) 未提及
男方难为情是因为手机不够气派，不是因为它老出故障。"goes out of order"录音里完全没
有对应。
D) 原词陷阱
录音确有 everyone at the office 出现"office"，D 用 functions office work requires
把"office"接到"工作功能缺失"上；但男方难为情是"不如别人气派"，从没说手机缺工作所需
功能。
借用原文：everyone at the office has a nice, expensive phone

questions.stem: What does the man say about the credit card he just got?

options.label: A
options.text: It enables him to buy a new phone at a more favorable price.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a special offer to recent college graduates working in offices.

options.label: C
options.text: It is available to office workers who have a good enough credit score.

options.label: D
options.text: It allows him to borrow money without paying interest for six months.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） It allows him to borrow money without paying interest for six months.
【定位】Maybe you're right, but the credit card has a very good special offer, where I don't pay any
interest for six months.
也许你说得对，但这张信用卡有个很不错的特别优惠，六个月内我不用付任何利息。
【信号】数字/期限信息点。男方介绍卡时给出 I don't pay any interest for six months——"不付
利息"加"六个月"是一处明确的数字/条件信息，正是该题的答案信号，听到数字就该锁定。
【替换】I don't pay any interest for six months ↔
It allows him to borrow money without paying interest for six months.
同义改写＋补出隐含的"借钱"
【排除】A) 未提及
卡的好处是"免息"而非"以更优价格买手机"。a more favorable price 录音里没有对应，免
息不等于降价。
B) 张冠李戴
录音里女方说 you are a recent graduate，B 借此编出"专给应届办公族的特别优惠"；但
这是女方议论男方身份的话，与卡的优惠对象无关，男方介绍卡时根本没提面向谁。
借用原文：you are a recent graduate
C) 原词陷阱
录音反复出现 credit card 的 credit，C 借此造 a good enough credit score 的门槛；但
男方说的是"免息"，从没提任何信用分要求，credit score 是凭 credit 一词联想出来的。
借用原文：the credit card has a very good special offer

questions.stem: What do we learn about one of the woman's colleagues?

options.label: A
options.text: She borrowed money to pay her debt.

options.label: B
options.text: She developed a habit of overspending.

options.label: C
options.text: She enjoys buying a lot of fancy things.

options.label: D
options.text: She regrets ignoring the woman's advice.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） She developed a habit of overspending.
【定位】One of my colleagues bought a lot of things on credit during her first year of work, and it
became a bad habit, and she accumulated a lot of debt.
我的一个同事在工作第一年用信用卡买了一大堆东西，后来变成了一个坏习惯，她还欠下了
一大笔债。
【信号】举例＋"became a bad habit"落点。女方用 One of my colleagues 引出例子，关键落在
it became a bad habit——"变成一个坏习惯"是这句话的结论，正是答案信号：举例句里
那个"演变成…"的结果才是要点。
【替换】bought a lot of things on credit ... it became a bad habit ↔
She developed a habit of overspending.
"乱买成习惯"概括为 overspending habit
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音确有 she accumulated a lot of debt 出现 debt，A 借此编出"借钱去还债"；但原文只
说她"欠了债"，从没说她"再借钱来还"，多绕了一步。
借用原文：she accumulated a lot of debt
C) 原词陷阱
录音说她 bought a lot of things on credit，C 改成"enjoys buying a lot of fancy
things"；"fancy（华而不实/高档）"与"enjoys（乐在其中）"录音都没有，原文重点是"成
了坏习惯"而非"她爱买好东西"。
借用原文：bought a lot of things on credit
D) 张冠李戴
后文男方说 I'm sure she regrets it，D 借此说"她后悔没听劝"；但这是男方的推测、且"没
听 the woman 的劝"录音根本没有，属把男方的话安到同事头上。
借用原文：I'm sure she regrets it

questions.stem: What does the tiny home movement mainly advocate?

options.label: A
options.text: Blog writing and natural resources saving.

options.label: B
options.text: Joint efforts to improve the local community.

options.label: C
options.text: Audience participation in The Morning Show.

options.label: D
options.text: Home ownership and environmental protection.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （主旨题） Home ownership and environmental protection.
【定位】Well, it's mainly about increasing home ownership and protecting the environment.
嗯，它主要就是关于提高住房拥有率和保护环境。
【信号】被问者应答 + mainly 点题。前一段主持人直接发问"can you tell our audience what it's
about"，紧接着这段是被问者 Bob 的正面应答，且自带点题词 it's mainly about——对话
题里"提问后被问者的第一句正面回答"加上 mainly 这种总括词，正是答案句的双重信号。
【替换】increasing home ownership ↔ Home ownership
动名词短语压缩成名词
protecting the environment ↔ environmental protection
动词短语名词化
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音开头确实说嘉宾是 a popular blog writer，后文也提到省 fewer resources，本项
Blog writing and natural resources saving 把这两个零散原词拼到一起冒充主旨，但"写
博客"只是嘉宾身份、不是这个运动主张的内容，答非所问。
借用原文：a popular blog writer
B) 未提及
Joint efforts to improve the local community 说"合力改善本地社区"，但录音通篇只讲
购房与环保，从未提到"社区"或"共同努力"，属凭空添加。
C) 原词陷阱
录音里 The Morning Show 只是这档节目的名字，本项 Audience participation in The
Morning Show 借这个耳熟的专有名词，硬说运动主张是"观众参与节目"，与运动内容毫不
相干。
借用原文：The Morning Show

questions.stem: What does the woman say about houses as small as 20 square meters?

options.label: A
options.text: Not a realistic size for families.

options.label: B
options.text: Not welcomed by most Americans.

options.label: C
options.text: Only fit for families of four or less.

options.label: D
options.text: Only suitable for renting to the poor.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Not a realistic size for families.
【定位】But I've seen your blog, and you write about houses that are as small as 20 square meters.
That's not a realistic size for families.
但是我看过你的博客，你写的是小到只有 20 平方米的房子。对家庭来说那可不是一个现实
的尺寸。
【信号】转折 But + 直接否定评价。这句以 But 转折开头，女方先承认目标好、随即话锋一转给出
否定评价 That's not a realistic size for families——转折后那句才是她的真实立场，正是
答案句信号。题干问"the woman 说了什么"，定位到女方说话的这一段即可。
【替换】That's not a realistic size for families ↔ Not a realistic size for families
去掉主系结构后近乎原意
【排除】B) 未提及
Not welcomed by most Americans 说"不受多数美国人欢迎"，但女方只说尺寸"不现
实"，从没提"美国人"或"受不受欢迎"，是凭空替换成另一种否定理由。
C) 张冠李戴
录音后面男方才提到 many families of four are happy living（四口之家也住得开），本项
Only fit for families of four or less 盗用"four"这个数字，还用 Only 把范围限死成"仅四
口以下"。这既张冠李戴（那是男方后说的、且态度相反），又把话说绝了。
借用原文：many families of four are happy living in houses that are under 30 square meters
D) 未提及
Only suitable for renting to the poor 说"只适合租给穷人"，录音里女方对小房子只评价
了"尺寸不现实"，从未谈到"出租"或"穷人"，纯属添加。

questions.stem: What does the man think about the dream of owning a 150-square-meter house?

options.label: A
options.text: It should be changed.

options.label: B
options.text: It isn't easy to realize.

options.label: C
options.text: It will come true sooner or later.

options.label: D
options.text: It doesn't appeal to average families.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （态度观点题） It should be changed.
【定位】Yes, but I think that dream needs to change, considering the cost of housing.
是的，但我认为考虑到住房成本，那个梦想需要改变。
【信号】but + I think + needs to change 表态。前一段女方说大房子"是人们梦想拥有的"，男方
先 Yes 让步、随即用 but I think that dream needs to change 转折表态。but + I think
是态度信号，needs to change（需要改变）直接亮明他的立场，正是答案句。
【替换】that dream needs to change ↔ It should be changed
主动 needs to 改成被动 should be
【排除】B) 偷换概念
录音男方提到 considering the cost of housing（考虑住房成本），本项 It isn't easy to
realize 借"成本高"联想成"梦想不易实现"，但男方的原话是"梦想该改"，不是"难实现"，偷
换了概念。
借用原文：considering the cost of housing
C) 与原文相反
It will come true sooner or later 说"迟早会实现"，方向与男方"该改变"完全相反。男方否
定的是这个大房梦本身，绝不会说它迟早成真。
借用原文：that dream needs to change
D) 未提及
It doesn't appeal to average families 说"对普通家庭没吸引力"，但男方对这个 150 平米
梦想只说了"该改"，从没说"对谁没吸引力"，是另造一个评价。

questions.stem: What does the man say about tiny homes?

options.label: A
options.text: They help to lower housing prices.

options.label: B
options.text: They help to save up for larger houses.

options.label: C
options.text: They are a good choice for many people.

options.label: D
options.text: They are vital to reducing waste worldwide.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （态度观点题） They are a good choice for many people.
【定位】So, tiny homes might not be for everyone, but they're a good option for many.
所以呢，微型住宅可能不适合所有人，但对很多人来说是个好选择。
【信号】So 收束 + but 后的总评。这句以 So 收束前面关于省钱的讨论，男方先让步"未必适合所有
人"、再用 but 给出总评 they're a good option for many。So 后的总结句加 but 后的真
态度，是这道总评题的双重信号。
【替换】they're a good option for many ↔ They are a good choice for many people
option=choice、many=many people
【排除】A) 偷换概念
录音谈到小房子便宜、能省钱 a tiny home costs just \$50,000，本项 They help to
lower housing prices 借"价格"话题，偷换成"帮助拉低房价"。男方说的是"个人买得起、
省钱"，不是"压低市场房价"，概念被偷换。
借用原文：Many people who can only afford to rent a large home are able to buy a tiny home
B) 与原文相反
录音说省下的钱让人能"买下小房子"，本项 They help to save up for larger houses 把方
向拧反成"攒钱去买更大的房子"。这与男方"买小房子、改掉大房梦"的主张正相反。
借用原文：are able to buy a tiny home
D) 过度推断
录音只在结尾说小房子"用更少土地与资源" they use less land and fewer resources，本
项 They are vital to reducing waste worldwide 用 vital（至关重要）、worldwide（全世
界）夸大成"对全球减废至关重要"，程度和范围都远超原话。
借用原文：they use less land and fewer resources to build them

questions.stem: What do children seem to have a natural desire to do?

options.label: A
options.text: Play outdoors and enjoy themselves.

options.label: B
options.text: Beat challenges and take risks.

options.label: C
options.text: Take care of their well-being.

options.label: D
options.text: Grow up strong and healthy.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Beat challenges and take risks.
【定位】To begin with, children seem to have a natural desire to overcome challenges and take risks.
首先，孩子们似乎天生就有克服挑战、承担风险的渴望。
【信号】序数词 To begin with 领出第一个要点。To begin with 是篇章列举的第一个序数词，它后
面紧跟的就是本段第一个论点句，也是题干里 natural desire 原话的落点，听到序数词起头
就要立刻锁定其后这句。
【替换】overcome challenges and take risks ↔ Beat challenges and take risks
overcome 同义替换为 Beat
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
原文开头确有 run, jump, stretch and play，又多处讲 pleasure，选项 Play outdoors
and enjoy themselves. 拼出 play 与 enjoy 听着耳熟，但这些不是孩子天生渴望要做的那
件事，与题干 natural desire 错位。
借用原文：run, jump, stretch and play
C) 张冠李戴
原文有 improve emotional well-being，选项 Take care of their well-being. 借了 well-
being 这个原词，但提升幸福感是运动带来的好处，不是孩子天生的渴望，把别处的内容安
到本题上。
借用原文：improve emotional well-being
D) 未提及
Grow up strong and healthy. 是人人认同的常识，听着最顺，但原文说孩子天生渴望的是
克服挑战、承担风险，并未说他们天生渴望健康成长，凭印象选它就中了陷阱。

questions.stem: According to the American Psychological Association, what does regular physical activity do to children?

options.label: A
options.text: Enable them to develop their motor skills.

options.label: B
options.text: Help them to conceal their frustration.

options.label: C
options.text: Reduce their stress and depression.

options.label: D
options.text: Prevent them from feeling lonely.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Reduce their stress and depression.
【定位】Thirdly, according to the American Psychological Association, regular physical activity (and
especially outdoor activity) reduces children's stress and depression, and improves their
ability to focus and learn.
第三，根据美国心理学会的说法，规律的身体活动（尤其是户外活动）能减轻孩子的压力和
抑郁，并提升他们专注和学习的能力。
【信号】出处词 according to 与题干同源对接。原文 according to the American Psychological
Association 与题干出处一字不差，听到这个机构名就知道答案句到了，其后 reduces
children's stress and depression 即为落点。
【替换】reduces children's stress and depression ↔ Reduce their stress and depression
近乎同表述、仅人称代词改写
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
原文 develop their motor skills 确有这个搭配，选项 Enable them to develop their
motor skills. 原词照搬，听着最像，但这是第一段讲运动总体好处时说的，不属于美国心理
学会出处句，被题干的出处限定排除。
借用原文：develop their motor skills
B) 偷换概念
原文出现 persist through frustration 与 positive outlet for frustration，选项 Help
them to conceal their frustration. 借 frustration 一词，却把原文的疏导挫折偷换成隐藏
挫折，方向相反。
借用原文：positive outlet for frustration
D) 未提及
Prevent them from feeling lonely. 听起来合理，但原文讲的是减压、抗抑郁、助专注，从
未提到防止孤独，属于无中生有。

questions.stem: What does the passage say about cultivating the habit of physical activity?

options.label: A
options.text: It begins early.

options.label: B
options.text: It proves demanding.

options.label: C
options.text: It calls for lifelong efforts.

options.label: D
options.text: It lies in nature experiences.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） It begins early.
【定位】Finally, we know that physical activity is important for our physical and mental health, and
cultivating the habit of physical activity starts early.
最后，我们知道身体活动对我们的身心健康很重要，而养成身体活动的习惯要从早开始。
【信号】序数词 Finally 领出末点、starts early 是定性词。Finally 标出最后一个要点，紧接着
cultivating the habit of physical activity starts early 直接对养成习惯下定性，starts
early 就是答案的核心信息。
【替换】cultivating the habit of physical activity starts early ↔ It begins early
starts 同义替换为 begins、习惯被代词 It 概括
【排除】B) 未提及
It proves demanding. 说养成习惯很费劲，但原文只说它 starts early，并未评价它吃力，
属于无中生有。
C) 原词陷阱
原文确有 a healthy coping skill throughout life 和 a lifelong love of physical activity，
选项 It calls for lifelong efforts. 借 lifelong 这个原词，但原文是说会终身热爱、终身受
用，绝不是说养成习惯需要终身努力，把听到的 lifelong 安错了对象，也与本题定性句
starts early 矛盾。
借用原文：a lifelong love of physical activity
D) 原词陷阱
原文结尾确有 gardening or nature experiences，选项 It lies in nature experiences. 搬
了 nature experiences 这个原词，但那是在举可替代的活动选项，不是在说养成习惯这件
事的特点，答非所问。
借用原文：gardening or nature experiences

questions.stem: When are job seekers willing to explore jobs with lower salaries, according to a new study?

options.label: A
options.text: When companies share their information online.

options.label: B
options.text: When their job search criteria are met fully.

options.label: C
options.text: When companies embrace greater diversity

options.label: D
options.text: When they find job postings visually attractive.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） When companies embrace greater diversity
【定位】A new study finds that job seekers are even willing to explore jobs with lower salaries when
companies are more diverse.
一项新研究发现，当企业更具多样性时，求职者甚至愿意去考虑薪资更低的工作。
【信号】when 条件状语点出触发条件。这句用 when companies are more diverse 这个条件状
语，直接把『愿接受低薪』的触发条件说出来，正是题干 When 所问。开篇第一句即点
题，是篇章独白的典型落点。
【替换】when companies are more diverse ↔ When companies embrace greater diversity
形容词转动词的同义改写
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音后文确有 sharing information about diversity 和提到在线平台，A 项 share their
information online 盗用了 information、online 这些原词，但它说的是公司在网上分享
信息，并非求职者接受低薪的触发条件，听到原词就选会落入陷阱。
借用原文：sharing information about diversity
B) 原词陷阱
录音提到平台按 their job search criteria 推送邮件，B 项 When their job search criteria
are met fully 借用了 job search criteria 这个原词，但录音从没说『求职标准被完全满足』
才接受低薪，这是用原词拼出的无中生有条件。
借用原文：their job search criteria
D) 偷换概念
录音说多样性让 job postings more attractive，D 项 When they find job postings
visually attractive. 盗用了 job postings、attractive，却加了 visually（视觉上）这层录音
没有的意思，把『内容上更有吸引力』偷换成『看起来好看』。
借用原文：more attractive to job seekers

questions.stem: What did participants see in the baseline condition of the study?

options.label: A
options.text: Emails in the normal format.

options.label: B
options.text: Major companies in one location.

options.label: C
options.text: All companies in the same sector.

options.label: D
options.text: Various aspects of a company's workforce.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Emails in the normal format.
【定位】In the baseline condition, participants saw emails in the normal format, with no information
on diversity; in the diversity condition, participants saw a diversity score for each listing.
在基线组，参与者看到的是普通格式的邮件，不含任何多样性信息；在多样性组，参与者则
看到每条招聘的多样性评分。
【信号】限定词 baseline condition 直接领出答案。录音用 In the baseline condition,
participants saw emails in the normal format 直接点名基线组及其所见，与题干限定词
完全对上，是顺听即可锁定的答案句；分号后是另一组，须切开别混。
【替换】participants saw emails in the normal format ↔ Emails in the normal format.
近乎原句的概括
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
录音末尾提到 others in the same sector and location，B 项 Major companies in one
location. 盗用了 location 这个原词，但录音从未说基线组看到『同一地点的大公司』，是
借词造出的无中生有内容。
借用原文：others in the same sector and location
C) 原词陷阱
录音里 others in the same sector and location 出现过 same sector，C 项 All
companies in the same sector. 直接搬来这个短语，但它说的是比较的参照系，不是基线
组所见，听到 same sector 就选会中招。
借用原文：compared to others in the same sector and location
D) 张冠李戴
Various aspects of a company's workforce. 描述的是多样性组看到的 information
about the race, gender, education, and language skills of a company's workforce，录
音明确说基线组 with no information on diversity，D 把另一组的内容安到基线组头上。
借用原文：information about the race, gender, education, and language skills of a
company's workforce

questions.stem: What does the passage say participants seem to be paying attention to?

options.label: A
options.text: Job security.

options.label: B
options.text: Potential pay raises.

options.label: C
options.text: Minimum base salary.

options.label: D
options.text: Information about diversity.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Information about diversity.
【定位】Participants seemed to be paying attention to information about diversity, and using this when
deciding whether to click on the listing.
参与者似乎在关注多样性方面的信息，并在决定是否点击招聘时用上了这些信息。
【信号】that is 收束句点明关注对象。这句由 that is 引出对前文的小结，并直接用 paying
attention to information about diversity 说出参与者关注的对象，与题干表态短语完全对
应，是篇章的结论落点。
【替换】paying attention to information about diversity ↔ Information about diversity.
提取宾语成名词短语
【排除】A) 未提及
A 项 Job security. 在录音里从未出现，整篇只谈多样性信息与薪资，没有任何关于工作稳
定性的内容，属凭印象添加的未提及项。
B) 过度推断
录音多次提到 lower salaries，B 项 Potential pay raises. 借薪资话题推出『可能的加
薪』，但录音只说参与者愿接受低薪、并未说他们关注加薪，是顺着薪资词过度推断。
借用原文：listings with lower salaries
C) 原词陷阱
C 项 Minimum base salary. 借用了录音反复出现的薪资话题，但录音从未提『最低底薪』
这一概念，更没说参与者关注它，是用薪资原词拼出的偷换项。
借用原文：listings with lower salaries

questions.stem: What does the passage say about the findings of a new study from Oregon State University?

options.label: A
options.text: Positive.

options.label: B
options.text: Original.

options.label: C
options.text: Important.

options.label: D
options.text: Surprising.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Important.
【定位】The findings are important because there is a growing body of evidence that dogs can help
children in many ways.
这些发现很重要，因为越来越多的证据表明狗能在许多方面帮助孩子。
【信号】对 findings 的直接定性。录音紧跟着研究结果给出定性 The findings are important，主
语正是题干问的 findings，是一句直接的"X 是怎样的"判断句，这种直接定性句就是评价类
细节题的答案落点。
【替换】The findings are important ↔ Important.
原词直接对应
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音第三段确实出现 positive impacts，但那是形容狗对孩子生活的影响，不是形容这项研
究的 findings，把 Positive. 安到 findings 上属答非所问。
借用原文：dogs can have a lot of positive impacts on a child's life
B) 未提及
Original. 表示"首创、原创的"，录音通篇没有对 findings 作此评价，属于无中生有。
D) 未提及
Surprising. 是"出人意料的"，录音只说 findings 重要，没有任何"惊讶/意外"的措辞，属无
中生有。

questions.stem: What does a growing body of evidence show according to the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: Dogs match their behavior with kids as much as with adults.

options.label: B
options.text: Kids and adults alike find in dogs a source of attachment.

options.label: C
options.text: Kids' attitude to dogs is influenced by adults.

options.label: D
options.text: Dogs can help kids in many ways.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Dogs can help kids in many ways.
【定位】there is a growing body of evidence that dogs can help children in many ways.
越来越多的证据表明狗能在许多方面帮助孩子。
【信号】evidence that 引出结论。录音 a growing body of evidence that dogs can help
children in many ways 中的 that 直接引出证据的内容，这种"evidence that + 句子"结构
里 that 后面就是答案落点。
【替换】dogs can help children in many ways ↔ Dogs can help kids in many ways.
children 与 kids 同义替换
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
Dogs match their behavior with kids as much as with adults. 借用了录音里
match...behavior 的说法，但本题问的是 evidence 表明什么（帮孩子），而且原文后文恰
恰说狗匹配孩子行为"少于"成人，并非 as much as，与原文相反。
借用原文：dogs are matching children's behavior, but less frequently than what we have seen
between dogs and adults
B) 原词陷阱
Kids and adults alike find in dogs a source of attachment. 套用了录音里 source of
attachment 一词，但原文是说狗"作为依恋来源"帮助孩子，并没有说"孩子和成人都把狗当
依恋来源"，多加了 adults，属偷换概念。
借用原文：serving as a source of attachment in the face of changing family structures
C) 未提及
Kids' attitude to dogs is influenced by adults. 谈的是"成人影响孩子对狗的态度"，录音
通篇没有这层意思，属无中生有。

questions.stem: What did Monique Udell say their study suggests?

options.label: A
options.text: Dogs pay much attention to the kids they live with.

options.label: B
options.text: Dogs view both adults and kids as social companions.

options.label: C
options.text: Kids differ from adults in their behavior towards dogs.

options.label: D
options.text: Kids need to be aware of the risks in playing with dogs.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Dogs pay much attention to the kids they live with.
【定位】This suggests that while dogs may view children as social companions, there are also some
differences that we need to understand better.
这表明，尽管狗可能把孩子视为社交伙伴，但也存在一些我们需要进一步了解的差异。
【信号】suggests that 引出研究暗示。录音中 This suggests that while dogs may view
children as social companions 用 suggests that 直接对应题干的 study suggests，这正
是 Udell 讲话里点明"研究暗示什么"的句子。
【替换】dogs may view children as social companions ↔
Dogs pay much attention to the kids they live with.
概括上位替换
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
Dogs view both adults and kids as social companions. 套用了原文 social companions
一词，但 Udell 强调的是狗把"孩子"当伙伴、且和成人有差异，并非"成人和孩子都"一视同
仁，加了 both...and 反而违背她说的 differences，与原文相反。
借用原文：while dogs may view children as social companions, there are also some differences
C) 张冠李戴
Kids differ from adults in their behavior towards dogs. 借用原文 differences 一词，但
原文说的是"狗匹配孩子行为少于成人"，差异在于"狗对孩子和对成人"的行为，而非"孩子和
成人对狗"的行为，主体被调换，属张冠李戴。
借用原文：dogs are matching children's behavior, but less frequently than what we have seen
between dogs and adults
D) 原词陷阱
Kids need to be aware of the risks in playing with dogs. 套用了第三段提到的 risks，但
本题问 Udell 说研究"暗示"什么，而风险是后文另一处内容，且原文未说"孩子需提防风
险"，答非所问。
借用原文：there are also risks associated with the dog-child relationship

questions.stem: What does research show kids are very capable of doing?

options.label: A
options.text: Understanding dogs.

options.label: B
options.text: Training dogs.

options.label: C
options.text: Taking care of dogs.

options.label: D
options.text: Associating with dogs.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Training dogs.
【定位】But research does show that kids are very capable of training dogs.
但研究确实表明，孩子非常擅长训练狗。
【信号】capable of 直接点能力。录音末句 research does show that kids are very capable of
training dogs 与题干几乎逐词重合，capable of 后面的 training dogs 就是答案动作，是
直接的能力陈述句。
【替换】kids are very capable of training dogs ↔ Training dogs.
动作短语直接对应
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
Understanding dogs. 借用了原文 understand 一词，但原文说的是"我们（研究者）还有
很多要去了解"，understand 的主体是研究者而非孩子，把它套到"孩子擅长理解狗"属张冠
李戴。
借用原文：there are also some differences that we need to understand better
C) 未提及 Taking care of dogs. 的"照料狗"录音通篇没有提到，属无中生有。
D) 未提及
Associating with dogs. 的"与狗交往"虽与全文话题相关，但原文明说孩子擅长的是
training（训练），没有说 associating，属未提及。
