questions.stem: What do we learn about the JetBlue Airlines flight from the news report?

options.label: A
options.text: It hit a bird shortly after takeoff.

options.label: B
options.text: Its crew members went on strike.

options.label: C
options.text: It narrowly escaped a plane crash when turning around.

options.label: D
options.text: Its captain got slightly injured during the forced landing.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） It hit a bird shortly after takeoff.
【定位】A JetBlue Airlines flight from West Palm Beach to New York City was forced to turn around
and land Sunday morning after the plane struck a bird.
周日上午，一架从西棕榈滩飞往纽约市的捷蓝航空航班在撞上一只鸟之后，被迫调头返航
降落。
【信号】新闻首句即事件核心。答案就在录音第一句 was forced to turn around and land Sunday
morning after the plane struck a bird：新闻报道往往开篇一句话就把 "谁、发生了什
么、为什么" 交代清楚，这句的 after 引出原因（撞鸟），正是承载答案的核心句。
【替换】after the plane struck a bird ↔ It hit a bird
struck 换成 hit
was forced to turn around and land Sunday morning ↔ shortly after takeoff
返航即起飞后不久
【排除】B) 未提及
Its crew members went on strike 说机组罢工，录音通篇只字未提任何罢工，返航原因明
确是撞鸟，属于无中生有。
C) 过度推断
It narrowly escaped a plane crash when turning around 盗用了录音里真出现的 turn
around（返航）来制造熟悉感，但录音只说返航降落、明说 No injuries were reported，
根本没提 "险些坠机"，是把普通返航夸大成濒临坠机。
借用原文：turned around just minutes after takeoff
D) 与原文相反
Its captain got slightly injured during the forced landing 借用了录音真有的 forced to
turn around and land（被迫降落）来骗耳朵，但录音紧接着明说 No injuries were
reported on the plane——没有任何人受伤，更没说机长受伤，与原文正好相反。
借用原文：No injuries were reported on the plane

questions.stem: How did the passengers feel when the plane came to a stop, according to Brian Healy?

options.label: A
options.text: Panic.

options.label: B
options.text: Nervous.

options.label: C
options.text: Relieved.

options.label: D
options.text: Contented.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （态度观点题） Relieved.
【定位】"There was total quiet, and then there was relief when the plane came to a stop."
"当时一片寂静，随后在飞机停稳的那一刻，大家都松了一口气。"
【信号】题干时间词对准原文。录音里 there was relief when the plane came to a stop 这句的时
间状语 when the plane came to a stop 与题干一字不差，时间点对上，这句就是答案
句；情绪词是 relief（松了口气）。
【替换】there was relief ↔ Relieved
名词relief转形容词Relieved
【排除】A) 答非所问
Panic 盗用了录音真说过的 a split second of panic，但那是描述事发瞬间（split
second）的情绪，不是题干问的 "飞机停稳时"，时间点错位。
借用原文：a split second of panic
B) 答非所问
Nervous 盗用了录音的 this nervous reaction on the plane，但那形容的是事件过程中的
紧张反应，同样不是 "飞机停稳时" 的感受，时间点不符。
借用原文：this nervous reaction on the plane
D) 未提及
Contented（满足）和正确项 relief 意思相近，是赌你分不清两个正面情绪词，但录音从头
到尾只说了 relief，从没出现 "满足" 这层意思，属于无中生有。
Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.
1 A deadly snake, which had finally been tracked down after escaping a zoo, has slipped away for
the second time. The poisonous snake forced the closure of the attraction last week when staff noticed
the disappearance.
一条致命的毒蛇在从动物园逃脱后终于被追踪到,却第二次溜走了。上周当工作人员注意到这条毒蛇失踪
时,它迫使该景点关闭。
2 After six days of desperate searching, he was eventually found and placed in a supposedly secure area.
But it seems the animal is no fan of the zoo, because yet again he is out on the loose. The snake is a
relative newcomer to the zoo but has already been frustrating its staff. The staff believe he squeezed
himself out of a gap located around new energy-saving bulbs installed inside the snake house. He
was only found the first time around because staff brought in a special machine to trace him inside a
wall opening.
经过六天的拼命搜寻,它最终被找到并被安置在一个据称安全的区域。但这只动物似乎并不喜欢这家动物
园,因为它再次逃脱了。这条蛇是动物园相对较新的成员,但已经让工作人员感到沮丧。工作人员认为它是
从蛇舍内安装的新型节能灯泡周围的缝隙中挤出去的。它第一次被找到是因为工作人员带来了一台特殊的
机器,在墙壁开口内追踪到了它。
3 This kind of snake is one of the most deadly and poisonous in the wild, and they can range from 3 to
5 meters in length.
这种蛇是野外最致命、毒性最强的蛇类之一,体长可达3至5米。

questions.stem: What do we learn about the deadly snake from the news report?

options.label: A
options.text: He is now kept in a secure area.

options.label: B
options.text: He has escaped the zoo once again.

options.label: C
options.text: He has been caught a second time.

options.label: D
options.text: He finally disappeared six days ago.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） He has escaped the zoo once again.
【定位】A deadly snake, which had finally been tracked down after escaping a zoo, has slipped away
for the second time.
一条致命的蛇，在逃出动物园后终于被找回，如今又第二次溜走了。
【信号】开篇首句即落点。新闻的核心事实常压在第一句。这里 has slipped away for the second
time（第二次溜走了）就是承载答案的信号句——它点明这条蛇"再次逃跑"这一最新状态。
【替换】has slipped away for the second time ↔ has escaped the zoo once again
slip away=escape，second time=once again
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音确实念到 placed in a supposedly secure area（被放进所谓安全区域），但紧接着就
是 yet again he is out on the loose——它早跑出来了。A 盗用 secure area 这个原词，
描述的却是已被推翻的"上一个阶段"状态，不是它"现在"的状况。
借用原文：placed in a supposedly secure area
C) 与原文相反
录音里确有 tracked down 和 found（被找到/被抓）以及 second time 的字眼，C 用
caught a second time 把这些原词拼起来。但 second time 在录音里是修饰"逃跑"的
（slipped away for the second time），抓只发生过一次。C 把动作方向从"逃"偷换
成"抓"，与原文相反。
借用原文：tracked down after escaping a zoo, has slipped away for the second time
D) 原词陷阱
录音的 After six days of desperate searching（搜寻了六天）里确有 six days，D 便拿
six days ago 来骗。但六天指的是"工作人员搜寻它花的时长"，不是它"六天前消失"；而且
它现在是又跑了、不是"finally disappeared（终于消失）"。数字对得上、事却对不上。
借用原文：After six days of desperate searching

questions.stem: How have the zoo staff been feeling about the snake?

options.label: A
options.text: Squeezed.

options.label: B
options.text: Threatened.

options.label: C
options.text: Disappointed.

options.label: D
options.text: Frustrated.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （态度观点题） Frustrated.
【定位】The snake is a relative newcomer to the zoo but has already been frustrating its staff.
这条蛇到动物园不算久，却已经让它的工作人员伤透了脑筋（备受挫败）。
【信号】情绪动词 frustrating。答案信号就是那个直接表达感受的词 frustrating its staff（让工作
人员受挫/懊恼）。态度题的落点往往就是这样一个带感情色彩的形容词或动词，听到它就
锁定。
【替换】has already been frustrating its staff ↔ Frustrated
主动 frustrating→被动 frustrated
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音里 he squeezed himself out of a gap（蛇把自己挤出缝隙）确有 squeezed，A 就拿
这个原词来骗。但 squeezed 讲的是蛇"怎么逃出去的"动作，根本不是工作人员的"感受"，
与题目问的 feeling 完全是两码事。
借用原文：he squeezed himself out of a gap
B) 未提及
这条蛇虽 deadly（致命），但录音从没说工作人员"感到受威胁"。Threatened 是顺着"毒
蛇危险"自行脑补出来的情绪，录音里并无对应的词，属无中生有。
C) 偷换概念
Disappointed（失望）与正确的 Frustrated（受挫/懊恼）都是负面情绪、含义相邻，最难
切开。但录音明明白白念的是 frustrating，不是 disappointing。C 用一个意思相近却并非
原文的情绪词来顶替，差在"不是录音说的那个词"。
借用原文：has already been frustrating its staff

questions.stem: What do we learn from the news report about the introduction of electric bikes into Jacksonville?

options.label: A
options.text: It is condemned as a crazy idea.

options.label: B
options.text: It is enriching the city's night life.

options.label: C
options.text: It is questioned by local residents.

options.label: D
options.text: It is giving rise to safety concerns.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） It is giving rise to safety concerns.
【定位】But they're leading to safety concerns, mainly at night when some riders don't follow the rules
of the road.
但它们正在引发安全担忧，主要发生在夜里，一些骑车人不遵守交通规则的时候。
【信号】转折 But 之后才是真意。答案藏在转折词后面：第 1 段先说电动车很火 Electric bikes
have been the craze，紧接一个 But they're leading to safety concerns。新闻里 But 一
转，前面的火爆是铺垫，转折后的安全担忧才是报道真正要讲的落点。
【替换】they're leading to safety concerns ↔ It is giving rise to safety concerns.
lead to = give rise to
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音说电动车 have been the craze（很火爆、风靡），A 项 condemned as a crazy idea
把 craze 这个原词联想成「crazy／疯狂主意被谴责」。craze（风靡）和 crazy（疯狂）发
音相近但意思相反，录音根本没有谴责之意，是听音近词就选的陷阱。
借用原文：Electric bikes have been the craze
B) 张冠李戴
enriching the city's night life 听着像呼应录音里夜里、城市等词，但录音第 4 段说的是引
进电动车是为了 bring new life into downtown（带来新活力，那是目的／初衷），并没
说它正在丰富夜生活。把第 4 段的目的安到第 5 题的现状评价上，张冠李戴。
借用原文：bring new life into downtown
C) 未提及
questioned by local residents 里的「被本地居民质疑」在录音里找不到落点：报道讲的是
safety concerns（安全担忧），并没有出现 local residents 质疑这一方。属于无中生有。

questions.stem: What are electric bike riders supposed to do?

options.label: A
options.text: Avoid entering one-way streets.

options.label: B
options.text: Ensure the safety of pedestrians.

options.label: C
options.text: Follow all the traffic rules drivers do.

options.label: D
options.text: Give way to automobiles at all times.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Follow all the traffic rules drivers do.
【定位】Electric bike riders have to follow all the same rules as you would if you were in
an automobile.
电动车骑车人必须遵守和你开汽车时一样的全部规则。
【信号】义务句 have to 即落点。第 3 段 have to follow all the same rules 里的 have to（必
须）是明确的义务标志。预读时就定了「听 have to／must」，这句一出现就是答案句。
【替换】follow all the same rules as you would if you were in an automobile ↔
Follow all the traffic rules drivers do.
in an automobile = drivers do
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
Avoid entering one-way streets 盗用了录音 one-way streets 这个原词，但录音说的是
「不要在单行道上逆行（traveling in the opposite direction）」，不是「避免进入单行
道」。它只截取了规则里的一个例子并改了意思，答非所问——题目问的是总要求，不是某
一条细则。
借用原文：traveling in the opposite direction of traffic on one-way streets
B) 张冠李戴
Ensure the safety of pedestrians 里的 pedestrians 借自第 2 段 pedestrian paths。但录
音从没要求骑车人「保证行人安全」；第 4 段只说骑车人和司机都要 paying attention
（注意安全）。把注意夸成保证行人安全，且 pedestrian 一词出处也不对，张冠李戴。
借用原文：on pedestrian paths
D) 原词陷阱
Give way to automobiles at all times 借了录音的 automobile 一词，但录音说骑车人要
遵守「和开汽车一样的规则」，是平等守规，绝没有「随时给汽车让路」的意思。at all
times（任何时候）是绝对化的无中生有。
借用原文：as you would if you were in an automobile

questions.stem: Why did City Council member Anna Cumber advocate the introduction of electric bikes into Jacksonville?

options.label: A
options.text: To ease the city's busy traffic.

options.label: B
options.text: To bring new life into the city.

options.label: C
options.text: To add a new means of transport.

options.label: D
options.text: To reduce the city's air pollution.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （目的题） To bring new life into the city.
【定位】City Council Member Anna Cumber was instrumental in introducing the electric bikes to
Jacksonville as a way to bring new life into downtown.
市议会议员 Anna Cumber 在把电动车引进杰克逊维尔一事上起了关键作用，目的是给市中
心带来新的活力。
【信号】目的状语 as a way to。第 4 段 as a way to bring new life into downtown 里的 as a
way to（作为……的一种方式）就是明确的目的标志，它后面接的就是 Anna Cumber 引进
电动车的初衷。预读已锁定听目的结构，这句正中。
【替换】as a way to bring new life into downtown ↔ To bring new life into the city.
downtown = the city
【排除】A) 未提及
To ease the city's busy traffic 听着合理，但录音里 Anna Cumber 引进电动车的目的只说
了 bring new life into downtown，从没提缓解繁忙交通。属无中生有的合理化推断。
C) 过度推断
To add a new means of transport 看似没错——电动车确实是新交通工具，但录音点明的
目的是带来新活力，不是增加一种交通方式。这是顺着常识多推一步、偏离原文所说目的。
D) 未提及
To reduce the city's air pollution 引入「空气污染」这个全新概念，录音通篇没出现
pollution 或环保相关内容。属彻底的无中生有。

questions.stem: What should we do with the topic of money, according to the woman?

options.label: A
options.text: Take it seriously.

options.label: B
options.text: Discuss it regularly.

options.label: C
options.text: Make it sound scary.

options.label: D
options.text: Talk about it openly.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Discuss it regularly.
【定位】You should make money a regular topic of discussion.
你应该让钱成为一个经常讨论的话题。
【信号】应答方的 should 建议句。男士问"最好怎么教孩子理财"，女士开口第一句就是 You
should make money a regular topic of discussion，should 是明确的建议信号，被问者
的应答正是答案落点。
【替换】a regular topic of discussion ↔ Discuss it regularly
名词短语改写成动词
【排除】A) 未提及
Take it seriously.（认真对待）听起来很顺理成章，但女士没说要"认真严肃对待"，反而强
调要让它不吓人、变本能，属凭常识脑补、原文未提。
C) 与原文相反
录音里女士说要让钱"不是个吓人的话题" rather than a scary subject，Make it sound
scary. 盗用了原词 scary 却把意思反了过来，正是"听到原词就想选"的陷阱。
借用原文：rather than a scary subject
D) 张冠李戴
Talk about it openly. 对应的 openly 来自男士的话 we talk openly about things，是男士
说的，而题目问的是 according to the woman（女士），把男士的话安到女士头上，属张
冠李戴。
借用原文：we talk openly about things

questions.stem: How does the woman say money can be made real for children?

options.label: A
options.text: By shopping around for the best deals.

options.label: B
options.text: By making abstract sums relevant.

options.label: C
options.text: By citing concrete examples.

options.label: D
options.text: By visiting discount stores.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） By citing concrete examples.
【定位】It's also essential to make money real for children through practical examples. Working out
how much we save using discount pizza coupons, for example, is much more relevant than
abstract sums.
通过实际的例子让钱对孩子变得真实也很重要。比如算一算我们用披萨折扣券省了多少钱，
这比抽象的算数有意义得多。
【信号】for example 引出具体做法。女士说要 through practical examples 并紧接 for example
举出披萨折扣券的例子，practical examples 加 for example 正是"用具体例子"的方式信
号，承载 How 的答案。
【替换】through practical examples ↔ By citing concrete examples
同义词替换
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
By shopping around for the best deals. 里 shopping around for the best deals 是男士
在 how to shop around for the best deals 里说的别的话题，且非"让钱变真实"的方法，
原词照搬却答非所问。
借用原文：how to shop around for the best deals
B) 与原文相反
录音说具体例子"比抽象算数有意义得多" much more relevant than abstract sums，
abstract sums 是被否定、被比下去的一方；By making abstract sums relevant. 盗用这
两个词反过来说"让抽象算数变得相关"，与原文相反。
借用原文：much more relevant than abstract sums
D) 偷换概念
By visiting discount stores. 里 discount 来自录音的 discount pizza coupons（折扣
券），但原文是"用折扣券"不是"逛折扣店"，盗一个 discount 把概念偷换了。
借用原文：discount pizza coupons

questions.stem: What is the common practice between the man and the woman?

options.label: A
options.text: Paying their kids to help with housework.

options.label: B
options.text: Setting kids a good example by sharing chores.

options.label: C
options.text: Giving kids pocket money according to their needs.

options.label: D
options.text: Urging kids to deposit some of their gift money.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Paying their kids to help with housework.
【定位】M: We also give our kids pocket money, and the amount they get is linked to chores, such as
putting the bins out and emptying the dishwasher. W: We do that too, and it's paid according
to their age.
男：我们也给孩子零花钱，金额跟做家务挂钩，比如倒垃圾、清空洗碗机。女：我们也这么
做，而且是按年龄发的。
【信号】We do that too 的附和。男士说零花钱"跟做家务挂钩" the amount they get is linked
to chores，女士紧接 We do that too（我们也这么做），这句附和正是"共同做法"的信
号，把男士那件事确认为两人共有。
【替换】pocket money, and the amount they get is linked to chores ↔
Paying their kids to help with housework
挂钩家务即按家务付钱
We do that too ↔ 10A
附和坐实共同点
【排除】B) 未提及
Setting kids a good example by sharing chores.（以分担家务给孩子做榜样）听着合
理，但录音说的是"让孩子做家务换零花钱"，不是大人分担家务做榜样，原文并无此意。
C) 原词陷阱
Giving kids pocket money according to their needs. 照搬原词 pocket money，但加的
条件是 according to their needs（按需要），录音里是"按家务"和"按年龄" it's paid
according to their age，条件被偷换。
借用原文：it's paid according to their age
D) 张冠李戴
Urging kids to deposit some of their gift money. 里 deposit、gift money 出自男士单
方面的 they would go to the branch and deposit their gift money，女士回应说"我没
考虑过这么做"，并非两人共同做法。
借用原文：they would go to the branch and deposit their gift money

questions.stem: What is the woman always talking about to her elder daughter?

options.label: A
options.text: The importance of cutting down family expenses.

options.label: B
options.text: The need to learn important lessons from her elders.

options.label: C
options.text: The delight in seeing their savings grow.

options.label: D
options.text: The necessity of saving into a pension.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） The necessity of saving into a pension.
【定位】W: I am always talking to my elder daughter about the importance of saving into a pension.
女：我总是跟我大女儿讲存钱进养老金的重要性。
【信号】always + importance 强调。女士说 I am always talking to my elder daughter about
the importance of saving into a pension，always 与 importance 双重强调，且对象
elder daughter 与题干完全一致，这句即答案落点。
【替换】the importance of saving into a pension ↔ The necessity of saving into a pension
importance 换成 necessity
【排除】A) 未提及
The importance of cutting down family expenses.（削减家庭开支的重要性）虽与省钱
沾边，但录音里女士对女儿谈的是"存养老金"，从未谈"削减家庭开支"，属无中生有。
B) 原词陷阱
The need to learn important lessons from her elders. 盗用了男士末句的 it's such an
important lesson to learn 与选项 11 里 elder daughter 的 elder，但 from her elders
（向长辈学）方向反了，女士是"对女儿讲"不是"向长辈学"。
借用原文：it's such an important lesson to learn
C) 张冠李戴
The delight in seeing their savings grow. 里 see savings grow 来自女士前面讲存钱罐的
so they can see their savings grow，那是对小孩子说的，不是对大女儿谈的内容，被错
接到本题。
借用原文：so they can see their savings grow

questions.stem: What do we learn about the man?

options.label: A
options.text: He is a successful businessman.

options.label: B
options.text: He reviews books on political affairs.

options.label: C
options.text: He has published a new bestseller.

options.label: D
options.text: He has worked in several banks.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） He has published a new bestseller.
【定位】Our guest today is John Banks, the author of the best selling new book, Rewarding Success.
今天的嘉宾是约翰·班克斯，畅销新书《奖励成功》的作者。
【信号】主持人开场介绍嘉宾。信号是访谈开场的身份介绍句 Our guest today is John Banks, the
author of the best selling new book——主持人介绍嘉宾时点出的身份，正是人物题答案
最常藏身处。
【替换】the author of the best selling new book ↔ He has published a new bestseller.
"畅销书作者"="出版了畅销书"
【排除】A) 未提及
录音说他是作者、教授、政治顾问，从没说他是商人；He is a successful businessman. 属
凭"成功"二字（书名 Rewarding Success）联想出来的误判，文中无据。
B) 张冠李戴
He reviews books on political affairs. 盗用了开场 Books in Review（节目名"书评"）和
author of the book 里的 book 字样，骗"听到 book/review 就选"。但评书的是主持人，
他是被采访的作者，身份张冠李戴。
借用原文：Welcome to Books in Review
D) 原词陷阱
He has worked in several banks. 借的是嘉宾姓 John Banks 里的 Banks（人名）和后文
谈经济、税收的氛围，骗人误以为他在银行工作过。实际他干的是 worked as a political
consultant，与银行无关。
借用原文：John Banks

questions.stem: What does the woman say is the most controversial?

options.label: A
options.text: The man's ideas about education.

options.label: B
options.text: The man's academic background.

options.label: C
options.text: The man's attempts at drawing public attention.

options.label: D
options.text: The man's proposals to solve economic problems.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） The man's ideas about education.
【定位】You discuss three of those problems in the book, improving public education, reducing our
nation's healthcare burden, and increasing personal savings. But your ideas about education
are the most controversial.
你在书里谈了其中三个问题：改善公共教育、减轻国家医疗负担、增加个人储蓄。但你关于
教育的主张最具争议。
【信号】转折 But + 最高级 the most controversial。信号是女方话里的转折加最高级 But your
ideas about education are the most controversial.——But 之后才是她真正想强调的落
点，the most controversial 直接点名争议所在。
【替换】your ideas about education are the most controversial ↔ The man's ideas about education.
近乎原句，只换 your→The man's
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
The man's academic background. 盗用了前文 let's talk about your background 里的
background。但谈背景是 But 之前的铺垫闲聊，女方明确说"最有争议"的是教育主张，不
是背景。
借用原文：let's talk about your background
C) 偷换概念
The man's attempts at drawing public attention. 借了前文 why it's getting so much
attention 里的 attention。原文 attention 指的是"书为何受关注"，并非说他"刻意博关
注"，是把客观受关注偷换成主观博眼球。
借用原文：why it's getting so much attention
D) 偷换概念
The man's proposals to solve economic problems. 沾了全书谈经济问题的大背景。但女
方点名最具争议的是 education（教育）这一具体领域，不是笼统的"经济提案"，范围对不
上。
借用原文：problems in our country

questions.stem: What does the man say is his real goal?

options.label: A
options.text: To reduce students' financial burden.

options.label: B
options.text: To motivate all students to be successful.

options.label: C
options.text: To give students incentive to excel in economics.

options.label: D
options.text: To provide remedies for students' poor performance.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） To motivate all students to be successful.
【定位】A lot of people think I'm trying to punish students who aren't doing well, when actually my
goal is to give all students more incentive to succeed.
很多人以为我想惩罚成绩不好的学生，其实我的目标是给所有学生更多动力去取得成功。
【信号】actually + my goal is 的澄清句。信号是他亲口纠正误解的句子 when actually my goal
is to give all students more incentive to succeed——actually 推翻前面"人们以为"的误
解，my goal is 直接交代真实目的，正是 real goal 题的答案落点。
【替换】to give all students more incentive to succeed ↔ To motivate all students to be successful.
give incentive=motivate，succeed=be successful
【排除】A) 未提及
To reduce students' financial burden. 谈减轻经济负担，但他在第 6 段说的目的是"给学
生动力"，与减负无关；减负是另一个层面的话题，文中没把它当作他的目标。
C) 原词陷阱
To give students incentive to excel in economics. 几乎照搬原话 give … incentive，却
把 all students to succeed 偷偷缩成 excel in economics（在经济学上拔尖）。他要激励
的是所有学生取得成功，不限于经济这一科。
借用原文：to give all students more incentive to succeed
D) 与原文相反
To provide remedies for students' poor performance. 借了女方后文 poor
performance in school 的原词，听着像"针对差生补救"。但他的目的恰恰不是只盯差生
——这正是他要澄清反对的"惩罚差生"那层误解的变体。
借用原文：poor performance in school isn't a child's fault

questions.stem: What will be one option for funding the proposed rewards according to the man?

options.label: A
options.text: Improving school budgeting.

options.label: B
options.text: Increasing tuition fees.

options.label: C
options.text: Seeking donations.

options.label: D
options.text: Raising taxes.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Raising taxes.
【定位】Well, by increasing taxes or moving money from other areas of the budget into education.
嗯，靠加税，或者把预算中其他领域的钱挪到教育上来。
【信号】对被问者"钱怎么出"的直接应答。信号是被问方对女方提问 How will we fund the
rewards in the meantime? 的直接应答 by increasing taxes or moving money from
other areas——对话题里问题落在哪、答案就在被问者那句应答里。
【替换】by increasing taxes ↔ Raising taxes.
increase taxes=raise taxes
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
Improving school budgeting. 盗用了原话 moving money from other areas of the
budget 里的 budget。但他说的是"把预算里别处的钱挪进教育"，不是"改善学校的预算编
制"，做法被偷换。
借用原文：moving money from other areas of the budget into education
B) 未提及
Increasing tuition fees. 与正确项 Raising taxes. 共用 increase/raise 结构、都谈"加钱"，
极易混。但他全程没提涨学费，只说加税和挪预算，tuition 是凭"学校、学生"话题脑补的。
C) 未提及
Seeking donations. 即募集捐款，录音里他只给了加税和挪预算两条路，从没提过募捐，
属凭"筹钱"话题硬补的选项。

questions.stem: Why is the speaker launching a campaign?

options.label: A
options.text: To show his sympathy towards people always being busy.

options.label: B
options.text: To prevent people from complaining about being "busy".

options.label: C
options.text: To call on busy people to take care of themselves.

options.label: D
options.text: To help busy people to sort out their priorities.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （目的题） To prevent people from complaining about being "busy".
【定位】So I'm launching a campaign to stop people complaining about being "busy."
所以我要发起一场运动，让大家别再抱怨『忙』了。
【信号】to 引出意图，紧跟在 campaign 后。答案句里 campaign 后面紧跟一个 to stop people
complaining，这个不定式直接交代了发起运动的目的——听到 launching a campaign
to… 时，to 后面那一截就是答案落点，这是目的题最典型的信号。
【替换】to stop people complaining about being "busy." ↔
To prevent people from complaining about being "busy".
stop = prevent，近义替换
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
A 项 To show his sympathy towards people always being busy. 利用了原文 you being
busy doesn't make me sympathetic at all 里的 sympathetic 一词，但原话是『一点也不
让我同情』，说话人恰恰是不同情，A 把否定听成了肯定、方向反了。
借用原文：you being busy doesn't make me sympathetic at all
C) 未提及
C 项 To call on busy people to take care of themselves. 说发起运动是为了呼吁忙人照顾
好自己，但全文从未提到 take care of themselves，说话人发起运动是为了让人别再抱怨
忙，而非关心忙人的健康，属凭常识臆造。
D) 原词陷阱
D 项 To help busy people to sort out their priorities. 借了原文 it's just about priorities
里的 priorities 一词，但那句是在第四段解释『没人真的太忙、只是优先级问题』，并不是
发起运动的目的；D 把后文一个无关概念词搬来充当发起动机，张冠李戴。
借用原文：nobody is too busy—it's just about priorities

questions.stem: What does the speaker advise us to do next time someone asks how we are?

options.label: A
options.text: Avoid saying we are busy.

options.label: B
options.text: Reflect on their true purpose.

options.label: C
options.text: Describe our schedule in detail.

options.label: D
options.text: Respond as most busy people do.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Avoid saying we are busy.
【定位】So the next time someone asks you how you are, maybe respond differently.
所以下次有人问你『最近怎么样』，也许可以换个方式回答。
【信号】next time + maybe，建议信号。答案句以 So the next time someone asks you how
you are 起头、接 maybe respond differently，next time 与建议词 maybe 连用，正是
说话人给建议的标志句——听到 maybe / you should / next time 一类软建议词，后面那
句就是建议内容。
【替换】respond differently ↔ Avoid saying we are busy.
differently 的具体所指 = 别再说忙
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
B 项 Reflect on their true purpose. 借了原文反复出现的 purpose（their real purpose）
一词，但说话人在第四段讲 real purpose 是在解释『忙是借口』，并没有建议我们『去反
思真正目的』；B 把别处的概念词搬来当本题建议，答非所问。
借用原文：they're not actually accomplishing their real purpose
C) 原词陷阱
C 项 Describe our schedule in detail. 用了原文出现过的 schedule（YOUR spot on their
schedule），但说话人从没建议我们详细描述自己的日程，反而是在反对把『忙』挂嘴边；
C 借 schedule 一词编了个原文没给的建议。
借用原文：it's a reflection of YOUR spot on their schedule
D) 与原文相反
D 项 Respond as most busy people do. 说『像多数忙人那样回答』，但原文恰恰让你
respond differently（换个方式、不要照旧），D 取了与建议完全相反的方向，正话反说。
借用原文：maybe respond differently

questions.stem: Why do many people make the "I'm busy" response according to the speaker?

options.label: A
options.text: To show their achievements resulted from great efforts.

options.label: B
options.text: To prove they stand out as accomplished professionals.

options.label: C
options.text: To cover up their failure to achieve some purpose.

options.label: D
options.text: To tell others a complete lie about their inability.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） To cover up their failure to achieve some purpose.
【定位】In my experience, the "I'm busy" response is really covering up the fact that they're not
actually accomplishing their real purpose.
以我的经验，『我很忙』这种回答其实是在掩盖一个事实——他们并没有真正完成自己真正
的目标。
【信号】really + covering up，点出真实原因。答案句里 is really covering up the fact 的 really
（其实/真正）是揭示真相的强调信号，covering up（掩盖）直接说出动机——听到 really
/ actually / the truth is 这类点真相的词，后面就是说话人要你听到的真实原因。
【替换】covering up the fact that they're not actually accomplishing their real purpose ↔
To cover up their failure to achieve some purpose.
没做成 = failure，概念升级
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
A 项 To show their achievements resulted from great efforts. 用了与原文
accomplished 同根的 achievements，但原文 "being busy" doesn't…mean…
accomplished 明说忙并不等于有成就，说话人是在否定『忙=有成就』，A 却说人们这么
答是为了炫耀成就，方向反了。
借用原文："being busy" doesn't stand out, nor does it mean productive, creative, accomplished,
or professional
B) 原词陷阱
B 项 To prove they stand out as accomplished professionals. 同时搬了原文 stand
out、accomplished、professional 三个原词，迷惑性很强，但原文那句是说『忙并不让人
显得突出、也不代表专业』，是否定；B 反过来说人们答忙是为了证明自己是杰出专业人
士，与原意相反、也不是题目问的真实动机。
借用原文："being busy" doesn't stand out, nor does it mean productive, creative, accomplished,
or professional
D) 原词陷阱
D 项 To tell others a complete lie about their inability. 借了原文 the lie they tell
themselves 的 lie，但原文说的是『他们对自己撒的谎』、且没有 complete（彻底）这种
程度，D 改成『对别人说彻底的谎、关于自己的无能』，对象（自己→别人）和程度（a
lie→a complete lie）都被篡改、过度夸大。
借用原文："being busy" is the lie they tell themselves about why they can't achieve it

questions.stem: What may sound strange to say about extreme sports?

options.label: A
options.text: They will help one reduce fear

options.label: B
options.text: They should become so popular.

options.label: C
options.text: They will be less challenging after a time.

options.label: D
options.text: They should cover so many different types.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） They will help one reduce fear
【定位】It may sound strange to say that their main function is to reduce fear.
要说极限运动的主要作用是减少恐惧，这听起来也许有点奇怪。
【信号】题干原话 sound strange 在原文回响。原文 It may sound strange to say that their
main function is to reduce fear 把题干里的 may sound strange to say 几乎原样念出，
这种"题干措辞在原文重现"是最强定位信号，紧跟其后的 to reduce fear 即答案内容。
【替换】their main function is to reduce fear ↔ They will help one reduce fear
main function = will help，reduce fear 原义保留
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
第1段确实念到 Why are these sports becoming so popular?，They should become so
popular 把 popular 原词搬来；但"流行"是全文引子，并非那句"听起来奇怪"的说法，属听
到原词就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：Why are these sports becoming so popular?
C) 未提及
They will be less challenging after a time 听起来"奇怪"但录音从未说极限运动会"变得不
那么有挑战"；它蹭了第2段 after a time 这个时间词，却把内容编造成"难度下降"，属未提
及。
借用原文：after a time, your fear response to other things in life will be dramatically reduced
D) 张冠李戴
第1段列举 snowboarding, skateboarding, mountain biking, and many more，They
should cover so many different types 借此说"涵盖很多类型"；但这是开篇举例，不是题
干所指那句"听起来奇怪"的话，张冠李戴。
借用原文：snowboarding, skateboarding, mountain biking, and many more

questions.stem: Why should one be highly focused when doing extreme sports?

options.label: A
options.text: To break one's ultimate limits.

options.label: B
options.text: To stop being extremely afraid.

options.label: C
options.text: To avoid dangerous mistakes.

options.label: D
options.text: To enjoy the sports to the full.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） To avoid dangerous mistakes.
【定位】You'll be pushed to your limits, and if you aren't focused you'll make dangerous mistakes.
你会被逼到极限，如果不专注，就会犯危险的错误。
【信号】if 引出的因果条件句。if you aren't focused you'll make dangerous mistakes 是个 if 条
件句："不专注→犯危险错误"，反过来即"专注是为了避免危险错误"。if…you'll… 的因果结
构就是原因题的答案信号。
【替换】if you aren't focused you'll make dangerous mistakes ↔ To avoid dangerous mistakes
肯否转换：不专注就犯错 = 专注为避免犯错
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
原文 You'll be pushed to your limits 念到 limits，To break one's ultimate limits 抢用
limits 制造"听到就选"；但原文是"你会被逼到极限"，并非"专注是为了突破极限"，属原词
陷阱。
借用原文：You'll be pushed to your limits
B) 张冠李戴
To stop being extremely afraid 对应的是第2段"减少恐惧"的内容，与第3段"为什么要专
注"无关；把别段的好处安到本题，张冠李戴。
借用原文：their main function is to reduce fear
D) 未提及
To enjoy the sports to the full 听着合理，但录音从没说"专注是为了把运动玩到尽兴"；它
无原文出处，是凭常识编出来的，属未提及。

questions.stem: How can extreme sports benefit us more than standard exercise routines and sports?

options.label: A
options.text: By allowing our motivation to be at an all-time high.

options.label: B
options.text: By stopping us hurting the same muscles repeatedly.

options.label: C
options.text: By burning as many as 300 calories per hour.

options.label: D
options.text: By enabling us to get an all-over workout.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） By enabling us to get an all-over workout.
【定位】With extreme sports, you'll be working entirely different muscles, and that means you get an
all-over workout.
做极限运动时，你会动用到完全不同的肌肉，这意味着你能得到全身锻炼。
【信号】对比 + that means 引出结论。前句 standard exercise routines and sports only work
the same muscles repeatedly 与本句"动用完全不同肌肉"形成对比，that means you get
an all-over workout 用 that means 把结论点出——"对比 + that means 的结论"就是答
案信号。
【替换】that means you get an all-over workout ↔ By enabling us to get an all-over workout
that means = By enabling us to，all-over workout 原义保留
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
By allowing our motivation to be at an all-time high 盗用第5段 your self-confidence
will be at an all-time high 的 all-time high；但原文说的是"自信"达到最高、且与"比常规
运动好在哪"无关，且把 self-confidence 偷换成 motivation，原词陷阱兼偷换概念。
借用原文：your self-confidence will be at an all-time high
B) 与原文相反
原文说常规运动 only work the same muscles repeatedly（反复练同一块肌肉，是它的不
足）；By stopping us hurting the same muscles repeatedly 盗用 same muscles
repeatedly，却把它说成极限运动的益处方式，与原文指向相反。
借用原文：only work the same muscles repeatedly
C) 原词陷阱
原文 Basketball burns around 300 in the same time，300 是篮球的消耗；极限运动（滑
板）是 can burn as many as 500 calories per hour。By burning as many as 300
calories per hour 故意配错数字，是典型数字陷阱。
借用原文：Basketball burns around 300 in the same time

questions.stem: What does the passage say about conflict in organizations?

options.label: A
options.text: It is natural.

options.label: B
options.text: It is instrumental.

options.label: C
options.text: It is personal.

options.label: D
options.text: It is vital.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） It is natural.
【定位】Conflict is natural. We all bring different life and work experiences to the table.
冲突是自然的。我们每个人都把各自不同的生活和工作经历带到一起来。
【信号】is + 形容词的直接定性。答案信号是一句最直白的判断句 Conflict is natural.——主语正是
题问的 conflict，紧跟 is + 形容词给它定性，这种'X is + 形容词'的下定义句就是定性题的
落点。
【替换】Conflict is natural. ↔ It is natural.
代词替换+原词保留
【排除】B) 未提及
It is instrumental.（起工具/促进作用的）原文从未用来形容冲突，是凭空安上的形容词，
与定性句 Conflict is natural. 不符。
C) 原词陷阱
原文后文确实提到 We all have different personality preferences and tendencies.，It is
personal. 盗用了 personality 这个原词，让人觉得'听到了'。但那句是在解释冲突为何自
然，并非给冲突定性为'个人的'，属答非所问。
借用原文：We all have different personality preferences and tendencies.
D) 原词陷阱
It is vital. 盗用的是第 3 段 Productive conflict is a vital part of teams and
organizations 里的 vital，但那是形容'有益的冲突 productive conflict'，而本题问的是冲
突本身的性质，原文这里给的定性是 natural，不是 vital。
借用原文：Productive conflict is a vital part of teams and organizations

questions.stem: Why do some people want to avoid conflict at all costs?

options.label: A
options.text: To guard against being perceived negatively.

options.label: B
options.text: To prevent themselves from being isolated.

options.label: C
options.text: To conceal personality preferences.

options.label: D
options.text: To maintain workplace harmony.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） To maintain workplace harmony.
【定位】But too often we get caught in this place where conflict is perceived to be negative—
something we want to avoid so that we can maintain the harmony of our workplace.
但我们常常陷入这样一种境地：冲突被视为负面的东西——一种我们想要回避的东西，以便
能维持工作场所的和谐。
【信号】so that 引出目的。答案信号是表目的的连接词 so that：something we want to avoid
so that we can maintain the harmony of our workplace，so that 之后正是'回避冲突'的
目的，这就是 Why 题要的落点。
【替换】so that we can maintain the harmony of our workplace ↔ To maintain workplace harmony.
语序压缩+同词复现
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
To guard against being perceived negatively. 盗用了原文 conflict is perceived to be
negative 里的 perceived/negative，听起来很耳熟。但原文那句是说'冲突被视为负面'，
是回避的背景，不是人们回避冲突所追求的目的，属答非所问。
借用原文：conflict is perceived to be negative
B) 未提及
To prevent themselves from being isolated.（防止自己被孤立）原文从未提到'被孤立'，
是凭空添加的目的，与 so that 后的'维持和谐'无关。
C) 原词陷阱
To conceal personality preferences. 盗用第 1 段 We all have different personality
preferences and tendencies. 里的 personality preferences，但那是讲冲突为何自然，
跟'回避冲突的目的'毫不相干，且原文没有'隐藏 conceal'之意。
借用原文：We all have different personality preferences and tendencies.

questions.stem: Why is productive conflict important for teams and organizations?

options.label: A
options.text: It helps to enhance team spirit.

options.label: B
options.text: It stimulates innovative ideas.

options.label: C
options.text: It helps to resolve problems.

options.label: D
options.text: It facilitates policy-making.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） It stimulates innovative ideas.
【定位】Without conflict, we're often stuck in this artificial harmony where people don't express
potentially innovative ideas for fear that they may start conflict with others.
没有冲突，我们往往困在这种虚假的和谐里，人们由于害怕会与他人引发冲突，而不去表达
那些可能很有创新性的想法。
【信号】Without...反面论证。答案信号是 Without conflict 引出的反面假设：没有冲突，人们就不
敢说出 potentially innovative ideas。反过来即说明'有益的冲突'的价值就在于能让创新想
法被表达出来，这是从反面点出作用的落点。
【替换】people don't express potentially innovative ideas ↔ It stimulates innovative ideas.
否定反推+同词保留
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
It helps to enhance team spirit. 借了原文反复出现的 team(s)，让人一听 team 就想选。
但原文说冲突带来的是 innovation 与 trust，从未说它增强'团队精神 team spirit'，属答非
所问。
借用原文：greater trust on teams
C) 原词陷阱
It helps to resolve problems. 利用第 1 段 how to approach policies, programs or
problems 里的 problems 一词，但那是说大家对如何处理问题有分歧（冲突的来源），并
非说冲突能'解决问题'，是偷换概念。
借用原文：how to approach policies, programs or problems
D) 原词陷阱
It facilitates policy-making. 把第 1 段 approach policies, programs or problems 中的
policies 改头换面成 policy-making，但原文从未说冲突有助于'制定政策'，是无中生有的
作用。
借用原文：how to approach policies, programs or problems

questions.stem: What does productive conflict need as a basis?

options.label: A
options.text: An innovative mind.

options.label: B
options.text: Corporate culture.

options.label: C
options.text: Mutual trust.

options.label: D
options.text: A healthy mentality.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Mutual trust.
【定位】But if you're in a place where you have a basis of trust, conflict can be extremely productive.
但如果你处在一个有信任基础的环境里，冲突可以变得极富成效。
【信号】a basis of 直接点前提。答案信号就是题干同款词 basis：if you're in a place where you
have a basis of trust，a basis of 后面紧跟的 trust 正是冲突变得有益所需的基础，与设问
的 as a basis 直接对上。
【替换】a basis of trust ↔ Mutual trust.
核心词同+补足限定
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
An innovative mind. 盗用原文多次出现的 innovative/innovation，但创新在原文里是冲
突带来的'结果'（lead to increased innovation），不是它需要的'基础'，前提与结果被颠
倒。
借用原文：It can lead to increased innovation
B) 未提及
Corporate culture.（企业文化）原文从未提及，是借'谈职场就该有企业文化'的常识硬塞
的，与 basis of trust 无关。
D) 原词陷阱
A healthy mentality. 盗用原文 good leaders and healthy teams 里的 healthy，但那是
形容'健康的团队'，而非冲突所需的'健康心态 mentality'，原文也没说前提是某种心态，是
张冠李戴。
借用原文：good leaders and healthy teams

questions.stem: Why did the six residents have to find another place to stay?

options.label: A
options.text: Due to a fire alarm in their apartments.

options.label: B
options.text: Because of the smoke and heat damage.

options.label: C
options.text: Due to the water used to extinguish the flames.

options.label: D
options.text: Because of the collapse of the three-story building.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Because of the smoke and heat damage.
【定位】Due to smoke and heat damage, the four apartments were declared uninhabitable, and the six
residents had to move to another place, officials said.
由于烟雾和高温造成的损坏，这四套公寓被判定为不适宜居住，六位居民因此不得不搬到别
处，官方表示。
【信号】因果信号 Due to 引出原因。答案句以 Due to smoke and heat damage 开头，Due to
是明确的因果信号，紧接着就是结果 the six residents had to move to another place
——「原因 + 结果」同句出现，这一句就是答案句。
【替换】Due to smoke and heat damage ↔ Because of the smoke and heat damage
Due to 与 Because of 同义替换
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
A 说因 a fire alarm in their apartments（公寓里的火警铃）。录音确实通篇讲 fire（火
灾），但从没说居民因为「火警铃响」才搬走，搬离的真正原因是烟热损坏。它借你对 fire
的耳熟来骗选。
借用原文：a fire broke out in a building
C) 原词陷阱
C 说因 the water used to extinguish the flames（灭火用的水）。录音里确有
extinguishing the flames（扑灭火焰）这个动作，但只讲了灭火过程，从没说「水渍」让
公寓不能住。它盗用 extinguish the flames 制造熟悉感。
借用原文：extinguishing the flames
D) 原词陷阱
D 说因 the collapse of the three-story building（三层楼坍塌）。录音确有 the three-
story building（三层楼）这个词，但全文只字未提坍塌，反而说 No injuries were
reported（无人受伤）。它盗用 three-story building，再编一个没发生的「坍塌」。
借用原文：the three-story building

questions.stem: What does the news report say the Norwalk Fire Marshal is doing?

options.label: A
options.text: Investigating the cause of the incident.

options.label: B
options.text: Helping search for the suspect of the crime.

options.label: C
options.text: Rescuing the businessmen trapped in the building.

options.label: D
options.text: Checking town records for the property developer.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Investigating the cause of the incident.
【定位】The Norwalk Fire Marshal is investigating the cause and origin of the fire.
诺沃克消防局长正在调查这场火灾的起因和源头。
【信号】主体名 Fire Marshal 后的动作。录音末句直接出现题目要找的主体 The Norwalk Fire
Marshal，紧跟其后的动词 is investigating the cause and origin of the fire 就是它正在
做的事——主体名 + 进行时动作，这句即答案句。
【替换】investigating the cause and origin of the fire ↔ Investigating the cause of the incident
the fire 概括为 the incident
【排除】B) 未提及
B 说在 Helping search for the suspect of the crime（帮忙搜捕嫌犯）。录音通篇是火灾
事故，没有任何「嫌犯 / 犯罪」字眼，消防局长做的是调查起因，不是抓人。
C) 原词陷阱
C 说在 Rescuing the businessmen trapped in the building（营救被困商人）。录音确实
提到一楼有 commercial businesses（商铺），但明说 No injuries were reported（无人
受伤），根本没人被困需救。它借 businesses 谐想出 businessmen 来诱选。
借用原文：commercial businesses
D) 张冠李戴
D 说在 Checking town records for the property developer（为开发商查市镇记录）。
录音确有 Town records list four apartments（市镇记录列有四套公寓）这一句，但 town
records 只是新闻引用的信息来源，消防局长做的是调查起因，没人「为开发商查记录」。
借用原文：Town records list four apartments in the building
Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.
1 A new study has cast doubt on historic research suggesting that the season or month of someone's
birth is associated with an increased risk of certain mental health conditions. The study looks at
symptoms of anxiety and depression among more than 70,000 older adults in Europe.
一项新研究对历史研究提出了质疑,这些历史研究认为某人的出生季节或月份与某些心理健康状况的风险增
加有关。该研究调查了欧洲超过7万名老年人的焦虑和抑郁症状。
2 A number of past studies have found the link between season of birth and mental health diagnoses.
Researchers have suggested that such links could arise from various things. These include nutrient intake,
sun exposure, climate, and disease exposure varying across the course of the year. However, evidence
has been mixed. More recent studies have suggested that factors such as social class or economic
background have more to do with these diagnoses than month of birth.
过去的许多研究发现了出生季节与心理健康诊断之间的联系。研究人员认为,这种联系可能源于各种因素。
这些因素包括全年不同时期的营养摄入、阳光照射、气候和疾病暴露的变化。然而,证据一直是混杂的。最
近的研究表明,社会阶层或经济背景等因素与这些诊断的关系比出生月份更大。
3 Overall, the new study found no significant relationship between participants' month of birth and
symptoms of depression or anxiety. There was some variability in some countries. In Poland, depressive
symptoms fluctuated a little depending on birth month. In the Czech Republic, the same was true of
anxiety symptoms. But on the whole, there was no systematic pattern.
总体而言,这项新研究发现参与者的出生月份与抑郁或焦虑症状之间没有显著关系。在一些国家存在一些变
化。在波兰,抑郁症状根据出生月份有轻微波动。在捷克共和国,焦虑症状也是如此。但总的来说,没有系统
性模式。

questions.stem: What have a number of past studies found about season of birth?

options.label: A
options.text: It plays a less important role in one's health than nutrient intake.

options.label: B
options.text: It impacts people's health to a lesser degree than sun exposure.

options.label: C
options.text: It is associated with people's mental health conditions.

options.label: D
options.text: It is linked with older adults' symptoms of depression.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） It is associated with people's mental health conditions.
【定位】A number of past studies have found the link between season of birth and mental
health diagnoses.
若干过往研究已发现出生季节与心理健康诊断之间存在关联。
【信号】主语原样复现作信号。题干主语 a number of past studies 在录音第 2 段以 A number of
past studies have found 几乎原样出现，这一「问谁就听谁」的主体复现就是定位信号：
被问主体一出现，紧跟其后的 found the link… 即为答案句。
【替换】the link between season of birth and mental health diagnoses ↔
associated with people's mental health conditions
link=associated、diagnoses≈conditions
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
A 用了录音第 2 段确实念到的 nutrient intake 一词，但录音只是把它列为「关联可能的成
因之一」，从没说出生季节「在健康中作用不及营养摄入」。A 把它编成一句子虚乌有的轻
重比较，是听到原词就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：These include nutrient intake, sun exposure, climate, and disease exposure
B) 原词陷阱
B 借用录音里同样念到的 sun exposure，谎称出生季节「对健康的影响不及日晒」。录音
把 sun exposure 与 nutrient intake 并列为可能成因，并未拿它和出生季节比影响大小，
属偷换概念式的原词陷阱。
借用原文：These include nutrient intake, sun exposure, climate, and disease exposure
D) 张冠李戴
D 说关联的是 older adults' symptoms of depression。录音中「老年人」与「抑郁/焦虑
症状」出现在介绍新研究样本（more than 70,000 older adults）与总结处，并非「过往
研究就出生季节发现的关联对象」；过往研究发现的是更宽的 mental health diagnoses。
D 把答案的范围从「心理健康」窄化到「老年人的抑郁症状」，张冠李戴。
借用原文：symptoms of anxiety and depression among more than 70,000 older adults

questions.stem: What did the new study find about the relationship between participants' month of birth and symptoms of depression?

options.label: A
options.text: It was indefinite.

options.label: B
options.text: It was systematic.

options.label: C
options.text: It was straightforward.

options.label: D
options.text: It was insignificant.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） It was insignificant.
【定位】Overall, the new study found no significant relationship between participants' month of birth
and symptoms of depression or anxiety.
总体而言，这项新研究发现参与者的出生月份与抑郁或焦虑症状之间没有显著关联。
【信号】总结词 Overall + 否定 no significant。段首的 Overall 是结论信号，提示这句是新研究的
总判断；其后的 no significant relationship 用「否定 + 程度词」给出定性——这种
「Overall/否定句」往往就是答案落点，前面铺垫的别国小波动都是干扰。
【替换】no significant relationship ↔ It was insignificant.
no significant=insignificant
【排除】A) 过度推断
A 说 It was indefinite.（不确定的）。录音其实给出了明确结论——「没有显著关联」「没
有系统性规律」，态度是确定的「无」，并非含糊不定。把「确定地没有」错听成「不确
定」，是对结论性质的误判。
B) 与原文相反
B 用了录音末句确实念到的 systematic，可原文是 no systematic pattern（没有系统性规
律），带否定。B 抹掉 no，单取 systematic 说成「它是系统性的」，正好与原文意思相
反，是典型听到原词就选、却漏听否定词的陷阱。
借用原文：there was no systematic pattern
C) 未提及
C 说 It was straightforward.（直接明了的）。录音从未用「直接/明了」评价这关系，只
说「无显著关联、无系统规律，部分国家有些小波动」。这个定性原文根本没出现，属凭空
臆造。

questions.stem: What do the researchers' tests show about the cloned dog?

options.label: A
options.text: It has helped solve several murder cases.

options.label: B
options.text: It has become a star office dog in Beijing.

options.label: C
options.text: It has surpassed its mother in performance.

options.label: D
options.text: It has done better than naturally born dogs.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） It has done better than naturally born dogs.
【定位】The clone has already performed better than traditionally bred dogs on several tests.
这只克隆犬在几项测试中已经表现得比传统繁育的狗更好。
【信号】tests一词复现即落点。题干问的是 tests 显示什么，录音第一段末句 performed better
than traditionally bred dogs on several tests 正好出现 tests，又给出明确比较结果，这
种'题干关键词在原文复现+给出结论'的句子就是答案句。
【替换】traditionally bred dogs ↔ naturally born dogs
传统繁育=自然出生
performed better ↔ done better
performed=done同义
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
It has helped solve several murder cases. 偷用了录音里 helped solve multiple
murders 的'破案'信息，但原文说破案的是 The mother dog（母亲），不是这只克隆犬，
把母亲的功劳安到了克隆犬头上。
借用原文：The mother dog helped solve multiple murders and many other crimes.
B) 原词陷阱
It has become a star office dog in Beijing. 拼接了录音里的 star（明星）和 Beijing（北
京）两个原词，但原文只说克隆犬生于北京实验室、母亲是明星警犬，从没说克隆犬变成
了'办公室明星狗'，属拼凑+无中生有。
借用原文：The clone was born in a laboratory in Beijing in December.
C) 偷换概念
It has surpassed its mother in performance. 利用了原文反复提到的 mother（母亲），
但录音说克隆犬与母亲 almost identical genetically（基因几乎相同），并没说它在表现
上'超过'了母亲；它超过的是普通狗，不是母亲。
借用原文：the clone and her mother are almost identical genetically

questions.stem: What is the scientists' purpose in cloning police dogs?

options.label: A
options.text: To speed up investigation into criminal cases.

options.label: B
options.text: To test the feasibility of cloning technology.

options.label: C
options.text: To cut down training expenses.

options.label: D
options.text: To reduce their training time.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （目的题） To reduce their training time.
【定位】The ultimate goal of scientists is to produce clones of talented police dogs that can be trained
in months instead of years.
科学家的最终目标是培育出有天赋的警犬克隆体，使它们能在几个月内、而不是几年内完成
训练。
【信号】ultimate goal点出目的句。录音第二段 The ultimate goal of scientists is to produce
clones 用 goal（目标）直接亮明目的，这正是目的题要等的那句话；其中 in months
instead of years（几个月而非几年）点出意图是缩短时间。
【替换】trained in months instead of years ↔ reduce their training time
几月而非几年=缩短时间
【排除】A) 未提及
To speed up investigation into criminal cases. 借了第一段 crimes（犯罪）的余味，但录
音讲的目的是缩短训练时间，从没说克隆是为了'加快案件调查'，属无中生有。
B) 未提及
To test the feasibility of cloning technology. 听起来很像科研口吻，但录音里克隆的目的
是缩短训练时间，并没说'是为了测试克隆技术是否可行'，是凭常识想当然添上的目的。
C) 偷换概念
To cut down training expenses. 与正解只差一个词：录音说的是省'时间'（months
instead of years），不是省'费用'。原文里 costs（成本）出现在最后一句、说的是'技术成
本高导致目标暂不可行'，是障碍、不是目的，被挪来当目的了。
借用原文：this goal is not yet possible due to the current costs of the technology

questions.stem: Why does the news report say the scientists' goal is not yet possible?

options.label: A
options.text: Cloning is too complicated a process.

options.label: B
options.text: The technology is yet to be accepted.

options.label: C
options.text: Cloning is ethically controversial.

options.label: D
options.text: The technology is too expensive.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） The technology is too expensive.
【定位】However, this goal is not yet possible due to the current costs of the technology.
然而，由于目前这项技术的成本问题，这个目标还无法实现。
【信号】However转折加due to因果。录音第二段末句先用 However 转折（前面说目标美好、这
里说还做不到），再用 due to the current costs of the technology 给出原因，转折+因
果双信号叠在一句，正是 Why 题的标准答案句。
【替换】the current costs of the technology ↔ The technology is too expensive.
成本高=太贵
【排除】A) 未提及
Cloning is too complicated a process. 听上去像个合理障碍，但录音明确把原因归到'成
本'（costs），从没说过程'太复杂'，是凭常识猜的障碍。
B) 偷换概念
The technology is yet to be accepted. 借用了录音 not yet possible（还不可行）里 yet
的语感，但原文说做不到是因为贵，不是因为'还没被接受'，属偷换原因。
借用原文：this goal is not yet possible due to the current costs of the technology
C) 未提及
Cloning is ethically controversial. 是一般人一提'克隆'就联想到的伦理争议，但本则新闻
只说障碍是成本，完全没提伦理，是被话题带偏的想当然选项。

questions.stem: How did the man get to know about the book The Three Body Problem?

options.label: A
options.text: He read it somewhere online.

options.label: B
options.text: He heard about it from a coworker.

options.label: C
options.text: He read an article reviewing it.

options.label: D
options.text: He watched a TV series based on it.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） He heard about it from a coworker.
【定位】A colleague mentioned the book, but I've been so busy writing my thesis that I haven't been
able to read for pleasure in months.
一个同事提到过这本书，但我一直忙着写论文，好几个月都没能读点闲书了。
【信号】被问者的直接应答。上一句女士问起这书，男士开口第一句就是 A colleague mentioned
the book——对话题里答案就落在被问者的应答上，这句正面回答了「怎么知道的」，是
答案句。
【替换】A colleague mentioned the book ↔ He heard about it from a coworker
colleague 等于 coworker
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
女士开场说 did you see the article online，选项 He read it somewhere online. 把这个
online 搬过来，但「网上看到」的主语是女士的提问、说的是那篇文章，不是男士得知书的
途径，属答非所问。
借用原文：did you see the article online
C) 偷换概念
录音里的 the article online about the new TV series 是讲改编剧的报道，选项 He read
an article reviewing it. 偷换成「读了一篇评论这本书的文章」，且读文章的是女士不是男
士，既偷换内容又张冠李戴。
借用原文：the article online about the new TV series
D) 与原文相反
录音通篇说剧还没看、甚至还没开播（When is the show supposed to start?），选项 He
watched a TV series based on it. 说他「看了改编剧」与事实相反，男士并没看过剧。
借用原文：the new TV series based on the book

questions.stem: What does the woman say she can't remember about the book's author?

options.label: A
options.text: His publications.

options.label: B
options.text: His first book.

options.label: C
options.text: His address.

options.label: D
options.text: His name.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） His name.
【定位】It's written by a Chinese science fiction writer. I can't remember his name, but he's written
three books in all, and The Three Body Problem is the first in the series.
它是一位中国科幻作家写的。我记不清他的名字了，不过他一共写了三本书，《三体》是这
个系列的第一本。
【信号】题干原词 can't remember 直接命中。题干问 can't remember，录音里女士原话就有 I
can't remember his name——can't remember 这个词组是直接信号，它后面紧跟的 his
name 就是答案。
【替换】I can't remember his name ↔ His name.
原句直接点名 name
【排除】A) 答非所问
选项 His publications. 对应录音 he's written three books in all——但作者的著作女士记
得清清楚楚（连写了三本、《三体》是第一本都说得出），她记不清的不是这个。
借用原文：he's written three books in all
B) 答非所问
选项 His first book. 对应录音 The Three Body Problem is the first in the series，女士
明确说得出第一本是《三体》，可见她记得，并非记不清的那一项。
借用原文：The Three Body Problem is the first in the series
C) 未提及
选项 His address. 的 address 听起来像录音里某个词，但全篇女士只字未提作者的「住
址」或「演讲」，这是无中生有。

questions.stem: What does the man have to do to finish his thesis?

options.label: A
options.text: Collect a lot more data.

options.label: B
options.text: Relax a bit less often.

options.label: C
options.text: Clarify many new concepts.

options.label: D
options.text: Read more reference books.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Collect a lot more data.
【定位】I'm a bit overwhelmed with the amount of data I still need to collect to finish my thesis.
为了完成论文，我还有大量数据要收集，这让我有点应付不过来。
【信号】still need to + 题干同词 finish thesis。男士说 the amount of data I still need to
collect to finish my thesis，still need to（还得）是「不得不做」的信号词，且 finish my
thesis 与题干 finish his thesis 撞词，这句正面回答了「为完成论文要做什么」。
【替换】the amount of data I still need to collect ↔ Collect a lot more data.
still collect 等于 collect more
【排除】B) 与原文相反
录音里男士说 But I still need to relax sometimes.——他强调「仍然需要放松」，选项
Relax a bit less often. 却说「少放松一点」，把 relax 这个原词拿走后反着说，与原意相
反。
借用原文：I still need to relax sometimes
C) 原词陷阱
选项 Clarify many new concepts. 的 concepts 来自女士说书里有 some amazing
technological and sociological concepts，那是夸书内容精彩，跟男士完成论文要做的事
毫无关系。
借用原文：some amazing technological and sociological concepts
D) 未提及
选项 Read more reference books. 蹭录音里反复出现的 read/book，但全篇说的「读」是
读《三体》这本闲书，没有任何「读参考书做论文」的内容，属无中生有。
借用原文：read the book first

questions.stem: What will the man most probably do first after the conversation?

options.label: A
options.text: Find out the show's most interesting episodes.

options.label: B
options.text: Watch the series together with the woman.

options.label: C
options.text: Get an e-copy of the book to read.

options.label: D
options.text: Check to see when the show starts.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （推断题） Get an e-copy of the book to read.
【定位】Well, maybe you could download an electronic copy of the book and try to read it before the
show starts.
嗯，也许你可以下载一本电子版的书，试着在剧开播之前把它读了。
【信号】建议句 + before the show starts 定先后。女士给出建议 maybe you could download
an electronic copy of the book and try to read it before the show starts，建议句是落
点；before the show starts（在开播前）明确点出「先读书」的次序，男士随即 That's a
good idea. 接受，故「先弄电子书读」被敲定。
【替换】download an electronic copy of the book and try to read it ↔ Get an e-copy of the book to read
download e-copy 等于 get e-copy
before the show starts ↔ Get an e-copy of the book to read
开播前读定下了先后
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 Find out the show's most interesting episodes. 蹭了录音里 There are 24
episodes. 的 episodes，但女士只说有 24 集，从没提「找最精彩的几集」，属无中生有。
借用原文：There are 24 episodes
B) 答非所问
男士确实说 maybe we can watch the series together，但那是「然后(and then)」「也
许」之后的安排，要等读完书、剧开播。题目问 first（最先），先做的是读书不是看剧。
借用原文：maybe we can watch the series together
D) 原词陷阱
选项 Check to see when the show starts. 来自男士问 When is the show supposed to
start?，但女士回 I can't remember exactly，且最终敲定的下一步是「先读书」，并没有
让他去查开播时间。
借用原文：When is the show supposed to start?

questions.stem: Why does the woman call the man?

options.label: A
options.text: To check the prices of his farm produce.

options.label: B
options.text: To ask the way to the Newcastle City Hall.

options.label: C
options.text: To inquire about the vegetarian food festival.

options.label: D
options.text: To seek the man's help with her work on the farm.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （目的题） To inquire about the vegetarian food festival.
【定位】I have an inquiry to make. It's about the vegetarian food festival you are holding on the 19th
of August at the Newcastle City Hall.
我有件事想咨询。是关于你们将在8月19日于纽卡斯尔市政厅举办的素食美食节的。
【信号】开场自报来意。女方一上来就说 I have an inquiry to make（我要咨询一件事），紧接着
点明 It's about the vegetarian food festival——开场"我打电话是为了……"的自述就是目
的题的答案句信号。
【替换】an inquiry to make ↔ inquire about
名词换动词同义
the vegetarian food festival ↔ the vegetarian food festival
话题对象一致
【排除】A) 未提及
录音里女方说自己 I grow organic vegetables on my farm，A借"农产品"做文章编出 To
check the prices of his farm produce."查菜价"，但全程没人提价格，属凭印象的臆造。
B) 原词陷阱
录音确实念到 the Newcastle City Hall，B便顺势编成 To ask the way to the Newcastle
City Hall."问去市政厅的路"。但市政厅只是节日地点，女方从没问路，这是"听到地名就
选"的原词陷阱。
借用原文：the Newcastle City Hall
D) 偷换概念
录音里 I grow organic vegetables on my farm 提到了农场，D便编成 To seek the man's
help with her work on the farm."求男方帮她干农活"。实际是她想在节上卖货，不是求人
帮农活，方向反了。
借用原文：I grow organic vegetables on my farm

questions.stem: What is the man still looking for?

options.label: A
options.text: Bakers.

options.label: B
options.text: Vendors.

options.label: C
options.text: Vegetarians.

options.label: D
options.text: Organisers.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Vendors.
【定位】It says on your website that you are still looking for vendors, and I grow organic vegetables
on my farm, as well as doing my own home baking.
你们网站上说你们还在找摊主，而我在自家农场种有机蔬菜，也自己在家做烘焙。
【信号】still looking for直接给出招募对象。女方转述网站内容 you are still looking for
vendors，still looking for 正是"还在招"的信号，紧跟其后的 vendors 就是答案对象。
【替换】vendors ↔ Vendors.
原词对应
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
女方说自己 doing my own home baking（在家做烘焙），A便顺手把她说成 Bakers."面
包师"。但她只是会烘焙的摊主之一，男方招的是"摊主"不是"面包师"，属听到 baking 就联
想的误选。
借用原文：doing my own home baking
C) 原词陷阱
节日叫 vegetarian food festival，C便取 Vegetarians."素食者"充数。但"素食"是节日主
题，不是男方招募的人群，男方招的是卖货的摊主。
借用原文：vegetarian food festival
D) 张冠李戴
男方一方正是办活动的组织者，D取 Organisers."组织者"反而是他们自己的身份，不是"还
在找"的对象，角色装反了。

questions.stem: What does the man say they are getting close to?

options.label: A
options.text: The issuing of certificates to vendors.

options.label: B
options.text: The completion of the baking task.

options.label: C
options.text: The festival they are organising.

options.label: D
options.text: The deadline for application.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） The deadline for application.
【定位】That's exactly the type of thing we are looking for. We're getting close to the
deadline, however.
这正是我们想要的那种摊位。不过，我们快到截止日期了。
【信号】getting close to紧跟落点。男方说 We're getting close to the deadline，getting close
to 这一"临近"信号后面紧跟 the deadline，即他们正逼近的那件事。
【替换】the deadline ↔ The deadline for application.
概括补全为完整短语
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音确有 all your certificates 和 certificates will be checked 之说，A拼成 The issuing
of certificates to vendors."给摊主发证书"。但证书是报名时要备齐、会被审核，录音并没
说"快到发证书"，且"发证"也非原文之意，是借证书原词的拼凑。
借用原文：all your certificates
B) 原词陷阱
女方提过 home baking，B据此编成 The completion of the baking task."烘焙任务完
成"。但录音从没说"快完成烘焙"，且"close to"接的是 deadline 不是 baking。
借用原文：home baking
C) 答非所问
The festival they are organising. 取了贯穿全程的话题 the vegetarian food festival，
但"快到美食节"并不是男方所说，他说的是快到截止日。话题对、答非所问。
借用原文：the vegetarian food festival

questions.stem: What does the man finally ask the woman to remember?

options.label: A
options.text: The closing date of submission.

options.label: B
options.text: The website of his company.

options.label: C
options.text: The details of the ceremony.

options.label: D
options.text: The organiser's address.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） The closing date of submission.
【定位】Remember that the closing date is next Tuesday, the 28th of June.
记住，截止日期是下周二，也就是6月28日。
【信号】结尾Remember领出叮嘱。男方在对话末尾说 Remember that the closing date is next
Tuesday，Remember that 是"特意叮嘱"的信号，其后的 the closing date 即他要她记住
的事。
【替换】the closing date ↔ The closing date of submission.
补出提交语境
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
录音前面女方提过 It says on your website，B便取 The website of his company."他公司
的网址"。但网址出现在对话前段、且不是男方让她记住的事，Remember 点的是截止日不
是网址。
借用原文：It says on your website
C) 未提及
The details of the ceremony."典礼细节"录音里压根没出现过 ceremony 这个事，是凭空
捏造的干扰。
D) 原词陷阱
男方确实在同段报了地址 Please address it to the Organic Organization，D据此取 The
organiser's address.。但地址是应女方"give me your details"的请求顺带给的，被
Remember 单独叮嘱的是"截止日"，不是地址，属"听到地址就选"的原词陷阱。
借用原文：Please address it to the Organic Organization

questions.stem: Why has wild camping become popular in the UK?

options.label: A
options.text: Most scenic sites have been closed.

options.label: B
options.text: Access to official campsites is limited.

options.label: C
options.text: Health experts advise going outdoors.

options.label: D
options.text: People have more time during the summer.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Access to official campsites is limited.
【定位】In part, this reflects the fact that official campsites have been wholly or partially closed, or are
overflowing in a summer when fewer people are going abroad.
在一定程度上，这反映出一个事实：正规营地已经全部或部分关闭，或者在出国人数减少的
这个夏天人满为患。
【信号】原因信号 this reflects the fact that。this reflects the fact that 是典型的解释原因句
式，后面紧跟的 official campsites have been wholly or partially closed, or are
overflowing 就是"野营为何流行"的直接答案。这种"反映出/源于"的句子，正是原因题该锁
定的答案句。
【替换】official campsites have been wholly or partially closed, or are overflowing ↔
Access to official campsites is limited.
"关闭/人满"概括为"使用受限"
【排除】A) 偷换概念
录音关闭的是 official campsites（正规露营营地），不是 scenic sites（风景景点）。A
把"营地"偷换成"景点"，听着相似却不是同一回事。
借用原文：official campsites have been wholly or partially closed
C) 原词陷阱
录音确实提到 a desire for going outdoors（向往户外），C 也写 going outdoors，原词
重合很诱人。但录音说的是"普通人的一种向往"，从没说是 Health experts（健康专家）建
议的；且这只是次要补充原因（it may also be），不是题干所问的主因。听到 going
outdoors 就选 C，正中原词陷阱。
借用原文：an expression of a desire for going outdoors
D) 原词陷阱
录音里 in a summer（夏天）确实出现，让 D 的 during the summer 显得耳熟。但录音
从未说人们"有更多时间（more time）"，这是凭空添加的原因。盗了"夏天"一个词，就编
出一个录音没讲的理由。
借用原文：in a summer when fewer people are going abroad

questions.stem: Why is camping banned for part of the summer in public parks?

options.label: A
options.text: It is strongly opposed by nearby residents.

options.label: B
options.text: It leads to much waste of public money.

options.label: C
options.text: It has caused environmental concerns.

options.label: D
options.text: It has created conflicts among campers.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） It has caused environmental concerns.
【定位】Camping in public parks has now been banned for August and the early part of September
because campers dump litter, human waste, and even their tents on the grassland.
公园露营如今已在八月和九月上旬被禁，因为露营者把垃圾、人体排泄物、甚至帐篷都丢弃
在草地上。
【信号】因果信号 because。because 直接引出禁露营的原因：campers dump litter, human
waste, and even their tents on the grassland。because 后面的内容就是答案句的核心，
因果题听到 because 就该锁定。
【替换】campers dump litter, human waste, and even their tents on the grassland ↔
It has caused environmental concerns.
乱丢垃圾的具体行为概括为环境问题
【排除】A) 未提及
录音只说禁露营是因乱丢垃圾，全程没提 nearby residents（附近居民）反对。这是录音根
本没说的内容，凭常识"居民会嫌吵"补上去就错了。
B) 未提及
录音讲的是垃圾污染草地，从没提 waste of public money（浪费公共资金）。这是凭空添
加的后果，与禁露营的真实原因无关。
D) 原词陷阱
录音反复出现 campers（露营者），D 也写 campers，原词重合很诱人。但录音说的是露
营者"破坏环境"，从没说他们"彼此起冲突（conflicts among campers）"。听到 campers
就选 D，正中原词陷阱。
借用原文：campers dump litter, human waste, and even their tents on the grassland

questions.stem: What does the speaker suggest campers do?

options.label: A
options.text: Look for open land in Scotland.

options.label: B
options.text: Leave no trace of their camping.

options.label: C
options.text: Avoid getting close to wilderness.

options.label: D
options.text: Ask for permission from authorities.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Leave no trace of their camping.
【定位】It would be common sense for people to use small tents and leave no trace of their visit.
人们使用小帐篷、不留下到访的任何痕迹，是合乎常理的做法。
【信号】建议信号 It would be common sense for...to。It would be common sense for
people to 是劝告做法的句式，后面 leave no trace of their visit 就是说话人给露营者的核
心建议。建议题该锁定这类"应当/合乎常理去做"的句子。
【替换】leave no trace of their visit ↔ Leave no trace of their camping.
visit换成camping，近乎同义改写
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音提到 especially outside Scotland（尤其在苏格兰以外），A 也写 Scotland，原词重
合很诱人。但录音是说"在苏格兰以外法律更严、要请求许可"，根本没建议人们"去苏格兰找
开放土地"。听到 Scotland 就选 A，正中原词陷阱。
借用原文：to camp from landowners, especially outside Scotland, where the law is far
more restrictive
C) 与原文相反
录音出现 close to wilderness（靠近荒野），C 也写 wilderness，但录音是说人们"被这块
靠近荒野的土地吸引、有责任维护它"，绝不是叫人 Avoid getting close to wilderness
（避开荒野）。意思被反着说了，盗了原词却背道而驰。
借用原文：They have been attracted by a patch of land this close to wilderness
D) 原词陷阱
录音确说要 ask for permission to camp from landowners（向地主请求许可），D 写
Ask for permission 原词重合很像。但录音的对象是 landowners（土地所有者），D 却换
成了 authorities（官方当局），把请求对象偷换了。听到 ask for permission 就选 D，正
中原词陷阱。
借用原文：wild campers need to ask for permission to camp from landowners

questions.stem: What does the passage say about pink dolphins?

options.label: A
options.text: They outcompete mythical creatures.

options.label: B
options.text: They usually mind their own business.

options.label: C
options.text: They truly exist in the Amazon region.

options.label: D
options.text: They resemble alarmingly large snakes.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） They truly exist in the Amazon region.
【定位】While this may seem like a mythical creature, pink dolphins do exist in the Amazon region.
虽然这看上去像是神话中的生物，但粉色海豚确实存在于亚马逊地区。
【信号】转折 while + 强调 do。信号有两层：让步转折 While this may seem like a mythical
creature 先抑（看似神话），转折后才是真意；再加强调助动词 pink dolphins do exist 中
的 do，把存在性钉死。转折之后、带强调语气的那句正是答案句。
【替换】pink dolphins do exist in the Amazon region ↔ They truly exist in the Amazon region.
do exist 同义改写为 truly exist
【排除】D) 原词陷阱
录音里 alarmingly large snakes 说的是船客在河上提防的大蛇，是另一种动物，根本不是
在说海豚像蛇。选项 They resemble alarmingly large snakes. 原封盗用 alarmingly large
snakes 这个词组，把蛇安到海豚头上，听到原词就想选正中下怀。
借用原文：calmly keeping an eye out for alarmingly large snakes
B)
录音 minding your own business 描述的是划船的你在专心赶路，不是海豚的习性。选项
They usually mind their own business. 把这句原话改成海豚不爱招惹别人，主语偷换成
海豚，且原文从未说海豚的脾性，属答非所问。
借用原文：minding your own business
A)
录音只说海豚 may seem like a mythical creature（看似神话生物），并未把海豚和神话
生物放在一起比高下。选项 They outcompete mythical creatures. 凭一个 mythical
creature 编出胜过神话生物的说法，原文无此意，属过度推断。
借用原文：While this may seem like a mythical creature

questions.stem: What is the unusual coloring of pink dolphins believed to originate in?

options.label: A
options.text: Scar tissue from dolphins' fighting.

options.label: B
options.text: Skin infection from water pollution.

options.label: C
options.text: Unhealed wounds from snake bites.

options.label: D
options.text: Swimming along in seasonal floods.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Scar tissue from dolphins' fighting.
【定位】Their unusual coloring is believed to be the result of scar tissue from dolphin fights—whether
playful fighting or a serious bid for a mate.
它们这种奇特的颜色，被认为是海豚打斗留下的疤痕组织造成的——无论是嬉戏打闹还是为
争夺配偶的认真争斗。
【信号】因果 the result of。答案信号是因果短语 is believed to be the result of，它后面接的正
是颜色的来源。题干问 originate in，原文用 result of 应答，听到 result of 立刻锁定其后
内容。
【替换】scar tissue from dolphin fights ↔ Scar tissue from dolphins' fighting.
fights 改写为 fighting
【排除】D) 原词陷阱
选项 Swimming along in seasonal floods. 里的 seasonal floods 来自第 2 段讲栖息地的
temporary lakes caused by seasonal flooding，与颜色来源无关。它盗用了原文出现过
的 seasonal flood 制造耳熟，但答的不是本题问的成因。
借用原文：temporary lakes caused by seasonal flooding
B) 未提及
选项 Skin infection from water pollution. 说颜色来自水污染引起的皮肤感染，可原文讲
来源时只字未提 pollution 或 infection，是凭空捏造的成因，属未提及。
C)
选项 Unhealed wounds from snake bites. 把成因说成蛇咬的未愈伤口，借第 1 段的
snakes 联想造势，但原文讲颜色来源从未说被蛇咬，属未提及加错接。

questions.stem: What has become of the Amazon wetland system since 2018?

options.label: A
options.text: It has been shrinking at an astonishing pace.

options.label: B
options.text: It has been placed under international protection.

options.label: C
options.text: It has been appealing to both freshwater and sea dolphins.

options.label: D
options.text: It has been abandoned as a battleground for male dolphins.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） It has been placed under international protection.
【定位】The Amazon wetland system, fed by the Amazon River, is a crucial place for pink dolphins to
breed, and since 2018 has been granted internationally protected status.
由亚马逊河滋养的亚马逊湿地系统，是粉色海豚繁殖的关键之地，并自 2018 年起被授予国
际保护地位。
【信号】时间锚 since 2018。答案信号是时间状语 since 2018，它与题干的 since 2018 完全对
应，后面紧跟的 has been granted internationally protected status 就是答案。听到年份
与题干同步，立即抓其后内容。
【替换】has been granted internationally protected status ↔
It has been placed under international protection.
granted protected status 改写为 placed under protection
【排除】C) 原词陷阱
选项 It has been appealing to both freshwater and sea dolphins. 里的 freshwater 取自
第 2 段 this freshwater dolphin，且原文只有淡水海豚、根本没提海水海豚或湿地吸引两
类海豚，属盗用原词加未提及。
借用原文：this freshwater dolphin is sometimes shockingly pink
A)
选项 It has been shrinking at an astonishing pace. 说湿地在惊人缩小，方向与原文相反
——原文说它自 2018 年起 granted internationally protected status，是受到保护、向
好，绝非缩小。这正是预读时提醒过的正反对立陷阱。
借用原文：since 2018 has been granted internationally protected status
D)
选项 It has been abandoned as a battleground for male dolphins. 借第 3 段 dolphin
fights 与雄性海豚的字眼，编出湿地被弃为雄海豚战场的说法，可原文恰说湿地是繁殖关键
地、被保护，从未说被弃用，属张冠李戴加相反。
借用原文：scar tissue from dolphin fights

questions.stem: What do we learn from a new survey by Merrill Lynch/Age Wave?

options.label: A
options.text: About 58% of young adults call parental support the new normal.

options.label: B
options.text: Most adult children enjoy increasing sources of financial support.

options.label: C
options.text: A full 70% of the young adults cannot afford to buy a car by themselves.

options.label: D
options.text: Most early adults cannot sustain their lifestyles without parental support.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Most early adults cannot sustain their lifestyles without parental support.
【定位】In a new Merrill Lynch/Age Wave survey, a full 70% of the early adults said they received
financial support from their parents in the past year and 58% said they couldn't afford their
current lifestyles without it.
在美林/年龄浪潮的一项新调查中，整整 70% 的年轻成年人表示，过去一年里他们得到了父
母的经济资助，而 58% 的人表示，没有这份资助他们就负担不起当前的生活方式。
【信号】开篇报数据即调查发现落点。录音一开篇就给出 a full 70% of the early adults said they
received financial support 与 58% said they couldn't afford their current lifestyles
without it 两组数据，篇章独白"开头点题报核心发现"，这两句就是承载答案的句子，关键
在把每个数字拴到它说明的那件事。
【替换】58% said they couldn't afford their current lifestyles without it ↔
Most early adults cannot sustain their lifestyles without parental support
同义改写且 58% 即"多数"
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项把 58% 与 the new normal 拼在一起，但原文里 58% 对应的是"撑不起生活"，而 the
new normal 是 CEO 个人的评价、根本没说"58% 的人这么叫它"，属盗用真实数字后乱配
对象。
借用原文：58% said they couldn't afford their current lifestyles without it
B) 未提及
enjoy increasing sources of financial support 凭空加了"资助来源在增加"且带正面色彩
enjoy，原文只列了 cell phone plans, food, school costs and car expenses 几类资助、
从未说它们在"增多"，更没说年轻人"乐享"，是无中生有式改写。
C) 原词陷阱
选项把真实的 70% 接到 cannot afford to buy a car by themselves 上，但原文 70% 说
的是 received financial support from their parents，"车"只是 car expenses 作为资助类
别被顺带提到，并没有"70% 的人买不起车"这回事，是典型的数字配错对象。
借用原文：a full 70% of the early adults said they received financial support from their parents

questions.stem: Why did most young adults in the survey say financial support to children aged 25 to 34 is a bad thing?

options.label: A
options.text: It renders them dependent.

options.label: B
options.text: It causes them to lose dignity.

options.label: C
options.text: It makes them mentally immature.

options.label: D
options.text: It hinders them from getting ahead.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） It renders them dependent.
【定位】But 64% of the young adults surveyed said parents' financial support to children age 25 to 34
is "a bad thing", because it makes those kids dependent.
但是，64% 的受访年轻人表示，父母对 25 至 34 岁子女的经济资助是"一件坏事"，因为它
让这些孩子变得依赖。
【信号】因果词 because 后即答案。本句用 because it makes those kids dependent 直接给出理
由，because 是最硬的因果信号，紧跟其后的 makes those kids dependent 就是答案落
点，前半句只是在陈述"是坏事"这一立场。
【替换】it makes those kids dependent ↔ It renders them dependent
make 与 render 同义、them 回指 kids
【排除】B) 未提及
It causes them to lose dignity. 听上去也像"坏处"，但原文给的理由只有"变依赖"，从未提
到 dignity（尊严），是顺着"坏事"语境编出的合理化干扰。
C) 过度推断
It makes them mentally immature. 把"依赖"过度引申成"心智不成熟"，原文只说
dependent、没说 mentally immature，属于在原意上加码的推断，超出文本。
D) 与原文相反
It hinders them from getting ahead. 盗用了原文的 get ahead，但原文 helps the adult
children get ahead 是讲资助 18-24 岁"好处"时说的、且是"helps（帮助）出人头地"，选
项却反成"hinders（阻碍）"并安到"坏事"这边，既偷原词又正话反说、还把对象张冠李戴。
借用原文：the remaining 71% think that assistance "helps the adult children get ahead"

questions.stem: What did the respondents in the survey say regarding financial independence?

options.label: A
options.text: It challenges one's willpower.

options.label: B
options.text: It results from education.

options.label: C
options.text: It calls for due assistance.

options.label: D
options.text: It defines adulthood.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） It defines adulthood.
【定位】In fact, the respondents said, financial independence defines adulthood.
事实上，受访者表示，经济独立定义了成年。
【信号】the respondents said 后的直接定性。题干问受访者说了什么，原文 the respondents
said, financial independence defines adulthood 用"受访者表示"直接引出他们的定性，
主语应答方明确、又含"下定义"的 defines，正是承载答案的句子。
【替换】financial independence defines adulthood ↔ It defines adulthood
It 回指经济独立、defines 原词保留
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
It challenges one's willpower. 借了原文 challenged by 的影子，但原文 challenged 出现
在 CEO 转述"经济独立让年轻人感到挣扎、受挑战"处，谈的是"被它难住"而非"它考验意志
力"，且这不是题干要的"受访者对经济独立的定性"。
借用原文：Financial independence is something they were struggling with and challenged by
B) 未提及
It results from education. 把"经济独立"归因于教育，原文从未谈两者的来源关系；
education 一词在原文压根没出现，是凭空捏造的因果。
C) 与原文相反
It calls for due assistance.（需要适当帮助）与受访者的态度正好相反——他们认为 by
25, younger adults ought to be financially independent，强调的是"应当独立"，而
非"需要援助"，方向反了。
借用原文：by 25, younger adults ought to be financially independent

questions.stem: What is one big reason young adults are struggling?

options.label: A
options.text: Current lifestyles.

options.label: B
options.text: Poor budgeting.

options.label: C
options.text: College loans.

options.label: D
options.text: Emergency expenses.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） College loans.
【定位】One big reason they're struggling is attributed to college loans, of which the average amounts
to $37,000.
他们之所以挣扎，一个大原因被归结为助学贷款，其平均金额高达 37000 美元。
【信号】one big reason… attributed to 双因果信号。本句 One big reason they're struggling
is attributed to college loans 与题干几乎同形，one big reason 与 attributed to 是叠加
的因果信号，attributed to 后点出的 college loans 就是答案落点。
【替换】attributed to college loans ↔ College loans
答案原词直现、近乎照搬
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
Current lifestyles 盗用了第 1 段 current lifestyles，但那是讲"没资助就撑不起当前生
活"时说的，与本题问的"挣扎的原因"无关，纯粹靠耳熟设饵。
借用原文：58% said they couldn't afford their current lifestyles without it
B) 未提及
Poor budgeting（不善理财）像是一个合情合理的"挣扎原因"，但原文归因明确指向
college loans，从未提及预算或理财问题，是凭常识脑补的干扰。
D) 未提及
Emergency expenses（应急开销）与正确项 college loans 同属"花钱"类、极易混淆，但
原文归因只点了助学贷款，根本没提 emergency expenses，是同类干扰。
