questions.stem: What do we learn from the police report?

options.label: A
options.text: A man was bitten by a snake.

options.label: B
options.text: A man was taken to a hospital.

options.label: C
options.text: A man kept a 4-foot snake as a pet.

options.label: D
options.text: A man fell off his toilet seat.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） A man was bitten by a snake.
【定位】Police have reported a man being bitten by a 4-foot snake when he lifted his toilet seat on
Sunday morning.
警方报告称，周日早晨一名男子在掀开马桶盖时被一条 4 英尺长的蛇咬伤。
【信号】新闻导语句即答案。答案句就是 Police have reported a man being bitten by a 4-foot
snake when he lifted his toilet seat on Sunday morning. 这一句——新闻报道的第一句
（导语）就是 Police have reported…，是"警方报告"信号的直接落点。新闻题里只要题干
问"警方/官方/这则报道说什么"，几乎都落在导语句。
【替换】a man being bitten by a 4-foot snake ↔ A man was bitten by a snake.
非谓语转过去时·同义直接对应
【排除】B) 与原文相反
录音第二段明确说 the man did not have to go to the hospital——这位男子**没有**去
医院，只是在现场处理了手臂。选项 A man was taken to a hospital. 盗用了原文的
hospital 一词却把否定砍掉，反成肯定，是典型"听到 hospital 就想选"的陷阱。
借用原文：the man did not have to go to the hospital
C) 原词陷阱
选项 A man kept a 4-foot snake as a pet. 把录音第 1 段里的 a 4-foot snake 原词搬过
来，看似耳熟。但录音第 3 段明确说 the snake didn't belong to the man，蛇并不是男子
的，更谈不上 kept…as a pet。这是"听到原词就想选"的原词陷阱。
借用原文：a 4-foot snake
D) 原词陷阱
选项 A man fell off his toilet seat. 借用了录音 he lifted his toilet seat 中的 toilet seat
这块"熟面孔"，但把动作偷换成了 fell off（从马桶上摔下来）。录音说的是"他掀开马桶
盖"，根本没说他摔倒。这又是一处原词陷阱叠加偷换概念。
借用原文：he lifted his toilet seat

questions.stem: What does the report say was still unclear?

options.label: A
options.text: Where the snake had been taken.

options.label: B
options.text: Whether the snake was infected.

options.label: C
options.text: How the snake was captured.

options.label: D
options.text: Who owned the snake.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Who owned the snake.
【定位】It was unclear who the owner was. The snake may be taken to a local zoo for care if the
owner does not come forward.
蛇的主人是谁尚不清楚。如果主人不出面认领，这条蛇可能会被送到当地一家动物园照料。
【信号】unclear + who 直接锁定。答案信号是 It was unclear who the owner was. 中的 unclear
一词——它与题干 still unclear 直接对应；unclear 后面跟的 who the owner was 就是"未
明的内容"，几乎是把答案塞到题干同款词的旁边。
【替换】It was unclear who the owner was. ↔ Who owned the snake.
名词转动词·who 从句同义重写
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音 The snake was eventually captured by the local animal handlers and taken to
an animal hospital afterward. 已经明确告诉我们蛇被送去了 animal hospital；之后还补
了一句若无主认领"可能送到当地动物园"，去向并非"unclear"。选项 Where the snake
had been taken. 借用 taken 这一原词制造"哪里去了仍不清楚"的错觉，实际录音对去向已
交代。
借用原文：taken to an animal hospital afterward
B) 原词陷阱
录音 It was being treated for an outer skin infection. 明确说蛇正在因外皮感染接受治
疗，感染状况已确认而非未明。选项 Whether the snake was infected. 把 infection 一词
盗作诱饵，骗"听到 infection 就想选"的考生。
借用原文：It was being treated for an outer skin infection.
C) 原词陷阱
录音 The snake was eventually captured by the local animal handlers 明确说蛇是被当
地的"动物管理员"捕获的，捕获方式（由谁、怎么抓）已交代。选项 How the snake was
captured. 直接挪用 captured 一词，把已说清的事伪装成 unclear，是经典原词陷阱。
借用原文：The snake was eventually captured by the local animal handlers
Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.
1 Every week since last April, Andrea Belcher has been doing something slightly unusual and amusing
when she takes out her trash.
自去年四月以来,每周当Andrea Belcher倒垃圾时,她都会做一件略显不寻常而有趣的事。
2 It all started off when a movie star shared a photo of herself putting her trash bins out in a ball
gown. This inspired Andrea to get dressed up to take out the trash.
这一切始于一位电影明星分享了一张自己穿着晚礼服倒垃圾的照片。这启发了Andrea盛装打扮去倒
垃圾。
3 She was too embarrassed to do it during the day. So one dark evening, she put on her black off-the-
shoulder gown and put her trash bin out. Her daughter filmed it and the whole family laughed, but it
seemed to go down well.
她白天不好意思这样做。所以在一个漆黑的夜晚,她穿上了黑色露肩礼服去倒垃圾桶。她女儿拍摄了这一
幕,全家人都笑了,但效果似乎不错。
4 The following weeks, she found other outfits in her dressing-up box, and dressed up as different
characters and famous people, sharing her exploits on social media. Before long, people started offering
up their own fancy dresses for her to wear. And before she knew it, she had done 20 weeks.
接下来的几周,她从自己的装扮箱里找出其他服装,打扮成不同的角色和名人,在社交媒体上分享她的趣事。
不久之后,人们开始主动提供自己的华丽服装给她穿。在她意识到之前,她已经坚持了20周。
5 Explaining why she has kept up the videos, Andrea explained how nice it was to have a little bit of
fun and craziness that made people smile. Besides, it also helps to remind people in the community to
put out their trash bins each week.
在解释为什么她一直坚持拍摄这些视频时,Andrea说能有一点乐趣和疯狂让人们微笑是多么美好。此外,这
也有助于提醒社区里的人们每周倒垃圾桶。

questions.stem: What has Andrea Belcher been doing since last April?

options.label: A
options.text: Taking her trash out in fancy dresses.

options.label: B
options.text: Amusing herself by going to ball parties.

options.label: C
options.text: Sharing her photos with famous movie stars.

options.label: D
options.text: Posting her daughter's photos on social media.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Taking her trash out in fancy dresses.
【定位】Every week since last April, Andrea Belcher has been doing something slightly unusual and
amusing when she takes out her trash.
自去年四月起，安德烈娅·贝尔彻每周倒垃圾的时候都会做一件稍微有点不寻常又搞笑的事。
【信号】开篇点题句 + 时间状语锁定。新闻开篇 Every week since last April 与题干 since last
April 完全对应，时间状语就是答案信号；后半句 when she takes out her trash 直接揭示
行为载体——倒垃圾，这是承载答案的那句话。
【替换】doing something slightly unusual and amusing when she takes out her trash ↔
Taking her trash out in fancy dresses
概括 + 后文具体细化
get dressed up to take out the trash ↔ in fancy dresses
get dressed up = 穿正装 = fancy dresses
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
录音第2段提到 a movie star shared a photo of herself putting her trash bins out in a
ball gown，ball gown（晚礼服）只是她穿的衣服样式，并不是说"她去参加舞会"。选项 B
把 ball 偷换成 ball parties，把"穿礼服倒垃圾"硬扭成"去舞会自娱"，是典型的原词陷阱。
借用原文：a movie star shared a photo of herself putting her trash bins out in a ball gown
C) 张冠李戴
录音第2段明确 a movie star shared a photo of herself putting her trash bins out in a
ball gown——分享照片的人是那位明星，分享的内容是明星自己的照片。选项 C 把动作主
语换成了 Andrea，把"她和明星分享照片"安到她头上，是张冠李戴。
借用原文：a movie star shared a photo of herself putting her trash bins out in a ball gown
D) 张冠李戴
录音第3段说 Her daughter filmed it，是女儿帮她拍视频；第4段说 sharing her exploits
on social media，分享的是"她自己的事迹"。选项 D 却说"发布她女儿的照片"，把"女儿帮
拍"偷换成"发布女儿的照片"，主客颠倒。
借用原文：Her daughter filmed it

questions.stem: Why has Andrea Belcher kept up her videos?

options.label: A
options.text: To make herself popular.

options.label: B
options.text: To amuse people.

options.label: C
options.text: To please her daughter.

options.label: D
options.text: To record her achievements.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） To amuse people.
【定位】Explaining why she has kept up the videos, Andrea explained how nice it was to have a little
bit of fun and craziness that made people smile.
在解释为什么坚持拍这些视频时，安德烈娅说，能有一点点乐趣和疯狂，让人们露出笑容，
这感觉真好。
【信号】结尾解释句直接对应题干。录音第5段开头 Explaining why she has kept up the videos
与题干 Why has Andrea Belcher kept up her videos? 是几乎逐字对应的解释信号；其后
的 a little bit of fun and craziness that made people smile 就是她给出的真实原因，是
承载答案的那句话。
【替换】a little bit of fun and craziness that made people smile ↔ To amuse people
made people smile = amuse people
fun and craziness ↔ amuse
fun ≈ amuse 的同根义
【排除】A) 未提及
录音里完全没有出现 popular/famous 类的动机描述；她坚持的原因被明确说成 to have a
little bit of fun and craziness that made people smile，与"让自己出名"无关。选项 A
是"花絮新闻最常见的诱选动机"——预读时已警惕。
C) 原词陷阱
录音第3段有 Her daughter filmed it and the whole family laughed，daughter 真的被
念到，但只是说女儿帮她拍、全家笑——这不是她坚持的目的。选项 C 把 daughter 偷过
来，硬安成"为了讨女儿欢心"，是典型原词陷阱。
借用原文：Her daughter filmed it and the whole family laughed
D) 未提及
录音里既没有 record（记录）也没有 achievements（成就）类的表达；she had done 20
weeks 只是叙述事实，并非"为了记录成就"。选项 D 是凭"长期坚持"脑补出来的，与解释信
号后给出的真实动机不符。

questions.stem: What can people do at Frank's restaurant?

options.label: A
options.text: Eat as much as they want for $10.

options.label: B
options.text: Have a chance of winning a $100 prize.

options.label: C
options.text: Have a meal even if they have no money.

options.label: D
options.text: Get a free meal after answering some questions.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Have a meal even if they have no money.
【定位】No money but still hungry? No problem! Welcome to Frank's restaurant where customers are
paying for meals and leaving receipts on a board. Anyone who is hungry and wants
something to eat can take one, no questions asked and hand it to the staff for some food.
没钱但还是饿着？没关系！欢迎来到 Frank's 餐厅——这里的顾客先付饭钱，再把小票留在
一块板上。任何饿了想吃东西的人都可以取下一张小票，无需任何询问，把它交给店员就能
换到一份食物。
【信号】导语句直接点题。开头连用两个设问 No money but still hungry? No problem!，紧接着
用 Welcome to… 引出餐厅做法，这是新闻典型的导语式信号——把整则新闻的核心事实押
在第一段第一句。听到设问+欢迎句出现，就要在心里把笔停在这一句。
【替换】No money but still hungry? No problem! ↔ even if they have no money
设问反问 = 让步条件
Anyone who is hungry and wants something to eat can take one, no questions asked and hand it to
the staff for some food
↔ Have a meal
hand it to the staff for some food = Have a meal
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音第三段确实提到每份饭 each costing about $10，但说的是每张小票背后对应的餐
费，并非顾客只要付 $10 就能 Eat as much as they want；选项盗用 $10 这个原词，把它
扭成自助式的随便吃，是典型的听到数字就想选式陷阱。
借用原文：each costing about $10
B)
录音第二段说 a donor came in with $100 for each member of its staff，$100 是某位捐
赠者发给员工的人均款项，根本不是 a $100 prize 抽奖奖金；选项盗用 $100 这个原词，
再嫁接 prize 制造抽奖联想。
借用原文：a donor came in with $100 for each member of its staff
D)
录音里 no questions asked 明确说取餐时不需要回答任何问题，而 Get a free meal after
answering some questions 偏偏要求顾客 answering some questions 才能得到免费餐，
与原文方向相反；选项盗用 questions 这个原词，却反转了它的语义。
借用原文：no questions asked

questions.stem: What does the owner of the restaurant say about the idea for the board of free meals?

options.label: A
options.text: It was brought up by two staffers.

options.label: B
options.text: It helped to popularize her restaurant.

options.label: C
options.text: It originated from a donation to her staff.

options.label: D
options.text: It was suggested by some of her customers.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） It originated from a donation to her staff.
【定位】The idea for the board of free meals started after a donor came in with $100 for each member
of its staff. After two staffers returned to their share, there was $700 leftover according to
Tarah Morris, the owner of the restaurant, so they decided to do something more by creating
the board.
餐厅老板 Tarah Morris 说，这块免费餐板的点子始于一位捐赠者走进店里、给每位员工
100 美元；其中两名员工把自己那份退了回去，于是剩下了 700 美元，他们便决定用这笔
钱做点更有意义的事，就这样有了这块板。
【信号】according to + owner 的转述信号。录音里 according to Tarah Morris, the owner of
the restaurant 是典型的新闻转述信号，把整段缘起绑定到店主之口，正好对应题干 the
owner…say about。听到 according to + 人物身份，就要在心里给整段打上本人原话的
标签。
【替换】The idea for the board of free meals started after a donor came in with $100 for each member of its
staff
↔ originated from a donation
started after = originated from
$100 for each member of its staff ↔ to her staff
for each member of its staff = to her staff
【排除】A)
录音里 After two staffers returned to their share 说的是两名员工把分到的 $100 退了回
来，他们的动作是 returned，而不是 brought up the idea；选项盗用 two staffers 这个
原词，把退款人偷换为想法的提出者，是张冠李戴。
借用原文：After two staffers returned to their share
B) 未提及
店主谈的是 idea 怎么开始的，整段录音从未提及这块板让餐厅本身变得更出名或更受欢
迎，popularize her restaurant 在原文中找不到对应信息，是用主题词撑起的无中生有
项。
D)
录音里把 idea 的发起归到店主与员工的商量（they decided to do something more by
creating the board），并未出现顾客建议的桥段；suggested by some of her
customers 把提议人替换成 customers，与原文角色不符，是典型的张冠李戴。
借用原文：they decided to do something more by creating the board

questions.stem: What has happened at Frank's restaurant since the board of free meals was created?

options.label: A
options.text: Fifty customers have offered donations.

options.label: B
options.text: More people have been giving than taking.

options.label: C
options.text: Many people have come to eat at the restaurant.

options.label: D
options.text: Most staffers have received messages of kindness.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） More people have been giving than taking.
【定位】The drive has been going on for two weeks and Morris said just under 50 customers have
picked up a free meal. There have been no reports of anyone taking advantage of the
situation. In fact, there are a lot more people giving tickets than receiving.
这场公益行动已经持续了两周，Morris 说接近 50 名顾客取走了免费餐；尚未出现任何人趁
机占便宜的情况；事实上，捐出小票的人远多于来取走小票的人。
【信号】In fact 强调真正结论。录音用 In fact, there are a lot more people giving tickets than
receiving，In fact 是新闻里典型的强调真正结论的信号词，把前文铺垫与轻描淡写一笔翻
起来，落到本则新闻的核心收束。听到 In fact 就要在心里抢一拍：这后面是答案落点。
【替换】there are a lot more people giving tickets than receiving ↔
More people have been giving than taking
more…than 结构原样保留
giving tickets ↔ giving
省略宾语而义不变
【排除】A)
录音里 just under 50 customers have picked up a free meal，50 这个数字指的是取走
免费餐的顾客接近 50 人，而不是 Fifty customers have offered donations 提供捐款的
人；选项盗用 50 这个原词数字，把动作从 picked up 偷换为 offered donations，是经典
的数字原词陷阱。
借用原文：just under 50 customers have picked up a free meal
C)
Many people have come to eat at the restaurant 只说很多人来吃饭，是泛化的常识陈
述；录音真正强调的是 giving 与 taking 的对比，而不是来店人数。选项盗用 people、
eat、restaurant 这类高频主题词，制造听起来都对的错觉。
借用原文：just under 50 customers have picked up a free meal
D)
录音里 The board has messages of kindness like, "If you want more kindness in the
world, put it here." 说的是这块板上写满了暖心留言，并不是 Most staffers have
received messages of kindness 大多数员工收到了暖心留言；选项盗用 messages of
kindness 这一原词短语，把接受方从板偷换成员工，是张冠李戴。
借用原文：The board has messages of kindness

questions.stem: What do we learn about the man?

options.label: A
options.text: He is a psychologist.

options.label: B
options.text: He is a famous writer.

options.label: C
options.text: He is a host for a TV program.

options.label: D
options.text: He is a primary school teacher.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） He is a psychologist.
【定位】Welcome to our program, Friends and Relationships. Our guest today is psychologist Steve
Pinker from McGill University.
欢迎收看我们的节目《朋友与关系》。今天的嘉宾是来自麦吉尔大学的心理学家史蒂夫·
平克。
【信号】开场介绍嘉宾的固定句。信号词是 Our guest today is psychologist——「今天的嘉宾
是…」是访谈节目报身份的标志句，紧跟其后的名词就是嘉宾职业。
【替换】psychologist Steve Pinker ↔ He is a psychologist.
同词直给——但听清职业
【排除】B) 未提及 录音通篇没有提到男士是作家，He is a famous writer. 属于无中生有。
C) 原词陷阱
录音里 Welcome to our program 中的 program 确实是「节目」原词，He is a host for
a TV program. 故意用 program 引诱，但说「欢迎收看节目」的是女主持人 Jane，男士是
「嘉宾」(guest)，不是主持人。
借用原文：Welcome to our program, Friends and Relationships.
D) 未提及
录音从头到尾未提及小学/教师/teach 等任何线索，He is a primary school teacher. 属于
完全无中生有。

questions.stem: What are the speakers mainly talking about?

options.label: A
options.text: Why social media accounts vanish without a trace.

options.label: B
options.text: Why parents raise their children in different ways.

options.label: C
options.text: Why people fail to respond to emails promptly.

options.label: D
options.text: Why friends break off contact all of a sudden.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （主旨题） Why friends break off contact all of a sudden.
【定位】Our question today is why friends suddenly disappear. They may block us on their social
media accounts and stop responding to our emails. They simply vanish without a trace.
我们今天的问题是：朋友为什么会突然消失。他们可能会在社交媒体上把我们拉黑、不再回
我们的邮件，就这么毫无踪迹地消失了。
【信号】Our question today is… 是节目抛题信号。信号词是 Our question today is why
friends suddenly disappear——访谈节目用 Our question today is…/Today we will talk
about… 这种句式直接点出本期话题，后面的从句就是主旨。
【替换】why friends suddenly disappear ↔ Why friends break off contact all of a sudden.
同义改写——disappear ↔ break off contact，suddenly ↔ all of a sudden
block us on their social media accounts and stop responding to our emails ↔
friends break off contact
详述↔概括
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
Why social media accounts vanish without a trace. 抠走了录音里的 social media
accounts 和 vanish without a trace 两个原词，听到就想选；但录音说的是「朋友」会通
过拉黑社交账号等方式消失，主体是「朋友」，不是「账号本身」——选项把「朋友消失」
的一种具体表现错读成了主题，属以偏概全。
借用原文：They may block us on their social media accounts
B)
录音确实在 The answer may lie in childhood, the way the person related to their
mom and dad. 谈到了童年与父母关系，但那是嘉宾对「为什么朋友会突然消失」的解释；
选项 Why parents raise their children in different ways. 把这个解释方向错抬成了主题，
主题是「消失」不是「育儿方式」。
借用原文：The answer may lie in childhood
C) 原词陷阱
Why people fail to respond to emails promptly. 抠走了录音原词 stop responding to
our emails，但「不回邮件」只是「朋友消失」的一种具体形态而已，把它当主题同样是以
偏概全，且和 A 犯一样的错。
借用原文：stop responding to our emails

questions.stem: How do children with an anxious attachment style react to a breakdown in their relationship with parents?

options.label: A
options.text: They simply shut themselves down.

options.label: B
options.text: They avoid showing their emotions.

options.label: C
options.text: They scream to get their parents back.

options.label: D
options.text: They attempt to ignore the whole situation.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） They scream to get their parents back.
【定位】When there is a relationship breakdown with their parents, children with an anxious
attachment style scream and cry to get their parents to come back. But other children simply
shut down and try to deal with their emotions by ignoring the situation.
当他们和父母的关系破裂时，焦虑型依附的孩子会尖叫、哭闹，把父母叫回来；而另一些孩
子则会直接封闭自己，试着通过忽视这种情境来处理自己的情绪。
【信号】对照结构 anxious …. But other children …。信号词是 But other children——嘉宾用
But 把两类孩子的反应并排对照。这种对照句是出题铁矿，正确反应几乎都在 But 两侧之
一。题干问的是 anxious 那一类，对应 But 前半部分。
【替换】scream and cry to get their parents to come back ↔ They scream to get their parents back.
选项几乎是原句裁剪
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
They simply shut themselves down. 抠走了录音原词 simply shut down，听到 simply
shut down 就想选；但录音明确说这是 But other children(另一类，即回避型)的反应，不
是焦虑型的反应。
借用原文：But other children simply shut down
B)
They avoid showing their emotions. 描述的是「回避情绪」，更接近回避型(But other
children…try to deal with their emotions by ignoring)；焦虑型 scream and cry 反而是
大力外露情绪，与本选项相反。
借用原文：try to deal with their emotions by ignoring the situation
D) 原词陷阱
They attempt to ignore the whole situation. 抠走的是录音原词 ignoring the
situation，听到就想选；但这同样是 But other children 那一类(回避型)的反应，不是焦虑
型的反应。
借用原文：try to deal with their emotions by ignoring the situation

questions.stem: What does the man say about insecurely attached people?

options.label: A
options.text: They may regard any difference as the end of a relationship.

options.label: B
options.text: They are on better terms with friends and romantic partners.

options.label: C
options.text: They try to express their feelings and thoughts effectively.

options.label: D
options.text: They attach more value to their relationships with others.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） They may regard any difference as the end of a relationship.
【定位】However, an insecurely attached person won't. They might either attack you, get defensive, or
just disappear from your life. To them, a difference, no matter how small in your eyes, signals
the end of the relationship.
然而，不安全依附的人就不会这样。他们要么攻击你、要么变得防御、要么干脆从你生活里
消失。在他们看来，再小的分歧，都意味着这段关系的终结。
【信号】However + To them 双重信号锁定结论。信号词一：However, an insecurely attached
person won't——However 是转折信号，前面说安全型怎么处理，转折后才是题干所问的
不安全型。信号词二：To them, a difference, no matter how small in your eyes, signals
the end of the relationship.——To them 是对前面群体下定论的总结句，是嘉宾真正要传
达给观众的「金句」，几乎必出题。
【替换】To them, a difference, no matter how small in your eyes, signals the end of the relationship. ↔
They may regard any difference as the end of a relationship.
同义改写——signals ↔ regard…as，no matter how small ↔ any
【排除】B)
They are on better terms with friends and romantic partners. 是正面描述「和朋友/恋
人相处更好」，但录音里嘉宾对不安全型的描述是 They might either attack you, get
defensive, or just disappear from your life.，是关系处理失败的方向，选项与录音方向完
全相反。
借用原文：They might either attack you, get defensive, or just disappear from your life.
C) 原词陷阱
They try to express their feelings and thoughts effectively. 抠走的是录音原词 express
their own feelings and thoughts effectively，听到 express…effectively 就想选；但这句
话是嘉宾对 securely attached(安全型)人的描述，不是问的不安全型。
借用原文：They're able to hear what the other person is saying and express their own feelings and
thoughts effectively.
D)
They attach more value to their relationships with others. 说「他们更看重关系」，录
音通篇没有这种说法。相反，录音说他们把小分歧当作关系终结的信号，是「轻易抛弃关
系」的方向，不是「更看重关系」。

questions.stem: What makes the man choose to buy jeans made in Japan?

options.label: A
options.text: Their price.

options.label: B
options.text: Their color.

options.label: C
options.text: Their quality.

options.label: D
options.text: Their design.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Their quality.
【定位】Also, the fabric they use is of a higher quality and the dyes are natural. They have a denser
weave, and are more durable than any other jeans in the world.
而且他们用的面料质量更高，染料是天然的。这种牛仔裤织得更密，比世界上任何其他牛仔
裤都更耐用。
【信号】比较级 higher / denser / more durable 集中爆发。the fabric they use is of a higher
quality 与 more durable than any other jeans in the world 连用三处比较级——比较级
在听力里几乎等同于『考点信号灯』，它在为日本牛仔裤的某项属性给出对比性证据。
【替换】the fabric they use is of a higher quality ↔ Their quality.
原文 higher quality 直接对应选项 quality
more durable than any other jeans in the world ↔ Their quality.
durable 是 quality 的下位表现
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
原文 They should be around $500. 提到了具体价格，让粗心的考生听到数字就奔
『price』；但价格出现在男士交代规格那段，根本不是他选择日本货的『理由』，男士选日
本货的理由集中在第 9 段的质量描述，Their price. 是典型原词陷阱。
借用原文：They should be around $500.
B) 未提及
全文没有出现任何关于 color 的描述，Their color. 属于无中生有；它和 quality/design 一
样是『物品属性词』，被列在这里只为凑成四项并列结构干扰考生。
D) 原词陷阱
原文末段 they're very fashionable too 与 But they are very special 容易让人联想到『款
式好』而选 Their design.；但 fashionable/special 在原文里是男士补充说明价格值不值时
的次要修饰，不是他选『日本货』的核心理由——核心理由是第 9 段集中讲的质量。
借用原文：they're very fashionable too

questions.stem: Why is the woman puzzled by the man's request?

options.label: A
options.text: Jeans are a typical American garment.

options.label: B
options.text: America makes the best-known brands of jeans.

options.label: C
options.text: America has the best weaving tools in the world.

options.label: D
options.text: Jeans are available in a greater variety in America.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Jeans are a typical American garment.
【定位】Really? I had no idea Japan made jeans. I would have thought America made the best jeans
because it's a typical American garment.
真的吗？我都不知道日本还做牛仔裤。我原本以为美国生产最好的牛仔裤，因为牛仔裤是典
型的美国服饰。
【信号】心理动词过去式 had no idea / would have thought。I had no idea Japan made
jeans 与 I would have thought America made the best jeans 紧跟 because it's a
typical American garment——『原本以为…因为它是典型美国服饰』这一句直接交代了女
士困惑的根源。
【替换】it's a typical American garment ↔ Jeans are a typical American garment.
代词 it 还原为 jeans 后字面等同
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
原文 I would have thought America made the best jeans 与 more durable than any
other jeans in the world 都出现了 best 类用语，容易误导考生选含 best-known 的
America makes the best-known brands of jeans.；但女士原话说的是 best jeans（最好
的牛仔裤），不是 best-known brands（最知名的品牌），后者是偷换概念。
借用原文：I would have thought America made the best jeans
C) 张冠李戴
原文 Japan still has some very old mills with the traditional weaving tools 说的是『日
本』有传统织布工具，America has the best weaving tools in the world. 把这条属性硬
安到 America 头上，是典型张冠李戴；同时女士困惑的依据也不是『美国有最好的织布工
具』，而是『牛仔裤是美国典型服饰』。
借用原文：Japan still has some very old mills with the traditional weaving tools
D) 未提及
原文从未做过『美国牛仔裤种类比日本多』的比较，Jeans are available in a greater
variety in America. 凭空造出 greater variety 这一比较，属未提及。

questions.stem: What does the man say about the dyes of Japanese jeans?

options.label: A
options.text: They are artificial.

options.label: B
options.text: They are natural.

options.label: C
options.text: They are unique.

options.label: D
options.text: They are special.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） They are natural.
【定位】Also, the fabric they use is of a higher quality and the dyes are natural.
而且他们用的面料质量更高，染料是天然的。
【信号】dyes are natural 是关键词后直接表语。the dyes are natural——题干关键词 dyes 在原
文里只出现一次，紧跟 are + 形容词 natural，完全是『关键词原句锁定 + 表语取答』的标
准结构。
【替换】the dyes are natural ↔ They are natural.
原词复现下的指代还原
【排除】A) 与原文相反
They are artificial. 是 the dyes are natural 的直接反义，原文明确说染料是天然的，
artificial 与之极性相反，属于反向干扰。
借用原文：the dyes are natural
C) 答非所问
原文整段 9 强调日本牛仔裤独特优良（traditional weaving tools / superior / denser
weave），容易让人选 They are unique.；但题干特定问 dyes，原文给的形容词是
natural，unique 是把『整段对日本牛仔裤的整体评价』错位安到 dyes 头上。
借用原文：But the end result is surely superior.
D) 答非所问
原文 But they are very special. 中的 special 形容的是『日本牛仔裤这件物品』，不是
dyes；They are special. 把整体的 special 嫁接到了局部 dyes 上，与 C 同类错法。
借用原文：But they are very special.

questions.stem: What does the man say about Japanese jeans at the end of the conversation?

options.label: A
options.text: They are for casual wearing.

options.label: B
options.text: They are popular with boys.

options.label: C
options.text: They are much too pricey.

options.label: D
options.text: They are worth the price.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （态度观点题） They are worth the price.
【定位】They are a little pricey, yes. But they are very special. Bear in mind, they will last me several
years and they're very fashionable too. I think they're totally worth it.
是的，它们是有点贵。但它们很特别。要知道，它们能穿好几年，款式也很时髦。我觉得它
们完全值这个价。
【信号】让步 but + 下结论 I think…totally worth it。They are a little pricey, yes. But they are
very special. 是让步转折，I think they're totally worth it. 是男士在对话末段亲口下的结
论——But 之后才是真意，I think + totally 是态度题答案句的金信号。
【替换】I think they're totally worth it. ↔ They are worth the price.
totally worth it 与 worth the price 同义
they will last me several years ↔ They are worth the price.
耐用是『值这个价』的下位证据
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
原文 Do you typically spend that much on a pair of casual trousers? 里 casual 出现在
女士的反问中，并非男士对 Japanese jeans 的表态；They are for casual wearing. 直接搬
走 casual 一词制造熟悉感，但题干特定问『男士说』，casual 不是男士的观点。
借用原文：Do you typically spend that much on a pair of casual trousers?
B) 未提及
原文从未提到日本牛仔裤『在男生中流行』，They are popular with boys. 完全是从
『jeans 这种衣物大众印象=年轻男孩穿的』的常识跳过来的，与录音内容无关。
C) 与原文相反
原文 They are a little pricey, yes. 确实承认贵，They are much too pricey. 把这句话强化
为『贵得过分』；但男士紧跟一个 But 把态度翻到 totally worth it，C 只取了让步前半、
丢了真意。much too pricey 的『过分嫌贵』也与男士的 a little pricey + 值得相矛盾。
借用原文：They are a little pricey, yes.

questions.stem: How does the speaker feel every time he walks out of a superhero movie?

options.label: A
options.text: He desires more in life.

options.label: B
options.text: He wants to see it again.

options.label: C
options.text: He feels as inspired as other audience members.

options.label: D
options.text: He longs to become a superstar himself.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） He desires more in life.
【定位】Every time I walk out of a superhero movie, I feel the same way. I experience a sense of
longing, realizing that there should be more in life.
每次我走出超级英雄电影的影厅，感受都一样。我体验到一种渴望，意识到生活里应该有更
多东西。
【信号】题干与原文几乎同句开篇。Every time I walk out of a superhero movie, I feel the same
way. 这句与题干 every time he walks out of a superhero movie 几乎逐词对应，紧跟其
后的 I experience a sense of longing, realizing that there should be more in life. 就是
对感受的具体说明——一句话点题、下一句给答案，是篇章题最常见的开门见山结构。
【替换】a sense of longing ↔ desires
longing 与 desire 同义
there should be more in life ↔ more in life
原话直接搬
【排除】B) 未提及
He wants to see it again. 原文从头到尾没说“想再看一遍”，only 说每次走出影院都有同样
的感受——这是把“every time（每次都）”误读成了“want to see again（想再看）”。
C) 原词陷阱
He feels as inspired as other audience members. 盗用了原文 being inspired 这个词，
但原文是说“hero stories 让人 inspired”是普遍道理，且根本没说“和其他观众一样被启发”
——加了“as … as other audience members”这层比较，是凭空添料。
借用原文：being inspired
D)
He longs to become a superstar himself. 用了 longs 这个 long 的近义动词来引诱，但
原文只说“渴望生活里有更多东西”，从未说“渴望自己也成为超级巨星”——这是把抽象的“渴
望”过度具体化成“想当超级巨星”。
借用原文：I experience a sense of longing

questions.stem: What does the passage say about the plot of all superhero movies?

options.label: A
options.text: It is rather unrealistic.

options.label: B
options.text: It is extremely artistic.

options.label: C
options.text: It is somewhat complicated.

options.label: D
options.text: It is relatively predictable.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） It is relatively predictable.
【定位】The plot of each superhero film has become relatively predictable: the world is in peril, the
world needs a hero, the hero is in peril, the hero resolves the peril, the hero saves the world.
每部超级英雄电影的剧情已变得相对可预测：世界陷入危机，世界需要英雄，英雄陷入危
机，英雄化解危机，英雄拯救世界。
【信号】题干关键词 plot 原词复现 + 冒号定义式说明。The plot of each superhero film has
become relatively predictable 里 plot 与题干 the plot of all superhero movies 是同一
指代，冒号后面用“世界陷入危机→英雄出场→英雄解危→拯救世界”五段式具体例证
predictable——既给定义又给例证，是答案句的典型信号。
【替换】relatively predictable ↔ relatively predictable
原词原义直接复现
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
It is rather unrealistic. 盗用了原文 numerous punches that land unrealistically well 里
的 unrealistically，但原文说的是“拳头打得不真实”，是描写动作镜头，不是说整个 plot
（剧情）不现实——把局部修饰偷换成整体判断。
借用原文：numerous punches that land unrealistically well
B) 张冠李戴
It is extremely artistic. 里 artistic 一词在原文出现的位置是第 3 段 They say the films
lack any form of artistry.——是精英说“缺乏 artistry”，恰好与“extremely artistic”相反；
且谈论对象是 films 整体而非 plot。
借用原文：They say the films lack any form of artistry.
C)
It is somewhat complicated. 与原文判断方向相反——第 3 段 These movies are
criticized as being too simple. 明说被批评为 too simple（太简单），与 complicated
（复杂）完全对立。
借用原文：These movies are criticized as being too simple.

questions.stem: What do the elites of American society think of superhero movies?

options.label: A
options.text: They are biased against women.

options.label: B
options.text: They are basically misleading.

options.label: C
options.text: They are full of shootings.

options.label: D
options.text: They are too simple.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） They are too simple.
【定位】The elites of our society have rejected superhero films. They say the films lack any form of
artistry. These movies are criticized as being too simple.
我们社会的精英已经拒绝了超级英雄电影。他们说这些电影毫无艺术性可言。这些电影被批
评为太过简单。
【信号】题干主语 elites 原词出现 + 三连否定评价。The elites of our society have rejected
superhero films. 中的 elites 与题干 the elites of American society 一致，紧跟 They say
与 are criticized 两个评价领句词，连出三句负面评价（rejected / lack any form of
artistry / too simple），其中最后一句 too simple 就是核心答案信号。
【替换】These movies are criticized as being too simple. ↔ They are too simple.
被动转主动 + too simple 原词复现
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
They are biased against women. 盗用了原文 women desire to play an irreplaceable
role 里的 women 一词，但第 4 段是作者引用作家观点说“女性想参与伟大冒险”，跟精英的
看法毫无关系；且原文从未说电影“对女性有偏见”。
借用原文：women desire to play an irreplaceable role in a great adventure
B) 过度推断
They are basically misleading. 用 misleading 替换了原文里的批评，但原文精英的批评只
有“lack artistry”和“too simple”，没有任何“误导观众”的意思——属于自行升级原文负评的
过度推断。
C) 未提及
They are full of shootings. 里的 shootings（枪战）一词在原文里根本没出现，唯一接近
的是 numerous punches（拳头），但 punches 是打斗、不是枪战，且这是讲套路不是精
英观点。

questions.stem: What does the passage say about storytelling?

options.label: A
options.text: It can highlight leadership.

options.label: B
options.text: It can help connect people.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a means to inspire creative thinking.

options.label: D
options.text: It is an intuitive way to solidify friendship.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） It can help connect people.
【定位】Storytelling forges connections among people.
讲故事会在人与人之间建立起紧密的联系。
【信号】首段并列直陈句。这是录音开头一气连说的核心结论之一：Telling stories is one of the
most powerful means leaders have to influence, teach and inspire. 之后紧跟
Storytelling forges connections among people.，用 forges 这个动作动词直接给
storytelling 下功能判断，是典型的『答案落在直陈结论句』的信号。
【替换】forges connections among people ↔ help connect people
动词同义＋名转动
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音首句出现 means leaders have to influence, teach and inspire，A 项把 leaders 与
leadership 嫁接成 highlight leadership，听到 leaders 就想选 A 是典型原词陷阱；但原
文是说『讲故事是领导者影响他人的手段』，并未说讲故事能突显领导力。
借用原文：means leaders have to influence, teach and inspire
C) 原词陷阱
录音里出现 influence, teach and inspire，inspire 的宾语并不是 creative thinking；C 项
把 inspire 抓出来后强行接上 creative thinking，构成『词对了搭配错了』的原词陷阱。
借用原文：influence, teach and inspire
D) 偷换概念
原文第二段确实有 help solidify relationships，D 项把 solidify 留住、把 relationships 偷
换成 friendship，缩小了范围。讲故事建立的是各种关系（包括职场关系），不专指友谊。
借用原文：help solidify relationships

questions.stem: What can good stories do to listeners according to the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: Allow them to recite data points.

options.label: B
options.text: Make them more open to learning.

options.label: C
options.text: Enable them to remember the main idea.

options.label: D
options.text: Stimulate them to engage in discussions.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Make them more open to learning.
【定位】They allow the listener to enter the story, making them more open to learning.
好故事让听者走进故事里，从而使他们更愿意去学习新东西。
【信号】主语 They + listener 直接出现。第三段开头 Good stories do more than create a
sense of connection. 起句后，紧跟一句 They allow the listener to enter the story,
making them more open to learning。主语 They 回指 Good stories、对象 listener 直
接出现，是题干两要素正合的句子，几乎一定是答案句。
【替换】making them more open to learning ↔ more open to learning
几乎原句搬运
【排除】A) 与原文相反
录音里讲 more engaging than the recital of data points，意思是故事比『罗列数据』更
吸引人——『让听众背数据』恰恰是讲故事要避免的反例。A 项把这个反向参照偷换成『允
许他们背数据』，方向反了。
借用原文：more engaging than the recital of data points
C) 偷换概念
录音说 Good stories can contain multiple meanings, so they're surprisingly
economical in conveying complex ideas in graspable ways.，意思是故事能以可理解的
方式传达复杂观点，但没说『让听者记住 main idea』。C 项把 graspable ways 与
conveying ideas 模糊归并成『记住主旨』，属于概念偷换。
借用原文：conveying complex ideas in graspable ways
D) 原词陷阱
录音里既出现 more engaging than the recital of data points or a discussion of
abstract ideas，D 项就把 engage 和 discussion 拼凑成 engage in discussions，但原文
是把『抽象观点的讨论』当成对照面，并不是说故事让听者参与讨论。
借用原文：a discussion of abstract ideas

questions.stem: What can leaders do with a simple personal story?

options.label: A
options.text: Inspire listeners' imagination.

options.label: B
options.text: Convey fundamental values.

options.label: C
options.text: Enrich their own experience.

options.label: D
options.text: Explain insightful ideas.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Convey fundamental values.
【定位】with a simple personal story, they can convey fundamental values.
凭借一个简单的个人故事，领导者就能传递出根本性的价值观。
【信号】题干双锚点同句出现。第四段中 with a simple personal story, they can convey
fundamental values 一句同时出现 simple personal story（与题干 a simple personal
story 完全对应）与代词 they（回指上文的 leaders），是题干两个关键词联合命中的句
子，必然就是答案承载句。
【替换】convey fundamental values ↔ Convey fundamental values
原句搬运
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音末句出现 they are more likely to inspire others to want to know more，A 项把
inspire 抓出来后接上 listeners' imagination，但原文是说激发别人『想了解更多』而非激
发『想象力』；inspire 的宾语被偷换了。
借用原文：inspire others to want to know more
C) 张冠李戴
录音里 They can offer insight into the evolution of their own experience and
knowledge，their own experience 指的是 leaders 自己的经验，而且动作是『提供洞
察』而非『丰富经验』；C 项把『让别人看见自己的经验』偷换成『丰富他们的经验』，主
体与动作都偏了。
借用原文：offer insight into the evolution of their own experience and knowledge
D) 原词陷阱
录音里出现 offer insight into the evolution of their own experience and knowledge，
D 项 Explain insightful ideas. 用 insightful 这个同根词钓人，但原文动作是『提供对自身
经验演变的洞见』，不是『解释富有洞见的观点』；同根词＋搭配错位是典型陷阱。
借用原文：offer insight into the evolution of their own experience and knowledge

questions.stem: What does the passage say statistics prove?

options.label: A
options.text: Immigrants outnumber U.S.-born Americans.

options.label: B
options.text: Immigrants have been contributing to the U.S.

options.label: C
options.text: Another wave of immigrants is hitting the U.S.

options.label: D
options.text: The number of immigrants to the U.S. is declining.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Immigrants have been contributing to the U.S.
【定位】The U.S. was founded by successive waves of immigrants, and immigrants are still
contributing to America today—statistics prove it.
美国是由一波又一波的移民建立的，而移民们今天仍在为美国做出贡献——统计数据证明了
这一点。
【信号】开头点题 + 题干关键词 statistics 原词出现。这句话出现在 P1，正是篇章的开篇点题句；
题干里的关键词 statistics prove 在原文里以 statistics prove it 原词出现，it 指代的就是前
半句 immigrants are still contributing to America today——这是典型的「代词回指找答
案」信号。
【替换】immigrants are still contributing to America today ↔
Immigrants have been contributing to the U.S.
are still contributing today 与 have been contributing 的时态同义改写
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 Immigrants outnumber U.S.-born Americans. 把录音里反复出现的 immigrants 和
后文 U.S.-born individuals 拼到一起，编造出「移民人数超过本土美国人」的关系，但原
文从未比较两群体的人数。
借用原文：From 1996 to 2016, the pace at which immigrants started businesses was double that of
U.S.-born individuals.
C) 原词陷阱
选项 Another wave of immigrants is hitting the U.S. 盗用了原文 successive waves of
immigrants 里的 wave 一词，但原文说的是「美国由一波波移民建立」，不是「现在又来
一波」，时间和事件都被改了。
借用原文：The U.S. was founded by successive waves of immigrants
D) 与原文相反
选项 The number of immigrants to the U.S. is declining. 说移民数量在下降，但原文
immigrants are still contributing to America today 强调的是移民在持续贡献，且后文还
说从 1996 到 2016 移民创业速度是本土的两倍，整体方向是积极的，不存在数量下降。
借用原文：immigrants are still contributing to America today

questions.stem: What do we learn about immigrants in the U.S., compared with native-born Americans?

options.label: A
options.text: More of them expect their children to succeed in business.

options.label: B
options.text: They have fewer chances to be hired by U.S. companies.

options.label: C
options.text: They have founded most Fortune 500 companies.

options.label: D
options.text: More of them are successful business people.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） More of them are successful business people.
【定位】From 1996 to 2016, the pace at which immigrants started businesses was double that of U.S.-
born individuals. Immigrants aren't just becoming entrepreneurs more frequently. They're
often succeeding. Over 40% of Fortune 500 companies had a founder who was either an
immigrant or the child of one.
从 1996 年到 2016 年，移民创业的速度是美国本土出生者的两倍。移民不仅创业更频繁，
而且经常获得成功。超过 40% 的财富 500 强公司，其创始人要么是移民，要么是移民的
子女。
【信号】比较结构 double that of + 递进 aren't just…They're often succeeding。double
that of U.S.-born individuals 是与题干 compared with native-born Americans 直接对
应的比较信号；紧接着的 Immigrants aren't just becoming entrepreneurs more
frequently. They're often succeeding. 是 not just…but also 类递进结构，递进后面的
succeeding 是这道题的真正落点。
【替换】Immigrants aren't just becoming entrepreneurs more frequently. They're often succeeding. ↔
More of them are successful business people.
「entrepreneurs + succeeding」概括为「successful business people」
Over 40% of Fortune 500 companies had a founder who was either an immigrant or the child of one
↔ More of them are successful business people.
用 Fortune 500 创始人占比作为「成功生意人多」的具象证据
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 More of them expect their children to succeed in business. 盗用了原文 the child
of one 里的 child，编出「期望子女在事业上成功」这一根本没说的意思。原文只是说
Fortune 500 创始人有的是移民、有的是移民子女，并未提及移民对子女的期望。
借用原文：Over 40% of Fortune 500 companies had a founder who was either an immigrant or the
child of one.
B) 与原文相反
选项 They have fewer chances to be hired by U.S. companies. 说移民被美国公司雇佣的
机会更少，但原文整段说的是移民自己创业、自己当 founder，根本不是「被雇佣」的角
度，更没说机会更少。
借用原文：the pace at which immigrants started businesses was double that of U.S.-
born individuals
C) 原词陷阱
选项 They have founded most Fortune 500 companies. 盗用了录音里非常醒目的
Fortune 500，但原文是 Over 40% of Fortune 500 companies had a founder who was
either an immigrant or the child of one，是「超过 40%」且「创始人之一是移民或移民
子女」，绝不是 most（大多数）。这是典型的范围/程度被偷改。
借用原文：Over 40% of Fortune 500 companies had a founder who was either an immigrant or the
child of one.

questions.stem: What does the passage say about immigrants in the U.S., in terms of financial strength?

options.label: A
options.text: They have higher installment loan debt than native-born Americans.

options.label: B
options.text: Nineteen percent of them borrow money from friends and family.

options.label: C
options.text: Their level of debt is lower than that of native-born Americans.

options.label: D
options.text: Thirty-four percent of them use credit for their daily purchases.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Their level of debt is lower than that of native-born Americans.
【定位】Another key measure of financial strength is debt level. Immigrants do better in this area too.
Immigrants use credit less often for purchasing cars, homes or starting businesses. This
results in significantly lower levels of debt than native-born Americans.
另一项衡量经济实力的关键指标是债务水平。移民在这方面表现也更好。移民较少使用信贷
购买汽车、住房或创业。这使得他们的债务水平显著低于美国本土出生者。
【信号】比较结构 lower…than + 因果信号 This results in。significantly lower levels of debt
than native-born Americans 是与题干 compared with native-born Americans 完全对
应的比较句；前面的 This results in 是因果信号，把「少用信贷」的原因和「债务更低」的
结果连起来，使这句成为本段的核心结论句。
【替换】This results in significantly lower levels of debt than native-born Americans. ↔
Their level of debt is lower than that of native-born Americans.
几乎是原文的「近义同结构改写」
【排除】A) 与原文相反
选项 They have higher installment loan debt than native-born Americans. 盗用了原文
installment loan debt，但原文明确说移民的债务「显著更低」，这里却说「更高」，方向
完全反掉。
借用原文：This results in significantly lower levels of debt than native-born Americans.
B) 张冠李戴
选项 Nineteen percent of them borrow money from friends and family. 盗用了原文
just 19% of the general population 里的 19% 和后文 they borrow money from
friends and family 中的借钱方式，但 19% 在原文里指的是 general population（一般人
口）里「没有信用卡或分期贷款债务」的比例，根本不是「19% 的移民找亲友借钱」。两
个原词被强行拼到一起，是典型的张冠李戴。
借用原文：just 19% of the general population
D) 原词陷阱
选项 Thirty-four percent of them use credit for their daily purchases. 盗用了原文 34%
of Americans born in Latin America 的 34%，但原文是说 34% 的拉美裔美国人「没有」
信用卡或分期贷款债务，选项却说「34% 的人用信用卡做日常消费」，对象不对、行为也
反过来了，还加上了 daily purchases 这个原文没有的限定。
借用原文：34% of Americans born in Latin America report no credit card or installment loan debt.

questions.stem: What do immigrants do to achieve their goals in the U.S.?

options.label: A
options.text: Keep their traditional values and old habits.

options.label: B
options.text: Find employment in competitive businesses.

options.label: C
options.text: Borrow money from financial institutions.

options.label: D
options.text: Collaborate with native-born Americans.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Keep their traditional values and old habits.
【定位】Why are immigrants doing so well? The values and habits they bring from their own
homelands help explain some of the success.
为什么移民们做得这么好？他们从故乡带来的价值观与习惯，可以解释他们部分的成功。
【信号】设问句 Why + 解释句中的 values and habits。Why are immigrants doing so well? 是
篇章独白里典型的设问句，紧接着的 The values and habits they bring from their own
homelands help explain some of the success. 是直接回答这个设问的解释句，整段功能
就是「解释移民达成目标的原因」。这是篇章独白里最强的「答案信号」之一。
【替换】The values and habits they bring from their own homelands ↔
Keep their traditional values and old habits.
「从故乡带来的价值观和习惯」=「保留传统价值观和旧习惯」
individuals must save more in order to achieve their goals ↔
Keep their traditional values and old habits.
in order to achieve their goals 与题干呼应，save more 是 old habits 的具体表现
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
选项 Find employment in competitive businesses. 盗用了原文反复出现的 businesses，
但原文说的是移民自己 started businesses（自己创业），而非 find employment（找工
作被雇佣），且原文从未提及行业「竞争激烈」。
借用原文：the pace at which immigrants started businesses was double that of U.S.-
born individuals
C) 与原文相反
选项 Borrow money from financial institutions. 盗用了原文 they borrow money from
friends and family rather than a bank 里的 borrow money，但原文明确说移民是「找亲
友借，而不是找银行」，financial institutions（金融机构）正好就是 bank 那一边，选项
把方向反掉了。rather than 是这道题的关键否定信号。
借用原文：they borrow money from friends and family rather than a bank
D) 未提及
选项 Collaborate with native-born Americans. 提出「与本土美国人合作」，但全文只出
现「移民 vs 本土美国人」的对比，从未提及二者合作。属于无中生有。
