questions.stem: What is the news report mainly about?

options.label: A
options.text: A proposed policy allowing Africans to travel in Africa without a visa.

options.label: B
options.text: An agreement among 13 African countries to set up a free-trade zone.

options.label: C
options.text: A plan to invite all African countries to join the African Union.

options.label: D
options.text: An important initiative to permit tourists to visit Africa without a visa.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （主旨题） A proposed policy allowing Africans to travel in Africa without a visa.
【定位】African leaders plan to turn the continent into a continent without borders. They will
introduce a single passport policy, allowing free movement between countries.
非洲各国领导人计划把整个非洲大陆变成一个没有边界的大陆。他们将推出统一护照政策，
允许各国之间自由通行。
【信号】开头点题即主旨。新闻类听力的导语句几乎就是主旨句。African leaders plan to turn the
continent into a continent without borders. 这一句开门见山讲"非洲领导人要让整个非
洲免边界（即免签）"，紧接着 They will introduce a single passport policy, allowing
free movement between countries. 直接落到具体政策上——"政策+对象"全在这里。
【替换】turn the continent into a continent without borders ↔ travel in Africa without a visa
"无边界"="免签通行"
allowing free movement between countries ↔ Africans to travel in Africa
free movement=travel
The African Union, which represents 54 states, wants to abolish the requirement of a visa for
Africans visiting other African countries.
↔ A proposed policy allowing Africans to travel in Africa without a visa.
原文反复点 Africans+visa
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
B 盗用了录音 Currently, 13 African countries have visa-free deals in place with each
other. 里的 13 African countries 这个数字原词，但原文说的是"目前已有 13 国互相免
签"，根本不是"13 国设立自贸区"——自贸区在原文里是另一桩"未来要做的事"，不限于 13
国。
借用原文：Currently, 13 African countries have visa-free deals in place with each other.
C) 原词陷阱
C 盗用了原文 The African Union, which represents 54 states（非盟代表 54 个国家）中
的 African Union 这一专名，制造"听到非盟就想选"的诱惑；但原文谈的是非盟"代表"54 国
并推动免签自贸，根本没说要"邀请各国加入非盟"——加入与否不是本新闻的话题。
借用原文：The African Union, which represents 54 states
D) 张冠李戴
D 用 tourists 替换了原文里的 Africans——原文 Americans are able to travel to 20 of
the continent's countries without a visa 是在拿"美国人（外来游客的代表）现状"与"非洲
人现状"作对照，目的恰恰是说"非洲人反而不如外人方便、所以才要改"。把主体从"非洲
人"偷换到"游客"，正好与新闻核心相反。
借用原文：Americans are able to travel to 20 of the continent's countries without a visa

questions.stem: What benefit will a free trade deal bring to African economy?

options.label: A
options.text: It will attract more investments from all over the world.

options.label: B
options.text: It will help many African countries reduce trade deficits.

options.label: C
options.text: It will reduce the cost of trade between African countries.

options.label: D
options.text: It will allow Africans to play a bigger role in world trade.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） It will reduce the cost of trade between African countries.
【定位】It also wants to establish a free trade deal across the continent in the near future, as trade
within the African continent costs more than any other region.
（非盟）还希望在不久的将来在整个非洲大陆建立自由贸易协定，因为目前非洲大陆内部的
贸易成本比其他任何地区都要高。
【信号】as 引出原因即落点。答案句里出现因果信号词 as trade within the African continent
costs more than any other region——as 在这里是"因为"。"自贸要解决的问题=非洲内
部贸易最贵"，反过来推就是"自贸的好处=降低非洲内部贸易成本"。这就是听力"信号词后
是落点"的典型用法。
【替换】trade within the African continent costs more than any other region ↔
reduce the cost of trade between African countries
因果对调＋反义改写
【排除】A) 未提及
录音通篇没提到 investment / invest 任何形式的词。A 听起来"很正确"是因为它符合考生
对"自贸好处"的常识联想，但题目问的是录音里给出的好处，不是考生想到的好处。
B) 偷换概念
B 用 trade deficits（贸易逆差）替换了原文真正说的 trade costs（贸易成本）。"贸易成
本"和"贸易逆差"是两个完全不同的经济概念——前者是"做生意要花多少钱"，后者是"进口
比出口多多少"。选项利用了 trade 这个原词来诱选。
借用原文：trade within the African continent costs more than any other region
D) 过度推断
D 说的 a bigger role in world trade（在世界贸易中扮演更大角色）把范围从"非洲内部"扩
到了"全世界"。原文里 free trade deal 限定的范围是 across the continent（在整个非洲
大陆），目标是降低非洲国家之间的贸易成本，并未谈到非洲在世界贸易里的地位变化。
借用原文：establish a free trade deal across the continent
Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.
1 Researchers in Iceland found a new way of tackling climate change by pumping carbon dioxide
underground and turning it into stone. Other carbon capture and storage methods store carbon dioxide as
a gas. But problems include a high cost and concern about leaks. This new method of burying carbon
dioxide and turning it into stone is cheaper and more secure, the Guardian reports. To turn carbon
dioxide into stone, researchers with the CarbFix project pumped the gas into volcanic rock and sped up
the natural process, in which the volcanic rock reacts with gas and forms carbon minerals. The gas
turned into solid in just two years, much faster than the hundreds or thousands of years researchers had
predicted. The research took place at Iceland's Hellisheidi power plant. Already, the project in Iceland
has been increased in scale to bury 10,000 tons of carbon dioxide each year. One potential difficulty is
that for each ton of carbon dioxide buried, the technique requires 25 tons of water. However, the lead
researcher said sea water could be used.

questions.stem: What new method has been developed to help fight climate change?

options.label: A
options.text: Cooling down volcanic rock with sea water.

options.label: B
options.text: Storing carbon dioxide underground as a gas.

options.label: C
options.text: Capturing carbon dioxide and burying it under the sea.

options.label: D
options.text: Pumping carbon dioxide underground to form stone.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Pumping carbon dioxide underground to form stone.
【定位】Researchers in Iceland found a new way of tackling climate change by pumping carbon
dioxide underground and turning it into stone.
冰岛的研究人员发现了一种应对气候变化的新方法：把二氧化碳泵入地下，将其变成石头。
【信号】首句点题信号 a new way。Researchers in Iceland found a new way of tackling
climate change 中的 found a new way 与题干 new method 形成同义对接，是新闻典型
的开门见山首句点题，这一句直接承载新方法是什么的答案。
【替换】pumping carbon dioxide underground ↔ Pumping carbon dioxide underground
原词同形复现
turning it into stone ↔ to form stone
turn into = form 的动词同义替换
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项把录音里两处出现的 volcanic rock 与 sea water 拼成 cooling down volcanic rock
with sea water，但录音从未说过冷却火山岩这件事，cooling 是凭空造的动作。
借用原文：pumped the gas into volcanic rock
B) 张冠李戴
录音原文 Other carbon capture and storage methods store carbon dioxide as a gas.
明确说把二氧化碳以气体形式储存是其他/已有方法，本则新闻要讲的恰恰是与之对照的新
方法；选项 B 把旧方法当成新方法的答案，是典型张冠李戴。
借用原文：Other carbon capture and storage methods store carbon dioxide as a gas.
C) 偷换概念
录音说的是 burying carbon dioxide and turning it into stone，埋的地方是地下
（underground / volcanic rock），但选项 C 写成 burying it under the sea，把地点偷
换成海底；只是单词长得像，意思完全偏。
借用原文：burying carbon dioxide and turning it into stone

questions.stem: What is a potential difficulty in applying the new technique?

options.label: A
options.text: Lack of burying ground.

options.label: B
options.text: Long time for processing.

options.label: C
options.text: High consumption of water.

options.label: D
options.text: Enormous cost of energy.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） High consumption of water.
【定位】One potential difficulty is that for each ton of carbon dioxide buried, the technique requires
25 tons of water.
一个潜在的困难是，每埋藏一吨二氧化碳，这项技术需要 25 吨水。
【信号】题干原词信号 One potential difficulty。One potential difficulty is that 与题干
potential difficulty 用词几乎完全一致，是录音替我们点出的答案句信号词；这是新闻收尾
段最常见的转折/补充结构，信号词后那一句就是承载答案的句子。
【替换】requires 25 tons of water ↔ High consumption of water
数量级 → 程度词，动词 → 名词化
for each ton of carbon dioxide buried, the technique requires 25 tons of water ↔
High consumption of water
1∶25 比例支撑 High 这一判断
【排除】A) 未提及
录音并未提到埋藏地点不够这件事，反而提到 the project in Iceland has been increased
in scale to bury 10,000 tons of carbon dioxide each year，说明埋藏规模在扩大，不是
缺地的问题；选项 A 属于无中生有。
B) 与原文相反
录音说的是 The gas turned into solid in just two years, much faster than the
hundreds or thousands of years researchers had predicted.，明确强调这项技术比预期
快得多，并不是耗时长；选项 B 取了 hundreds of years 这一原词却反了方向。
借用原文：The gas turned into solid in just two years, much faster than the hundreds or thousands
of years researchers had predicted.
D) 原词陷阱
录音里的 Other carbon capture and storage methods store carbon dioxide as a gas.
But problems include a high cost and concern about leaks. 中的 high cost 是描述其
他/旧方法的问题，且讲的是费用而非 energy；选项 D 把 cost 与 energy 拼到一起，既张
冠李戴（说的是旧方法）、又偷换概念（cost ≠ energy）。
借用原文：problems include a high cost and concern about leaks

questions.stem: What does the news report say about French people's bread consumption?

options.label: A
options.text: It varies with the seasons.

options.label: B
options.text: It has been on the decline.

options.label: C
options.text: It has caused nationwide concern.

options.label: D
options.text: It is ninety grams daily on average.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） It has been on the decline.
【定位】The National Association of French Millers says bread consumption is on the decline, with
French people eating nine grams less than in the previous year.
法国全国磨坊主协会表示，面包消费正在下滑，法国人比前一年少吃了 9 克。
【信号】权威主体+趋势动词直陈。The National Association of French Millers says bread
consumption is on the decline 一句里，权威主体 says 引出对消费状况的直接断言，is
on the decline 是清晰的趋势判定信号，是本题事实陈述题的典型答案句标志。
【替换】bread consumption is on the decline ↔ It has been on the decline.
几乎原词直接对应
【排除】A) 未提及
It varies with the seasons. 在录音里找不到任何 season/seasonal/winter/summer 之类
的踪迹，属于完全凭空捏造的方向。
C)
录音里说 The association is concerned about the effects this trend will have on their
trade，关注者是行业协会、关注对象是他们的生意，选项 nationwide concern 把范围扩
大到了'全国关注'，是典型的范围/程度放大。
借用原文：The association is concerned about the effects this trend will have on their trade
D) 原词陷阱
录音里的 90 grams 出现在 women eat 80 to 90 grams，特指女性消费区间的上限，不是
全体法国人的日均量；选项 It is ninety grams daily on average. 盗用了原文中的 90
grams 这个原词，却安到了'整体平均'头上，是典型原词陷阱。
借用原文：women eat 80 to 90 grams

questions.stem: What do we learn about French women from their port?

options.label: A
options.text: They emphasize food variety.

options.label: B
options.text: They prefer French stick loaves.

options.label: C
options.text: They do more cooking than men.

options.label: D
options.text: They favor diets lower in calories.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） They favor diets lower in calories.
【定位】Firstly, the association cited changing diets, in particular, the switch to those low in calories,
as a factor in the reduction of bread consumption. This could explain why the difference in
consumption between genders is so big. Nowadays, men eat an approximate average of 140
grams of bread daily, whereas women eat 80 to 90 grams.
首先，协会指出饮食结构的变化、特别是转向低卡饮食，是面包消费下降的一个原因。这或
许能解释为什么男女之间的消费差距如此之大。如今男性日均吃约 140 克面包，而女性只吃
80 到 90 克。
【信号】因果链 explain why+男女对比。the switch to those low in calories 与 This could
explain why the difference in consumption between genders is so big 通过 explain
why 把低卡饮食与男女消费差异连成因果链，男性 140g/女性 80–90g 的对比正好印证女
性更倾向低卡，这条因果链就是本题的答案信号。
【替换】the switch to those low in calories ↔ favor diets lower in calories
the switch to=favor 的同义改写
women eat 80 to 90 grams ↔ favor diets lower in calories
对比数据印证偏好
【排除】A)
They emphasize food variety. 在录音里找不到 variety/different kinds 之类的对应表达，
属于无中生有。
B) 原词陷阱
录音 People in France are keeping away from the narrow French stick loaf 明确说法国
人是'远离'法棍，而 They prefer French stick loaves. 偷换为'偏爱'，方向正好相反，且盗
用了 French stick loaves 这一原词制造熟悉感。
借用原文：People in France are keeping away from the narrow French stick loaf
C) 偷换概念
They do more cooking than men. 在录音里完全没有 cook/cooking 的对应词，且男女
对比的对象始终是'吃多少面包'而非'谁下厨'，属于编造对比维度。

questions.stem: What is said about lifestyle changes of the French people?

options.label: A
options.text: They bake more bread at home.

options.label: B
options.text: They spend less time eating breakfast.

options.label: C
options.text: They eat more fruit than they used to.

options.label: D
options.text: They put jam instead of butter on bread.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） They spend less time eating breakfast.
【定位】The second reason they say is lifestyle changes in the country, with people dedicating less
time to breakfast when bread would traditionally be eaten with butter and jam.
他们说的第二个原因是这个国家的生活方式发生了变化——人们花在早餐上的时间变少了，
而早餐传统上是把面包配上黄油和果酱来吃的。
【信号】明示 lifestyle changes 标题句。The second reason they say is lifestyle changes in
the country 直接以 lifestyle changes 标题切入，紧接的 dedicating less time to
breakfast 就是这条生活方式变化的具体内容，是本题答案句的明确信号。
【替换】dedicating less time to breakfast ↔ They spend less time eating breakfast.
dedicate=spend 的同义替换
【排除】A) 未提及
They bake more bread at home. 在录音里找不到 bake/at home 的踪迹，是无中生有的
方向。
C)
eat more fruit than they used to 用了 used to 这种生活方式变化的常见框架来伪装，但
fruit 在录音里完全没出现，属于借框架编内容。
D) 原词陷阱
录音里 bread would traditionally be eaten with butter and jam 表明的是传统上面包
是'同时'配黄油和果酱来吃，并不存在'用果酱取代黄油'。选项 put jam instead of butter
on bread 盗用了 butter 和 jam 两个原词，又添加 instead of 制造一个原文没有的替换关
系。
借用原文：bread would traditionally be eaten with butter and jam

questions.stem: When would the man like to leave for London?

options.label: A
options.text: After the rush hour.

options.label: B
options.text: Early in the morning.

options.label: C
options.text: As soon as possible.

options.label: D
options.text: Around lunch time.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） After the rush hour.
【定位】Well, after the rush hour, I think. We'd like to avoid the crowds if possible. So, probably
sometime around 10 o'clock.
嗯，我想是早高峰之后吧。我们希望尽量避开人潮。所以大概十点钟左右。
【信号】被问者的直接应答。前一句售票员问 What time would you like to go?，紧接着男士开口
Well, after the rush hour, I think.——这是"问—答"结构里答的那一句，是听力定位答案
最稳的信号。
【替换】after the rush hour ↔ After the rush hour.
原句原词整体回收
avoid the crowds ↔ After the rush hour.
因果同义印证
【排除】B) 未提及
录音里没有任何 early in the morning 的表述；恰恰相反，男士说 after the rush hour，
明显是"避开早高峰"——选 B 等于把"早高峰之后"反着理解成"清早"。
C) 与原文相反
As soon as possible. 与男士 after the rush hour avoid the crowds 的意思相反——他要
的是错开高峰、不是越早越好。
借用原文：after the rush hour
D) 过度推断
男士说 sometime around 10 o'clock，10 点不是午餐时间；选 D 是把"10 点"误推到
lunch time，属于对原词的过度引申。
借用原文：around 10 o'clock

questions.stem: What is the man's other request?

options.label: A
options.text: Two first class seats.

options.label: B
options.text: Two seats together.

options.label: C
options.text: One window seat.

options.label: D
options.text: One seat near the exit.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） One window seat.
【定位】Second class is fine. Thanks. Is there any chance we could have a window seat for one
of those?
二等座就行，谢谢。其中一张能不能给我们安排一个靠窗的座位？
【信号】请求句 Is there any chance。男士在确认席别后用 Is there any chance we could have
a window seat for one of those? 主动提出一个"额外要求"，这种请求句式是答案信号；
前半 Second class is fine. 是先答售票员问题，真正的 other request 在 chance 之后。
【替换】a window seat for one of those ↔ One window seat.
数量+席位类型逐项对齐
【排除】A) 与原文相反
男士明确说 Second class is fine.——选的是二等座，不是头等座；A 项盗用了对话里讨论
过的 first class 话题词，但极性反了。
借用原文：Second class is fine.
B) 张冠李戴
I've booked those seats next to each other for you. 是售票员主动给出的服务，不是男
士提出的请求；B 项盗用了 next to each other = together 的语义，但来源不是男士——
属于把售票员的话安到男士头上。
借用原文：I've booked those seats next to each other for you.
D) 未提及
One seat near the exit. 里的 exit 在录音中完全没念，属于凭常识或对窗口座位的反义臆
造出的干扰项。

questions.stem: Where should the man wait for the train?

options.label: A
options.text: In the middle of the platform.

options.label: B
options.text: At the far end of the platform.

options.label: C
options.text: Behind the yellow line.

options.label: D
options.text: In the waiting room.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） At the far end of the platform.
【定位】All you need to do is wait at the far end of the platform.
你们要做的就是在站台的最远端等候。
【信号】All you need to do 的指示句。All you need to do is wait at the far end of the
platform. 用 All you need to do 这种强调式的祈使指示句，等于给出一条明确指令，是答
案信号；后面紧跟 When the train arrives, tell the train guard... 是补充流程，不是该等的
地点。
【替换】at the far end of the platform ↔ At the far end of the platform.
原句完整搬运
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音只说在 the far end of the platform 等车，没有说 middle；A 项盗用了原文里的
platform 一词，把方位偷换成 middle。
借用原文：at the far end of the platform
C) 未提及
录音里完全没提 yellow line；这是日常乘车经验里的安全规则，主体考生容易凭母语常识硬
选。
D) 未提及
录音里也没提 waiting room；男士被告知直接到 the far end of the platform 等车，不是
去候车室。

questions.stem: What should the man do to collect the bicycles?

options.label: A
options.text: Wait in a queue for his turn.

options.label: B
options.text: Go to the baggage claim area.

options.label: C
options.text: Pay an extra fee for the service.

options.label: D
options.text: Give the ticket to the train guard.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Give the ticket to the train guard.
【定位】When you arrive in London, hand the ticket to the guard and he will return the bicycles
to you.
等你们到了伦敦，把票交给乘务员，他会把自行车还给你们。
【信号】When you arrive 的时间状语+祈使。When you arrive in London, hand the ticket to
the guard and he will return the bicycles to you. 这一句的 When you arrive in
London 正好对应题干 to collect the bicycles 的"到达后"语境；hand the ticket 是祈使动
词，他/还给你 是结果——这是地道的答案信号。
【替换】hand the ticket to the guard ↔ Give the ticket to the train guard.
同义动词替换
he will return the bicycles to you ↔ Give the ticket to the train guard.
因果配套印证
【排除】A) 未提及
录音里没有 wait in a queue 或类似的排队动作；A 项是凭常识"想象车站要排队"硬塞的。
B) 偷换概念
baggage claim area 是机场用语；录音里说的是 he will help you secure the bicycles in
the last carriage——在火车最后一节车厢交接，不存在行李提取区。B 项盗用了与"取
回"语义相似的航空场景词。
借用原文：he will help you secure the bicycles in the last carriage
C) 与原文相反
售票员明确说 It's no extra cost. The price will be the same.——不会再收额外费用；C
项却说要 pay an extra fee，与原文极性正相反。
借用原文：It's no extra cost.

questions.stem: What do we learn about hat factories in Britain?

options.label: A
options.text: Almost all of them were operating at a deficit.

options.label: B
options.text: They have all been turned into movie theatres.

options.label: C
options.text: Nearly all of them closed down decades ago.

options.label: D
options.text: They have adapted to meet fashion changes.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Nearly all of them closed down decades ago.
【定位】There used to be many hat factories in Britain until around the 1950s, but fashion changed
and most people stopped wearing hats. So practically all of those factories had to close down.
英国曾经有很多帽厂，一直延续到 1950 年代左右；但后来潮流变了，大多数人不再戴帽
子，所以那些工厂几乎全都倒闭了。
【信号】but + So 的双重连接信号。but fashion changed 的 but 把话题从「曾经繁荣」掰向「后
来衰落」，紧接 So practically all of those factories had to close down. 的 So 又把因果
一锤定音——「but 转折 + So 结论」这一组连贯信号，正是答案句的标志。
【替换】practically all of those factories had to close down ↔
Nearly all of them closed down decades ago.
practically ≈ nearly，1950s = decades ago
【排除】A) 未提及
录音从头到尾没提帽厂亏损的事，Almost all of them were operating at a deficit. 是把
「衰落」这个事实换成了「亏损」这个具体的财务原因，原文并未给出。
B) 原词陷阱
They have all been turned into movie theatres. 盗用了 we transformed it into a
movie theater 中「改造成电影院」的措辞——但录音明说这件事只发生在「这一家」帽厂
（This one, in particular, was closed for 47 years before we transformed it into a
movie theater.），把单数案例扩大到全部，是典型张冠李戴。
借用原文：This one, in particular, was closed for 47 years before we transformed it into a
movie theater.
D) 与原文相反
录音说 fashion changed and most people stopped wearing hats 才导致工厂关门——
是被潮流「抛弃」，而非 They have adapted to meet fashion changes. 所说的「成功顺
应潮流」，极性正好相反。
借用原文：fashion changed and most people stopped wearing hats

questions.stem: What is special about Cube Movie Theater?

options.label: A
options.text: It shows foreign movies exclusively.

options.label: B
options.text: It shows movies from the 1950s.

options.label: C
options.text: It is the oldest theatre in London.

options.label: D
options.text: It is located next to a hat factory.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） It shows foreign movies exclusively.
【定位】We are the only movie theater in the whole country that only shows foreign movies.
我们是全国唯一一家只放外语电影的影院。
【信号】the only + only 双重独家信号。the only movie theater in the whole country 用 the
only 给独特性钉了第一颗钉子，that only shows foreign movies 又用 only 把范围进一步
缩死——「the only ... only」这种双重限定，是答案句最强的信号。
【替换】only shows foreign movies ↔ It shows foreign movies exclusively.
only ↔ exclusively 的同义替换
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
It shows movies from the 1950s. 把第 12 题里出现过的 until around the 1950s 这个时
间数字盗过来当影院题材，制造「听到 1950s 就想选」的诱惑——可 1950s 在录音里讲的
是「帽厂的年代」，而非影院上映的电影年代，是典型的张冠李戴。
借用原文：until around the 1950s
C) 未提及
It is the oldest theatre in London. 录音里压根没提「最老」，反而说 Cube Movie
Theater has been around now for 11 years.——只有 11 年的影院显然算不上 oldest。
借用原文：Cube Movie Theater has been around now for 11 years.
D) 原词陷阱
It is located next to a hat factory. 利用了录音里 It's located in what used to be a hat
factory. 的措辞——但原文说的是「影院开在原先的帽厂里」，next to（紧邻）与 in what
used to be（开在旧址里）位置关系完全不同，是典型的偷换位置概念。
借用原文：It's located in what used to be a hat factory.

questions.stem: What does the man say about most people in London?

options.label: A
options.text: They wear hats on social occasions.

options.label: B
options.text: They don't speak foreign languages.

options.label: C
options.text: They enjoy watching foreign movies.

options.label: D
options.text: They don't go to movie theatres often.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） They don't speak foreign languages.
【定位】Is there enough demand for that? I would have thought that in London, most people don't
speak foreign languages.
这种电影真有那么多人看吗？我本以为伦敦的大多数人是不懂外语的。
【信号】I would have thought + most people don't 的观点信号。I would have thought that
... 是男方亮出自己看法的标志性结构，紧跟其后的 most people don't speak foreign
languages 就是他对伦敦多数人的判断——「I thought / I would have thought」之后那
句是观点句，必抓。
【替换】most people don't speak foreign languages ↔ They don't speak foreign languages.
几乎原句对原句，主语等值替换
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
They wear hats on social occasions. 利用录音里反复出现的 most people stopped
wearing hats 这个词组制造熟悉感——但原文是说英国人「不再戴帽」，并非「在社交场
合戴帽」，且这句话是关于「英国人对帽子的态度」，不是「伦敦人对外语的态度」，话题
与说话人都对不上。
借用原文：most people stopped wearing hats
C) 与原文相反
They enjoy watching foreign movies. 的极性正好和男方观点相反——男方明说 most
people don't speak foreign languages，正是在质疑「demand 够不够」，而非肯定他们
爱看外语片；而后女方才反驳说外语片仍有市场，但那是女方的话，不是男方的。
借用原文：most people don't speak foreign languages
D) 未提及
They don't go to movie theatres often. 是关于伦敦人「去影院频率」的描述，录音里从
未提及伦敦人「常不常去影院」，属于无中生有。

questions.stem: What does the woman say about foreign movies shown in London?

options.label: A
options.text: They are meant mostly for immigrants.

options.label: B
options.text: They attract large crowds of young Londoners.

options.label: C
options.text: They are hard for English people to appreciate.

options.label: D
options.text: They have an English translation on the screen.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） They have an English translation on the screen.
【定位】Furthermore, I might add, all movies come with English text at the bottom of the screen. So
even if you don't understand what the actors say, you can still read it.
另外我得补一句，所有的电影都在屏幕下方配有英文文字，所以哪怕听不懂演员说什么，你
也能读字幕。
【信号】Furthermore + I might add 的补充强调信号。女方一连用 Furthermore 和 I might add
两个补充强调标志把这条信息推到台前，紧跟其后给出「屏幕下方有英文」这一具体事实
——「Furthermore + I might add」组合是答主特别想让人记住的那一句的信号灯。
【替换】all movies come with English text at the bottom of the screen ↔
They have an English translation on the screen.
English text ↔ English translation；at the bottom of the screen ↔ on the screen
even if you don't understand what the actors say, you can still read it ↔
They have an English translation on the screen.
补充句佐证字幕功能
【排除】A) 未提及
They are meant mostly for immigrants. 把外语片的受众限定为「移民」，录音里完全没
出现 immigrants 这个话题，是凭常识脑补出来的无中生有。
B) 原词陷阱
They attract large crowds of young Londoners. 利用了录音中 lots of people
interested in watching such movies 与 London 的搭配——但原文只说「有很多人感兴
趣」，并未限定为「年轻伦敦人」；选项把宽泛的 lots of people 偷换成具体的 young
Londoners，加了原文没有的修饰语 young。
借用原文：lots of people interested in watching such movies
C) 与原文相反
They are hard for English people to appreciate. 的极性和女方观点相反——女方一直在
反驳「外语片在伦敦没人看」的怀疑，强调 there's enough demand 和 lots of people
interested，没有任何「难以欣赏」的意思。
借用原文：there's enough demand

questions.stem: What do we learn about Astrid Natley, a secondary school math teacher?

options.label: A
options.text: She doesn't think smartphones can replace tablets.

options.label: B
options.text: She incorporates smartphones into her teaching.

options.label: C
options.text: She cannot stop children using smartphones.

options.label: D
options.text: She regards smartphones as a distraction.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） She incorporates smartphones into her teaching.
【定位】Astrid Natley, a secondary school math teacher, incorporates phones into her classroom.
Astrid Natley是一位中学数学老师，她把手机融入到了自己的课堂里。
【信号】人物登场首句即定调。原文Astrid Natley, a secondary school math teacher,
incorporates phones into her classroom.是该人物在文中首次出现的那句话，篇章独白介
绍人物时通常"姓名+身份+核心做法"一句话点题，这种"登场首句"就是关于该人物事实的答
案信号。
【替换】incorporates phones into her classroom ↔ incorporates smartphones into her teaching
phones=smartphones、classroom≈teaching
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音里她说My school doesn't have money for tablets，意思是"学校没钱买平板，所以
才用手机"，盗用了原文的tablets一词，做成"她不认为手机能替代平板"这种相反观点，属
于原词陷阱+与原文相反。
借用原文：My school doesn't have money for tablets
C) 偷换概念
录音If we stop children using phones, we're rejecting something they care about.
是"如果我们阻止孩子用手机，等于拒绝他们在乎的东西"——是"不愿阻止"的价值判断；选
项She cannot stop children using smartphones.盗用stop children using phones原
词，却换成"无法阻止"，偷换了情态。
借用原文：If we stop children using phones, we're rejecting something they care about.
D) 与原文相反
原文她把手机视为a powerful tool in their hands，是正面评价；选项She regards
smartphones as a distraction.却说她把手机视为"干扰"，立场与原文相反。
借用原文：a powerful tool in their hands

questions.stem: Why does Helen Lockhart, a registered nurse, support a complete ban on smartphone use in the classroom?

options.label: A
options.text: To enforce school discipline.

options.label: B
options.text: To make students concentrate.

options.label: C
options.text: To help children grow up to be professionals.

options.label: D
options.text: To cultivate children's good study habits.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） To help children grow up to be professionals.
【定位】We need to teach children how to behave like the professionals they are striving to become.
我们需要教孩子们像他们将来要努力成为的那些专业人士一样去行事。
【信号】段尾"need to"目的陈述。原文We need to teach children how to behave like the
professionals they are striving to become.位于Helen段落末尾，以We need to开头的句
子是她整段论证的结论与目的——"need to"是表目的的强信号词，是答案信号。
【替换】teach children how to behave like the professionals they are striving to become ↔
To help children grow up to be professionals
behave like professionals=grow up to be professionals
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音I will be subject to disciplinary procedure是她讲自己工作场所的纪律后果，作为引
出"教孩子像专业人士"目的的铺垫；选项To enforce school discipline.盗用disciplinary原
词，扭成"她支持禁手机的目的是维护校纪"，张冠李戴。
借用原文：I will be subject to disciplinary procedure
B) 未提及
录音里Helen段没有任何关于concentration/focus/attention的表述，选项To make
students concentrate.是听上去合理但原文未提及的干扰项。
D) 未提及
录音里Helen段没有提到study habits或类似的"养成学习习惯"，选项To cultivate
children's good study habits.是另一个"听上去禁手机的合理理由"，属于未提及陷阱。

questions.stem: What should students do in the classroom according to Richard Stone, an English teacher?

options.label: A
options.text: Use books and pens only.

options.label: B
options.text: Cut down their screen time.

options.label: C
options.text: Make full use of electronic devices.

options.label: D
options.text: Learn to use the internet for research.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Use books and pens only.
【定位】so let's leave phones and laptops at home, and show them a different world in their lessons—
one of books and pens
所以让我们把手机和笔记本电脑都留在家里，在课堂上向他们展示一个不一样的世界——一
个由书本和钢笔构成的世界。
【信号】let's+破折号定义结论句。原文so let's leave phones and laptops at home, and show
them a different world in their lessons—one of books and pens以"so let's…"建议式结
构开头，又用破折号引出对"a different world"的同位语解释"one of books and
pens"——这是典型的"结论+具象化"信号，是答案句。
【替换】leave phones and laptops at home ↔ Use books and pens only
把手机和电脑留家=不用电子设备
show them a different world in their lessons—one of books and pens ↔ Use books and pens only
books and pens的世界=只用书本和钢笔
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
录音Children are getting more than enough screen time in their lives without the
need to bring their phone into the classroom.提到screen time，是Richard用以解释"为
什么不该带手机进课堂"的背景论据，并非他对学生课堂行为的主张；选项Cut down their
screen time.盗用screen time原词来制造听到就想选的诱惑。
借用原文：Children are getting more than enough screen time in their lives without the need to
bring their phone into the classroom.
C) 与原文相反
Richard明确主张let's leave phones and laptops at home，是反对在课堂用电子设备；选
项Make full use of electronic devices.反过来说"充分利用电子设备"，立场反向。
借用原文：let's leave phones and laptops at home
D) 与原文相反
录音The internet is too easy and too unreliable a research tool里，Richard明明在批
评"互联网作为研究工具太简单、太不可靠"；选项Learn to use the internet for research.
盗用internet、research原词，反过来说"学会用网做研究"，立场翻转。
借用原文：The internet is too easy and too unreliable a research tool

questions.stem: How did Kate earn the reward from her mother?

options.label: A
options.text: By cleaning the kitchen floor.

options.label: B
options.text: By looking after her baby brother.

options.label: C
options.text: By helping her mother do the dishes.

options.label: D
options.text: By helping her brother wash windows.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） By helping her brother wash windows.
【定位】Kate, a six-year-old girl, helped her brother wash windows to get a reward promised by her
mother, a purple doll that she wanted.
凯特，一个六岁的小女孩，帮哥哥擦窗户，为的是拿到妈妈答应的奖励——一只她想要的紫
色娃娃。
【信号】to get a reward 的目的状语。helped her brother wash windows to get a reward
promised by her mother 这句里 to get a reward 是目的状语，前面的动作（helped
her brother wash windows）就是为了拿奖励而做的事，正是题目问的 how earn
the reward。
【替换】helped her brother wash windows ↔ helping her brother wash windows
几乎原词复现，仅时态变形
【排除】A) 未提及
By cleaning the kitchen floor. 是常见家务但录音里完全没提，属于未提及型干扰，专骗那
些把做家务挣奖励脑补成打扫卫生的考生。
B) 原词陷阱
By looking after her baby brother. 盗用了录音里的 brother 一词制造熟感，但录音里说
的是 helped her brother wash windows，是凯特帮哥哥，而不是照看弟弟。
借用原文：helped her brother wash windows
C) 原词陷阱
By helping her mother do the dishes. 蹭了录音里 helped 与为妈妈做事的氛围，但录音
里凯特帮的是 brother、做的是 wash windows，不是帮 mother do the dishes。
借用原文：promised by her mother

questions.stem: What did Kate do after her mother left the room?

options.label: A
options.text: She ordered a large number of dolls.

options.label: B
options.text: She checked if a purple doll was ordered.

options.label: C
options.text: She mistakenly canceled her mom's order.

options.label: D
options.text: She ordered a more expensive doll instead.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） She ordered a large number of dolls.
【定位】15 minutes and a few clicks later, with more than $350 worth of dolls in her cart, Kate placed
the order and ran off to play.
15 分钟和几次点击之后，购物车里装着价值 350 多美元的娃娃，凯特下了单，跑去玩了。
【信号】总结性结尾句加数量爆炸。15 minutes and a few clicks later, with more than $350
worth of dolls in her cart, Kate placed the order 这句是这一段动作的收束句，350 美
元、placed the order 几个反常细节直接交代了凯特在妈妈走后做了什么——她下了一大
堆娃娃的订单。这种数量或价格爆表的细节，几乎一定是答案信号。
【替换】more than $350 worth of dolls in her cart ↔ She ordered a large number of dolls.
数量上的同义改写
Kate placed the order ↔ She ordered a large number of dolls.
动词短语到单动词的等值替换
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
She checked if a purple doll was ordered. 盗用了录音里 purple doll 和 check the
shipping status 制造她检查了紫娃娃订单的幻觉，但录音里 check 的是 shipping status
（物流），而且那是动作的起点不是后果，她做了什么的真正答案是后面的下单。
借用原文：Kate asked if she could check the shipping status
C) 张冠李戴
She mistakenly canceled her mom's order. 录音里恰恰是 cancel 这个词出现了，但执行
者是妈妈第二天才取消的两单，不是凯特；凯特做的事是反方向的加单。
借用原文：She was able to cancel two of them
D) 偷换概念
She ordered a more expensive doll instead. 录音里凯特的问题不是换了一只更贵的，而
是在原本一只之外又加了一大堆，重点是数量爆炸而不是单只价格升级，是过度推断式的偏
移。
借用原文：more than $350 worth of dolls in her cart

questions.stem: What did Kate's family do after the packages arrived?

options.label: A
options.text: They asked the children's hospital to pick them.

options.label: B
options.text: They took all of them to the children's hospital.

options.label: C
options.text: They opened all of them one by one.

options.label: D
options.text: They discussed where to keep them.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） They took all of them to the children's hospital.
【定位】Instead of sending back the dolls, her father suggested giving them to the local children's
hospital. So the next week, Kate's family loaded up their car and took all the dolls to the
playroom at the children's hospital.
她父亲提议不要把娃娃寄回去，而是捐给当地的儿童医院。于是第二周，凯特一家装了一
车，把所有娃娃送到了儿童医院的活动室。
【信号】结果句 So 加 took all the dolls。So the next week, Kate's family loaded up their car
and took all the dolls to the playroom at the children's hospital. 中的 So 是因果结果
信号，把前面父亲提议的话变成实际行动，直接给出全家把所有娃娃送去了医院这个确定
答案。
【替换】took all the dolls to the playroom at the children's hospital ↔
They took all of them to the children's hospital.
几乎原句直译
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
They asked the children's hospital to pick them. 蹭了录音里的 children's hospital 制造
熟感，但录音里是家里人把娃娃送去，不是请医院来挑，动作方向完全相反。
借用原文：took all the dolls to the playroom at the children's hospital
C) 张冠李戴
They opened all of them one by one. 盗用了录音里 opened up all the boxes 这个动
作，但执行人是凯特和医院里的小女孩患者们，不是凯特一家，而且发生地点也在医院里、
不是包裹一到家就打开。
借用原文：they opened up all the boxes together
D) 未提及
discussed where to keep them. 这个动作完全没出现，录音直奔父亲提议捐医院，没经过
商量放哪儿。

questions.stem: According to recent research conducted in Australia, what has a lasting impact on one's life?

options.label: A
options.text: The time one starts school.

options.label: B
options.text: The classroom atmosphere.

options.label: C
options.text: The school that one attends.

options.label: D
options.text: The relationship with classmates.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） The time one starts school.
【定位】The researchers found that the time when a person starts school has an enduring impact on
their lives.
研究者发现，一个人开始上学的时间会对其一生产生持久的影响。
【信号】researchers found 这一研究结论信号。篇章独白里 The researchers found that 是典型
的结论提示词——后面紧跟的句子就是研究的核心发现，几乎必然是答案句。再加上 has
an enduring impact on their lives 与题干 lasting impact on one's life 完全对应，可以
确认就是这一句。
【替换】the time when a person starts school ↔ The time one starts school.
句式压缩同义替换
has an enduring impact on their lives ↔ a lasting impact on one's life
形容词同义替换
【排除】B) 未提及
录音从头到尾没有出现 atmosphere、classroom environment 这类表达，The
classroom atmosphere. 属于教育话题里常用的凑数干扰，没有任何原文支撑。
C) 原词陷阱
The school that one attends. 借了录音里反复出现的 school 一词来制造熟悉感，但录音
说的是 the time when a person starts school——重点在 time 不在 school 本身，把入
学时间偷换成了上的什么学校，是典型的原词陷阱。
借用原文：the time when a person starts school
D) 原词陷阱
The relationship with classmates. 提到的 classmates 虽然在录音里以 compared to
their classmates 出现过一次，但录音只是用 classmates 来做参照对象，没有讨论同学关
系本身对人生的影响，属于借词不传义。
借用原文：compared to their classmates

questions.stem: What was the purpose of the Australian research?

options.label: A
options.text: To help parents decide when to send their children to school.

options.label: B
options.text: To find causes for differences in the participants' performance.

options.label: C
options.text: To identify students having potential to be professional athletes.

options.label: D
options.text: To offer constructive suggestions for making educational policies.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （目的题） To find causes for differences in the participants' performance.
【定位】But the Australian researchers wanted to discover what was driving these differences.
但澳大利亚的研究者们想要弄清楚究竟是什么在驱动这些差异。
【信号】but + wanted to discover 这一双重信号。But the Australian researchers wanted to
discover what was driving these differences. 既有转折信号 but，又有目的结构 wanted
to discover，两个信号叠加，几乎可以确认这就是研究目的的官方表述句。
【替换】wanted to discover what was driving these differences ↔
To find causes for differences in the participants' performance.
同义动词与名词改写
【排除】A) 偷换概念
To help parents decide when to send their children to school. 借了 starts school 的话
题词，把研究目的偷换成给家长的择校建议，但录音从未提及 parents 或 advice，是典型
的应用层偷换。
借用原文：the time when a person starts school
C) 原词陷阱
To identify students having potential to be professional athletes. 借了录音里
professional athletes 一词来制造听到就想选的诱惑，但录音里 athletes 只是顺带列举的
成功人士之一，不是研究目的。
借用原文：professional athletes
D) 过度推断
To offer constructive suggestions for making educational policies. 把研究目的拔高到
教育政策层面，录音里完全没有出现 policy、policymaker 或 suggestion 等表达，属于无
中生有。

questions.stem: Who were the participants in the researchers' first study?

options.label: A
options.text: Political leaders.

options.label: B
options.text: Financial analysts.

options.label: C
options.text: Professional athletes.

options.label: D
options.text: High-school students.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） High-school students.
【定位】In the first study more than 600 high school students were surveyed about their tendency to
take risks and feel confident.
在第一项研究中，超过六百名高中生接受了关于其冒险倾向与自信感的调查。
【信号】In the first study 这一段落标志。In the first study 是典型的研究步骤标志词，后面紧跟
的就是该研究的被试群体，是非常明确的定位信号；紧随其后的 high school students 就
是答案。
【替换】more than 600 high school students ↔ High-school students.
数量修饰被剥离的概括式替换
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
Political leaders. 借了录音末尾 political leaders 一词制造熟悉感，但 political leaders 是
在 including athletes, political leaders and entrepreneurs 这一举例结构里出现，是成功
人士的例子，不是第一项研究的被试。
借用原文：including athletes, political leaders and entrepreneurs
B) 未提及
Financial analysts. 在录音里完全没有对应表达，录音只在 managing their finances 中出
现过 finances 一词，但讲的是受试者管理财务时的冒险行为，与金融分析师这个职业身份
毫不相关。
C) 原词陷阱
Professional athletes. 借了录音里反复出现的 professional athletes 一词，但录音里
athletes 始终是作为成功人士的例子出现，从未被列为第一项研究的被试群体，属于借词换
位。
借用原文：professional athletes

questions.stem: According to the researchers, what is one characteristic of successful people?

options.label: A
options.text: Leadership ability.

options.label: B
options.text: Commitment to work.

options.label: C
options.text: Risk-taking.

options.label: D
options.text: Self-confidence.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Risk-taking.
【定位】While risk-taking can be considered a negative attribute, it's also a characteristic of successful
people, including athletes, political leaders and entrepreneurs.
尽管冒险有时被视为一种负面特质，但它同时也是成功人士的一种特征，包括运动员、政界
领袖与企业家在内。
【信号】while 让步 + it's also 转折强调。While risk-taking can be considered a negative
attribute, it's also a characteristic of successful people 用 while 引导让步、随后 it's
also 强调真正想说的一面——这种让步+强调结构里的强调句几乎必然是答案。
【替换】it's also a characteristic of successful people ↔ one characteristic of successful people
句式结构高度复现
risk-taking ↔ Risk-taking.
代词指代回填
【排除】A) 过度推断
Leadership ability. 利用了录音末尾 political leaders 一词制造领导力联想，但录音说成功
人士包括政界领袖，并没有把 leadership ability 列为他们的共性特征。
借用原文：including athletes, political leaders and entrepreneurs
B) 未提及
Commitment to work. 是非常常见的成功学描述，但录音里完全没有出现 commitment、
dedication、hard work 等字眼，属于无中生有。
D) 原词陷阱
Self-confidence. 借了录音里多次出现的 self-confidence 与 feel confident，但录音只把
self-confidence 作为研究的假设变量，最终结论强调的特征是 risk-taking，不是 self-
confidence。
借用原文：it's also a characteristic of successful people

questions.stem: What event will take place in Glasgow?

options.label: A
options.text: A free car show.

options.label: B
options.text: A yearly concert.

options.label: C
options.text: A sports competition.

options.label: D
options.text: A pipe band contest.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） A pipe band contest.
【定位】The World Pipe Band Championships will take place in Glasgow on Saturday.
「世界风笛乐队锦标赛」将于周六在格拉斯哥举行。
【信号】开篇点题句。新闻首句 The World Pipe Band Championships will take place in
Glasgow on Saturday. 与题干 What event will take place in Glasgow? 在结构上几乎一
一对应(will take place in Glasgow 完全相同)，这就是新闻「导语 = 答案」的强信号。
【替换】The World Pipe Band Championships ↔ A pipe band contest
championships 同义替换为 contest
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音通篇没出现任何 car show、汽车相关表述，A free car show. 属凭空想象。它唯一沾
边的是 free 这个词——录音里 The event is free. 确实说了 free，于是把「免费」错按到
「车展」上，是典型的把原词嫁接到错对象。
借用原文：The event is free.
B) 原词陷阱
录音说的是 the annual event，annual 与选项里的 yearly 同义，但核心活动是 pipe
band championships，不是 concert(音乐会)。yearly 这个原义被偷出来盖到一个录音从
未提到的 concert 上。
借用原文：the annual event
C) 偷换概念
A sports competition. 中 competition 与 D 项的 contest 几乎同义——录音里的
Championships 翻译成 competition 也讲得通，但风笛比赛属于音乐文化赛事，不是体育
(sports)赛事。把 sports 这一定语换成 pipe band 才对。
借用原文：Over 120 of the world's best pipe bands will compete at the championships.

questions.stem: What does Glasgow City Council say the event will do?

options.label: A
options.text: Improve the image of Glasgow city.

options.label: B
options.text: Enrich the local culture of Glasgow.

options.label: C
options.text: Contribute a lot to the local economy.

options.label: D
options.text: Entertain people in local communities.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Contribute a lot to the local economy.
【定位】Glasgow City Council says it is estimated to bring £300,000 to the local economy.
格拉斯哥市议会表示，预计本次活动将为当地经济带来 30 万英镑的收入。
【信号】题干主语 + 金额词同时命中。原文 Glasgow City Council says it is estimated to bring
£300,000 to the local economy. 与题干 What does Glasgow City Council say the
event will do? 在「Glasgow City Council says」上几乎逐字对接，再叠加金额
£300,000，是双重答案信号。
【替换】bring £300,000 to the local economy ↔ Contribute a lot to the local economy.
bring 金额 = contribute a lot
【排除】A) 未提及
录音通篇无 image / reputation 等谈论城市形象的字眼。它和 C 在「为城市好」的方向上
同方向，容易让考生「感觉对」，但题目问的是 Council 实际说了什么，没说就是没说。
B) 张冠李戴
录音里 The first World Pipe Band Championships were held in Edinburgh in 1947. 等
句确实交代了赛事历史，乍听有文化色彩，但「丰富格拉斯哥本地文化」 (Enrich the local
culture of Glasgow.) 这一定性并不是 Glasgow City Council 给的，更不是题干所问。
借用原文：It has been held regularly in Glasgow since 1986.
D) 过度推断
录音里 Over 4,000 pipers and drummers are expected to descend on the city for the
annual event. 说的是有 4000 名风笛手鼓手前来参赛，并未提及「娱乐当地社区居民」。
选项把「热闹场面」这一表象误读成「让 local communities 开心」，方向偏。
借用原文：Over 4,000 pipers and drummers are expected to descend on the city for the
annual event.
Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.
1 Summer doesn't begin for two more days, but scientists are already sounding the alarm about
dangerous ice melts going on right now in Greenland.
距离夏季开始还有两天,但科学家们已经对格陵兰岛目前正在发生的危险冰层融化发出警报。
2 The vast island usually locks away enough fresh water in its ice sheet, which if melted can raise
global sea levels by six meters. And research shows that in recent years its ice has melted faster than
ever before. This month, as temperatures in northwestern Greenland approach all-time highs, researchers
are encountering unusual, surprising levels of melting ice in the region.
这座广袤的岛屿通常将足够多的淡水锁在其冰盖中,如果融化可使全球海平面上升六米。研究表明,近年来
其冰层融化速度比以往任何时候都快。本月,随着格陵兰岛西北部气温接近历史最高值,研究人员在该地区
遇到了异常且令人惊讶的冰层融化水平。
3 The most significant concern here is how early this is all happening. Greenland experiences annual ice
melt and growth cycles. But this year, the melting season began in early May. That's a month earlier
than normal and something that's happened only once before in the historical record in 2016.
这里最重大的担忧是这一切发生得如此之早。格陵兰岛经历着年度冰层融化和增长周期。但今年,融化季节
始于五月初。这比正常情况提前了一个月,而且在历史记录中只在2016年发生过一次。
4 That means that not only is the ice melting very fast, it has more time to melt this summer than it
would in a normal climate system. Longer melt seasons like this one seem to lead to much greater
contributions to sea-level rise than in previous decades.
这意味着冰层不仅融化得非常快,而且今年夏天它有比正常气候系统中更多的时间融化。像这样更长的融化
季节似乎会导致对海平面上升的贡献远大于前几十年。

questions.stem: What is scientists' warning in the news report?

options.label: A
options.text: Surprising rise in global sea levels.

options.label: B
options.text: Dangerous ice melts in Greenland.

options.label: C
options.text: Changing weather patterns in summer.

options.label: D
options.text: Record growth of Greenland's ice sheets.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （主旨题） Dangerous ice melts in Greenland.
【定位】Summer doesn't begin for two more days, but scientists are already sounding the alarm about
dangerous ice melts going on right now in Greenland.
夏天还有两天才开始，但科学家们已经在为格陵兰岛正在发生的危险融冰拉响警报。
【信号】导语 + 转折 but + sounding the alarm。答案信号有三层叠加：第一，这是新闻第一句
（导语，新闻惯例第一句点题）；第二，句中 but 是强转折，新闻里 but 之后才是真正要
说的事；第三，紧跟 sounding the alarm（拉响警报）正是题干 warning 的同义信号，三
者合在一起把答案句钉死在这一句。
【替换】sounding the alarm ↔ scientists' warning
拉响警报等于发出警告
dangerous ice melts going on right now in Greenland ↔ Dangerous ice melts in Greenland.
几乎是原句压缩
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
A 借用原文第 2 段 raise global sea levels by six meters 里的 sea levels 做诱饵，但原文
那句只是『如果冰盖融化，可能抬升海平面 6 米』，是一个假设性的后果，且 surprising
rise in global sea levels 并未在录音中实际宣布，把『潜在后果』当成『已经发生的警
告』，属偷换概念。
借用原文：which if melted can raise global sea levels by six meters
C) 未提及
C 盗用原文里 Summer 与第 3、4 段反复出现的『季节、夏季』语境，把话题悄悄从『冰
融』扩大到『夏季天气模式的变化』。整则新闻没有讨论 weather patterns（如降雨、风
暴等气象格局），范围被无故放大。
借用原文：Summer doesn't begin for two more days
D) 与原文相反
D 把录音里 ice melts、ice sheet 这些原词搬过来，但把动作整个反过来说成 record
growth of Greenland's ice sheets（『创纪录地增长』），与原文 its ice has melted
faster than ever before 方向相反，是典型的『反向』诱饵。
借用原文：its ice has melted faster than ever before

questions.stem: What do we learn about this year's ice melting?

options.label: A
options.text: It began in late May.

options.label: B
options.text: It lasted three months.

options.label: C
options.text: It started a month earlier than usual.

options.label: D
options.text: It ended a month earlier than before.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） It started a month earlier than usual.
【定位】But this year, the melting season began in early May. That's a month earlier than normal and
something that's happened only once before in the historical record in 2016.
但今年，融冰季在 5 月初就开始了。这比往年提前了一个月，是历史上仅在 2016 年出现过
一次的情况。
【信号】转折 But this year 加时间反常。信号有两层：第一，But this year 是强转折，前面在讲
『通常的融冰周期』，But 一拐就来到『今年反常』的落点；第二，紧跟出现的 a month
earlier than normal 与题干 this year 严丝合缝，正是答案承载句。
【替换】the melting season began in early May ↔ It started a month earlier than usual.
began 对应 started
a month earlier than normal ↔ a month earlier than usual
than normal 等于 than usual
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
A 借用原文 began in early May 里的 May 做诱饵，但把 early May（5 月初）偷换成 late
May（5 月底）；只要听清 early 与 late 这一字之差，就能识破。
借用原文：the melting season began in early May
B) 未提及
B 项 It lasted three months. 在录音中完全没有出现『三个月』或任何与 three months 对
应的时长表述，是利用考生听到 Longer melt seasons 就想去补一个具体时长的心理凭空
捏造的数字。
D) 与原文相反
D 与正确项 C 只差一个动词：started 变 ended。原文清清楚楚说的是融冰季『开始』提前
一个月（began in early May），而非『结束』提前一个月；D 把动作整个反向，是典型的
『开始或结束』互换陷阱。
借用原文：the melting season began in early May

questions.stem: What happened on the streets of Blackhall Colliery?

options.label: A
options.text: Bundles of £20 notes kept turning up.

options.label: B
options.text: A villager was searching for his lost cash.

options.label: C
options.text: Local policemen came across bundles of £20 notes.

options.label: D
options.text: A bundle containing thousands of pounds got stolen.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Bundles of £20 notes kept turning up.
【定位】Bundles containing thousands of pounds in cash keep turning up on the streets of Blackhall
Colliery in northern England, according to police.
据警方称，装有数千英镑现金的成捆钞票不断出现在英格兰北部布莱克霍尔矿区的街道上。
【信号】新闻导语首句即落点。答案信号是"导语首句"：Bundles containing thousands of
pounds in cash keep turning up on the streets 正是全篇第一句，新闻把核心事件放在开
头，无需转折、就是它。
【替换】keep turning up on the streets ↔ kept turning up
时态变体的同一短语
Bundles containing thousands of pounds in cash ↔ Bundles of £20 notes
概括与具体互指同物
【排除】B)
B 说 A villager was searching for his lost cash.（一名村民在找他丢失的现金），但录音
是钱不断"出现"、村民是"捡到"，从无谁在"找丢失的钱"，方向与原文相反。
C) 原词陷阱
C 盗用了录音原词 came across 与 policemen 拼成 Local policemen came across
bundles of £20 notes.，但原文是 Residents of the village have been coming across
bundles of £20 notes——"撞见"现金的是村民居民，不是警察，把发现者张冠李戴了。
借用原文：Residents of the village have been coming across bundles of £20 notes
D) 原词陷阱
D 说 A bundle containing thousands of pounds got stolen.（一捆数千英镑被偷），盗
用了原文 Bundles containing thousands of pounds 的措辞，却把"出现并被上交"歪曲
成"被偷"，与全篇"现金被发现、还给失主"的事实相反。
借用原文：Bundles containing thousands of pounds in cash

questions.stem: What do the local police do with the money if not claimed in two weeks?

options.label: A
options.text: They give it to charity.

options.label: B
options.text: They return it to the finder.

options.label: C
options.text: They hand it over to the local government.

options.label: D
options.text: They place a notice in The Northern Echo.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） They return it to the finder.
【定位】The owner has two weeks to collect the cash, which is then returned to the finder if not
claimed, according to Peterlee Police.
据彼得利警方称，失主有两周时间来领取现金，如果无人认领，这笔钱随后会归还给发
现者。
【信号】条件状语后的处置动词。答案信号是条件 + 处置动词：which is then returned to the
finder if not claimed 里 if not claimed（若无人认领）正对题干 not claimed in two
weeks，紧跟的动词 returned to the finder 就是处置结果。
【替换】returned to the finder ↔ return it to the finder
被动转主动的同一动作
【排除】A)
A 说 They give it to charity.（捐给慈善），录音通篇没出现 charity 或捐赠的说法，是
凭"无主之财常做公益"的常识硬填，属未提及。
C)
C 说 hand it over to the local government（上交当地政府），录音里出现的是 Peterlee
Police、Durham Police 这些警方，从未说交给 local government（地方政府），把接收
对象张冠李戴了。
D) 原词陷阱
D 说 place a notice in The Northern Echo（在《北方回声报》登启事），盗用了录音原
词 The Northern Echo，但那是警察 John Forster 后文受访的报纸，与"无人认领后怎么处
置钱"毫无关系，答非所问。
借用原文：He told The Northern Echo

questions.stem: What did the policeman John Forster say about the villagers?

options.label: A
options.text: They cooperated well with the police.

options.label: B
options.text: They enjoyed a fairly affluent life.

options.label: C
options.text: They were puzzled by the mystery.

options.label: D
options.text: They had a strong community spirit.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （态度观点题） They had a strong community spirit.
【定位】It isn't an affluent part of the world, so for them to find cash of that amount and instantly
think about taking it to the police stations shows the community spirit there is.
这里并不是个富裕的地方，所以他们能捡到那么多现金、还立刻想到把钱送去警局，这显示
出了当地的社区精神。
【信号】so…shows 引出结论评价。答案信号是"因果连词 so + 总结动词 shows"：so for them to
find cash…instantly think about taking it to the police stations shows the
community spirit，so 后是 Forster 对村民的总结性定性，shows 后面那个词就是他真正
想说的评价。
【替换】shows the community spirit there is ↔ They had a strong community spirit.
结论原词直接对应
instantly think about taking it to the police stations ↔ strong community spirit
行为佐证情感程度
【排除】A)
A 说 They cooperated well with the police.（他们与警方配合良好），录音里村民确
有"把钱送去警局"的行为，但 Forster 并未据此评价他们"配合警方"，而是上升为社区精神
——A 是对行为的过度推断。
B)
B 说 They enjoyed a fairly affluent life.（过着相当富裕的生活），盗用了录音原词
affluent，但原文是 It isn't an affluent part of the world——明明说"不富裕"，B 把否定
去掉、反了极性。
借用原文：It isn't an affluent part of the world
C) 原词陷阱
C 说 They were puzzled by the mystery.（他们被这谜团困惑），盗用了录音原词 The
circumstances remain a mystery 的 mystery，但感到费解的是警方（Forster 说 remain
a mystery、想 get to the bottom），不是村民，把困惑者张冠李戴了。
借用原文：The circumstances remain a mystery

questions.stem: How does the man often feel on his birthday?

options.label: A
options.text: Excited.

options.label: B
options.text: Delighted.

options.label: C
options.text: Indifferent.

options.label: D
options.text: Strange.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （态度观点题） Strange.
【定位】I often feel strange on my birthday. It's like my brain decides to have a crisis.
我过生日时常常觉得怪怪的。就好像我的大脑决定要闹一场危机似的。
【信号】被问者的直接应答 + 原话情绪词。女士先问"生日有什么打算"，男士开口就答 I often feel
strange on my birthday，这是被问者的直接应答，且 often feel strange 几乎是直接给出
心情词，正是答案句的强信号。
【替换】I often feel strange on my birthday ↔ Strange.
原词直接对应
【排除】A) 未提及
Excited. 是大家默认"过生日该有"的情绪，靠常识容易误选，但录音男士从头到尾没说兴
奋，反而说怪怪的、像要闹危机，与 A 相反。
B) 未提及
Delighted.(高兴)同样是想当然的"生日心情"，录音并未表达欢喜，男士说的是 strange，故
排除。
C) 偷换概念
Indifferent.(无所谓)看似贴近"不太在乎生日"，但录音说的是 feel strange、brain has a
crisis，是"心绪不宁"而非"无所谓"，态度强度对不上。

questions.stem: What does the woman say many people tend to do on their birthday?

options.label: A
options.text: Search for the meaning of their life.

options.label: B
options.text: Look back on their years at school.

options.label: C
options.text: Call on their relatives and friends.

options.label: D
options.text: Talk about future plans with friends.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Search for the meaning of their life.
【定位】Many begin to search for the meaning of their existence, leading to behaviors such as ending
or starting a relationship, or plans, like starting a vigorous diet or fitness program.
许多人开始寻找自己存在的意义，由此引发一些行为，比如结束或开始一段感情，或是制订
计划，比如开始严格的节食或健身方案。
【信号】Many begin to… 的群体行为陈述。女士说 Many begin to search for the meaning of
their existence，主语 Many 正对题干的 many people，begin to + 动作 直接给出"多数
人会做的事"，是答案句的明确信号。
【替换】search for the meaning of their existence ↔ Search for the meaning of their life.
近义词 existence=life
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
录音确实提到 their achievements in life in the past decade 里的"过去十年/过去一年"，
让人联想到"回顾在校岁月"，但原文说的是回顾"成就"、并未提 school 或"回顾学生时代"，
Look back on their years at school. 把"回顾过往成就"偷换成了"回顾学校岁月"。
借用原文：their achievements in life in the past decade, or their accomplishments of the past year
C) 未提及
Call on their relatives and friends.(拜访亲友)是大家想象中"过生日"的常见举动，但录音
列举的群体行为是"找人生意义、结束/开始感情、节食健身"，从未提走访亲友，属常识脑
补、无原文支撑。
D) 原词陷阱
录音里有 or plans, like starting a vigorous diet or fitness program，出现了 plans 一
词，Talk about future plans with friends. 顺手盗用 plans 设套；但原文的 plans 指"制订
节食/健身计划"这类行动，并非"和朋友谈未来打算"，对象与方式都被改了。
借用原文：or plans, like starting a vigorous diet or fitness program

questions.stem: What does the man say about birthday celebrations?

options.label: A
options.text: He prefers to have them shown on social media.

options.label: B
options.text: He loves them but does not want to make a fuss.

options.label: C
options.text: He enjoys celebrating others' birthdays rather than his own.

options.label: D
options.text: He looks forward to receiving presents from his close friends.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） He enjoys celebrating others' birthdays rather than his own.
【定位】I have wonderful friends and I love celebrating their birthdays. But I don't like being the
center of attention, receiving gifts and having a fuss made.
我有很棒的朋友，我很喜欢为他们庆祝生日。但我不喜欢成为众人焦点、收礼物、被大张旗
鼓地庆祝。
【信号】转折 But 切出真意。前半 I love celebrating their birthdays 说爱给别人过，转折词 But I
don't like being the center of attention 之后才是落点——爱别人的、却不愿自己被庆
祝，But 后才是答案信号。
【替换】I love celebrating their birthdays ↔ He enjoys celebrating others' birthdays
love=enjoy、their=others'
I don't like being the center of attention ↔ rather than his own
否定句概括成 rather than
【排除】A) 与原文相反
录音确有 social media too can intensify things as birthdays now play out more
publicly，但男士是说社交媒体让生日更公开、加重了他的不安，He prefers to have them
shown on social media. 却说他"偏爱在社交媒体上展示"，与原文态度正相反。
借用原文：social media too can intensify things as birthdays now play out more publicly
B) 原词陷阱
He loves them but does not want to make a fuss. 用了录音原词 fuss(见 having a fuss
made)且"喜欢但不想张扬"也部分贴合男士的话，极具迷惑性；但 B 漏掉了关键对比"喜欢
的是别人的生日、不喜欢的是自己的"，泛指 them 反而把"自己 vs 别人"这层最核心的区分
抹掉了，不如 C 精准。
借用原文：But I don't like being the center of attention, receiving gifts and having a fuss made
D) 与原文相反
录音里 receiving gifts 是男士"不喜欢"的事，He looks forward to receiving presents
from his close friends. 却把它说成"盼着收礼物"，gifts/presents 同义但态度被彻底反
转。
借用原文：I don't like being the center of attention, receiving gifts

questions.stem: What does the woman suggest the man do about his birthday celebration at the end of the conversation?

options.label: A
options.text: Hold it on a modest scale to remove birthday anxieties.

options.label: B
options.text: View it as a chance for people to socialize and have fun.

options.label: C
options.text: Extend invitation to those he trusts most.

options.label: D
options.text: Make it an occasion to collect donations.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） View it as a chance for people to socialize and have fun.
【定位】Exactly. Or even simply see your birthday as an opportunity to bring people together for them
to have fun.
正是如此。或者干脆把你的生日看作一个把大家聚到一起、让他们开心玩乐的机会。
【信号】结尾处女士的建议句。题干限定 at the end，而这正是对话最后一句女士的话 see your
birthday as an opportunity to bring people together for them to have fun，see…as
an opportunity to 是明显的建议口吻，落在末尾，正是答案信号。
【替换】bring people together for them to have fun ↔
View it as a chance for people to socialize and have fun.
聚人=socialize、机会=chance
【排除】A) 答非所问
对话前段女士确实围绕生日焦虑(birthday blues)给过"别孤立自己、逐步面对"的话，Hold
it on a modest scale to remove birthday anxieties. 借"消除焦虑"设套；但"小规模操办
以消焦虑"并非女士结尾(at the end)所说，且原文没说"小规模"，定位错位。
借用原文：to deal with the birthday blues, you should not isolate yourself
C) 原词陷阱
录音 gradually face your birthday with people you trust 出现了 trust，Extend
invitation to those he trusts most. 盗用 trust 设套；但那是女士在对话中段说的，且原文
是"和你信任的人一起逐步面对"，不是"只邀请最信任的人"，既非结尾建议、内容也被改
了。
借用原文：It's best to gradually face your birthday with people you trust
D) 张冠李戴
录音里 asking people to make a donation instead of buying a gift 提到捐款，Make it
an occasion to collect donations. 盗用 donation；但这是"男士"自己提出的想法，题干
问的是"女士"在结尾的建议，张冠李戴了。
借用原文：asking people to make a donation instead of buying a gift

questions.stem: What does the woman say about her subway ride?

options.label: A
options.text: It was absolutely exhausting.

options.label: B
options.text: There was a terrible smell.

options.label: C
options.text: There was too long a delay.

options.label: D
options.text: She got off at the wrong station.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） It was absolutely exhausting.
【定位】No, but the train was so packed that I could barely move, and it was difficult to breathe too...
Once I did get out, I was totally exhausted.
不是(晚点)，但车厢太挤了，我几乎动不了，连呼吸都困难……等我终于挤出来，已经累得精
疲力竭了。
【信号】先否定再描述，落点在收尾。她先用 No否掉"晚点"，再细数挤、喘不上气，最后用 I
was totally exhausted收束——"totally(完全)"的加重语气正是答案信号，整段抱怨
归到"累"上。
【替换】I was totally exhausted ↔ It was absolutely exhausting.
同义词+主被动改写
【排除】C) 原词陷阱
男方问 was there a delay?，女方明确回 No。选项 There was too long a delay.正是盗用
了录音里反复出现的 delay 一词，但"晚点"恰恰是她否认的，属听到原词就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：No, but the train was so packed
B) 未提及
录音说 it was difficult to breathe too，原因是太挤、不是有味道。There was a terrible
smell.借"呼吸"联想出"异味"，是无中生有的过度引申，原文并未提到任何 smell。
D) 偷换概念
录音只说她 could hardly get out(挤得几乎下不了车)，是"难下车"不是"下错站"。She got
off at the wrong station.把"下车困难"偷换成"下错站"，原文无此意。
借用原文：When I got to my station, I could hardly get out

questions.stem: Why hasn't the woman got her own car?

options.label: A
options.text: She hasn't saved enough money.

options.label: B
options.text: She is worried about traffic jams.

options.label: C
options.text: She hasn't passed the driving test yet.

options.label: D
options.text: She is used to taking public transport.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） She hasn't saved enough money.
【定位】I've got a driver's license, but that's all. I'm saving up to buy something reasonably small and
cute, but it's still a bit expensive for me, and it'll take a while before I have enough money.
我有驾照，但也就这样了。我正在攒钱想买辆小巧可爱点的车，但对我来说还是有点贵，得
过一阵子才能攒够钱。
【信号】转折 but 后才是真原因。她先说 I've got a driver's license(有驾照)，紧接 but it's still a
bit expensive for me——转折 but 之后的"贵、还没攒够钱"才是真正没车的原因，前半
句"有驾照"是用来排除C的。
【替换】it'll take a while before I have enough money ↔ She hasn't saved enough money.
肯否转换+概括
【排除】C) 与原文相反
选项 She hasn't passed the driving test yet.借"driving"语境制造混淆，但录音开口就是
I've got a driver's license(已有驾照)，正好与"还没考过"相反——没车的卡点在钱，不在
证。
借用原文：I've got a driver's license
B) 张冠李戴
She is worried about traffic jams.里的"拥挤/慢"其实对应她吐槽地铁公交 The bus takes
twice as long and it's just as crowded.，与"为什么没车"无关，把别处的抱怨安到这题
上。
借用原文：it's just as crowded
D) 与原文相反
She is used to taking public transport.与原文相反：她一开口就在抱怨地铁、还在
saving up to buy车，分明想摆脱公共交通，并非"习惯并满足于"它。
借用原文：I'm saving up to buy something

questions.stem: What does the woman say about electric motorbikes?

options.label: A
options.text: They are popular.

options.label: B
options.text: They are dangerous.

options.label: C
options.text: They are a bit expensive for her.

options.label: D
options.text: They are environmentally friendly.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （态度观点题） They are dangerous.
【定位】I consider that for maybe a minute. But honestly, I've just seen too many horrible accidents
involving those dangerous monsters.
我也就考虑了大概一分钟。但说实话，我见过太多那些"危险怪物"造成的可怕事故了。
【信号】But honestly 后的强烈贬词。她先敷衍"考虑了一分钟"，转折 But honestly后甩出
horrible accidents与 dangerous monsters——"honestly"加
重、"dangerous/horrible"是强烈负面评价，态度信号集中在此。
【替换】those dangerous monsters ↔ They are dangerous.
原词点评直接对应
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
They are popular.盗用了男方下一句 those popular shared bikes里的 popular，但那是
评价"共享单车"、且出自男方之口，并非女方对电摩的看法，张冠李戴。
借用原文：those popular shared bikes
C) 张冠李戴
They are a bit expensive for her.盗用了她在买车时说的 it's still a bit expensive for
me，但"贵"评价的是要买的小车，对电动摩托车她说的是危险、从未说贵。
借用原文：it's still a bit expensive for me
D) 未提及
They are environmentally friendly.听起来很符合"电动"的常识联想，但全篇没有任何一句
说电摩环保，属凭电动二字脑补出来的未提及项。

questions.stem: How was the woman going to get to work?

options.label: A
options.text: By bus.

options.label: B
options.text: By jogging.

options.label: C
options.text: By renting a bike.

options.label: D
options.text: By sharing a ride.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） By sharing a ride.
【定位】M: Not if you use a ride sharing app. W: Good idea. I'll download one immediately.
Thank you.
男：用拼车app就不贵了。女：好主意。我这就下载一个。谢谢。
【信号】结尾"Good idea+这就去做"的拍板。前面公交、单车、慢跑、出租都被她一一否掉或挑
刺，直到男方提 a ride sharing app，她答 Good idea. I'll download one immediately
——"Good idea"+立刻行动是明确的最终拍板信号。
【替换】use a ride sharing app ↔ By sharing a ride.
动名词概括+去掉app
Good idea. I'll download one immediately ↔ By sharing a ride.
认可信号坐实最终选择
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
By bus.盗用对话里讨论过的 bus，但她明确说 The bus takes twice as long and it's just
as crowded.——又慢又挤，早被否掉，属"提过即否"的陷阱。
借用原文：The bus takes twice as long and it's just as crowded.
C) 原词陷阱
By renting a bike.对应 those popular shared bikes，她回 that's a possibility——只
是"一种可能"，并未像拼车那样"Good idea+这就去做"，停在备选阶段。
借用原文：that's a possibility
B) 原词陷阱
By jogging.盗用她自己提的 jog to work，但她紧接着说 the air pollution is a real
problem，因污染把慢跑否了，并非最终选择。
借用原文：the air pollution is a real problem

questions.stem: What do we learn about Steve Miller?

options.label: A
options.text: He is a sign language interpreter.

options.label: B
options.text: He is a deaf person working in IT.

options.label: C
options.text: He doesn't like speaking at meetings.

options.label: D
options.text: He doesn't use email or text messages.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） He is a deaf person working in IT.
【定位】Steve Miller began his career in IT back in the late 1980s. Being a deaf person in tech
required a huge amount of effort in organization.
史蒂夫·米勒在上世纪80年代末开始了他在 IT 行业的职业生涯。作为科技行业里的一名聋
人，这需要在组织安排上付出巨大的努力。
【信号】开篇直接交代身份。篇章开头第一句就点出他的处境——Being a deaf person in tech，介
绍人物的篇章往往一开口就交代身份，这句即是答案句。
【替换】a deaf person in tech ↔ a deaf person working in IT
tech 与 IT 同义、in 改 working in
began his career in IT ↔ working in IT
'开启IT生涯'='在IT工作'
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
原文确实念到 He needed a sign language interpreter for every meeting，但那是说
他'需要'一名手语翻译，不是说他'是'手语翻译；选项 He is a sign language interpreter.
把'他需要的人'安到他自己头上。
借用原文：He needed a sign language interpreter for every meeting
C) 偷换概念
原文说 Communicating in meetings was very difficult.(开会沟通'很困难')，这是客观障
碍；选项 He doesn't like speaking at meetings. 偷换成'他不喜欢在会上发言'的主观好
恶，文中从未提他喜不喜欢。
借用原文：Communicating in meetings was very difficult.
D) 与原文相反
原文是 there was no email or text message service——当年(80年代末)根本'没有'这种服
务，是时代背景；选项 He doesn't use email or text messages. 偷换成'他(现在)不用'电邮
短信，把'当时不存在'歪曲为'他个人不用'。
借用原文：there was no email or text message service

questions.stem: What does Miller say is making things better for people like him?

options.label: A
options.text: Improved communication skills.

options.label: B
options.text: Speech recognition technology.

options.label: C
options.text: Big advances in sign language.

options.label: D
options.text: Transformation in the IT industry.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Speech recognition technology.
【定位】Big advances in speech recognition technology have enabled communication tools to turn
live speech into text in real time on your smartphone or laptop, and sign language into text
as well.
语音识别技术的巨大进步，使得沟通工具能够在智能手机或笔记本电脑上实时把现场语音转
成文字，也能把手语转成文字。
【信号】因果信号 enabled 点出真正推动者。句子主语 Big advances in speech recognition
technology 后接 have enabled(使……得以)，enabled 是因果信号，前面那个名词正是'带
来改善'的诱因，即答案句。
【替换】Big advances in speech recognition technology ↔ Speech recognition technology
选项是原文核心名词的浓缩
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
原文反复出现 communication(如 communication tools)，选项 Improved
communication skills. 借这个熟词造干扰，但原文说变好的是'沟通工具'靠技术运转，不
是'沟通技能'提高了，文中也没说他技能改善。
借用原文：communication tools
C) 原词陷阱
原文确实念到 sign language into text as well，选项 Big advances in sign language. 借
sign language 造干扰，但原文的'大进步(advances)'是修饰 speech recognition
technology 的，并非'手语本身的大进步'。
借用原文：sign language into text as well
D) 过度推断
原文话题虽在 IT 行业，但带来改善的是一项具体技术；选项 Transformation in the IT
industry. 借 IT 一词把'语音识别技术'夸大成'整个 IT 行业的变革'，范围被无限放大，原文没
说行业整体变革。
借用原文：a good time to be a deaf person in tech

questions.stem: In what way can Miller benefit from attending meetings via video?

options.label: A
options.text: He can avoid being mistaken.

options.label: B
options.text: He can take notes on the spot.

options.label: C
options.text: He can understand with ease.

options.label: D
options.text: He can see the speakers' images.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） He can understand with ease.
【定位】He can employ lip-reading and have meetings via video instead of on the phone. These
things have made a huge difference. He no longer has to worry about whether or not he
can understand.
他可以借助唇读，并通过视频而非电话开会。这些做法带来了巨大的改变。他再也不必担心
自己能否听懂了。
【信号】结果句 no longer has to worry 点出好处。在 have meetings via video 之后，原文用
These things have made a huge difference 收束，再接 He no longer has to worry
about whether or not he can understand——'不再担心能否听懂'正是视频开会带来的好
处，即答案句。
【替换】He no longer has to worry about whether or not he can understand ↔
He can understand with ease
'不再担心能否听懂'=肯否转换为'能轻松听懂'
【排除】A) 未提及
选项 He can avoid being mistaken. 说'能避免被误解'，原文谈的是他能否'听懂'，从未提
到'被误解'这回事，属凭空添加。
B) 未提及
选项 He can take notes on the spot. 说'能当场记笔记'，原文虽提到技术能把语音转成
text(文字)，但从没说他'记笔记'，是把'转文字'歪联想成'记笔记'。
D) 原词陷阱
题干和原文都念到 have meetings via video，选项 He can see the speakers' images. 借
video 字面推出'能看到说话人画面'，但原文说视频开会的好处是'不再担心能否听懂'，而
非'看到画面'本身；越和 video 字面像，越是诱人下钩的原词陷阱。
借用原文：have meetings via video

questions.stem: What do people want upon returning home according to the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: To find pure white walls shining.

options.label: B
options.text: To enter a house well looked after.

options.label: C
options.text: To get a hug from family members.

options.label: D
options.text: To see cheerful colours all around.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） To see cheerful colours all around.
【定位】When people return home, they want to see colours that cheer them up and give them a hug.
人们回家时，想看到能让自己振奋、给自己一个拥抱的色彩。
【信号】want 直陈诉求。录音用 they want to see colours that cheer them up 直接点出回家想
要什么，want to 后面就是答题落点；紧接着 Pure white walls simply don't do that. 又
用否定把白墙排除，进一步确认想要的是彩色而非白墙。
【替换】colours that cheer them up ↔ cheerful colours
动词转形容词
see colours ↔ see cheerful colours all around
动作原词保留
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
To find pure white walls shining. 盗用了原文里 Pure white walls 这个原词，但原文紧接
着说 Pure white walls simply don't do that.，白墙恰恰是被否定的、不能给人拥抱的东
西，听到 white walls 就选正好掉坑。
借用原文：Pure white walls simply don't do that.
B) 偷换概念
To enter a house well looked after. 借用了原文 They don't look after you. 里的 look
after，但原文说的是色彩照顾人（you），不是人想进入一座被照看好的房子，主语和对象
都被偷换了。
借用原文：They don't look after you.
C) 未提及
To get a hug from family members. 用了原文的 hug，但原文是 give them a hug——
给拥抱的是色彩，根本没提 family members，把拥抱的来源安给了原文没说的家人。
借用原文：give them a hug

questions.stem: What does the passage say people should avoid doing in home decoration?

options.label: A
options.text: Choosing a colour because it is fashionable.

options.label: B
options.text: Painting the interior of their cupboards.

options.label: C
options.text: Doing the painting job all by themselves.

options.label: D
options.text: Designing all window frames the same way.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Choosing a colour because it is fashionable.
【定位】Don't go for a colour because it's in fashion, or you've seen it in a magazine.
不要因为某种颜色正流行、或你在杂志上见过它，就去选它。
【信号】Don't 否定建议。录音用祈使否定句 Don't go for a colour because it's in fashion 直接
给出劝阻——别因为时髦而选色，Don't 就是该避免做法的信号词，这句即答案句。
【替换】because it's in fashion ↔ because it is fashionable
名词短语转形容词
go for a colour ↔ Choosing a colour
动词同义替换
【排除】B) 与原文相反
Painting the interior of their cupboards. 盗用了原文 the inside of a cupboard，但原文
把刷柜子内部当作试色的好办法来推荐，而非要避免的事，态度正好相反。
借用原文：test your tolerance with smaller spaces, such as the inside of a cupboard
C) 未提及
Doing the painting job all by themselves. 里 all by themselves（亲力亲为）原文从未提
及，录音只谈选什么色、刷哪里，没说该不该自己动手。
D) 原词陷阱
Designing all window frames the same way. 借了原文出现过的 window frame（a
bright window frame），但原文说的是把窗框作为试色的小空间，没说所有窗框要设计成
同一款式，更没说要避免。
借用原文：a bright window frame

questions.stem: What can one do to make a room look bigger?

options.label: A
options.text: Fit most of the cupboards into walls.

options.label: B
options.text: Hang landscape paintings all around.

options.label: C
options.text: Match the room's ceiling with all the furniture in colour.

options.label: D
options.text: Paint the wooden frameworks and walls the same colour.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Paint the wooden frameworks and walls the same colour.
【定位】One can also paint the wooden frameworks the same colour as the walls, helping the rooms
look bigger.
也可以把木质框架刷成与墙壁相同的颜色，这有助于让房间显得更大。
【信号】helping…look bigger 因果。录音里 paint the wooden frameworks the same colour
as the walls 后面紧跟 helping the rooms look bigger，用 helping 把做法和显大的效果
直接连起来，正对应题干 look bigger，这句即答案句。
【替换】paint the wooden frameworks the same colour as the walls ↔
Paint the wooden frameworks and walls the same colour
近乎原句改写
helping the rooms look bigger ↔ Paint the wooden frameworks and walls the same colour
效果直接对上题干
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
Fit most of the cupboards into walls. 借了原文反复出现的 cupboards，但原文谈柜子是
说把柜子和墙刷同色（painting the overhead cupboards and the walls in the same
colour），没说把柜子嵌进墙里，做法被改造成原文没说的内容。
借用原文：painting the overhead cupboards and the walls in the same colour
B) 未提及
Hang landscape paintings all around. 里挂风景画原文完全没说，录音只谈刷颜色，没有
任何挂画的内容。
C) 张冠李戴
Match the room's ceiling with all the furniture in colour. 借用了原文出现过的 ceiling
（a painted ceiling）和同色概念，但原文让显大的同色是框架与墙，天花板只是另说能影
响空间感，没说要与家具同色，把同色的双方张冠李戴。
借用原文：a painted ceiling is a magical thing without being too obvious

questions.stem: What does the passage say parents increasingly understand?

options.label: A
options.text: Children must read at least 3 times a week.

options.label: B
options.text: Reading is a habit every child can develop.

options.label: C
options.text: Reading to their children is important.

options.label: D
options.text: Children should start reading at age 3.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Reading to their children is important.
【定位】Parents often hear that reading to their children is critical for supporting development, and the
message is getting through to them.
父母常听到『给孩子读书对支持其发展至关重要』这一说法，而且这个信息正在被他们接收
（理解）。
【信号】开篇点题句 + getting through 表领悟。答案信号是开篇直接点题：reading to their
children is critical for supporting development，紧跟 the message is getting
through to them，getting through 正对应题干的 understand，是承载答案的那一句。
【替换】reading to their children is critical for supporting development ↔
Reading to their children is important.
critical=important 同义替换
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 Children must read at least 3 times a week. 把原文 three or more times per
week 的频次盗来，但原文说的是『父母给孩子读』的统计数据，不是『孩子自己必须每周
读3次』的要求，答非所问。
借用原文：three or more times per week
B) 未提及
选项 Reading is a habit every child can develop. 听起来很正确很顺耳，但全文只谈父母
给孩子读书的好处与选书，从未说『阅读是每个孩子都能养成的习惯』，属凭常识脑补、原
文无据。
D) 原词陷阱
选项 Children should start reading at age 3. 借用原文 between the ages of three and
five 里的 three，但那是统计样本的年龄段，不是『孩子应3岁开始读书』的建议，数字真
听到了、意思全拧了。
借用原文：between the ages of three and five

questions.stem: What can predict children's reading skills according to recent research?

options.label: A
options.text: The number of books they have read by age four.

options.label: B
options.text: The speed of their brain development in infancy.

options.label: C
options.text: The number and quality of books parents read to them in infancy.

options.label: D
options.text: The quality and quantity of time parents spend playing with them.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） The number and quality of books parents read to them in infancy.
【定位】In fact, recent research has found that both the quality and quantity of shared book reading in
infancy predicted later childhood vocabulary and reading skills.
事实上，最近的研究发现，婴儿期共同读书的质量和数量都预测了孩子日后的词汇和阅读
能力。
【信号】研究发现信号 recent research has found + predicted。答案信号是表研究结论的
recent research has found 和动词 predicted，predicted 直接对应题干 predict，其前面
的主语 the quality and quantity of shared book reading in infancy 就是被点名的预测
因素。
【替换】the quality and quantity of shared book reading in infancy ↔
The number and quality of books parents read to them in infancy.
quantity=number、shared book reading=books parents read
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 The number of books they have read by age four. 借用原文 four-year-old
children 的 four，但原文 four 是说『四岁孩子身上的发展益处』，从没说『到四岁读了多
少本书』能预测能力，数字听到了、意思编造了。
借用原文：four-year-old children
B) 原词陷阱
选项 The speed of their brain development in infancy. 借了原文 brain development，
但原文是说『读书有助于语言和大脑发育』，大脑发育是『结果/益处』，不是『预测阅读
能力的原因』，把因果位置弄反了。
借用原文：reading to young children helps their language and brain development
D) 偷换概念
选项 The quality and quantity of time parents spend playing with them. 几乎照抄原文
的 quality and quantity 结构，却把核心动作从『读书』换成 playing（玩），原文谈的始
终是 reading，不是陪玩，偷换了概念。
借用原文：the quality and quantity of shared book reading in infancy

questions.stem: What kind of books are said to help babies learn more?

options.label: A
options.text: Books with specifically labeled images.

options.label: B
options.text: Books with pictures of dolls and toys.

options.label: C
options.text: Books describing the lives of animals.

options.label: D
options.text: Books telling very interesting stories.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Books with specifically labeled images.
【定位】It followed infants across the second six months of life and found that when parents showed
babies books that had faces or objects with specific labels, they learned more.
研究跟踪了出生后第二个半年的婴儿，发现当父母给婴儿看『带有具体标签的面孔或物体』
的书时，他们学得更多。
【信号】因果/条件句 when…they learned more。答案信号是条件结果句 when parents
showed babies books that had faces or objects with specific labels, they learned
more，learned more 正对应题干 learn more，其条件部分点名的书就是答案；后文 This
is in contrast to 进一步用对比反衬，强化了这一类。
【替换】books that had faces or objects with specific labels ↔ Books with specifically labeled images.
faces or objects=images、specific labels=specifically labeled
【排除】B) 过度推断
选项 Books with pictures of dolls and toys. 把原文 objects（物体）具体化为『玩偶和玩
具』，原文从未指明是玩偶玩具，是凭常识把抽象的 objects 想象成具体玩具，属脑补。
借用原文：faces or objects with specific labels
C) 未提及
选项 Books describing the lives of animals. 看似贴近『讲动物』，但原文 P3 全程没提
animals，更没说『描写动物生活的书』有用，纯属无中生有。
D) 偷换概念
选项 Books telling very interesting stories. 把『有用的书』偷换成『很有趣的故事书』，
原文判定标准是『有没有具体标签』，不是『故事有不有趣』，换了一套评价维度。
借用原文：books that had faces or objects with specific labels

questions.stem: What are parents advised to do at the end of the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: Read as many books as possible to their children.

options.label: B
options.text: Choose carefully what to read to their children.

options.label: C
options.text: Share experience with other parents.

options.label: D
options.text: Create picture books for their children.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Choose carefully what to read to their children.
【定位】Not all books are created equal, so parents need to choose the books they share with their
children with great care.
并非所有书都一样（有价值），所以父母需要非常用心地挑选要和孩子共读的书。
【信号】结尾因果建议句 so parents need to…。答案信号是篇章结尾的因果建议句 so parents
need to choose the books they share with their children with great care，so 引出结
论、need to 是直接建议，正是题干要的『结尾建议』。
【替换】choose the books they share with their children with great care ↔
Choose carefully what to read to their children.
with great care=carefully、share=read to
【排除】A) 与原文相反
选项 Read as many books as possible to their children. 主张『尽量多读』，但结尾恰恰
强调 Not all books are created equal『书有好坏之分』、要『用心选』，方向与原文相反
——原文要的是质而非量。
借用原文：Not all books are created equal
C) 原词陷阱
选项 Share experience with other parents. 借了一个似曾相识的 share，但原文的 share
是 the books they share with their children（与孩子共读书），从没说『与其他父母分享
经验』，对象被换且原文无此建议。
借用原文：the books they share with their children
D) 未提及
选项 Create picture books for their children. 借了原文反复出现的 books 和图像概念，
但原文建议父母『挑选』书，从没说『为孩子创作绘本』，create 是无中生有的动作。
借用原文：parents need to choose the books they share with their children
