questions.stem: What happened at one of Australia's largest gold mines?

options.label: A
options.text: Part of its dam wall collapsed.

options.label: B
options.text: It released a lot of harmful gases.

options.label: C
options.text: It was destroyed by an earthquake.

options.label: D
options.text: Some miners were trapped underground.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Part of its dam wall collapsed.
【定位】Operations at one of Australia's largest gold mines had to be temporarily suspended on Friday
after a partial wall collapse at one of the mine's dams.
澳大利亚一座最大的金矿之一不得不在周五暂停作业，原因是该矿其中一个尾矿坝的坝体发
生了局部坍塌。
【信号】新闻导语首句锁定核心事件。Operations at one of Australia's largest gold mines had
to be temporarily suspended on Friday after a partial wall collapse at one of the
mine's dams. 是整篇新闻的导语句，结构「结果（停产）+ after + 原因（坝体局部坍
塌）」完整地把核心事件交代清楚——after 之后的 partial wall collapse 就是事件本身，
对应第 1 题答案。
【替换】a partial wall collapse at one of the mine's dams ↔ Part of its dam wall collapsed.
名词化 ↔ 主谓化
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
录音第 4 段 materials which are harmful to the environment and human health 出现
了 harmful 这个词，但说的是「坝里盛着的矿渣可能对环境与人体有害」，并非「这次事件
释放了有害气体」。选项 B 把 harmful 这个原词盗过来，再加上原文从未提及的 gases，
制造了「听到 harmful 就选」的诱惑。
借用原文：materials which are harmful to the environment and human health
C) 原词陷阱
录音第 2 段 The wall collapse at the Cadia mine came just a few days after two
earthquakes hit the area. 只说「坝塌发生在两次地震几天之后」，并未说「金矿被地震毁
了」；第 6 段更明说 The company was unable to confirm whether the recent
earthquakes had contributed to the dam's wall collapse——连地震是否与坝塌有关都
未确认。选项 C 把 earthquakes 这个原词盗过来，硬生生升级成「被地震毁」，是典型的
过度推断。
借用原文：The wall collapse at the Cadia mine came just a few days after two earthquakes hit
the area.
D) 未提及
录音从头到尾只讲「坝体局部坍塌、暂停作业、调查中」，第 7 段反而明说 the break had
posed no safety threat to workers——发言人特意说事故对工人没有安全威胁。选项 D
描述的「矿工被困井下」完全是矿难常见画面，凭考生的「常识联想」来骗人，原文无任何
依据。

questions.stem: What did the spokesperson say about the incident?

options.label: A
options.text: It posed a safety threat to the miners.

options.label: B
options.text: It caused damage too heavy to assess.

options.label: C
options.text: It brought the mine's operations to a halt.

options.label: D
options.text: It was followed by two more earthquakes.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） It brought the mine's operations to a halt.
【定位】A company spokesperson said the operations at the site had been halted while the
investigation is ongoing and that the break had posed no safety threat to workers.
公司发言人表示，调查期间该矿区已停止作业，并称这次坝体破裂并未对工人构成任何安全
威胁。
【信号】spokesperson said 引述信号词。第 7 段开头 A company spokesperson said 是最强的
引述信号，直接告诉考生「下面这句就是发言人的原话」。句中包含两个并列宾语从句
（halted while investigation + no safety threat），把「停产」和「对工人无安全威胁」
一并说出，正是第 2 题的答案句。
【替换】the operations at the site had been halted ↔ It brought the mine's operations to a halt.
被动 ↔ 主动 + 动词名词化
had to be temporarily suspended on Friday ↔ It brought the mine's operations to a halt.
suspend = halt
【排除】A) 与原文相反
录音第 7 段明确说 the break had posed no safety threat to workers——发言人特意强
调「没有」构成安全威胁。选项 A 把 posed、safety threat 这几个高辨识度原词原样照
搬，唯独把 no 去掉，含义彻底反转。这是听力里最经典的「否定词陷阱」。
借用原文：the break had posed no safety threat to workers
B) 过度推断
录音第 6 段说 said it was conducting a thorough investigation——公司正在做全面调
查；选项 B 却把「在调查」升级成「损失大到无法评估」 It caused damage too heavy to
assess.，凭空加上了 too heavy to assess 这一程度判断，原文无任何依据。
借用原文：said it was conducting a thorough investigation
D) 原词陷阱
录音第 2 段说 The wall collapse at the Cadia mine came just a few days after two
earthquakes hit the area.——坝塌发生在两次地震「之后」（事件 ← 两次地震在前）；
选项 D It was followed by two more earthquakes. 却说「这次事件之后又有两次地
震」，时序刚好相反，更多了 more 这个原文没有的词。选项 D 把 two earthquakes 这个
原词盗过来，把时序对调。
借用原文：The wall collapse at the Cadia mine came just a few days after two earthquakes hit
the area.
Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.
1 Two boys and four girls were born on Monday to the surprise of a young couple and doctors who
had expected five babies.
周一,一对年轻夫妇和原本预期会有五个婴儿的医生们惊讶地迎来了两个男孩和四个女孩的诞生。
2 This was the first record of six babies being born at the same time in that region. The doctors
prepared from early in the morning to help deliver five tiny citizens. They were in the operating room
with five teams of doctors, one for each baby.
这是该地区首次有六个婴儿同时出生的记录。医生们从清晨就开始准备协助接生五个小公民。他们在手术
室里准备了五组医生团队,每个婴儿配备一组。
3 The first five babies were delivered successfully, and all baby beds were occupied. And then all of a
sudden, it turned out there was another waiting to come out.
前五个婴儿成功分娩,所有婴儿床都被占用了。然后突然之间,发现还有另一个婴儿等待出生。
4 The doctor said the babies were in healthy condition, but could not go home immediately. They
needed to stay in the hospital for two to three months for medical supervision.
医生表示婴儿们健康状况良好,但不能立即回家。他们需要在医院接受两到三个月的医学监护。
5 The mother who is in stable condition could return home a day later if all physical tests came back
normal. The babies' mother commented that they had already prepared room for five babies at home, so
they will have to rearrange things for their happy surprise. The new parents have yet to name the sixth
baby but are considering either Lily or Rose.
状况稳定的母亲如果所有体检结果正常,一天后就可以回家。婴儿的母亲表示他们已经在家里为五个婴
儿准备了房间,所以他们必须为这个惊喜重新安排。这对新父母尚未给第六个婴儿取名,但正在考虑Lily
或Rose。

questions.stem: What did the hospital do for the delivery of the babies?

options.label: A
options.text: It prepared beds for all the six new citizens.

options.label: B
options.text: It assigned a team of doctors for each expected baby.

options.label: C
options.text: It made ample preparations for various possibilities.

options.label: D
options.text: It brought in the most advanced instruments.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） It assigned a team of doctors for each expected baby.
【定位】The doctors prepared from early in the morning to help deliver five tiny citizens. They were
in the operating room with five teams of doctors, one for each baby.
医生们从清晨就开始做准备，迎接五个小公民的降生。他们和五组医生一起守在产房，每个
宝宝都配一组医生。
【信号】动词 prepared 直接对接题干 do。题干问 do，录音里出现 The doctors prepared from
early in the morning——同一语义场的动词 prepared 就是答案信号；紧接着的 five
teams of doctors, one for each baby 把"准备"具体化为"按预计人数一对一配"，两句合起
来构成完整答案句。
【替换】five teams of doctors, one for each baby ↔ a team of doctors for each expected baby
one for each baby ↔ a team for each baby
five teams of doctors ↔ a team of doctors for each expected baby
总数→分配视角的转换
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
It prepared beds for all the six new citizens. 把"六个新公民都准备了床"安在医院头上，
但录音 all baby beds were occupied. And then all of a sudden, it turned out there
was another waiting to come out 说前五张床被占满后突然来了第六个，恰恰证明医院只
准备了五张床，第六个是意外。选项里的 six 是听到的原词，却用在错误事实上。
借用原文：all baby beds were occupied. And then all of a sudden, it turned out there was another
waiting to come out
C)
It made ample preparations for various possibilities. 听起来像"做了充分应对各种可能
性的准备"，但录音里没有任何"应对多种可能性"的话——医院其实只按五个宝宝准备，第
六个是意外，恰恰说明它并未为"各种可能"做准备。这是用空泛大词诱选的典型。
借用原文：all of a sudden, it turned out there was another waiting to come out
D)
It brought in the most advanced instruments. 说医院引进了最先进的仪器，可录音通篇
都没提到任何 instrument 或 advanced 之类的词，纯属无中生有。最高级 the most 一旦
录音里没有等值表述就不能选。

questions.stem: What did the doctor say about the newborns?

options.label: A
options.text: They had to undergo 2-3 physical checkups.

options.label: B
options.text: They were all of normal size except the sixth.

options.label: C
options.text: They could go home together with their mother a day later.

options.label: D
options.text: They needed to stay in the hospital for a couple of months.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） They needed to stay in the hospital for a couple of months.
【定位】The doctor said the babies were in healthy condition, but could not go home immediately.
They needed to stay in the hospital for two to three months for medical supervision.
医生说宝宝们身体状况良好，但不能马上回家。他们需要在医院留观两到三个月以接受医疗
监护。
【信号】the doctor said 直接领出答案句。录音里出现的 The doctor said 完美对应题干中的 the
doctor say，紧接着的 but 转折引出真正落点：could not go home immediately. They
needed to stay in the hospital for two to three months——but 之后才是答案。
【替换】needed to stay in the hospital for two to three months ↔
They needed to stay in the hospital for a couple of months.
two to three months ↔ a couple of months
【排除】A) 偷换概念
They had to undergo 2-3 physical checkups. 把录音里听到的 two to three 借走，却安
在 physical checkups（体检次数）上——可录音里 two to three 修饰的是 months（月
数）。这是把同一数字偷换修饰对象的典型原词陷阱。
借用原文：two to three months for medical supervision
B)
They were all of normal size except the sixth. 说"除第六个外都是正常大小"，但录音里
医生只说 the babies were in healthy condition（健康），并未提任何"大小是否正常"，
更没说第六个例外。这是"加细节诱选"。
C) 原词陷阱
They could go home together with their mother a day later. 把"一天后回家"安在宝宝
身上，但录音 The mother who is in stable condition could return home a day later 明
确指出 a day later 是妈妈的安排；而宝宝那边是 could not go home immediately。选项
盗用了 a day later 这个原词，把妈妈的待遇张冠到宝宝头上。
借用原文：The mother who is in stable condition could return home a day later

questions.stem: What do we learn from the news report about the Spanish island Palmador?

options.label: A
options.text: It is owned by the local government.

options.label: B
options.text: It has been turned into a public park.

options.label: C
options.text: It has been bought by an American.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a perfect tourist destination.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） It is a perfect tourist destination.
【定位】A Spanish island called Palmador has been bought by a family from Europe for 18 million
euros. The island is often described as heaven on earth by holidaymakers.
一个名叫帕尔马多尔的西班牙岛屿已被一个来自欧洲的家庭以 1800 万欧元买下。这个岛常
被度假者形容为「人间天堂」。
【信号】新闻导语+总括赞美句。答案信号有两层：一是开头第一句作为新闻导语，交代核心事实「a
family from Europe（欧洲家庭）买下了岛」；二是紧接的总括赞美 often described as
heaven on earth by holidaymakers——heaven on earth 这种总括式形容词，正是与选
项 a perfect tourist destination 对应的同义信号。
【替换】often described as heaven on earth by holidaymakers ↔ a perfect tourist destination
总括赞美·同义改写
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项说岛 owned by the local government，但原文 has been bought by a family from
Europe 与第三段 it was offered to the local government but proved too expensive
for the local authorities 明确说「曾打算卖给地方政府，但地方政府嫌太贵买不起」——
所以买家是欧洲家庭，不是政府，A 反了。
借用原文：it was offered to the local government but proved too expensive for the local authorities
B) 偷换概念
原文只说「它位于一个 natural park 里面」（its natural beauty is protected as it lies
inside a natural park），是说岛位于自然公园之内、受保护；并没有说岛本身「被变成了
公共公园」。选项 turned into a public park 偷换了「位于公园内」和「自身变成公
园」。
借用原文：its natural beauty is protected as it lies inside a natural park
C) 原词陷阱
原文 has been bought by a family from Europe 明确说买家来自欧洲（Europe），选项
bought by an American 把国籍换成了美国人——动作（bought）原音照搬，国籍偷换，
是典型的「原词陷阱+张冠李戴」组合。
借用原文：has been bought by a family from Europe

questions.stem: What do holidaymakers come to Palmador to enjoy?

options.label: A
options.text: Its seafood.

options.label: B
options.text: Its unusual coastline.

options.label: C
options.text: Its unspoiled beaches.

options.label: D
options.text: Its architecture.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Its unspoiled beaches.
【定位】For decades tourists have been flocking to Palmador, which is located off the southeast coast
of Spain. They come to enjoy its unspoiled beaches and crystal clear waters.
几十年来，游客们一直涌向帕尔马多尔，它位于西班牙东南海岸外。他们来这里是为了享受
未受破坏的海滩和清澈见底的海水。
【信号】原音 come to enjoy 直接点题。答案信号是原音里 They come to enjoy its unspoiled
beaches and crystal clear waters 出现的 come to enjoy——它与题干 come to…enjoy
完全同构，紧跟其后的两个名词短语就是答案的两个候选。
【替换】its unspoiled beaches and crystal clear waters ↔ Its unspoiled beaches
原词原音直接复现
【排除】A) 未提及
全文未出现任何与 seafood 相关的词。这项是预读时就预警过的「海岛+seafood」刻板印
象陷阱——主体考生容易凭「海岛大概有好吃的海鲜」这种常识脑补出答案，但原文没说就
是没说。
B) 原词陷阱
原文提及 coast（located off the southeast coast of Spain）只是说岛「位于西班牙东南
海岸外」，是定位用语，不是描述岛本身的海岸线独特。选项 Its unusual coastline 借了
coast 这个原词，并加了一个原文没有的形容词 unusual。
借用原文：located off the southeast coast of Spain
D) 未提及
原文通篇没有提到岛上有什么建筑（无任何 building / architecture / house 的描述），与
选项 Its architecture 完全无对应原文。

questions.stem: What do estate agents say about Palmador?

options.label: A
options.text: It has an unmatched location.

options.label: B
options.text: It is worth over 18 million euros.

options.label: C
options.text: It has beautiful weather all year round.

options.label: D
options.text: It is an ideal place to meet famous stars.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） It has an unmatched location.
【定位】It is said to have a remarkable location that few other private islands of this size can match,
according to estate agents.
据房产中介称，这座岛拥有非凡的地理位置，少有同等大小的其他私人岛屿能与之匹敌。
【信号】引述标志 according to + 最高级语义。答案信号有两层：①引述定位词 according to
estate agents 与题干 estate agents say 完全对应——这是这道题答案句的硬信号；②引
述句内含最高级语义 few other private islands of this size can match（少有同等大小的
私人岛能比得过），与选项 unmatched location 的最高级语义一一对应。
【替换】a remarkable location that few other private islands of this size can match ↔
It has an unmatched location
最高级语义·同义浓缩
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
18 million euros 确实出现在原音里（bought by a family from Europe for 18 million
euros），但它是新闻导语里的成交价格，不是房产中介对这座岛的评价。预读时就把 18
million euros 标为数字陷阱预警——正是为这一题做准备。
借用原文：has been bought by a family from Europe for 18 million euros
C) 未提及
全文没有出现 weather / climate / sunshine 等任何与天气有关的描述。选项 beautiful
weather all year round 是基于「度假胜地通常天气好」做的常识脑补，并不来自原音。
D) 偷换概念
原文 its seafront is public land and is a favorite destination for famous people 说海滨
是「名人爱来的地方」，但这与选项 an ideal place to meet famous stars（一个见明星的
理想场所）不同——前者讲名人来此度假，后者讲普通人来此能「遇见」明星。同时该句也
不是 estate agents 说的，而是新闻自己的陈述，连发话人都对不上。
借用原文：its seafront is public land and is a favorite destination for famous people

questions.stem: What do we learn about the woman from the conversation?

options.label: A
options.text: She has been attending some group classes.

options.label: B
options.text: She has registered for two new gym classes.

options.label: C
options.text: She became a member of the gym two months ago.

options.label: D
options.text: She is entitled to a discount on all the gym exercises.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） She became a member of the gym two months ago.
【定位】Yes, I signed up two months ago, but I haven't been to any of the group classes yet.
是的，我两个月前就注册了，不过我还一节团体课都没上过。
【信号】被问者应答 = 答案落点。前一句 Are you already a member? 是询问者抛出的问题，被问
的女士紧接着用 Yes, I signed up two months ago 给出直接应答——对话题里，问句之后
被问者的应答几乎就是答案句。
【替换】I signed up two months ago ↔ She became a member of the gym two months ago
signed up = became a member
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 She has been attending some group classes. 借用了录音 any of the group
classes 这一原词，但女士说的是 I haven't been to any of the group classes yet(还没上
过)——典型听到原词就想选的原词陷阱，方向恰好相反。
借用原文：I haven't been to any of the group classes yet
B) 偷换概念
选项 She has registered for two new gym classes. 把录音里 two of our brand new
classes 拼到女士头上，但全文女士只在最后报名了一门 hot yoga，根本没有「报了两
门」，且打电话之初仍只是咨询阶段——属偷换「咨询/报名」的概念。
借用原文：two of our brand new classes, hot yoga, and advanced spinning
D)
选项 She is entitled to a discount on all the gym exercises. 里的 all 是范围词陷阱：原
文明确 the discount doesn't apply to any of our regular classes，折扣只限两门新课、
不及于所有项目——把「局部」扩成「全部」。
借用原文：the discount doesn't apply to any of our regular classes

questions.stem: What is the gym center doing right now?

options.label: A
options.text: Considering the promotion of its regular classes.

options.label: B
options.text: Taking measures to expand its exercise programs.

options.label: C
options.text: Recruiting coaches for hot yoga and advanced spinning.

options.label: D
options.text: Offering existing members a discount off two new classes.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Offering existing members a discount off two new classes.
【定位】Currently we are offering existing members discounts off two of our brand new classes, hot
yoga, and advanced spinning, but the discount doesn't apply to any of our regular classes
I'm afraid.
目前我们正给老会员提供两门全新课程的折扣——热瑜伽和高级动感单车，但是这个折扣不
适用于任何常规课程，很抱歉。
【信号】时间副词 Currently 直接领出现行举措。Currently we are offering existing members
discounts off two of our brand new classes 用 Currently+we are offering 把「当前正
在做什么」摆得明明白白，正是题干 right now 的同义信号。
【替换】we are offering existing members discounts off two of our brand new classes ↔
Offering existing members a discount off two new classes.
几乎逐字对应的同义改写
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 Considering the promotion of its regular classes. 借用了录音里 regular classes 的
原词，但原文是 the discount doesn't apply to any of our regular classes——常规课程
恰恰是「不打折」的对象，健身房并未推广常规课程。
借用原文：the discount doesn't apply to any of our regular classes
B) 过度推断
选项 Taking measures to expand its exercise programs. 里的「扩展锻炼项目」在录音里
没有任何句子支撑——录音只说推出了两门新课的折扣，并未提「扩张/扩展」。属于把
「推新课折扣」过度推断为「扩张项目」。
C) 原词陷阱
选项 Recruiting coaches for hot yoga and advanced spinning. 把录音 hot yoga, and
advanced spinning 这两个原词照搬过来，但行为是「招教练」——录音里从未提到招
聘，是听到课程名就想选的典型原词陷阱。
借用原文：two of our brand new classes, hot yoga, and advanced spinning

questions.stem: What does the man say is a pity for the woman?

options.label: A
options.text: She missed the deadline for the 10-week course.

options.label: B
options.text: She missed out on the gym's general discount.

options.label: C
options.text: She didn't sign up for membership in time.

options.label: D
options.text: She wasn't so much interested in hot yoga.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） She missed out on the gym's general discount.
【定位】The same discount of 20% is being offered to everyone at the door on a "first come, first
served" basis for the first month. It's a shame you missed out on the general discount.
首月对所有人在现场都按「先到先得」提供同样的 20% 折扣。可惜你错过了这个普通
折扣。
【信号】惋惜句标志 It's a shame…。It's a shame you missed out on the general discount 用
It's a shame 把男方的「惋惜」明明白白说出口，正与题干 a pity 一一对应；shame 之后
跟的就是「错过了什么」。
【替换】you missed out on the general discount ↔ She missed out on the gym's general discount.
几乎原词复现的同义改写
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 She missed the deadline for the 10-week course. 借用录音里 the 10-week
course on Thursday evenings 的原词，但 10-week course 是女士最后真正报上的课、
不存在「错过截止日」；男方的惋惜对象是 general discount，不是 10-week course。
借用原文：Can you sign me up for the 10-week course on Thursday evenings?
C) 与原文相反
选项 She didn't sign up for membership in time. 与录音 I signed up two months ago
直接冲突：女士两个月前已经入会，根本不存在「没及时入会」的问题。
借用原文：I signed up two months ago
D) 与原文相反
选项 She wasn't so much interested in hot yoga. 与录音 I am only really interested in
hot yoga 完全相反——女士只对热瑜伽感兴趣，而非「不感兴趣」。属盗用 hot yoga 原
词的反向陷阱。
借用原文：I am only really interested in hot yoga

questions.stem: Why is the woman unwilling to pay in advance?

options.label: A
options.text: She doesn't want to reveal her card details over the phone.

options.label: B
options.text: She doesn't think it wise to pay before attending any class.

options.label: C
options.text: She might have to cancel her registration any minute.

options.label: D
options.text: She prefers to have the fee added to her monthly bill.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） She doesn't want to reveal her card details over the phone.
【定位】No, I don't like giving my card details over the phone anyway.
不用，反正我也不喜欢在电话里报我的卡号细节。
【信号】表态句 No+理由句 I don't like… 紧贴在一起。No 是女士对 Would you prefer to pay in
advance? 的明确拒绝，紧跟其后的 I don't like giving my card details over the phone
就是拒绝的原因——这种「先表态、后给因」的结构是对话原因题的标志答案句。
【替换】I don't like giving my card details over the phone ↔
She doesn't want to reveal her card details over the phone.
don't like giving = doesn't want to reveal
【排除】B) 未提及
选项 She doesn't think it wise to pay before attending any class. 听起来合理，但录音
里女士的原因仅围绕「电话里报卡号」，完全没有「上课前付不明智」这种判断——属凭常
识替原文补理由。
C) 未提及
选项 She might have to cancel her registration any minute. 中「随时可能退课」在录音
里没有任何句子支持——女士反而紧接着报了 10-week course，并未表现出要退的迹象。
D) 原词陷阱
选项 She prefers to have the fee added to her monthly bill. 借用 the fee of the class
will just be added to your monthly bill 的原词，但 monthly bill 是男方在女士拒绝预付
之后才提出的替代方案，并不是女士拒绝预付的原因——属把「结果」当「原因」的原词陷
阱。
借用原文：the fee of the class will just be added to your monthly bill

questions.stem: Why are the speakers in China?

options.label: A
options.text: To make investments.

options.label: B
options.text: To sign a business contract.

options.label: C
options.text: To research new markets.

options.label: D
options.text: To open a new office.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） To research new markets.
【定位】There are lots of great potential markets here in China. So I'm sure that the head office in
London will be pleased once we get back and present our research.
这里中国市场潜力很大。我相信我们回去把调研结果汇报给伦敦总部，他们一定会满意的。
【信号】research 一词定位。答案落点不靠『目的信号词 to do』，而是靠对此行成果的总结句
present our research。当对话里一方在概括『我们这趟做了什么/带回什么』，那句往往就
是目的题的答案句——做的事就是来此的目的。
【替换】present our research ↔ To research new markets.
名词化转动作
potential markets here in China ↔ To research new markets.
潜在=新
【排除】A)
录音从头到尾没有 invest/investment/money 之类的词，To make investments. 属于
『未提及』型干扰，靠的是听众对『商务出差=投资』的常识联想。
B) 未提及
录音没出现 contract/sign/deal 等词，To sign a business contract. 是『未提及』型干
扰，与 A 同属『商务=签合同』的常识误判。
D) 原词陷阱
录音多次出现 the head office in London，To open a new office. 盗用了 office 这个原
词，让人听到 office 就想选；但录音里 office 始终指『已经存在的伦敦总部』，没有任何
『开设新办公室』的动作。
借用原文：the head office in London

questions.stem: Where will the man stop over on his way to London?

options.label: A
options.text: Dubai.

options.label: B
options.text: Beijing.

options.label: C
options.text: Amsterdam.

options.label: D
options.text: Earl's Court.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Dubai.
【定位】There's a flight arriving the following morning, with a two-hour stopover in Dubai, or a flight
arriving at 11:30 in the evening, with a five-hour stopover in Amsterdam.
有一班次日早晨到达、在迪拜中转两小时的航班；还有一班晚上 11:30 到达、在阿姆斯特丹
中转五小时的航班。
【信号】两项并列与男方应答。答案不在女方那句『二选一』里，而在男方第 5 段的应答 Well,
that's obvious then, isn't it? 之后、女方第 6 段的确认 okay, so that's Dubai. ——这是对
话题的标志性信号：被问者/被选方的应答才是落点。
【替换】so that's Dubai ↔ Dubai.
确认句直给
【排除】B)
flights from Beijing to London 里 Beijing 是出发城市，不是中转地。Beijing. 盗用了这个
原词，制造『一听到 Beijing 就选』的陷阱。
借用原文：flights from Beijing to London
C)
a five-hour stopover in Amsterdam 中 Amsterdam 确实是中转，但属于男方放弃的『晚
到+长候机』那条线——男方那句 Well, that's obvious then, isn't it? 暗示选 short
stopover（两小时的 Dubai）。Amsterdam. 盗用 Amsterdam 原词，但选错了那条线。
借用原文：a five-hour stopover in Amsterdam
D)
The nearest metro station is Earl's Court. 中 Earl's Court 是伦敦酒店附近的地铁站，是
男方到达伦敦后的活动地点，与『中转』毫无关系。Earl's Court. 盗用了一个完全异类的地
名做干扰。
借用原文：The nearest metro station is Earl's Court.

questions.stem: What does the man ask the woman to do?

options.label: A
options.text: Rent a bike for him to get around the town.

options.label: B
options.text: Reserve a meeting room in the head office.

options.label: C
options.text: Help him prepare his presentation.

options.label: D
options.text: Send him a map of the hotel area.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Send him a map of the hotel area.
【定位】Can you find a map that shows where the hotel is and send it to me online?
你能找一份显示酒店位置的地图，然后线上发给我吗？
【信号】Can you 请求信号。Can you find a map that shows where the hotel is and send it to
me online? 是男方说出口的请求句，Can you 是最经典的请求信号——本题答案就在这一
句里。
【替换】find a map that shows where the hotel is and send it to me online ↔
Send him a map of the hotel area.
详述变概括
send it to me online ↔ Send him a map of the hotel area.
代词与人称转换
【排除】A)
I want to see if I can get one of those rental bicycles and ride to the office just for
fun. 这是男方自己想做的事，主语是 I，不是请求女方。Rent a bike for him to get
around the town. 盗用了 rental bicycles 这个原词，制造『听到 bike 就选』的陷阱。
借用原文：I want to see if I can get one of those rental bicycles and ride to the office just for fun.
B)
Do you remember the capacity of their meeting room? 男方只是问女方『记不记得容
量』，I'll check. 是女方主动表示要去查，没人请她去『预订（reserve）会议室』。
Reserve a meeting room in the head office. 盗用 meeting room 原词、把 capacity 偷
换成 reserve。
借用原文：Do you remember the capacity of their meeting room?
C)
For the presentation, I'll bring my own laptop and hook it up to their projector.
presentation 由男方自己准备（I'll bring…），没有请求女方帮忙。Help him prepare his
presentation. 盗用 presentation 原词，制造『听到就选』。
借用原文：For the presentation, I'll bring my own laptop and hook it up to their projector.

questions.stem: What did the woman remind the man to do at the end of the conversation?

options.label: A
options.text: Bring his projector.

options.label: B
options.text: Keep all his receipts.

options.label: C
options.text: Submit his claims form.

options.label: D
options.text: Pay with his credit card.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Keep all his receipts.
【定位】No problem. Just remember to keep all your receipts. You remember the trouble you had
last time.
没问题。记得把所有发票留好。你记得上次遇到的麻烦吧。
【信号】Just remember to 提醒信号。答案信号是 Just remember to keep all your receipts.
中的 Just remember to——这是英语里最典型的『提醒』句式，直接对应题干 remind…
to do。
【替换】Just remember to keep all your receipts. ↔ Keep all his receipts.
祈使变陈述
【排除】A)
hook it up to their projector 中 projector 指对方公司已有的，男方说 I'll hook it up
——根本没有『自带投影仪』的意思，更不是女方的提醒。Bring his projector. 是张冠李
戴 + 与原文相反双重错。
借用原文：hook it up to their projector
C)
I'll submit my claims form afterwards. 是男方自己说『事后我会提交报销单』，主语是
I，不是女方提醒。Submit his claims form. 盗用 claims form 这个原词制造陷阱，让人听
到 submit/claims 就选。
借用原文：I'll submit my claims form afterwards.
D)
I'll pay everything with my own card, right? 是男方自己交代会用自己的卡付款，并非女
方提醒。Pay with his credit card. 盗用 card 原词。
借用原文：I'll pay everything with my own card, right?

questions.stem: What did the researchers of the new study try to determine?

options.label: A
options.text: Whether a country's educational level is linked to women's rights.

options.label: B
options.text: Whether women's rights are making good progress around the world.

options.label: C
options.text: Whether a country's protection of women's rights is related to its public health.

options.label: D
options.text: Whether women's rights are more often overlooked in less-developed countries.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Whether a country's protection of women's rights is related to its public health.
【定位】Thus, they wanted to determine if there was a link between protection of women's rights and
public health.
因此，他们想要确定女性权利的保护与公共健康之间是否存在某种联系。
【信号】因果信号 Thus 引出研究目的句。Thus, they wanted to determine if there was a link
between protection of women's rights and public health. 由 Thus 引出，是前文铺垫之
后的结论性目的句；同时 wanted to determine 与题干 try to determine 是同义改写，双
重信号锁定本句为答案句。
【替换】if there was a link between protection of women's rights and public health ↔
Whether a country's protection of women's rights is related to its public health.
if↔Whether、a link↔is related to 的同义替换
【排除】A) 未提及
选项 Whether a country's educational level is linked to women's rights. 用了一个录音
根本没提的 educational level；录音只谈 protection of women's rights and public
health，根本没有把教育水平作为研究对象，属于未提及式干扰。
B) 原词陷阱
选项 Whether women's rights are making good progress around the world. 借用了录
音 many parts of the world have made good economic progress 里的 good progress
与 the world 两个原词，但录音说的是经济进展不错而女性权利常被忽视，并不是在问女性
权利本身有没有进展；属于盗用原词答非所问。
借用原文：many parts of the world have made good economic progress, but women's rights are
often overlooked
D) 原词陷阱
选项 Whether women's rights are more often overlooked in less-developed
countries. 盗用录音原词 often overlooked，但录音只说 women's rights are often
overlooked，并没有把这种忽视限定到 less-developed countries；选项擅自加了一个原
文没有的范围限定。
借用原文：women's rights are often overlooked

questions.stem: What does the passage say about countries lacking in medical resources?

options.label: A
options.text: Their people still have better health if women's rights are respected.

options.label: B
options.text: They must make efforts to increase women's access to health care.

options.label: C
options.text: Their people tend to attach importance to women's rights.

options.label: D
options.text: They need to invest more in hospital staff and facilities.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Their people still have better health if women's rights are respected.
【定位】Furthermore, in countries where women's rights were most respected, but where access to
hospitals and doctors was below average, health outcomes were still better than in countries
rated as moderate or poor.
此外，在那些最尊重女性权利但医院与医生资源低于平均水平的国家里，健康结果仍然要好
于那些评级为中等或较差的国家。
【信号】转折信号 but+still 锁定反差结论。in countries where women's rights were most
respected, but where access to hospitals and doctors was below average, health
outcomes were still better 中的 but 与 still 是双重转折/让步信号，听到 but…still 几乎就
等于答案句敲钟，篇章里这种条件下仍如何的句子是出题点的常态。
【替换】access to hospitals and doctors was below average ↔
Their people still have better health if women's rights are respected.
缺医疗资源↔lacking medical resources 同义概括
health outcomes were still better ↔ still have better health
health outcomes↔health、still better↔still better 的近乎逐词等值
in countries where women's rights were most respected ↔ if women's rights are respected
where 从句条件化↔if 条件句的等值改写
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
选项 They must make efforts to increase women's access to health care. 借用录音里
access to hospitals and doctors 的 access 一词，但录音是在客观描述这些国家医疗资源
不足下仍有好的健康结果，根本没有说他们必须做什么；选项把客观陈述偷换成主观对策，
又强加了 women's access to health care 这种原文没有的提法。
借用原文：access to hospitals and doctors was below average
C) 张冠李戴
选项 Their people tend to attach importance to women's rights. 把录音里关于这些国
家本身尊重女性权利的客观描述，偷换为这些国家的人民倾向于重视女性权利；录音说的是
国家层面的尊重程度，并没有谈人民的态度倾向。
借用原文：in countries where women's rights were most respected
D) 原词陷阱
选项 They need to invest more in hospital staff and facilities. 借用了录音 hospitals
and doctors 里的 hospitals，但录音从未说这些国家需要投入更多在医院上；选项把缺资
源仍健康好这一反差客观结论，偷换成需要加大投入的对策。
借用原文：access to hospitals and doctors was below average

questions.stem: What has often been questioned regarding women's rights?

options.label: A
options.text: Their link with a country's public health.

options.label: B
options.text: Their potential impact on social progress.

options.label: C
options.text: Their value to a country's international image.

options.label: D
options.text: Their positive effect on economic development.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Their positive effect on economic development.
【定位】They note that the value of women's rights has often been questioned from an
economic standpoint.
他们指出，女性权利的价值常常从经济角度受到质疑。
【信号】题干同根词 questioned 直接对应。the value of women's rights has often been
questioned from an economic standpoint 几乎是题干 What has often been
questioned regarding women's rights? 的逐词同根回响：questioned 对 questioned、
women's rights 对 women's rights，定位极其稳。
【替换】the value of women's rights has often been questioned from an economic standpoint ↔
Their positive effect on economic development.
from an economic standpoint↔on economic development 的角度替换
ensuring those rights would limit progress, but this study indicates the opposite ↔
positive effect on economic development
否定的反面=正面效应的等值推理
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 Their link with a country's public health. 借用了录音前文 protection of women's
rights and public health 的 public health 一词，但 18 题问的是被质疑的内容，而录音里
女性权利与公共健康的关系是被研究证实的，并非被质疑的对象；属于盗用原词答非所问。
借用原文：protection of women's rights and public health
B) 偷换概念
选项 Their potential impact on social progress. 借用了录音 ensuring those rights
would limit progress 里的 progress，但录音里的 progress 是与 economic 挂钩的，且
选项加了一个 social 修饰；录音从未谈过对 social progress 的潜在影响，属于偷换概念。
借用原文：Some have argued that ensuring those rights would limit progress
C) 未提及
选项 Their value to a country's international image. 谈的是对国家国际形象的价值，录
音从头到尾都没谈过 international image 或与之相关的概念，属于未提及式干扰。

questions.stem: What does the passage say about hot sunshine?

options.label: A
options.text: It creates a wonderful setting for dating.

options.label: B
options.text: It may cause strange physical reactions.

options.label: C
options.text: It turns parks into picnic sites.

options.label: D
options.text: It may result in a crowded beach.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） It may cause strange physical reactions.
【定位】Sunshine and high temperatures can mean picnics and parks and trips to beaches, but they can
make your body react in some strange ways.
阳光和高温可能意味着野餐、公园和海滩之旅，但它们可能让你的身体以一些奇怪的方式作
出反应。
【信号】but 转折后才是真意。答案信号在 but they can make your body react in some strange
ways 的 but——前半 Sunshine and high temperatures can mean picnics and parks
and trips to beaches 列举的野餐、公园、海滩都是 A/C/D 选项的来源（陷阱区），but
之后才是文章真正要讲的主题：让身体出现奇怪反应。
【替换】make your body react in some strange ways ↔ cause strange physical reactions
同义改写：make…react ≈ cause…reactions
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 It creates a wonderful setting for dating. 借后文第二段提到 You may think that
summer is the perfect time to go on a date 里的 "date" 制造"听到约会就想选"的诱惑，
但录音说的是"你以为夏天适合约会"，是一个被推翻的设定，不是"阳光创造了约会良机"这
一主张。
借用原文：You may think that summer is the perfect time to go on a date or chat with an attractive
boy or girl.
C) 原词陷阱
选项 It turns parks into picnic sites. 盗用了第一段铺垫中的 picnics and parks，但
picnics 和 parks 在录音里只是 but 前的场景列举，根本没说"阳光把公园变成野餐地"——
纯粹靠原词诱导的干扰。
借用原文：Sunshine and high temperatures can mean picnics and parks and trips to beaches
D) 未提及
选项 It may result in a crowded beach. 盗用了 trips to beaches 里的 beaches 制造熟悉
感，但录音里只有"去海滩"这件事，从未说 crowded（拥挤的）——"拥挤的海滩"是额外想
象出来的细节。
借用原文：trips to beaches

questions.stem: What does the passage say is a negative side effect of water loss?

options.label: A
options.text: Breathing difficulty.

options.label: B
options.text: Bad breath.

options.label: C
options.text: Excessive sweating.

options.label: D
options.text: High blood pressure.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Bad breath.
【定位】But excessive heat can cause you to lose water, which has been proven to have a pretty
unattractive side effect—bad breath.
但是过度的高温会让你失去水分，而水分流失已被证明有一个相当不雅观的副作用——
口臭。
【信号】破折号后的解释就是答案。答案信号是 a pretty unattractive side effect—bad breath 这
个破折号结构：unattractive side effect 与题干 negative side effect 直接对应，破折号后
面的 bad breath 就是这个 side effect 的具体所指。
【替换】a pretty unattractive side effect ↔ a negative side effect of water loss
unattractive 与 negative 同义
bad breath ↔ Bad breath
答案点原词复现
【排除】A)
选项 Breathing difficulty. 利用 breathing 与录音 bad breath 中 breath 的近形——只差
一字，听感几乎相同，最容易让靠耳朵抓"差不多的词"的考生上当。但 breath 是"口气"，
breathing 是"呼吸"，录音从未提到呼吸困难。
借用原文：bad breath
C)
选项 Excessive sweating. 利用了第三段 Sunshine can stop you from sweating, too. 里
的 sweating 一词，但录音说的是 stop you from sweating（让你停止出汗），与
excessive sweating（过度出汗）方向恰好相反。
借用原文：Sunshine can stop you from sweating, too.
D) 未提及
选项 High blood pressure. 听起来像是常见的高温副作用，但录音里讲水分流失的副作用
时只提到 bad breath，从未出现 high blood pressure 或 blood pressure 之类的词——
纯属凭常识脑补出来的干扰。

questions.stem: What is said to be a positive effect of sunshine?

options.label: A
options.text: It protects people against bacteria.

options.label: B
options.text: It enables people to build up endurance.

options.label: C
options.text: It accelerates people's blood circulation.

options.label: D
options.text: It provides people with extra energy.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） It provides people with extra energy.
【定位】However, the sun can have a positive influence on your body by raising your energy
levels. You might feel like the sun is giving you extra energy for your day, which is
actually happening.
然而，阳光可以通过提高你的能量水平对身体产生积极的影响。你可能感觉阳光在为你这一
天提供额外的能量，而这其实是真的在发生。
【信号】However 转折+ positive influence 极性词。答案信号是双重的：However 把话题从前
文负面反应扳向正面作用；紧接着 positive influence 与题干 positive effect 直接对应；再
后面给出具体方式 raising your energy levels 和加倍说明 giving you extra energy——
三处叠加锁死答案句。
【替换】raising your energy levels ↔ provides people with extra energy
raise levels ≈ provide extra
the sun is giving you extra energy ↔ provides people with extra energy
give 与 provide 同义、extra energy 原词复现
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 It protects people against bacteria. 借用第三段 Bacteria accumulate because
there isn't enough water in your mouth to wash it away 里的 bacteria 制造熟悉感，但
录音说的是"细菌会累积"，根本没说阳光保护人免受细菌侵害——把细菌的角色彻底搞反
了。
借用原文：Bacteria accumulate because there isn't enough water in your mouth to wash it away
B) 未提及
选项 It enables people to build up endurance. 中的 endurance（耐力）在录音里完全没
有对应表述——既没说运动耐力，也没说体力持久；纯粹是凭"阳光对身体好"这种泛印象塞
进来的诱选项。
C)
选项 It accelerates people's blood circulation. 的 blood circulation（血液循环）听起来
非常"科学"，但录音里从未出现 blood、circulation 或任何对应表达；这是利用考生"阳光
促进血液循环"的常识印象设计的陷阱。

questions.stem: What does the passage say about left-handed people?

options.label: A
options.text: They are more likely to win in combat sports.

options.label: B
options.text: They are in the minority among the population.

options.label: C
options.text: They have a higher chance of joining sports teams.

options.label: D
options.text: They have more disadvantages in getting ahead.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） They are more likely to win in combat sports.
【定位】Research found that they were overrepresented among fighters in combat sports. Left-handed
fighters also had higher chances to win.
研究发现，他们（左撇子）在搏击运动的拳手中占比偏高。左撇子拳手获胜的概率也更高。
【信号】Research found 是研究结论信号。Research found that 是非常典型的"研究结论"信号，
听力篇章一旦出现 Research found / Studies show / Scientists discovered，紧跟的那句
几乎一定是出题点；这里跟着两句具体结论，正好对应一个选项。
【替换】Left-handed fighters also had higher chances to win ↔
They are more likely to win in combat sports.
had higher chances to win = more likely to win
【排除】B) 未提及
B 项 They are in the minority among the population. 借了讲者 they were
overrepresented among fighters in combat sports 里 overrepresented 涉及"人群占
比"的话题，但讲者说的是"在搏击拳手中占比偏高（overrepresented）"，根本没说他们在
总人口中是"少数（in the minority）"。一个是"在某个子群里偏多"，一个是"在总人口里偏
少"，方向完全不一样。
C) 原词陷阱
C 项 They have a higher chance of joining sports teams. 用 higher chance 这个原文里
出现的搭配勾人，但 Left-handed fighters also had higher chances to win 说的是"赢的
概率更高"，不是"加入运动队的概率更高"。原词 higher chances 被留下，宾语却从 win
被偷换成了 joining sports teams。
D) 与原文相反
D 项 They have more disadvantages in getting ahead. 借了讲者开头 Left-handed
people can find it inconvenient to do certain things 里 inconvenient 的负面色彩，但
讲者紧接着用 but 转折说 there are a number of advantages of being left-handed——
全文真正落点是"优势更多"，不是"不利更多"。

questions.stem: What is said to be special about left-handed people?

options.label: A
options.text: Their brain is more powerful than that of right-handed people.

options.label: B
options.text: The left side of their brain is more powerful than its right side.

options.label: C
options.text: They tend to be a lot more aggressive than right-handed people.

options.label: D
options.text: Their brain has a stronger connection between its two sides.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Their brain has a stronger connection between its two sides.
【定位】Left-handers may also be better at remembering events. The explanation is that the two brain
spheres of left-handers are more strongly connected.
左撇子在记忆事件方面可能也更出色。原因是左撇子的两个脑半球之间联系更紧密。
【信号】The explanation is 是因果信号。The explanation is that 直接告诉考生"接下来这句是解
释/原因"，是答案句典型路标；并且这句正好给出大脑结构特征 the two brain spheres of
left-handers are more strongly connected，与选项群里 brain 相关那一项直接对位。
【替换】the two brain spheres of left-handers are more strongly connected ↔
Their brain has a stronger connection between its two sides.
brain spheres = two sides; strongly connected = stronger connection
【排除】A) 过度推断
A 项 Their brain is more powerful than that of right-handed people. 借了原文 brain
这个核心词，但讲者只说"两脑半球之间连接更强（more strongly connected）"，并没有
说"整个大脑都比右撇子强"。从"连接性"被扩大到了"整体性能"。
B) 偷换概念
B 项 The left side of their brain is more powerful than its right side. 借了原文 brain 与
spheres 这两个原词的话题，却把讲者"两个脑半球连接更强（two brain spheres … more
strongly connected）"偷换成了"左半球比右半球更强"。一个讲"连接"，一个讲"哪一侧更
强"，根本不在同一维度。
C) 未提及
C 项 They tend to be a lot more aggressive than right-handed people. 利用第 1 段
fighters in combat sports 这种暗示攻击性的话题做联想，但讲者全篇没有任何"左撇子更
具攻击性（aggressive）"的描述，更没有把它当作"特殊之处"提出。

questions.stem: Why are left-handed people better at solving more difficult problems?

options.label: A
options.text: They have a larger brain.

options.label: B
options.text: It still remains unknown.

options.label: C
options.text: It is related to their genes.

options.label: D
options.text: They are better at reasoning.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） It still remains unknown.
【定位】An Italian study found that for simple arithmetic there was little difference between right- and
left-handed performance, but for more difficult problem-solving, left-handers won out. No
one understands the reason for this.
一项意大利研究发现，在简单算术方面，左右撇子之间表现差别不大；但在更难的解题方
面，左撇子胜出。然而没人弄清楚其中的原因。
【信号】No one understands the reason 是"未知"信号。No one understands the reason for
this 是非常明确的"原因尚不清楚"型信号句，与选项 It still remains unknown. 的语义直接
对应，是听力里最容易被忽视但出题率极高的句式之一。
【替换】No one understands the reason for this ↔ It still remains unknown.
No one understands = remains unknown
【排除】A) 未提及
A 项 They have a larger brain. 想借第 2 段 brain 这个原词诱选，但讲者全篇没有任何"左
撇子大脑更大"的描述。
C) 未提及
C 项 It is related to their genes. 在常识上很像"科学解释"，但讲者在第 3 段明明说 No
one understands the reason for this，根本没有把原因归到基因。
D) 答非所问
D 项 They are better at reasoning. 借了第 3 段讲到的"在更难的解题里胜出（for more
difficult problem-solving, left-handers won out）"的话题，但 problem-solving（解
题）≠ reasoning（推理）；而且讲者从未把 reasoning 当作"为什么更擅长难题"的解释。

questions.stem: What should parents do about a left-handed child?

options.label: A
options.text: Teach them how to perform tasks with their right hand.

options.label: B
options.text: Help them fully develop their mathematical abilities.

options.label: C
options.text: Encourage them to play fast-paced interactive sports.

options.label: D
options.text: Advise them to choose jobs that require quick reactions.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Encourage them to play fast-paced interactive sports.
【定位】So if you have a left-handed child, you should encourage them to play table tennis, baseball
and tennis.
所以如果你的孩子是左撇子，就应该鼓励他们去打乒乓球、棒球和网球。
【信号】you should encourage 是直给建议信号。you should encourage them 几乎是听力里最
干脆的建议信号——should + encourage 直接对位题干 should do，紧跟的动作就是答案
句的内容。
【替换】encourage them to play table tennis, baseball and tennis ↔
Encourage them to play fast-paced interactive sports.
三项具体运动 = fast-paced interactive sports
you should encourage them ↔ Encourage them
should encourage 与 encourage 动宾完全对位
【排除】A) 与原文相反
A 项 Teach them how to perform tasks with their right hand. 让父母教孩子"用右手做
事"，与全文为左撇子鸣不平、最后还鼓励他们发展左撇子优势的基调相反——讲者从未要
求父母把孩子扳成右撇子。
B) 原词陷阱
B 项 Help them fully develop their mathematical abilities. 借了第 3 段 Being left-
handed might be a factor in mathematical ability 里 mathematical 这个原词，但讲者
从未让父母"帮孩子开发数学能力"，那一段只是描述现象、没给建议。
D) 偷换概念
D 项 Advise them to choose jobs that require quick reactions. 借了原文 Those that
require the fastest reaction 里 reaction 这个高识别度词做诱饵，但讲者说的是"需要最快
反应的运动（sports）"，根本不是"需要快速反应的职业（jobs）"。修饰词 quick
reactions 留下了，对象却被偷换。

questions.stem: What do we learn from the news report about the study?

options.label: A
options.text: It examines the effect of cholesterol on people's health.

options.label: B
options.text: Its participants all had high blood cholesterol levels.

options.label: C
options.text: It questions the benefits of a vegetarian protein diet.

options.label: D
options.text: Its finding came as a surprise to the researchers.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Its finding came as a surprise to the researchers.
【定位】This finding surprised researchers, who admitted they didn't expect that eating white meat
would lead to higher blood cholesterol levels.
这一发现令研究者们感到意外,他们承认自己没有料到吃白肉会导致血液胆固醇水平升高。
【信号】情绪信号词 surprised。答案落点不是平铺的数据句,而是带情绪色彩的 This finding
surprised researchers,再用 who admitted they didn't expect 加重——新闻里出现"意
外/没料到"这种态度词,往往就是出题点。
【替换】This finding surprised researchers ↔ Its finding came as a surprise to the researchers
动词 surprised 改写成名词 a surprise
who admitted they didn't expect ↔ came as a surprise
"没料到"与"意外"同义互证
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
A 借了原文反复出现的 blood cholesterol levels 里的 cholesterol 一词,把研究说成"考察
胆固醇对健康的影响";但录音考察的是"不同肉类的饮食对胆固醇的影响",胆固醇是被测的结
果而非被研究的起因,A 把对象说反了。
借用原文：blood cholesterol levels
B) 与原文相反
B 说参与者"都是高胆固醇",但第二段原文是 researchers looked at 113 healthy
people(113 名健康人);B 盗用了 cholesterol levels 这个反复出现的词,再加个绝对的 all,
把"健康人"悄悄换成"高胆固醇人群",与原文相反。
借用原文：researchers looked at 113 healthy people
C) 原词陷阱
C 说研究"质疑素食蛋白饮食的好处",借的是原文真出现过的 a vegetarian protein diet;但
原文第四段恰恰是 eat...more vegetarian protein(建议多吃素食蛋白),研究从头到尾力挺素
食蛋白、绝无质疑,属无中生有又反向。
借用原文：a vegetarian protein diet

questions.stem: What did the researchers acknowledge?

options.label: A
options.text: They do not know all the effects of eating meat.

options.label: B
options.text: Red meat itself does not cause heart diseases.

options.label: C
options.text: White meat may be healthier than red meat.

options.label: D
options.text: Vegetarian protein may be easier to absorb.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） White meat may be healthier than red meat.
【定位】The team acknowledged that it is possible that white meat is better for our health than red
meat despite their findings.
研究团队承认,尽管有这些发现,白肉仍有可能比红肉更有益于我们的健康。
【信号】题干同词 acknowledged 引出让步。答案句正是题干 acknowledge 在原文里的对应词
The team acknowledged that it is possible that,其后 white meat is better for our
health than red meat 就是承认的内容;"题干动词在原文复现"是最稳的定位信号。
【替换】white meat is better for our health than red meat ↔ White meat may be healthier than red meat
better for our health 改写成 healthier
it is possible that ↔ may be
it is possible that 等于 may
【排除】A) 过度推断
A 借了第四段 other effects of red meat consumption 里的 effects,说研究者"承认还不了
解吃肉的全部影响";但原文只说红肉"另有别的影响可能致病",并没说研究者"不知道全部影
响",A 把局部说法夸大成笼统的"全不知",属过度推断。
借用原文：other effects of red meat consumption
B) 与原文相反
B 借了原文 contribute to heart disease 里的 heart disease,说"红肉本身不致心脏病";但
原文恰说红肉的别的影响"可能促成心脏病",方向正相反,B 把原文的肯定关系反成了否定。
借用原文：contribute to heart disease
D) 未提及
D 借了原文反复出现的 vegetarian protein,却安上一个原文压根没提的角度 absorb(更易吸
收);全文只说建议多吃素食蛋白、它对胆固醇影响更小,从未谈"吸收",属无中生有。
借用原文：vegetarian protein
Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.
1 At around half past nine this morning, a trailer attached to a lorry turned over at the crossing of High
Street in Milton. Hundreds of frozen turkeys were spilled all over the road. It is reported that nobody
was hurt in the incident, but police said it may affect traffic and Christmas dinners. With just one week
to go before Christmas, there are worries that local supermarket supplies of this holiday favorite may
be affected.
今天上午九点半左右,一辆卡车拖挂的拖车在Milton的High Street十字路口发生侧翻。数百只冷冻火鸡散
落在路面上。据报道,此次事故中无人受伤,但警方表示这可能会影响交通和圣诞晚餐。距离圣诞节仅剩一
周时间,人们担心当地超市这一节日热门食品的供应可能会受到影响。
2 A police spokeswoman said that officers were currently in attendance at the scene. She stated that the
driver of the lorry had been arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving.
一名警方女发言人表示,警员目前正在现场处置。她说,卡车司机已因涉嫌危险驾驶被逮捕。
3 The crossing on High Street is a well-known accident blackspot. This year alone, there have been
seven traffic accidents at this location. Thankfully, none of these accidents have resulted in serious injury.
High Street的这个十字路口是一个众所周知的交通事故多发点。仅今年一年,该路口就发生了七起交通事
故。幸运的是,这些事故均未造成重伤。

questions.stem: What does the news report say about the accident at the crossing of High Street in Milton?

options.label: A
options.text: It may have been due to the lorry driver's drunk driving.

options.label: B
options.text: It may affect the local supply of turkeys for Christmas.

options.label: C
options.text: It interrupted traffic for several hours running.

options.label: D
options.text: It was caused by a lorry running into a trailer.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） It may affect the local supply of turkeys for Christmas.
【定位】It is reported that nobody was hurt in the incident, but police said it may affect traffic and
Christmas dinners. With just one week to go before Christmas, there are worries that local
supermarket supplies of this holiday favorite may be affected.
据报道，事故中无人受伤，但警方表示这可能影响交通和圣诞晚餐。距圣诞节仅剩一周，人
们担心当地超市这一节日抢手货的供应可能受影响。
【信号】转折 but 后接真正落点。答案藏在转折词后面：nobody was hurt in the incident, but
police said it may affect traffic and Christmas dinners 里 but 之后才是报道强调的影
响，紧接着 supplies of this holiday favorite may be affected 进一步点明"节日抢手
货"（即火鸡）供应受影响，这正是答案句。
【替换】supplies of this holiday favorite may be affected ↔
It may affect the local supply of turkeys for Christmas.
this holiday favorite=turkeys
may be affected ↔ It may affect
被动转主动·affect 同词根
【排除】A) 偷换概念
录音说司机 had been arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving（涉嫌危险驾驶被
捕），选项却写成 drunk driving（酒驾）。dangerous driving 与 drunk driving 长得
像、都沾"driving"，但危险驾驶不等于酒驾，原文从没提到喝酒，属偷换。
借用原文：the driver of the lorry had been arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving
C) 原词陷阱
选项 interrupted traffic for several hours running 里"中断交通"沾了原文 it may affect
traffic 的边——traffic 确实被念到，所以听到就想选；但原文只说"可能影响交通"，从没
说"中断了好几个小时"，several hours 是凭空加的时长。
借用原文：it may affect traffic and Christmas dinners
D) 原词陷阱
选项 It was caused by a lorry running into a trailer 把 lorry、trailer 两个原词都用上
了，极像答案；但原文是 a trailer attached to a lorry turned over——挂在卡车上的拖车
翻倒，并不是"一辆卡车撞上一辆拖车"，选项把"翻车"歪曲成了"撞车"，动作对不上。
借用原文：a trailer attached to a lorry turned over at the crossing of High Street

questions.stem: What do we learn about the crossing on High Street?

options.label: A
options.text: It has been the scene of several fatal accidents recently.

options.label: B
options.text: It is the spot that causes the local police a lot of worry.

options.label: C
options.text: It has witnessed several traffic accidents this year.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a location frequented by local traffic police.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） It has witnessed several traffic accidents this year.
【定位】The crossing on High Street is a well-known accident blackspot. This year alone, there have
been seven traffic accidents at this location. Thankfully, none of these accidents have resulted
in serious injury.
高街的这个路口是出了名的事故黑点。仅今年一年，这个地点就发生了七起交通事故。所幸
这些事故没有一起造成严重伤亡。
【信号】数字+时间范围·具体数据句。答案落在带具体数据的那句：This year alone, there have
been seven traffic accidents at this location——"今年"这个时间范围加上"七起"这个数
字，正是新闻里最常被设题的信息点，听到数字就该锁定。
【替换】there have been seven traffic accidents ↔ It has witnessed several traffic accidents
seven=several·具体数概括成"几起"
This year alone ↔ this year
时间范围一致·this year
【排除】A) 与原文相反
选项 several fatal accidents 借用了原文 accident 一词，但 fatal（致命的，会死人）与原
文恰好相反——录音明说 none of these accidents have resulted in serious injury（没
有一起造成严重伤亡），更别提致命，方向反了。
借用原文：none of these accidents have resulted in serious injury
B) 未提及
选项 causes the local police a lot of worry 用了 police 这个原文出现过的词（A police
spokeswoman、officers were currently in attendance）来诱选，但原文只说警方到场处
理、发言人通报，从没说这个路口"让警方很担忧"，担忧是凭空加的。
借用原文：officers were currently in attendance at the scene
D) 原词陷阱
选项 frequented by local traffic police 把 traffic（原文 it may affect traffic 念过）和
police（A police spokeswoman 念过）拼在一起，听着字字耳熟；但原文从没说"交警经
常光顾这个路口"，frequented 这层意思是编出来的。
借用原文：A police spokeswoman said that officers were currently in attendance at the scene

questions.stem: What is Bangalore airport trying to do about the helicopter taxi service?

options.label: A
options.text: Get approval to add more routes.

options.label: B
options.text: Attract more international tourists.

options.label: C
options.text: Advertise it through a mobile app.

options.label: D
options.text: Make it affordable to common folk.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Get approval to add more routes.
【定位】The service, which claims to be the first of its kind in India, offers only one route, but
Bangalore airport will add more once it gets approval.
这项服务号称是印度同类中的首创，目前只提供一条线路，但班加罗尔机场一旦获批就会增
加更多线路。
【信号】but 后\+将来动作。答案句靠两个信号锁定：一是转折词 but，新闻里 but 之后常落真正
要说的事；二是将来动作 will add more once it gets approval，正好对应题干"trying to
do（正打算做的事）"。
【替换】will add more once it gets approval ↔ Get approval to add more routes
同一动作换序表达
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
选项 Attract more international tourists. 借"国际"二字勾连录音里的 International
Airport terminal（国际机场航站楼），但 International 在原文只是机场名字的一部分，录
音从未说机场要"吸引国际游客"，属听到 International 就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：International Airport terminal
C) 原词陷阱
选项 Advertise it through a mobile app. 盗用录音 Customers can book their
helicopter ride through a mobile app 里的 mobile app，但原文说 app 是用来"预订
（book）"的，不是机场用来"打广告（advertise）"，动作被偷换，属原词陷阱。
借用原文：Customers can book their helicopter ride through a mobile app
D) 与原文相反
选项 Make it affordable to common folk. 搬来录音里的 affordable，但原文是
Helicopter taxi is not an affordable option for many travelers（对许多人并不便宜），
机场也明说 This is not a low cost option，根本没打算降价惠民，选项把"不便宜"反着说
成"要让普通人买得起"，是与原文相反的陷阱。
借用原文：Helicopter taxi is not an affordable option for many travelers

questions.stem: What do we learn from the news report about the helicopter taxi ride?

options.label: A
options.text: It costs more than twice as much as a car ride.

options.label: B
options.text: It is gaining popularity among ordinary Indians.

options.label: C
options.text: It symbolizes India's advancement in high-tech.

options.label: D
options.text: It can get anywhere in the city within 15 minutes.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） It costs more than twice as much as a car ride.
【定位】Helicopter taxi is not an affordable option for many travelers. A car ride for the same journey
costs less than half as much.
直升机出租车对许多旅客来说并不便宜。同样的行程，打车的花费还不到它的一半。
【信号】价格比较句。答案句是带比较结构的事实陈述 A car ride for the same journey costs less
than half as much，含 less than half 这种倍数/比例信号，正对应选项里的价格数字题，
是听力里"听到数字/比较就锁定"的典型答案句。
【替换】A car ride for the same journey costs less than half as much ↔
It costs more than twice as much as a car ride
比例反向换算
【排除】B) 与原文相反
选项 It is gaining popularity among ordinary Indians. 与录音 not an affordable
option for many travelers（对许多人并不便宜）相悖——既然普通人嫌贵，就谈不上
在"普通印度人"中流行；选项借"印度"这个大背景词制造熟悉感，实则与原文相反。
借用原文：not an affordable option for many travelers
C) 过度推断
选项 It symbolizes India’s advancement in high-tech. 把这项服务上升到"象征印度高科
技进步"，但录音通篇只讲它的线路、价格、客户、运营方，从未做这种象征性评价，属录
音根本没说的过度拔高。
D) 原词陷阱
选项 It can get anywhere in the city within 15 minutes. 盗用录音的 15 分钟，但原文
ferry customers the 40 miles between Bangalore’s Electronic City tech hub and the
International Airport terminal in 15 minutes 说的是"特定两点间 40 英里 15 分钟"，选
项偷偷把范围放大成"城内任何地方"，数字对、范围被改大，属原词陷阱。
借用原文：between Bangalore’s Electronic City tech hub and the International Airport terminal in
15 minutes

questions.stem: Who are the targeted customers of the helicopter taxi service?

options.label: A
options.text: International tourists.

options.label: B
options.text: High-class travelers.

options.label: C
options.text: Prominent superstars.

options.label: D
options.text: Customers in a hurry.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） High-class travelers.
【定位】"A large number of high-class travelers, including CEOs, have to spend more than three hours
by road to get there and that is a loss of time," a Bangalore airport spokesperson said.
"包括首席执行官在内的大量高端旅客，开车去那里要花三个多小时，这是时间上的损
失，"班加罗尔机场一位发言人说。
【信号】发言人点名人群。答案句是发言人原话里直接点名的人群 A large number of high-class
travelers, including CEOs，新闻里"官方发言人/负责人"的引语常承载关键信息，且这里直
接报出目标客户，是最可靠的答案信号。
【替换】A large number of high-class travelers, including CEOs ↔ High-class travelers
原话即选项措辞
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 International tourists. 借 International 勾连录音里多次出现的 International
Airport terminal，但原文从没说目标客户是"国际游客"，International 只属于机场名字，
属听到原词就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：International Airport terminal
C) 未提及
选项 Prominent superstars.（知名巨星）在录音里根本没出现，发言人点的是 high-class
travelers 和 CEOs，从未提明星；这是"凭直觉觉得贵东西该卖给名人"的常识陷阱，原文无
据。
D) 原词陷阱
选项 Customers in a hurry. 盗用录音 tech executives in a hurry 里的 in a hurry，但原
文 in a hurry 只是修饰"赶时间的科技高管"，回答"为谁服务"的官方表述用的是 high-class
travelers 这个上位称呼；选项抓住次要修饰语 in a hurry 当答案，偷换了概念层级，属原
词陷阱。
借用原文：tech executives in a hurry

questions.stem: What does the woman plan to do for the weekend?

options.label: A
options.text: Treat her friends in a bar.

options.label: B
options.text: Take a trip to Washington.

options.label: C
options.text: Make some cheese.

options.label: D
options.text: Throw a party.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Throw a party.
【定位】It will be very casual. We will just be a small group of friends gathering together at
Washington Park. There will be around 20 of us, including children.
会很随意。我们就是一小群朋友聚在华盛顿公园，大约20个人，还带着孩子。
【信号】女方自述聚会安排。答案藏在女方对自己活动的描述里：a small group of friends
gathering together 加上前文 a barbecue this weekend，合起来说明她要办一场朋友聚
会/派对，这是问"她计划做什么"时该锁定的自述句。
【替换】a small group of friends gathering together ↔ Throw a party.
聚会即办派对
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
原文确实有 friends，但聚会在 Washington Park 公园而非酒吧，bar 是凭空加的；选项
借"朋友"这个原词诱你选，地点对不上。
借用原文：a small group of friends gathering together at Washington Park
B) 原词陷阱
原文 Washington Park 只是聚会地点，选项把 Washington 拎出来说成 take a trip，
把"在华盛顿公园聚会"歪曲成"去华盛顿旅行"。
借用原文：gathering together at Washington Park
C) 原词陷阱
全程女方是去 buy some cheese，从没说要"做"奶酪；选项借高频词 cheese 诱选，把
buy 偷换成 make。
借用原文：buy some cheese for a barbecue

questions.stem: What does the man suggest the woman do?

options.label: A
options.text: Spend no more than 30 dollars.

options.label: B
options.text: Buy different kinds of cheese.

options.label: C
options.text: Help him prepare the barbecue.

options.label: D
options.text: Find out different people's tastes.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Buy different kinds of cheese.
【定位】I would suggest having at least one soft cheese and one hard cheese. That will offer you a
good variety to suit different people's tastes.
我建议至少买一种软奶酪和一种硬奶酪。这样能提供丰富的选择，照顾到不同人的口味。
【信号】建议信号词 suggest。I would suggest having at least one soft cheese and one hard
cheese 里的 suggest 是明确的建议信号，紧随其后的内容就是男方给的建议，正是答案
落点。
【替换】one soft cheese and one hard cheese ↔ Buy different kinds of cheese.
软硬各一=多种
a good variety to suit different people's tastes ↔ Buy different kinds of cheese.
丰富选择即多种
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
30 dollars 出自女方 Let's say $30.，是她自报的预算，不是男方的建议；选项盗用这个数
字，又把它说成"花不超过30"，与"男方建议"无关。
借用原文：Let's say $30.
C) 原词陷阱
barbecue 在 a barbecue this weekend 出现过，但男方从未建议女方"帮忙准备烧烤"，
help prepare 是凭空添加。
借用原文：a barbecue this weekend
D) 原词陷阱
different people's tastes 确在原文 to suit different people's tastes，但它是"买软硬两
种"想达到的目的，不是男方让她"去了解口味"这个动作；选项盗用原词却答非所问。
借用原文：to suit different people's tastes

questions.stem: What does the man say about Spanish goat cheese?

options.label: A
options.text: It is the best kind of hard cheese.

options.label: B
options.text: It is the most popular in Spain.

options.label: C
options.text: It is more delicious than honey.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a good choice for children.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） It is a good choice for children.
【定位】I would suggest something like this Spanish goat cheese. It's only $15, a very good price. You
can spread it on bread with a knife, and then add a tiny bit of honey on top. It's delicious.
Children love it.
我建议这种西班牙山羊奶酪。只要15美元，价格很划算。你可以用刀把它抹在面包上，再在
上面加一点蜂蜜，很美味，孩子们都爱吃。
【信号】落点在 Children love it。讲西班牙山羊奶酪的几句里，结尾 Children love it. 是最贴近选
项的评价句，这句直接给出"孩子爱吃"这一可与选项对应的信息。
【替换】Children love it. ↔ It is a good choice for children.
孩子爱吃=适合孩子
【排除】A) 偷换概念
西班牙山羊奶酪在原文是作为软奶酪 soft cheeses are creamy 举例的，根本不是 hard
cheese，更没说"最好的硬奶酪"；best 也是凭空拔高。
借用原文：soft cheeses are creamy and go well with sweet things
B) 原词陷阱
Spanish 确实出现在 Spanish goat cheese，但原文只说它产自西班牙/价格好，从没说
它"在西班牙最受欢迎"；most popular 是无中生有。
借用原文：this Spanish goat cheese
C) 原词陷阱
honey 出自 add a tiny bit of honey on top，原文是说"加点蜂蜜更美味"，并没拿奶酪和
蜂蜜比谁更好吃；选项把"配蜂蜜"歪成"比蜂蜜好吃"。
借用原文：add a tiny bit of honey on top. It's delicious.

questions.stem: What is the woman going to do at the end of the conversation?

options.label: A
options.text: Buy what the man recommended.

options.label: B
options.text: Have a taste of both of the cheeses.

options.label: C
options.text: Choose one of the two types of cheese.

options.label: D
options.text: Ask the man to cut the cheese into slices.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Buy what the man recommended.
【定位】Okay, I'll take both. Thank you for your help.
好的，两种我都要。谢谢你的帮助。
【信号】结尾表态 I'll take both。对话末句 I'll take both. 是女方的最终拍板，I'll 是结尾决定的信
号，这句决定了她要怎么做。
【替换】I'll take both. ↔ Buy what the man recommended.
都要=买他推荐的
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
女方说的是 I'll take both.（两种都买下），不是"先尝两种"；选项盗用"两种"这个概念却把
take（买）偷换成 taste（尝）。
借用原文：I'll take both.
C) 与原文相反
原文 I'll take both. 明说"都要"，选项却说"二选一"，方向正好相反；two types 这个原词
对得上，结论却反了。
借用原文：I'll take both.
D) 张冠李戴
cut...into slices 出自男方介绍硬奶酪 You can cut it into thin slices，是吃法说明，女方结
尾从没让对方切片；选项把男方的话安到女方动作上。
借用原文：You can cut it into thin slices and eat it on its own.

questions.stem: What does the woman say about using e-textbooks?

options.label: A
options.text: New teachers and staff have to be recruited.

options.label: B
options.text: It might take some time for students to adapt.

options.label: C
options.text: It involves buying lots of tablets and software.

options.label: D
options.text: The software has to be constantly upgraded.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） It involves buying lots of tablets and software.
【定位】What about the cost, not only buying all those tablets, but the software and electronic
infrastructure that goes with it, not to mention retraining all the teachers and
administration staff?
那成本怎么办呢？不光是买那些平板，还有随之而来的软件和电子基础设施，更别提还要重
新培训所有教师和行政人员了。
【信号】女士用反问抛出顾虑。男士刚说期待换电子书，女士立刻用 Really? What about the cost
反问抛出"成本"这一顾虑——对话里一方的质疑/反问句往往就是该方观点的答案句，这句
把"买平板和软件"列在最前。
【替换】buying all those tablets, but the software ↔ buying lots of tablets and software
原话"买平板和软件"=选项"买大量平板和软件"
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音说的是 retraining all the teachers and administration staff（重新培训现有教师和行
政人员），A 把它偷换成 New teachers and staff have to be recruited.（招聘新教师和
员工）。"培训"不等于"招新人"，听到 staff 一词就选 A 正中陷阱。
借用原文：retraining all the teachers and administration staff
B) 未提及
It might take some time for students to adapt. 说学生适应需要时间，但女士的顾虑全
在成本和环境上，整段对话没有任何一句谈"学生适应电子书要花时间"，属凭常识脑补的未
提及项。
D) 张冠李戴
The software has to be constantly upgraded. 的"软件升级"出自男士 the software for
electronic readers can be updated instantly，而且男士是把它当"好处"说的；本题问女
士的顾虑，把男士的话张冠李戴到女士头上、又把好处当代价，双重错位。
借用原文：the software for electronic readers can be updated instantly

questions.stem: According to the man, how can the use of tablets benefit students?

options.label: A
options.text: It can greatly improve their learning efficiency.

options.label: B
options.text: It can help them to interact more with teachers.

options.label: C
options.text: It can save their trouble of carrying printed books.

options.label: D
options.text: It can develop their skills in using electronic devices.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） It can greatly improve their learning efficiency.
【定位】Anyway, tablets help students learn up to 80% faster.
总之，平板能帮学生的学习速度提升多达 80%。
【信号】男士用 Anyway 收束抛出核心好处。男士先回应成本问题，再用 Anyway, tablets help
students learn up to 80% faster 把话题收回到"平板的好处"上——Anyway 后的总结句配
上 80% 这个具体数字，正是他强调的核心益处，是答案句。
【替换】tablets help students learn up to 80% faster ↔ greatly improve their learning efficiency
"学得快 80%"="大幅提升学习效率"
【排除】B) 未提及
It can help them to interact more with teachers. 说能多和老师互动，但男士讲的好处
是"学得快"和能高亮、记笔记、快速搜索，没有一句提到"与老师互动更多"，是凭"电子设备
促进互动"的印象脑补出来的。
C) 原词陷阱
录音多次出现 printed textbooks/printed books，C 借这个原词编出 It can save their
trouble of carrying printed books.（省去背纸质书的麻烦）。但男士说的好处是高亮、记
笔记、搜索快，从没说"省得背书"，是听到 printed books 就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：printed textbooks
D) 偷换概念
录音谈的是 tablets contain many technological features（平板有很多技术功能），D 把
它偷换成 It can develop their skills in using electronic devices.（培养学生用电子设备的
技能）。男士讲的是功能带来的便利，不是"练会用设备"，借 technological/electronic 这
层词制造混淆。
借用原文：tablets contain many technological features

questions.stem: What does the woman say about students using tablets?

options.label: A
options.text: They may have trouble comprehending texts.

options.label: B
options.text: They may encounter technological problems.

options.label: C
options.text: They may pay less respect to teachers.

options.label: D
options.text: They may get distracted more easily.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） They may get distracted more easily.
【定位】Not necessarily. Tablets have too many distractions. Students may pay attention to apps,
games and websites instead of their teachers.
未必。平板有太多让人分心的东西。学生可能会去关注各种应用、游戏和网站，而不是听老
师讲课。
【信号】Not necessarily 否定后才是女士真意。女士用 Not necessarily 先否定男士"学得快"的说
法，紧接着抛出 Tablets have too many distractions——否定/转折之后亮出的才是她真
正要说的弊端，distractions 这个词直接对应"分心"。
【替换】Tablets have too many distractions ↔ get distracted more easily
"有太多让人分心的东西"="更容易分心"
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音说 people who read printed text comprehend more（读纸质的人理解得更多），A
借 comprehend 这个词编成 They may have trouble comprehending texts.（理解文字
有困难）。原文是"读纸质理解更多"的对比，不是说学生用平板"看不懂"，听到
comprehend 就选即落陷阱。
借用原文：people who read printed text comprehend more
B) 未提及
They may encounter technological problems. 说学生会遇到技术问题，但女士谈的是分
心和纸质阅读理解更好，全程没说"学生用平板会碰到技术故障"，是凭"用电子设备会出故
障"的常识补出来的。
C) 偷换概念
录音说学生可能 pay attention to apps, games and websites instead of their teachers
（去看应用游戏而非听老师），C 借 teachers 偷换成 They may pay less respect to
teachers.（不那么尊重老师）。原文说的是"注意力不在老师身上"，不是"不尊重老师"，听
到 teachers 就选即中招。
借用原文：pay attention to apps, games and websites instead of their teachers

questions.stem: What does the woman say about making electronic readers?

options.label: A
options.text: It generates a great deal of electronic garbage.

options.label: B
options.text: It does a lot of damage to the environment.

options.label: C
options.text: It emits huge amounts of harmful radiation.

options.label: D
options.text: It accelerates the exhaustion of rare minerals.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） It does a lot of damage to the environment.
【定位】Actually, manufacturing tablets is environmentally destructive and dangerous to human
health. A lot of minerals are extracted from the earth to make electronic readers. It does far
more damage to the environment.
实际上，制造平板对环境有破坏性，也危害人体健康。要从地里开采大量矿物来制造电子阅
读器。它对环境造成的破坏要大得多。
【信号】末句 It does far more damage 是收束结论。女士这段先说制造平板 environmentally
destructive，列举健康危害和开采矿物，最后用 It does far more damage to the
environment 一句收束——段末的总括性结论句正是她对"制造电子阅读器"的核心表态，
是答案句。
【替换】It does far more damage to the environment ↔ does a lot of damage to the environment
"破坏环境大得多"="对环境造成很大破坏"
【排除】A) 未提及
It generates a great deal of electronic garbage. 说产生大量电子垃圾，但女士谈的是健
康危害、开采矿物、破坏环境，没有一句提到"电子垃圾/garbage"，是把环保话题往"电子
垃圾"这个常见印象上靠的未提及项。
C) 未提及
It emits huge amounts of harmful radiation. 说释放大量有害辐射，听上去很吓人，但女
士只说 destructive、dangerous to health、extract minerals，从没说"辐
射/radiation"，是凭"电子产品有辐射"的印象编的未提及项。
D) 原词陷阱
录音说 A lot of minerals are extracted from the earth to make electronic readers（开
采大量矿物来造电子阅读器），D 借 minerals 编成 It accelerates the exhaustion of rare
minerals.（加速稀有矿物枯竭）。原文说的是"开采矿物"这一事实，没说"加速枯竭"这个后
果，且本题要的是女士的总括结论（破坏环境），D 是中途细节的过度引申。
借用原文：A lot of minerals are extracted from the earth to make electronic readers

questions.stem: What does the passage say we tend to do every day?

options.label: A
options.text: Communicate with our coworkers.

options.label: B
options.text: Encounter people in different places.

options.label: C
options.text: Judge people based on our first impressions.

options.label: D
options.text: Engage in a variety of psychological activities.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Judge people based on our first impressions.
【定位】Consider how often you make this kind of judgment every day. When you meet with a new
coworker, you immediately begin to develop an initial impression of this person.
想想你每天多频繁地做出这种评判。当你见到一位新同事，你立刻就开始形成对这个人的最
初印象。
【信号】every day 原词复现+举例佐证。录音用 Consider how often you make this kind of
judgment every day 直接点出我们每天都在做的这件事就是 judgment（评判），随后用
见新同事就 develop an initial impression 的例子佐证，every day 与题干同词，是答案句
的定位信号。
【替换】this kind of judgment ↔ Judge people based on our first impressions
judgment 名词→Judge 动词同根
develop an initial impression ↔ based on our first impressions
initial impression=first impression 同义
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音确实出现 When you meet with a new coworker，A 项 Communicate with our
coworkers. 借了 coworker 这个原词，但录音说的是见到新同事时会形成印象，不是与同
事沟通，盗词却答非所问。
借用原文：When you meet with a new coworker
B) 偷换概念
录音有 When you visit the grocery store 这个去不同地方的例子，B 项 Encounter
people in different places. 借此包装成在不同地方遇见人，但录音此处讲的仍是对收银员
形成评判，不是强调遇见人这件事本身，属把例子细节偷换成选项主语。
借用原文：When you visit the grocery store
D) 过度推断
录音讲的是一种具体行为——做评判、形成印象，D 项 Engage in a variety of
psychological activities. 用 a variety of psychological activities 把它说得又大又泛，范
围被夸大，不是录音点名的那一件每天做的事。

questions.stem: What do we learn about person perception from this passage?

options.label: A
options.text: It is an objective evaluation of a person's character.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a mental process influenced by many factors.

options.label: C
options.text: It contributes to the formation of personal traits.

options.label: D
options.text: It varies greatly among different social groups.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） It is a mental process influenced by many factors.
【定位】Obviously, person perception is a very subjective process that can be affected by a number of
variables, including the characteristics of the person you are observing, the context of the
situation, your own personal traits, and your past experiences.
显然，识人知觉是一个非常主观的过程，会受到许多变量的影响，包括你所观察对象的特
征、情境的背景、你自身的性格特质，以及你过往的经历。
【信号】Obviously 强调+定性句。录音用 Obviously 加重语气引出对该概念的定性，紧接着 a
very subjective process that can be affected by a number of variables 直接说它是主观
的、受许多变量影响，这是专门给 person perception 定性的答案句。
【替换】a very subjective process ↔ It is a mental process influenced by many factors
subjective process=mental process
affected by a number of variables ↔ influenced by many factors
affected by variables=influenced by factors
【排除】A) 与原文相反
录音明说它是 a very subjective process（主观过程），A 项 It is an objective
evaluation of a person's character. 却说成 objective（客观），把性质说反了，且
evaluation、character 也只是蹭话题词。
借用原文：a very subjective process
C) 原词陷阱
录音里 your own personal traits 是影响 person perception 的因素之一，C 项 It
contributes to the formation of personal traits. 却反过来说它造就了性格特质，借了
personal traits 这个原词，但把因果方向整个调反了。
借用原文：your own personal traits
D) 未提及
D 项 It varies greatly among different social groups. 说它在不同社会群体间差异巨大，
但录音讲的是它受个人层面的多种变量影响，从未提到社会群体之间的差异，属凭空添加。

questions.stem: What is the problem with using social categorization in person perception?

options.label: A
options.text: It can lead to incorrect judgments.

options.label: B
options.text: It can cause mistrust among people.

options.label: C
options.text: It can result in instant losses.

options.label: D
options.text: It can give rise to gender bias.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） It can lead to incorrect judgments.
【定位】Problems with this technique include the fact that it can lead to errors and prejudice.
这种方法的问题包括：它会导致错误和偏见。
【信号】Problems 原词+lead to errors。录音用 Problems with this technique 直接对应题干的
problem，紧跟 it can lead to errors and prejudice 点出弊端就是导致错误和偏见，
Problems 一词与题干同义，是定位答案句的强信号。
【替换】it can lead to errors ↔ It can lead to incorrect judgments
errors=incorrect judgments
【排除】B) 未提及
B 项 It can cause mistrust among people. 说会造成人际不信任，但录音讲的弊端是
errors and prejudice（错误与偏见），从没说到不信任，属凭空添加的后果。
C) 原词陷阱
录音例子结尾说被偷了钱包 leading to the loss of your wallet，C 项 It can result in
instant losses. 借 loss 这个原词包装成即时损失，但那只是一个具体例子的细节，本题问
的是 social categorization 的整体弊端（错误与偏见），盗词答非所问，且 instant 也是录
音没有的。
借用原文：leading to the loss of your wallet
D) 偷换概念
录音说弊端含 prejudice（偏见），D 项 It can give rise to gender bias. 借偏见这层意思
却收窄成性别偏见，录音例子讲的是凭老妇与壮汉的外貌分类，从没限定为性别偏见，属以
偏概全。
借用原文：prejudice

questions.stem: What does the new study suggest about young people today and those from the previous generation?

options.label: A
options.text: Both groups spend a lot of time on mobile devices.

options.label: B
options.text: Both groups attach importance to social connections.

options.label: C
options.text: They are equally competent in using new technology.

options.label: D
options.text: They are similar in terms of social skills.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） They are similar in terms of social skills.
【定位】Despite smartphones and social media, young people today are as socially competent as those
from the previous generation.
尽管有智能手机和社交媒体，今天的年轻人在社交能力上与上一代人不相上下。
【信号】让步 Despite 后才是真意。答案信号是让步词 Despite smartphones and social media
——让步状语先抛出一个看似负面的前提，真正的研究结论在它之后的主句 young people
today are as socially competent as those from the previous generation，这种
Despite／Although 后的主句正是篇章听力的高频落点。
【替换】as socially competent as those from the previous generation ↔
They are similar in terms of social skills.
as…as 等同改写成 similar
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音开头确实念到 smartphones and social media，A 项 Both groups spend a lot of
time on mobile devices. 借这个原词诱你选，但原文只说尽管有手机、社交能力照样相
当，从没说两代人都花大量时间在设备上，属听到原词就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：smartphones and social media
B) 未提及
B 项 Both groups attach importance to social connections. 说两代都重视社交联系，但
原文只比较社交能力强弱（competent），从未说他们重视或看重社交，研究里没有这层意
思。
C) 偷换概念
录音提到 mobile devices were widespread，C 项 They are equally competent in
using new technology. 借 technology 与 competent 两个耳熟词诱选，但原文说的是社
交能力（socially competent）相当，不是使用技术的能力相当，把社交能力偷换成了用技
术的能力。
借用原文：mobile devices were widespread

questions.stem: What did the study find about children who accessed social networking sites many times a day?

options.label: A
options.text: Their social skills were negatively affected.

options.label: B
options.text: Their school performance was slightly lower.

options.label: C
options.text: Their emotions were much harder to regulate.

options.label: D
options.text: Their relations with peers were badly strained.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Their social skills were negatively affected.
【定位】There was one exception: Social skills were slightly lower for children who accessed online
games and social networking sites many times a day.
有一个例外：对于每天多次玩网络游戏和上社交网站的孩子，他们的社交能力略低一些。
【信号】例外 one exception 即落点。答案信号是转折式提示词 There was one exception——前
文一直说社交能力保持不变或提升，唯独这个 exception 后面交代了负面发现 Social skills
were slightly lower，例外句是典型的答案落点。
【替换】Social skills were slightly lower ↔ Their social skills were negatively affected.
变低概括为受负面影响
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
录音里 slightly lower 修饰的是 social skills（社交能力），B 项 Their school
performance was slightly lower. 原封不动搬来 slightly lower，却把对象换成学业表现，
原文从没说成绩略低，属听到 slightly lower 就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：Social skills were slightly lower
C) 张冠李戴
录音在第 3 段提过 regulate their temper，C 项 Their emotions were much harder to
regulate. 借 regulate 诱选，但那是第 3 段讲两组孩子在自控上相似时的话，跟第 4 段每
天多次上网那群孩子无关，且程度被夸成 much harder，与原文 slightly 相反。
借用原文：regulate their temper
D) 过度推断
D 项 Their relations with peers were badly strained. 说同伴关系严重紧张，原文既没说
这群孩子的同伴关系受损，也没用 badly 这种重程度词（原文是 slightly），属夸大加无中
生有。

questions.stem: What is adults' worry about technological change?

options.label: A
options.text: It may pose a threat to their children's safety.

options.label: B
options.text: It may affect society's traditional values.

options.label: C
options.text: It may hurt their relations with children.

options.label: D
options.text: It may change their children's ethical values.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） It may hurt their relations with children.
【定位】Adults are worried when technological change starts to undermine traditional relationships,
particularly the parent-child relationship.
当科技变化开始侵蚀传统关系、尤其是亲子关系时，成年人会感到担忧。
【信号】worried 直陈担忧 + particularly 点重点。答案信号是表担忧的谓语 Adults are
worried，其担忧对象由 undermine traditional relationships 给出，再由强调词
particularly the parent-child relationship 把重点收窄到亲子关系——particularly 后面的
限定正是答案要的具体落点。
【替换】undermine traditional relationships, particularly the parent-child relationship ↔
It may hurt their relations with children.
undermine=hurt，parent-child=with children
【排除】A) 未提及
A 项 It may pose a threat to their children's safety. 借耳熟的 children 诱选，但原文成
年人担忧的是亲子关系被侵蚀，从没提孩子的人身安全（safety），属新增内容。
B) 偷换概念
录音念过 traditional relationships 与第 6 段的 moral panic，B 项 It may affect
society's traditional values. 借 traditional 诱选，但原文担忧的是传统关系
（relationships），不是社会传统价值（values），把关系偷换成了价值观。
借用原文：traditional relationships
D) 过度推断
第 6 段提到 moral panic，D 项 It may change their children's ethical values. 借这条道
德暗线诱选，但 moral panic 指成年人面对新技术的恐慌情绪，原文从未说科技会改变孩子
的道德／伦理价值观，属由 moral 一词过度推断。
借用原文：moral panic

questions.stem: What does the speaker say about inspiration from consuming others' ideas and success stories?

options.label: A
options.text: It is motivating.

options.label: B
options.text: It is passive.

options.label: C
options.text: It is incredible.

options.label: D
options.text: It is impracticable.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） It is passive.
【定位】The problem is that consuming the success and ideas of others is passive inspiration.
问题在于，消费他人的成功与想法，是一种被动的灵感。
【信号】下定义句 is + 定性词。这句用 consuming the success and ideas of others is passive
inspiration 的 "A is B" 结构，直接给 "消费他人成功" 贴上 passive inspiration 的标签，
是典型的下定义信号，定性题答案就藏在这种 "...is..." 的判断里。
【替换】passive inspiration ↔ It is passive.
原词原义直接对应
【排除】A) 与原文相反
录音把 consuming 来的灵感判为 passive（被动），而 It is motivating. 说它有激励性，
恰与原文相反，是把被动说成主动激励。
借用原文：passive inspiration
C) 原词陷阱
录音 P1 确实出现过 incredible videos, articles and news stories，incredible 是用来形
容那些视频文章 "很精彩"，并不是给 passive inspiration 的定性；选项 It is incredible. 盗
这个原词来骗 "听到就选"。
借用原文：incredible videos, articles and news stories
D) 未提及
录音从未说 consuming 来的 inspiration 是 impracticable（不切实际的），原文只说它
passive、不能代替自己创造，并没有 "不可行" 这层意思，属凭空添加。

questions.stem: What do we learn from the passage about active inspiration?

options.label: A
options.text: It results in short-term excitement.

options.label: B
options.text: It helps us avoid making mistakes.

options.label: C
options.text: It breeds long-term passion and enthusiasm.

options.label: D
options.text: It is bound to help us achieve greater success.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） It breeds long-term passion and enthusiasm.
【定位】Furthermore, active inspiration is what results in long-term passion and enthusiasm.
此外，主动的灵感正是带来长久热情与激情的东西。
【信号】递进 Furthermore 后给定论。Furthermore, active inspiration is what results in long-
term passion and enthusiasm 由 Furthermore 引出对 active inspiration 的进一步定
论，递进词后常接观点落点；同时 results in 是因果信号，直接给出它的结果。
【替换】results in long-term passion and enthusiasm ↔ It breeds long-term passion and enthusiasm.
results in 同义替换为 breeds
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
录音说 short-term 的是 watching 别人成功带来的兴奋——Watching someone else's
success might leave you feeling excited for a few minutes，那是 passive 一侧的效
果；It results in short-term excitement. 把这份 "短暂兴奋" 安到 active inspiration 头
上，张冠李戴。
借用原文：Watching someone else's success might leave you feeling excited for a few minutes
B) 与原文相反
录音讲 active inspiration 包含 making mistakes（犯错）才认识自我，从没说它能 avoid
making mistakes（避免犯错），It helps us avoid making mistakes. 把原文里的 "犯错"
反着安成 "避免犯错"，原文无此说法。
借用原文：making mistakes that we discover who we are
D) 过度推断
录音只说 active inspiration 带来长期热情、给你 power，并没有保证它 "必然带来更大成
功"；It is bound to help us achieve greater success. 中 bound to（必定）把效果夸成
必然成功，推过了头。
借用原文：active inspiration is what results in long-term passion and enthusiasm

questions.stem: What does the passage say passive inspiration can do?

options.label: A
options.text: Drive us forward.

options.label: B
options.text: Bring us power.

options.label: C
options.text: Spur us to action.

options.label: D
options.text: Give us ideas.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Give us ideas.
【定位】Passive inspiration can give you ideas, but active inspiration will give you power.
被动的灵感能给你想法，但主动的灵感会给你力量。
【信号】对比句 but 两侧分派功能。Passive inspiration can give you ideas, but active
inspiration will give you power 用 but 把两种 inspiration 的功能并排对照，passive 给
ideas、active 给 power；对比句两侧的分工正是答案点，须按主语取属于 passive 的那
半句。
【替换】Passive inspiration can give you ideas ↔ Give us ideas.
give you ideas 改 give us ideas
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
录音 P4 说 creating, producing, and experimenting is what drives you forward，drive
forward 是 active 一侧（创造、试验）的功能；Drive us forward. 把它安到 passive 头
上，张冠李戴。
借用原文：creating, producing, and experimenting is what drives you forward
B) 原词陷阱
对比句明说 active inspiration will give you power，给 power 的是 active；Bring us
power. 盗用原词 power 却把它派给 passive，正中 but 后半句被对调的陷阱。
借用原文：active inspiration will give you power
C) 原词陷阱
录音 P3 出现过 taking action and applying a new idea to your life，action 是讲 active
inspiration 的语境，且原文并无 "passive 能 spur us to action" 的说法；Spur us to
action. 借 action 这个原词制造熟悉感，却答非所问。
借用原文：taking action and applying a new idea to your life

questions.stem: Where does the best inspiration come from according to the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: Listening to success stories.

options.label: B
options.text: Applying ideas to one's life.

options.label: C
options.text: Following the advice of experts.

options.label: D
options.text: Consuming the world around us.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Applying ideas to one's life.
【定位】The best inspiration comes from the application of ideas, not the consumption of them.
最好的灵感来自对想法的应用，而非对它们的消费。
【信号】结尾总括句 the best...comes from。The best inspiration comes from the application
of ideas, not the consumption of them 是末段收束的总括定调句，the best...comes
from 直接给出结论，且用 not 把对立的 consumption 排掉，是篇章结尾的答案落点
信号。
【替换】the application of ideas ↔ Applying ideas to one's life.
名词 application 还原为动词 applying
【排除】A) 与原文相反
录音讲的是 application 对 consumption，并没说最佳灵感来自 "listening to success
stories（听成功故事）"，反倒把 "听别人成功" 归为 passive；Listening to success
stories. 与结论相悖。
借用原文：Hearing about other people's success isn't the same as creating your own
C) 未提及
全文从未提到 "following the advice of experts（听从专家建议）"，没有任何对应句，属
凭空添加的来源。
D) 与原文相反
结尾 not the consumption of them 明确用 not 把 consumption 排在最佳来源之外，
Consuming the world around us. 盗用录音确实念过的 consuming/consumption，却恰
恰选了被否定的那一极。
借用原文：not the consumption of them
