questions.stem: What do we learn about the new study from the news report?

options.label: A
options.text: It studied the effects of exercise on sleep.

options.label: B
options.text: Its participants came from various walks of life.

options.label: C
options.text: Its findings confirmed those of previous studies.

options.label: D
options.text: It ran for as long as some thirty years.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） It ran for as long as some thirty years.
【定位】They were followed for approximately three decades.
他们被跟踪研究了大约三十年。
【信号】时长事实 three decades。答案句的信号是一个明确的时长数据 followed for
approximately three decades，three decades 即三十年；新闻里凡出现具体年限、数
字，往往就是出题落点，听到就应锁定。
【替换】approximately three decades ↔ as long as some thirty years
three decades = thirty years
They were followed for ↔ It ran for
被跟踪＝研究持续
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
A 说研究的是运动对睡眠的影响，盗用了录音 questions about sleep and exercise 里真出
现过的 sleep、exercise 两个原词；但录音里这两项只是参与者被问到的调查内容之一，本
研究的真正主题是含糖饮料与死亡风险，并非研究运动对睡眠的影响，听到原词就选正中圈
套。
借用原文：questions about sleep and exercise and health
B) 与原文相反
B 说参与者来自各行各业（various walks of life），但录音明说 Participants worked in
the health profession.，即都是医疗卫生行业的人；B 与原文事实相反，是对参与者构成的
曲解。
借用原文：Participants worked in the health profession.
C) 未提及
C 说本研究证实了以往研究的结论，但录音通篇没提与任何 previous studies 的比较，反而
在结尾强调 it did not prove that drinks with added sugar cause early death——只是
关联、未下定论；C 属录音根本没说的内容。

questions.stem: What is the scientists' recommendation?

options.label: A
options.text: Eating more vegetables instead of meats.

options.label: B
options.text: Drinking water instead of beverages with added sugar.

options.label: C
options.text: Consuming more energy drinks and sports drinks.

options.label: D
options.text: Forming the habit of exercising regularly.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Drinking water instead of beverages with added sugar.
【定位】They argue we should replace them with other drinks, with water being the best choice.
他们主张我们应当用其他饮品来替代含糖饮料，其中水是最佳选择。
【信号】建议句 should + 最佳选择。答案句同时出现两个强信号：建议词 we should replace
them 和择优表达 water being the best choice；should 表建议、the best choice 直接
点名最优做法，是这句成为答案句的标志。
【替换】replace them with other drinks, with water being the best choice ↔
Drinking water instead of beverages with added sugar
用水替换＝喝水代替
them ↔ beverages with added sugar
代词 them 还原即含糖饮料
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
A 说多吃蔬菜代替肉，盗用了录音 not eating enough vegetables 与 consuming too
much meat 里出现过的 vegetables、meat；但录音里这两项是研究者考虑过的其他影响
健康的因素，不是科学家给出的建议，把干扰因素当成建议正是陷阱。
借用原文：lack of exercise and not eating enough vegetables
C) 与原文相反
C 让人多喝能量饮料和运动饮料，盗用录音 soda, energy drinks and sports drinks 里的
原词；但录音明确说这些正是含糖饮料、应当限制，C 把该少喝的说成多喝，与原文意思相
反。
借用原文：These beverages included soda, energy drinks and sports drinks.
D) 原词陷阱
D 说养成规律运动的习惯，盗用录音 lack of exercise 里的 exercise；但运动同样只是研究
者排查的其他健康因素之一，录音从未把规律运动作为科学家的建议提出，D 答非所问。
借用原文：These factors included lack of exercise
Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.
1 German police appealed Friday for information about the possible owners of two 17th-century
oil paintings.
德国警方周五呼吁民众提供有关两幅17世纪油画可能所有者的信息。
2 Police said a 64-year-old man found the paintings in a garbage pile at a highway rest stop last month.
He later handed them in to the Cologne police.
警方表示,一名64岁男子上个月在高速公路休息站的垃圾堆中发现了这些画作。他后来将它们交给了科隆
警方。
3 An initial assessment by an art expert concluded the two framed paintings were originals, police said.
警方称,一位艺术专家的初步评估认定这两幅带框画作是原作。
4 One is a landscape painted by the Italian artist Pietro Bellotti dating to 1665. The other is a painting
of a boy by the 17th-century Dutch artist Samuel van Hoogstraten, date unknown. Their combined worth
is estimated to be around one million euros.
其中一幅是意大利艺术家Pietro Bellotti于1665年创作的风景画。另一幅是17世纪荷兰艺术家Samuel
van Hoogstraten创作的男孩肖像画,创作日期不详。两幅画的总价值估计约为一百万欧元。
5 Authorities have not yet confirmed what will happen if the rightful owner is not found. Nevertheless,
it is speculated that they could either be handed over to the National Art Museum of Cologne or sold to
the public by the local government.
当局尚未确认如果找不到合法所有者将如何处理。不过,有人推测这些画作可能会被移交给科隆国家美术
馆,或由地方政府向公众出售。

questions.stem: What did German police say about a 64-year-old man?

options.label: A
options.text: He asked them about his lost paintings.

options.label: B
options.text: He knew the owner of two missing paintings.

options.label: C
options.text: He left his paintings at a highway rest stop.

options.label: D
options.text: He found two 17th-century oil paintings.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） He found two 17th-century oil paintings.
【定位】Police said a 64-year-old man found the paintings in a garbage pile at a highway rest stop
last month.
警方称，上个月一名 64 岁的男子在一处高速公路服务区的垃圾堆里发现了这些画。
【信号】对象出场即答案句。录音念到 a 64-year-old man 这个题干点名的对象时，紧跟其后的动
词 found the paintings 就是答案落点——细节题的答案句信号，就是题干那个专有对象一
出现。
【替换】found the paintings ↔ found two 17th-century oil paintings
the paintings 还原为完整名称
【排除】A) 与原文相反
选项把 his lost paintings 安在男子头上，可录音说的是他在垃圾堆里发现（found）画并
上交，画不是他丢的、更不是他来打听自己丢的画，方向正好反了。
B) 原词陷阱
选项盗用了录音 owners、rightful owner 里反复出现的 owner 一词，编出 "他认识两幅失
踪画的主人"，可录音只说警方在找失主，从没说这位男子认识失主，是听到 owner 就想选
的原词陷阱。
借用原文：if the rightful owner is not found
C) 原词陷阱
选项盗用录音 at a highway rest stop 这个真地点，却把动作篡改成 left（把画留在那
里），而录音说的是他在那里 found（发现）画，地点是真的、动作是假的，典型原词陷
阱。
借用原文：at a highway rest stop

questions.stem: What is the art expert's conclusion about the two framed paintings?

options.label: A
options.text: They are imitations.

options.label: B
options.text: They are originals.

options.label: C
options.text: They were stolen by an Italian boy.

options.label: D
options.text: They came from the same artist.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） They are originals.
【定位】An initial assessment by an art expert concluded the two framed paintings were originals,
police said.
警方称，一位艺术专家的初步鉴定认为这两幅装框画作是真迹。
【信号】结论动词 concluded 引出定性。录音里 An initial assessment by an art expert
concluded 用 concluded（得出结论）这个下结论的信号词，后面紧跟的 were originals
就是专家的定性，正是题干要的答案。
【替换】were originals ↔ They are originals.
几乎原句保留
【排除】A) 与原文相反
选项 imitations（赝品）与专家结论 were originals（真迹）意思正好相反，是把定性极性
反转的陷阱；A、B 一真一假对立，听准 originals 就该排除 A。
借用原文：were originals
C) 原词陷阱
选项盗用录音第 4 段 the Italian artist 的 Italian 和 a painting of a boy 的 boy，拼成 "被
一个意大利男孩偷走"，可录音根本没提偷画，画里有个男孩、画家是意大利人都被偷换成
了偷窃情节，原词陷阱。
借用原文：a painting of a boy by the 17th-century Dutch artist
D) 与原文相反
录音第 4 段明说一幅是意大利画家 Pietro Bellotti 所作、另一幅出自荷兰画家 Samuel van
Hoogstraten，是两位不同画家；选项却说出自 same artist，与原文事实直接矛盾。
借用原文：One is a landscape painted by the Italian artist Pietro Bellotti dating to 1665. The other
is a painting of a boy by the 17th-century Dutch artist Samuel van Hoogstraten

questions.stem: What did the four-year-old girl attempt to do?

options.label: A
options.text: Look after her grandfather.

options.label: B
options.text: Leave the remote cold region.

options.label: C
options.text: Save her sick grandmother.

options.label: D
options.text: Flee from the threat of bears.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Save her sick grandmother.
【定位】A four-year-old girl has walked eight kilometers through a snowy forest to seek help for her
sick grandmother who later died of a heart attack.
一个四岁女孩徒步八公里穿过白雪覆盖的森林，去为她生病的奶奶求助，奶奶后来死于心脏
病发作。
【信号】目的状语 to seek help for 直指意图。本句用不定式目的状语 to seek help for her sick
grandmother 点明女孩此行的目的——"问意图"的题，答案就藏在 to do 这个目的状语
里，这是定位的信号。
【替换】to seek help for her sick grandmother ↔ Save her sick grandmother.
为奶奶求助=救奶奶（概括同义）
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音第 2 段确实念到 her blind grandfather，A 项 Look after her grandfather. 就盗用这
个"爷爷"原词制造"听到就选"的诱惑；但女孩求助的对象是奶奶不是爷爷，对象张冠李戴。
借用原文：her blind grandfather
B) 原词陷阱
录音念到 through a remote region in Siberia，B 项 Leave the remote cold region. 盗
用 remote region 把女孩动机歪曲成"为自己离开寒冷地区"；实际她是为奶奶求助而穿越该
地区，不是想离开它。
借用原文：through a remote region in Siberia
D) 原词陷阱
录音念到 braved the threat of bears，D 项 Flee from the threat of bears. 把这个醒目画
面词搬进选项；但原文是说女孩"冒着"熊的威胁去求助，不是"为逃避熊"才出门，目的被偷
换。
借用原文：braved the threat of bears

questions.stem: What do we learn from the news report about the girl's mother?

options.label: A
options.text: She has to face a criminal charge.

options.label: B
options.text: She was found lying motionless in the snow.

options.label: C
options.text: She searched for her daughter in freezing cold.

options.label: D
options.text: She works in childcare services.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） She has to face a criminal charge.
【定位】As a result, the girl's mother is facing a criminal case. She stands accused of leaving a minor
in danger in the care of the elderly.
结果，女孩的母亲正面临一桩刑事案件。她被指控把一个未成年人置于危险之中，交由老人
照看。
【信号】专门讲 mother 的那句直接应答题干。录音里唯一正面交代母亲的句子是 the girl's
mother is facing a criminal case，紧接着用 stands accused of 补充指控内容——题干专
问母亲，答案就锁定在这"专讲母亲"的两句上。
【替换】is facing a criminal case ↔ She has to face a criminal charge.
面临刑事案件=要面临刑事指控（近义词替换）
【排除】B) 张冠李戴
录音第 1 段说"奶奶"被发现时 motionless，B 项 She was found lying motionless in the
snow. 把这个画面安到"母亲"头上；motionless 是原词，但躺着不动的是奶奶不是妈妈。
借用原文：waking up to find her grandmother motionless
C) 未提及
录音通篇讲严寒（negative 26 degrees Celsius 等），C 项 She searched for her
daughter in freezing cold. 借"严寒"主题编出"母亲冒寒找女儿"的情节；但原文从没说母亲
外出寻找，是女孩自己出门求助。
D) 原词陷阱
录音念到 investigation from childcare services，D 项 She works in childcare services.
盗用 childcare services 这个机构词；但原文是该机构要"调查"这件事，不是说母亲"在那儿
工作"。
借用原文：She also faces investigation from childcare services

questions.stem: What happened to the little girl according to the news report?

options.label: A
options.text: She was found in a forest after three days.

options.label: B
options.text: She lay totally unconscious for three days.

options.label: C
options.text: She suffered from the effects of severe cold.

options.label: D
options.text: She was finally rescued by her relatives.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） She suffered from the effects of severe cold.
【定位】But though she was suffering from the effects of extreme cold, the child reportedly suffered
no life-threatening effects.
但尽管她正遭受极度寒冷带来的影响，据报道这个孩子并未出现危及生命的状况。
【信号】末段交代结果，让步状语 though 引出真实状况。答案落在末段交代女孩结局的一句，信号
是让步连词 though：though 引出的 suffering from the effects of extreme cold 正是女
孩的真实遭遇，后半句"无生命危险"是补充，问遭遇就抓 though 这半句。
【替换】suffering from the effects of extreme cold ↔ She suffered from the effects of severe cold.
extreme cold=severe cold（近义形容词替换）
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
录音末句说"去年一个三岁男孩" survived alone for three days in a remote forest，A 项
She was found in a forest after three days. 盗用 forest 和 three days，把男孩的旧事安
到这个女孩头上。
借用原文：a three-year-old boy survived alone for three days
B) 过度推断
B 项 She lay totally unconscious for three days. 借男孩那句的 three days 拼出"女孩昏
迷三天"；原文既没说女孩昏迷，也没说她经历三天，no life-threatening effects 反而说明
她无大碍，程度被严重夸大。
借用原文：the child reportedly suffered no life-threatening effects
D) 与原文相反
录音里女孩是"独自外出为亲属求助"，D 项 She was finally rescued by her relatives. 把方
向反过来说成"被亲属救出"；relatives 算原文涉及的关系词，但谁救谁正相反。
借用原文：to seek help for her sick grandmother

questions.stem: What does the woman say about her new friend Susan?

options.label: A
options.text: She shows a real passion for taking photos.

options.label: B
options.text: She has just returned from her hometown.

options.label: C
options.text: She comes from the city of Cape Town.

options.label: D
options.text: She has a truly amazing appearance.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） She comes from the city of Cape Town.
【定位】Her name is Susan and she's from South Africa.
她叫 Susan，来自南非。
【信号】女士介绍朋友的开场陈述。对话一开口，女士就主动交代 she's from South Africa，这
是"被介绍人的出身"，正面回答了"关于 Susan"。随后第5段又点出家乡 It's called Cape
Town.，两处合起来坐实她来自开普敦这座城市。
【替换】she's from South Africa ↔ She comes from the city of Cape Town.
from = comes from，国家细化到城市
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音说的是 She has very cool photos on her social media.——朋友圈有好照片，并没说
她"热爱拍照"。选项把"有酷照片"偷换成"对拍照有热情"，是听到 photos 就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：She has very cool photos on her social media.
B) 原词陷阱
录音里 hometown 出现在 The photos of her hometown look amazing.，说的是"家乡
的照片好看"，根本没说她"刚从家乡回来"。选项借 hometown 这个原词编了个时间动作。
借用原文：The photos of her hometown look amazing.
D) 张冠李戴
录音里 amazing 形容的是 The photos of her hometown look amazing.——家乡的照片
惊艳，不是说"她本人长相惊艳"。选项把形容"照片"的词安到了"她的外貌"上。
借用原文：The photos of her hometown look amazing.

questions.stem: What does the woman say about Table Mountain?

options.label: A
options.text: It is as famous as Cape Town.

options.label: B
options.text: It has a flat surface at the top.

options.label: C
options.text: It is green and free from pollution.

options.label: D
options.text: It was named by European settlers.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） It has a flat surface at the top.
【定位】The mountain is called Table Mountain because it's flat at the top.
这座山叫桌山，因为它顶部是平的。
【信号】因果 because 后给出命名缘由即特征。The mountain is called Table Mountain
because it's flat at the top. 中 because 后那句才是关键——它解释了山名的由来，也正
面给出了这座山的物理特征"顶部平坦"。because 引出的正是答案落点。
【替换】it's flat at the top ↔ It has a flat surface at the top.
flat at the top = flat surface at the top
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音提到 It's called Cape Town. 是城市名，但从没说桌山"和开普敦一样有名"。选项借
Cape Town 这个原词，凭空造了个"知名度比较"。
借用原文：It's called Cape Town.
C) 偷换概念
录音说 it's very green and windy——这是形容开普敦这座城市"很绿、多风"，既不是说桌
山，也没说"无污染"。选项把 green 扩大成 free from pollution，程度被悄悄拔高。
借用原文：it's very green and windy
D) 张冠李戴
录音里 European settlers 出现在 The city was built by European settlers.——欧洲移
民"建了这座城"，命名桌山的依据是"顶平"而非欧洲移民。选项把"建城"换成"给山命名"。
借用原文：The city was built by European settlers.

questions.stem: What do we learn from the conversation about the woman's friend Susan?

options.label: A
options.text: She has British ancestors.

options.label: B
options.text: She is of mixed blood.

options.label: C
options.text: She grew up in India.

options.label: D
options.text: She speaks several languages.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） She has British ancestors.
【定位】Susan is white. She says her ancestors were from Britain.
Susan 是白人。她说她的祖先来自英国。
【信号】明确指向 Susan 本人的直接陈述。第7段先讲南非"很混杂"，但话锋一转点名 Susan is
white. She says her ancestors were from Britain.——主语明确是 Susan 本人，正面交代
了她的血统来源，是答案句。前面那句"很混杂"是说整个国家，不是说她。
【替换】her ancestors were from Britain ↔ She has British ancestors.
ancestors from Britain = British ancestors
【排除】B) 张冠李戴
录音 South Africa is very mixed 说的是"南非（这个国家/人口）很混杂"，紧接着却明说
Susan is white.——她是白人，不是混血。选项把形容国家的 mixed 安到了她头上。
借用原文：South Africa is very mixed
C) 原词陷阱
录音只说南非有 Indian people（印度裔居民），从没说 Susan"在印度长大"。选项借
Indian 这个原词编了段她个人的成长史。
借用原文：Indian people
D) 与原文相反
录音说 Many languages are spoken in South Africa, but she only speaks English.——
南非语言多，但她只会英语。选项说她"会好几门语言"，正好把 but 之后"只说英语"的真意
说反了。
借用原文：Many languages are spoken in South Africa, but she only speaks English.

questions.stem: What does the woman say about rugby in South Africa?

options.label: A
options.text: It is an extremely violent sport.

options.label: B
options.text: It is becoming a national sport.

options.label: C
options.text: It is originated in New Zealand.

options.label: D
options.text: It is more popular than football.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） It is more popular than football.
【定位】I think they play football, but it's not as popular as rugby.
我想他们踢足球，但足球不如橄榄球受欢迎。
【信号】转折 but 后给出真正的流行度比较。I think they play football, but it's not as popular as
rugby. 中 but 之后才是落点——"足球不如橄榄球受欢迎"，等于说橄榄球比足球更火。but
后那句承载了答案，前半"他们踢足球"是铺垫。
【替换】it's not as popular as rugby ↔ It is more popular than football.
football not as popular as rugby = rugby more popular than football
【排除】A) 过度推断
录音说 the players push each other 且 I think it's very complicated.——只说球员互相
推挤、规则复杂，从没说它"极度暴力"。选项借"推挤/复杂"的印象夸大成 extremely
violent。
借用原文：the players push each other
B) 未提及
录音只说它在南非比足球受欢迎、在英国及前殖民地也流行，从没说它"正在成为国球"。
national sport 在原文里根本没出现，是无中生有。
C) 原词陷阱
录音 it's also popular in Britain and in other former British colonies like Australia and
New Zealand 说新西兰是"它也流行"的地方之一，并非"起源地"。选项把"流行地"偷换
成"起源于新西兰"。
借用原文：it's also popular in Britain and in other former British colonies like Australia and
New Zealand

questions.stem: What does the woman advise the man to do?

options.label: A
options.text: Prepare a study guide.

options.label: B
options.text: Consult his advisors.

options.label: C
options.text: Go over his notes regularly.

options.label: D
options.text: Take stress-relief sessions.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Prepare a study guide.
【定位】Have you considered making a study guide? It's a tool you can make yourself to take the
stress out of studying.
你考虑过做一份学习指南吗？这是一个你可以自己制作的工具，能帮你把学习的压力卸
下来。
【信号】建议信号 Have you considered 引出的提议。女方用 Have you considered making a
study guide? 这个建议句式回应男方的求助，「考虑过……吗」就是典型的提建议信号，信
号后跟的 making a study guide 即为她建议的动作。
【替换】Have you considered making a study guide? ↔ Prepare a study guide.
making 改写成 Prepare，同义动词替换
【排除】B) 未提及
选项 Consult his advisors. 说的「咨询顾问」在整段对话里从未出现，女方建议的是自己做
学习指南，不是去找顾问。
C) 原词陷阱
选项 Go over his notes regularly. 借了对话里反复出现的 notes 来诱你，但女方此处的建
议是做 study guide，并未叫他「定期复习笔记」；regularly（定期）更是录音里没有的。
借用原文：my study folder is full of notes and worksheets
D) 原词陷阱
选项 Take stress-relief sessions. 抓住录音里 take the stress out of studying 的 stress 做
文章，但录音说的是「学习指南能卸掉压力」，不是叫他去「上减压课程」；stress-relief
sessions 是凭 stress 一词编出来的。
借用原文：take the stress out of studying

questions.stem: What is the biggest problem the man has with his studies?

options.label: A
options.text: His worksheets are terribly messy.

options.label: B
options.text: He finds the workload too heavy.

options.label: C
options.text: His study folder is badly disorganized.

options.label: D
options.text: He has difficulty taking notes quickly.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） His study folder is badly disorganized.
【定位】My main problem is that my study folder is full of notes and worksheets, and is
badly disorganized.
我主要的问题是，我的学习文件夹里塞满了笔记和练习题，而且乱得一塌糊涂。
【信号】强调信号 My main problem is 直接点题。男方用 My main problem is 这个强调句式
亲口点出最大困扰，main problem 就是直接指向答案的信号，其后描述的状况即为答案
内容。
【替换】my study folder is full of notes and worksheets, and is badly disorganized ↔
His study folder is badly disorganized.
study folder 与 badly disorganized 原句几乎直取
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
选项 His worksheets are terribly messy. 借了录音的 worksheets，但录音说乱的是整个
study folder，worksheets 只是文件夹里装着的东西之一；把「乱」单独安到 worksheets
头上是偷换对象。
借用原文：my study folder is full of notes and worksheets
B) 原词陷阱
选项 He finds the workload too heavy. 抓住男方开场 struggling with this semester's
workload 的 workload，但那只是他来求助的引子，他亲口说的 main problem 是文件夹
乱，不是工作量大。
借用原文：I'm really struggling with this semester's workload
D) 原词陷阱
选项 He has difficulty taking notes quickly. 借录音里的 notes 做文章，但录音只说文件
夹里塞满 notes 且很乱，从没提男方「记笔记速度慢」这个困难，taking notes quickly 是
凭 notes 一词编造的。
借用原文：my study folder is full of notes and worksheets

questions.stem: What kind of learner does the woman say she is?

options.label: A
options.text: A visual learner.

options.label: B
options.text: An emotional learner.

options.label: C
options.text: An organized learner.

options.label: D
options.text: A logical learner.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） An emotional learner.
【定位】I'm an emotional learner, which means I need to connect to information emotionally to
understand it.
我是一个情感型学习者，意思是我需要在情感上与信息建立联结才能理解它。
【信号】第一人称自指 I'm an emotional learner。女方在介绍完 visual、logical 两类后，用 I'm
an emotional learner 这个第一人称自指句点明自己的类别，I'm 就是「这是说我自己」的
信号，与前面介绍他人类别区分开。
【替换】I'm an emotional learner ↔ An emotional learner.
emotional learner 原词对应
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
选项 A visual learner. 借了录音里 visual learners 这一类，但视觉型对应的是男方（他说
I'm very much dependent on vision），女方自称的是情感型；把男方的类别安给女方即
张冠李戴。
借用原文：visual learners prefer using images, pictures, colors, and maps
C) 原词陷阱
选项 An organized learner. 蹭了全篇「整理笔记 organize」的氛围，但录音介绍的三类是
visual、logical、emotional，从没有 organized learner 这一类，更不是女方的自称。
借用原文：reorganizing your notes using color-coded sections
D) 张冠李戴
选项 A logical learner. 取了录音 Logical learners have a linear mind 这一类，但那是女
方泛指介绍的一类人，她自称的是 emotional，不是 logical；安到女方头上属张冠李戴。
借用原文：Logical learners have a linear mind and would rather use logic, reasoning and systems

questions.stem: What does the woman think the man can do with his notes?

options.label: A
options.text: Arrange them using color and pictures.

options.label: B
options.text: Restructure them in a logical way.

options.label: C
options.text: Commit them to memory after class.

options.label: D
options.text: Organize them into a well-connected story.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Arrange them using color and pictures.
【定位】Well, I suggest reorganizing your notes using color-coded sections in your study guides, or
using idea mapping to lay out the information.
嗯，我建议你用彩色分区的方式重新整理笔记放进学习指南里，或者用思维导图把信息铺陈
出来。
【信号】建议信号 I suggest 引出给男方的方法。女方用 I suggest reorganizing your notes
using color-coded sections 直接给男方建议，I suggest 是明确的建议信号，your notes
表明是针对男方的笔记，信号后跟的「彩色分区、思维导图」即建议内容。
【替换】using color-coded sections in your study guides, or using idea mapping ↔
Arrange them using color and pictures.
color-coded、idea mapping 概括成 color and pictures
arrange my notes using color and pictures in place of text ↔
Arrange them using color and pictures.
男方复述确认，几乎原句对应 A
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
选项 Restructure them in a logical way. 借了录音介绍 logical learners 时的 logic 一词，
但女方给男方（视觉型）的建议是用颜色和图，不是「按逻辑重构」；logical 属另一类学
习者的特征。
借用原文：Logical learners have a linear mind and would rather use logic, reasoning and systems
C) 原词陷阱
选项 Commit them to memory after class. 蹭了录音 more quickly accessible 的「快」
感，但录音说的是用颜色图让信息更快被取用，从没建议「课后把笔记背下来」；
memory、after class 都是录音没有的。
借用原文：make it more quickly accessible
D) 张冠李戴
选项 Organize them into a well-connected story. 取了录音 I organize my notes into a
story，但那是女方作为情感型学习者「自己」的做法，不是建议给视觉型的男方的；把女
方的做法安成给男方的建议即张冠李戴。
借用原文：As an emotional learner, I organize my notes into a story that I can connect to and recite
to myself

questions.stem: What do we learn from the passage about the golden rule?

options.label: A
options.text: It is mainly based on a society's religion.

options.label: B
options.text: It is interpreted differently in different times.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a code of conduct based on laws and ethics.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a moral principle to guide people's behavior.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） It is a moral principle to guide people's behavior.
【定位】The golden rule is a moral principle which states that you should treat others the way you
want to be treated yourself.
黄金法则是一条道德准则，它主张你应当以你希望被别人对待的方式去对待别人。
【信号】开篇“X is...”下定义句即落点。录音第一句就用 The golden rule is a moral principle
which states that you should treat others the way you want to be treated yourself.
直接给 golden rule 下定义，这种篇首“主题词 + is + 定义”的句子就是定义题的答案句信
号，开篇即点题。
【替换】a moral principle which states that you should treat others the way you want to be treated ↔
a moral principle to guide people's behavior
“主张你该怎样待人”=“指导人的行为”
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音确实提到 the religion in their society，但只是说不同人接触到的“形式”受宗教等因素
影响，从没说它“mainly based on religion”。A 项盗了 religion 这个原词，把“影响形式的
因素之一”偷换成“主要建立在宗教上”，是听到原词就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：based on factors such as the religion in their society
B) 偷换概念
录音说 Different people tend to be exposed to different forms——是“不同人接触不同
形式”，B 项 17B 式地改成“interpreted differently in different times”（不同时代有不同
解读），把“不同人/不同形式”偷换为“不同时代”，且录音第 3 段强调 all forms... revolve
around the same concept（内核其实相同），与 B 相悖。
借用原文：Different people tend to be exposed to different forms of the golden rule
C) 原词陷阱
a code of conduct based on laws and ethics 里的 laws and ethics 录音里确实反复出现
（如 laws and ethical principles），但那是讲它与法律伦理的“冲突”关系，并非说 golden
rule 本身“基于法律伦理”。录音定义它是 a moral principle（道德准则），C 把它的本质错
挂到法律伦理上，是张冠李戴式的原词陷阱。
借用原文：when it conflicts with laws and ethical principles

questions.stem: What is a notable criticism of the golden rule?

options.label: A
options.text: It may lead to misunderstanding despite good intentions.

options.label: B
options.text: It assumes that human beings are all good-natured.

options.label: C
options.text: It may sometimes produce undesirable outcomes.

options.label: D
options.text: It fails to consider the complexity of human relationships.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） It may sometimes produce undesirable outcomes.
【定位】A notable criticism of the golden rule is that its application can lead to undesirable outcomes,
when it conflicts with laws and ethical principles.
对黄金法则一条显著的批评是：当它与法律和伦理原则相冲突时，其应用可能导致不良
后果。
【信号】信号词 criticism 直接领出答案句。录音第 4 段以 A notable criticism of the golden rule
is that... 开头，criticism 这个批评信号词一出，紧跟的 that 从句就是批评的具体内容——
这正是答案句，靠信号词定位而非逐句扫读。
【替换】its application can lead to undesirable outcomes ↔
It may sometimes produce undesirable outcomes.
lead to=produce，原词 undesirable outcomes 几乎照搬
【排除】A) 未提及
It may lead to misunderstanding despite good intentions. 里的 misunderstanding
（误解）和 good intentions（好意）录音通篇没提，批评句讲的是“与法律伦理冲突导致不
良后果”，与误解无关，属凭常识想象的未提及项。
B) 过度推断
It assumes that human beings are all good-natured. 是录音从未表达的论断——录音只
说不同形式都 help you treat others better，并没说“它假设人人本性善良”。B 借
“better/good”的善意语感引申出“假设人皆善良”，属过度推断。
借用原文：they help you treat others better
D) 未提及
It fails to consider the complexity of human relationships. 听着像个高级批评，但录音
对它的批评只指向“与法律伦理冲突”，从未说它“没考虑人际关系的复杂性”。这是一个原文
未提及、却被包装得很像批评的干扰项。

questions.stem: What does the example of someone breaking the law serve to show?

options.label: A
options.text: The golden rule is often in conflict with certain laws and ethical principles.

options.label: B
options.text: The golden rule must sometimes give way to more important principles.

options.label: C
options.text: Failure to follow the golden rule may lead to violation of laws and ethics.

options.label: D
options.text: Observing the golden rule is the first step to becoming a responsible citizen.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） The golden rule must sometimes give way to more important principles.
【定位】Specifically, in the example described above, most individuals and societies choose to place
laws and ethical principles above the golden rule. This means that they strive to implement
the golden rule whenever possible, as long as it doesn't clash with a more important concept.
具体来说，在上面描述的例子里，大多数个人与社会选择把法律和伦理原则置于黄金法则之
上。这意味着，只要不与更重要的理念相冲突，他们就尽力践行黄金法则。
【信号】例后“This means”总结句即论点落点。违法的例子在第 5 段，但作者在第 7 段用 most
individuals and societies choose to place laws and ethical principles above the
golden rule 与 This means that... 把例子升华成论断——“This means”这种总结信号之后
才是例子真正要说明的观点。
【替换】place laws and ethical principles above the golden rule ↔
The golden rule must sometimes give way to more important principles.
“把法律置于其上”=“黄金法则让位于更重要原则”
as long as it doesn't clash with a more important concept ↔ sometimes give way to
“一旦与更重要理念冲突”=“有时须让位”
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
The golden rule is often in conflict with certain laws and ethical principles. 借了录音
里的 conflict（conflicts with、clash）。但录音说的是“冲突时如何处理（让位）”，不是强
调“它经常与法律冲突”；A 把例子的用意偷换成“频繁冲突”，且 often 程度过强，是原词陷
阱。
借用原文：when it conflicts with laws and ethical principles
C) 与原文相反
Failure to follow the golden rule may lead to violation of laws and ethics. 用了
laws、violation 等近义词，但录音的逻辑是“遵守黄金法则反而可能让违法者逍遥（we
should let them go）”，即遵守它才可能冲突法律，而非“不遵守它就违法”。C 把因果方向
整个弄反了。
借用原文：the golden rule would suggest that we should let them go
D) 过度推断
Observing the golden rule is the first step to becoming a responsible citizen. 听着正
能量，但录音从没说遵守它是“成为合格公民的第一步”，反而强调它要让位于更重要原则。
D 借“principle、society”的语境拔高出一个原文没有的结论，属过度推断。

questions.stem: What do we learn from the current statistics about diversity in large corporations?

options.label: A
options.text: Many of them find it rather difficult to manage.

options.label: B
options.text: They have not seen as much diversity as desired.

options.label: C
options.text: Many of them have an increasingly diversified staff.

options.label: D
options.text: They have not quite grasped the concept of diversity.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） They have not seen as much diversity as desired.
【定位】Obviously, the desire to bring about diversity has not translated into corporate reality.
显然，想要实现多元化的愿望并没有变成公司里的现实。
【信号】否定句 has not 是落点。这句的答案信号是含蓄否定 has not translated into corporate
reality，前面 many large corporations stress the importance of diversity 是铺垫的美
好愿望，转到 has not 才是真意——愿望没落地，这正是细节题要抓的结论句。
【替换】the desire to bring about diversity has not translated into corporate reality ↔
have not seen as much diversity as desired
愿望未落地=未达期望
【排除】A) 答非所问
选项 Many of them find it rather difficult to manage. 听上去像盗用了后文 it might be
difficult to work with someone who has completely different views 的 difficult，但那
是讲人们对多元化的顾虑，不是 current statistics 这道题问的统计现状，属答非所问。
借用原文：it might be difficult to work with someone who has completely different views
C) 与原文相反
选项 Many of them have an increasingly diversified staff. 盗用了 diversified 这个原
词，方向却反了：录音明说 the typical manager in America still tends to be white and
male，统计显示多元化并未实现，C 却说员工日益多元，与原文相反。
借用原文：the typical manager in America still tends to be white and male
D) 未提及
选项 They have not quite grasped the concept of diversity. 说公司没理解多元化的概
念，但录音只说愿望没落实为现实，从没说公司不懂这个概念，属未提及、无中生有。

questions.stem: What is the newly published study focused on?

options.label: A
options.text: Initiatives to achieve diversity in large corporations.

options.label: B
options.text: Advantages and disadvantages of a diversified team.

options.label: C
options.text: People's attitudes towards diversity at the workplace.

options.label: D
options.text: Innovative ideas and solutions resulting from diversity.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （主旨题） People's attitudes towards diversity at the workplace.
【定位】A team of researchers from the University of Basel published their new study about people's
attitudes towards diversity at work.
巴塞尔大学的一组研究者发表了他们关于人们对职场多元化态度的新研究。
【信号】study about 直接点题。答案信号是介绍研究时的点题结构 published their new study
about people's attitudes towards diversity at work，about 后面紧跟的就是研究主题，
这是主旨题最该锁定的总括句。
【替换】people's attitudes towards diversity at work ↔
People's attitudes towards diversity at the workplace.
at work=at the workplace
【排除】A) 答非所问
选项 Initiatives to achieve diversity in large corporations. 蹭了 diversity in large
corporations 这串原词，但 achieve diversity 的举措是第三、四段给组织的建议，不是这
项研究本身聚焦的主题，把分论点冒充主旨，以偏概全。
借用原文：These findings could help organizations become more diverse.
B) 偷换概念
选项 Advantages and disadvantages of a diversified team. 对应录音第二段 On the
one hand / On the other hand 讲的多元化利弊，但那是人们态度的具体内容（人们一方
面看到价值、一方面担心），属于主题之下的一个层面，拿来当全篇主旨则范围偏小，以偏
概全。
借用原文：On the one hand, many see value in diversity ... On the other hand, they assume that it
might be difficult
D) 原词陷阱
选项 Innovative ideas and solutions resulting from diversity. 盗用了 generate
innovative solutions 的原词，但那只是多元化的众多好处之一，是态度里看到价值的细
节，远不是研究聚焦的总主题，属以偏概全。
借用原文：encourage new ideas, and generate innovative solutions

questions.stem: What do the findings of the new study show?

options.label: A
options.text: People prefer to work with team members similar to themselves.

options.label: B
options.text: Employers attach great importance to their corporations' diversity.

options.label: C
options.text: Employers differ from employees in their perspectives on diversity.

options.label: D
options.text: Doubts about the practicability of diversity are gradually disappearing.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） People prefer to work with team members similar to themselves.
【定位】In other words, when a person's own work group is involved, they tend to prefer team
members who are similar to themselves.
换句话说，当涉及一个人自己的工作团队时，他们往往倾向于选择和自己相似的团队成员。
【信号】In other words 后是结论。答案信号是总结性标志 In other words，它后面紧跟的就是对
前文的提炼结论 they tend to prefer team members who are similar to themselves，细
节题正应锁定这句被点明的发现。
【替换】they tend to prefer team members who are similar to themselves ↔
People prefer to work with team members similar to themselves.
tend to prefer=prefer to work with
【排除】B) 张冠李戴
选项 Employers attach great importance to their corporations' diversity. 蹭了 many
large corporations stress the importance of diversity 的 importance、diversity，但那
是开头讲公司在网站上的表态，不是这项研究的 findings，张冠李戴地把背景当成了发现。
借用原文：many large corporations stress the importance of diversity on their websites
C) 偷换概念
选项 Employers differ from employees in their perspectives on diversity. 偷换了主
体：录音区分的是 when a person's own work group is involved 与 when people make
decisions for others（自己是否被直接波及），而非 employers 和 employees 两种身
份，属偷换概念。
借用原文：when a person's own work group is involved ... But when people make decisions
for others
D) 与原文相反
选项 Doubts about the practicability of diversity are gradually disappearing. 盗用了
Doubts about the practicability of diversity 整串原词，方向却反了：录音说当人被直接
波及时这种疑虑 have a greater weight（分量更重），并非在逐渐消失，与原文相反。
借用原文：Doubts about the practicability of diversity have a greater weight if a person is
directly affected

questions.stem: What is a major key to success in international business according to the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: Choosing the best time for signing a business contract.

options.label: B
options.text: Changing one's form of communication from time to time.

options.label: C
options.text: Laying equal stress on written and spoken communication.

options.label: D
options.text: Using different forms of communication appropriately.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Using different forms of communication appropriately.
【定位】Understanding when it's appropriate to exchange one form for another can be a major key to
success in international business.
懂得在什么时候适合把一种沟通形式换成另一种，可以是国际商务成功的一个重要关键。
【信号】题干原词 major key to success 在录音里原句重现。这句里 a major key to success in
international business 与题干几乎逐字相同，是直接点题的下结论句，听到 key to
success 就该锁定它，再回头听它前半 Understanding when it's appropriate to
exchange one form for another 才是答案的实质。
【替换】when it's appropriate to exchange one form for another ↔
Using different forms of communication appropriately
换一种形式=用不同形式，appropriate=appropriately
【排除】A) 答非所问
Choosing the best time for signing a business contract. 借了录音的商务背景和
appropriate（合适）的影子，把它偷换成挑签合同的最佳时机，但录音说的是恰当地切换
沟通形式，根本没讲签合同的时间点，属答非所问。
B) 偷换概念
Changing one's form of communication from time to time. 借用了换形式这个动作，却
把录音强调的 when it's appropriate（看场合）偷换成 from time to time（时不时地）的
随意更换，录音讲的是合适与否而非更换频率，属偷换概念。
C) 与原文相反
Laying equal stress on written and spoken communication. 借了书面与口头这对原文
概念，却说要对两者等量看重，而录音通篇强调的是看场合选用合适的那种，不是一视同
仁，方向正好相反。
借用原文：Understanding when it's appropriate to exchange one form for another

questions.stem: What does the passage say about spoken word agreements in some Middle East countries?

options.label: A
options.text: They are regarded as seriously binding.

options.label: B
options.text: They are seldom honored by business partners.

options.label: C
options.text: They are taken as memos of understanding.

options.label: D
options.text: They are to be confirmed in written form.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） They are regarded as seriously binding.
【定位】In parts of the Middle East, you'll find spoken word agreements are seen as seriously binding.
在中东部分地区，你会发现口头约定被看作具有严肃约束力。
【信号】地名 Middle East 后紧跟对口头约定的定性。录音 In parts of the Middle East 一出现就
锁定答案区，紧跟的 spoken word agreements are seen as seriously binding 正是对题
干对象的直接定性，是顺着地名定位到的答案句。
【替换】spoken word agreements are seen as seriously binding ↔ They are regarded as seriously binding
seen as=regarded as，几乎原义对应
【排除】B) 与原文相反
They are seldom honored by business partners. 与录音相反，录音说中东口头约定 are
seen as seriously binding 且 A person's word is linked to their honor（一个人的话与
荣誉相连，被高度看重），seldom honored（很少被信守）恰好反了过来。
借用原文：A person's word is linked to their honor
C) 张冠李戴
They are taken as memos of understanding. 盗用了录音原句 written contracts are
taken as memos of understanding，但录音里被当作谅解备忘录的是书面合同（written
contracts），不是题干问的口头约定，属张冠李戴——听到原词 memos of
understanding 就选会中招。
借用原文：written contracts are taken as memos of understanding
D) 未提及
They are to be confirmed in written form. 借用了 written（书面）这个原文话题词，但
录音对中东口头约定只说其约束力强，从未说它要以书面形式确认，属无中生有。

questions.stem: What do we learn about the Western working culture?

options.label: A
options.text: It has reached the highest level of evolution.

options.label: B
options.text: It places a high value on written contracts.

options.label: C
options.text: It regards written contracts as unalterable.

options.label: D
options.text: It has seen a decline in verbal agreements.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） It places a high value on written contracts.
【定位】Western working culture tends to place a high value on the written word, and this reaches its
highest level of intensity when it comes to contracts.
西方工作文化往往很看重书面文字，而这种看重在涉及合同时达到最强的程度。
【信号】对象名 Western working culture 后紧跟其定性主干。录音 Western working culture
tends to place a high value on the written word 一出现题干对象就锁定，紧跟的主
干 place a high value on the written word 即对该文化的定性，是顺对象名定位到的答
案句。
【替换】place a high value on the written word ↔ It places a high value on written contracts
the written word 与 written contracts 同指书面，且原句下文点明 contracts
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
It has reached the highest level of evolution. 盗用了录音 reaches its highest level of
intensity 里的 highest level，却把 intensity（程度）换成 evolution（进化），还擅自拔
高成进化最高级，录音从未说西方文化进化到顶，属过度推断+偷换原词。
借用原文：this reaches its highest level of intensity
C) 过度推断
It regards written contracts as unalterable. 把录音 something that must be strictly
carried out（必须严格执行）推到 unalterable（绝对不可更改），严格执行讲的是履行，
不可更改讲的是能否修改，录音没说合同不能改，属过度推断。
借用原文：written contracts tend to be seen as something that must be strictly carried out
D) 未提及
It has seen a decline in verbal agreements. 借了 verbal/口头这个话题词，但录音讲西方
文化只说它看重书面合同，从未提到口头协议出现下降，属无中生有。

questions.stem: How does a Japanese firm tend to view a written contract?

options.label: A
options.text: Its details cannot be renegotiated.

options.label: B
options.text: It has to be carried out to the letter.

options.label: C
options.text: It strengthens business partnerships.

options.label: D
options.text: Its terms may not be strictly binding.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （态度观点题） Its terms may not be strictly binding.
【定位】For example, a Japanese firm may have signed a contract, but they may not feel bound by
every detail of it—particularly if circumstances later change.
举例来说，一家日本公司可能已经签了合同，但他们未必觉得受合同每一条细节的约束——
尤其是当后来情况发生变化时。
【信号】转折 but 之后才是真意，且 may not 软化约束。录音 may have signed a contract, but
they may not feel bound by every detail 里转折词 but 后面才是落点，may not feel
bound（未必感到受约束）是日本公司对合同的真实态度，转折+may not 两个信号合起来
指向弱约束。
【替换】they may not feel bound by every detail of it ↔ Its terms may not be strictly binding
not feel bound 主动表述=not be binding 被动表述，detail≈terms
【排除】A) 与原文相反
Its details cannot be renegotiated. 借了上文 renegotiate terms 的原词，但录音正说情
况变化时这类公司可能想重新协商条款，并非不能重谈，cannot be renegotiated 与原意
相反。
借用原文：if your business partner wants to renegotiate terms that you thought were already
agreed on
B) 张冠李戴
It has to be carried out to the letter. 盗用了第6段说西方文化的 something that must
be strictly carried out，但严格照字面执行讲的是西方文化（美法德），不是题干问的日本
公司，张冠李戴——听到 carried out 就选会中招。
借用原文：written contracts tend to be seen as something that must be strictly carried out
C) 与原文相反
It strengthens business partnerships. 与录音相反，录音说这种价值观差异 tend to
cause many problems when it comes to business relationships（往往给商业关系带来
很多问题），而非巩固伙伴关系，属与原文相反兼无中生有。
借用原文：tend to cause many problems when it comes to business relationships

questions.stem: What was the woman's problem?

options.label: A
options.text: She was pierced by a chicken bone.

options.label: B
options.text: She was coughing all the time.

options.label: C
options.text: She suffered from lung cancer.

options.label: D
options.text: She suffered from shock.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） She was coughing all the time.
【定位】The unnamed woman, from the province of Shandong, started to have coughing problems
when she was 7 or 8 years old. For 14 years, she made numerous hospital visits. However, no
doctor could identify any problem. Her uncontrollable coughing was a mystery.
这名未透露姓名的女子来自山东省，从七八岁起就开始有咳嗽的毛病。十四年间，她无数次
跑医院。然而，没有一个医生能查出任何问题。她那无法控制的咳嗽成了一个谜。
【信号】反复强调的核心症状即答案句。判定她问题是什么，要抓原文反复落在同一件事上的那句。
第 2 段 started to have coughing problems、Her uncontrollable coughing was a
mystery 两处都把焦点钉在咳嗽上，第 1 段也以 a persistent cough（持续的咳嗽）开篇
——多处强调、贯穿始终的那个症状，就是她的核心问题，这就是答案信号。
【替换】coughing problems ↔ coughing all the time
同义改写：咳嗽的毛病等于一直在咳
For 14 years ↔ all the time
概括替换：长达 14 年等于一直总是
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 She was pierced by a chicken bone. 借用了原文确实念到的 a piece of chicken
bone，听到 chicken bone 很容易手一抖就选。但原文说的是鸡骨头卡在肺里，是导致咳
嗽的原因，而且并非 pierced（刺穿）；题问的是她表现出的问题——咳嗽，不是病因，故
A 答非所问。
借用原文：a piece of chicken bone lodged in her lung
C) 原词陷阱
选项 She suffered from lung cancer. 蹭了原文反复出现的 lung（肺），把肺里有东西夸
大成肺癌。原文通篇只说咳嗽和鸡骨头，根本没出现 cancer 一词，这是把听到的 lung 顺
手脑补成重病的陷阱。
借用原文：lodged in her lung
D) 原词陷阱
选项 She suffered from shock. 借了原文 was shocked to learn（得知时大为震惊）里的
shock。但原文的 shocked 指她得知真相时很吃惊这一情绪反应，不是她患的疾病；题问她
的问题（毛病），故 D 张冠李戴、答非所问。
借用原文：was shocked to learn

questions.stem: How was the woman's problem eventually solved?

options.label: A
options.text: By eating chicken soup daily.

options.label: B
options.text: Through regular exercising.

options.label: C
options.text: Through a surgical operation.

options.label: D
options.text: By using traditional Chinese medicine.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Through a surgical operation.
【定位】Doctors performed surgery and removed the bone.
医生做了手术，把那根骨头取了出来。
【信号】结尾处交代最终处置的动作句。问最终怎么解决，答案信号是叙事收束段里那句表最后
做了什么的动作句。第 3 段先靠扫描查出病因，紧接 Doctors performed surgery and
removed the bone 给出明确处置动作——做手术取骨，这就是解决问题的那一刻，是答
案句。
【替换】Doctors performed surgery ↔ Through a surgical operation
同根改写：做手术等于通过外科手术
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 By eating chicken soup daily. 蹭了原文反复出现的 chicken（来自 a piece of
chicken bone），把鸡骨头致病偷换成天天喝鸡汤治病。原文根本没提任何喝汤、食疗，这
是靠 chicken 撞词制造的听到鸡就选陷阱。
借用原文：a piece of chicken bone
B) 未提及
选项 Through regular exercising. 说靠规律锻炼解决，但原文从开头到结尾只字未提运动
锻炼。它利用的是考生生病要多锻炼的生活常识，诱你用常识替代原文，属于原文未提及。
D) 原词陷阱
选项 By using traditional Chinese medicine. 里的 Chinese 和原文 A 22-year-old
Chinese woman 的 Chinese 撞词，让人以为中国人就用中医。但原文交代的解决手段明明
是 performed surgery（手术），全篇没提任何中医草药，这是借 Chinese 撞词加常识联
想的双重陷阱。
借用原文：A 22-year-old Chinese woman
Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.
1 A white sheep named Prickles that ran away from an Australian farm during the 2013 bushfires,
recently returned home.
一只名叫Prickles的白羊在2013年丛林大火期间从澳大利亚一个农场逃跑,最近回家了。
2 According to farmer Alice Gray, Prickles was only a lamb when she ran away. The bushfires that hit
the area back then destroyed a large part of her family's massive property. They thought Prickles had
died in the fire. But instead, the young sheep escaped into a 200-acre forest near the farm. Once the
fires were over, the family had to fix the damage done to the farm, as it was such a large property. This
included rebuilding about 50 kilometers of fencing. It was this huge fencing that prevented Prickles from
finding her way back. Over the years, the family spotted her a few times. They even recorded her with
cameras installed to monitor deer activity. But while they knew Prickles was alive, they couldn't find her
and never expected her to return by herself. Seven years later, they were proven wrong.
据农场主Alice Gray说,Prickles逃跑时还只是一只羊羔。当时袭击该地区的丛林大火摧毁了她家大片地产
的很大一部分。他们以为Prickles在火灾中丧生了。但实际上,这只小羊逃进了农场附近一片200英亩的森
林。火灾结束后,由于地产面积很大,这家人不得不修复农场遭受的损坏。这包括重建约50公里的围栏。正
是这道巨大的围栏阻止了Prickles找到回家的路。多年来,这家人看到过她几次。他们甚至用安装来监测鹿
类活动的相机拍到过她。但尽管他们知道Prickles还活着,却找不到她,也从未料到她会自己回来。七年后,
事实证明他们错了。

questions.stem: What does the news report say about the white sheep Prickles?

options.label: A
options.text: It was born 13 years ago.

options.label: B
options.text: It was Alice Gray's lovely pet.

options.label: C
options.text: It got injured in a big bushfire.

options.label: D
options.text: It ran away into a nearby forest.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） It ran away into a nearby forest.
【定位】A white sheep named Prickles that ran away from an Australian farm during the 2013
bushfires, recently returned home.
一只名叫 Prickles 的白羊，在 2013 年的山火期间从一座澳大利亚农场逃走，最近回了家。
【信号】新闻首句即核心事实。新闻短消息的第一句通常就把最关键的事实交代清楚。这里开篇 A
white sheep named Prickles that ran away from an Australian farm during the 2013
bushfires 直接点明这只羊 "在山火期间逃走"，这就是承载第 3 题答案的信号句——顺听到
第一句就该锁定。
【替换】ran away from an Australian farm ↔ ran away into a nearby forest
同一逃走动作的去向补全
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项说羊 It was born 13 years ago.，但录音只提到 "2013 bushfires" 这个火灾年份，从
没说羊出生于 13 年前——它把年份信息张冠李戴到 "出生" 上，专骗听到年数就对号入座
的人。
借用原文：during the 2013 bushfires
B) 原词陷阱
选项称羊是 It was Alice Gray's lovely pet.，录音里 According to farmer Alice Gray 确
实出现了 Alice Gray，但她是农场主、是消息来源，录音从没说这羊是她的 "宠物"——这
是借真实人名编造的关系。
借用原文：According to farmer Alice Gray
C) 原词陷阱
选项说羊 It got injured in a big bushfire.，"bushfire" 是录音反复出现的原词，听到就想
选；但录音说的是羊 escaped into a 200-acre forest 逃走并活了下来，从没说它在火中受
伤，"injured" 是无中生有。
借用原文：escaped into a 200-acre forest near the farm

questions.stem: What did the family do after the bushfires?

options.label: A
options.text: They rebuilt the fencing around their farm.

options.label: B
options.text: They spent seven years replanting their farm.

options.label: C
options.text: They claimed damages for their heavy losses.

options.label: D
options.text: They installed a camera to monitor sheep activity.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） They rebuilt the fencing around their farm.
【定位】Once the fires were over, the family had to fix the damage done to the farm, as it was such a
large property. This included rebuilding about 50 kilometers of fencing.
大火一过，这家人就不得不修复农场受到的损坏，因为农场面积太大了。这其中就包括重建
约 50 公里的围栏。
【信号】时间信号词 Once the fires were over。答案句由时间信号 Once the fires were over
（大火一过）引出，正好对上题干的 "after the bushfires"。这个时间词就是定位信号——
它一出现，后面紧跟的就是 "灾后这家人做的事"，听到它要立刻进入接答案状态。
【替换】rebuilding about 50 kilometers of fencing ↔ rebuilt the fencing around their farm
同一重建围栏动作的概括
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
选项说 They spent seven years replanting their farm.，"seven years" 是录音原词，但
录音里 Seven years later, they were proven wrong 的七年指的是 "羊七年后回来"，不是
"花七年补种农场"，"replanting" 录音根本没提，是张冠李戴加无中生有。
借用原文：Seven years later, they were proven wrong
C) 未提及
选项称 They claimed damages for their heavy losses.，录音确实说山火 destroyed a
large part of her family's massive property 造成了损失，听到 "损失" 容易顺势联想到
"索赔"，但录音从头到尾没说他们去索赔，"claimed damages" 是凭损失情节脑补出来
的。
借用原文：destroyed a large part of her family's massive property
D) 偷换概念
选项说 They installed a camera to monitor sheep activity.，录音里 cameras installed
to monitor deer activity 确实有装摄像头，但监控的是 "deer（鹿）" 不是 "sheep
（羊）"，选项只改了一个名词就把意思偷换了，专骗听到 "camera/monitor" 就选的人。
借用原文：cameras installed to monitor deer activity

questions.stem: What is the news report mainly about?

options.label: A
options.text: The disappearance of some gold and diamonds.

options.label: B
options.text: The transfer of tons of precious metal by air.

options.label: C
options.text: The crash of a Russian cargo airplane.

options.label: D
options.text: The loss of gold from an airplane.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （主旨题） The loss of gold from an airplane.
【定位】Tons of gold have fallen out of the sky in Russia after a cargo plane malfunctioned in midair
this morning.
今天上午，一架货机在半空中发生故障后，数吨黄金从俄罗斯的天空中坠落下来。
【信号】新闻首句即点题。新闻短消息的核心动作往往压在开头第一句，本则的首句 Tons of gold
have fallen out of the sky in Russia after a cargo plane malfunctioned in midair 一句
话就交代了"金子从飞机上掉下来"，整篇后文都是围着它展开的细节。
【替换】Tons of gold have fallen out of the sky ↔ The loss of gold from an airplane.
金子掉落=金子丢失
a cargo plane ↔ from an airplane
货机就是飞机
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
A 盗用了录音里的 gold 和 diamonds 两个原词，听着很耳熟，但它说的是 The
disappearance of some gold and diamonds.（金子钻石的消失），"消失"指不知去向，
而录音明确是"从飞机上掉落"且大部分已被寻回，方向不符，也漏掉了"飞机"这个关键。
借用原文：265 million pounds worth of gold and diamonds
B) 答非所问
B 的 The transfer of tons of precious metal by air.（用飞机空运大量贵金属）确实是事情
的背景，precious metal、by air 也都能在录音里找到影子，但它只描述了"正在空运"这个
前提，完全没提"出故障、金子掉落"这个真正的新闻点，以偏概全。
借用原文：265 million pounds worth of gold and diamonds
C) 过度推断
C 说 The crash of a Russian cargo airplane.（俄罗斯货机坠毁），Russian、cargo
airplane 都是原词，但录音里飞机是 made an emergency landing（紧急迫降）而非坠
毁，crash 把事故程度夸大了，与事实相反。
借用原文：the aircraft made an emergency landing in Magan

questions.stem: What did the aircraft do when the incident happened?

options.label: A
options.text: It made an emergency landing.

options.label: B
options.text: It informed the local police at once.

options.label: C
options.text: It contacted the goldmine company.

options.label: D
options.text: It had a crew member fix the problem.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） It made an emergency landing.
【定位】However, the aircraft made an emergency landing in Magan after it began losing some of its
valuable cargo.
然而，这架飞机在开始丢失部分贵重货物后，于马甘紧急迫降。
【信号】转折 However 后是落点。本句以转折词 However 起头——前文一直在讲金子掉了、被寻
回多少，转折之后才交代飞机本身的应对动作 made an emergency landing，转折后的句
子正是本题答案句。
【替换】the aircraft made an emergency landing ↔ It made an emergency landing.
几乎原句对应
【排除】B) 张冠李戴
B 说 It informed the local police at once.（飞机立刻通知了当地警方），police 一词录
音确实念到了，但录音是 Police have sealed off the runway（警方封锁跑道），是警方主
动介入，并没有"飞机通知警方"这回事，张冠李戴。
借用原文：Police have sealed off the runway
C) 原词陷阱
C 说 It contacted the goldmine company.（飞机联系了金矿公司），goldmine
company 是原词，但录音只说 Nine tons of gold on plane AN-12 belonged to a
goldmine company（飞机上九吨金子归一家金矿公司所有），金矿公司只是货物的主人，
根本没说飞机去联系它。
借用原文：belonged to a goldmine company
D) 未提及
D 说 It had a crew member fix the problem.（飞机让机组人员修好了故障），录音确实
提到 malfunctioned（故障）和后文的 technical engineers（技术工程师），听着像"有人
修"，但录音里飞机是迫降处理，从没说让机组成员在空中把问题修好了，纯属无中生有。

questions.stem: What does the news report say about the technical engineers who worked on the plane before take-off?

options.label: A
options.text: They will cooperate with the police.

options.label: B
options.text: They had checked the plane carefully.

options.label: C
options.text: They will be questioned by the police.

options.label: D
options.text: They took some gold bars and diamonds.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） They will be questioned by the police.
【定位】Technical engineers who worked on the plane prior to take-off are reportedly going to be
questioned by the police.
据报道，起飞前给这架飞机做过工作的技术工程师将接受警方问询。
【信号】末段交代相关人员后续。新闻把对涉事人员的后续处置放在结尾，末段 Technical
engineers ... are reportedly going to be questioned by the police 一句直接点出工程师
的去向，是本题答案句；且它与题干用的 technical engineers...prior to take-off 几乎同
词，定位极其明确。
【替换】are reportedly going to be questioned by the police ↔ They will be questioned by the police.
将被警方问询，几乎同句
Technical engineers who worked on the plane prior to take-off ↔ They
代词回指工程师
【排除】A) 与原文相反
A 说 They will cooperate with the police.（他们将配合警方），police 是原词且"将来 +
警方"的框架很像，但录音是 be questioned by the police（被警方问询，被动），工程师
是被调查的对象，并非主动配合，主被动方向被偷换。
借用原文：are reportedly going to be questioned by the police
B) 未提及
B 说 They had checked the plane carefully.（他们已仔细检查过飞机），借工程师
worked on the plane 联想出"检查"，但录音只说工程师"起飞前做过工作"且"将被问询"，
从没说他们"仔细检查过"，更没说检查得是否仔细，无中生有。
D) 过度推断
D 说 They took some gold bars and diamonds.（他们拿走了金条和钻石），gold
bars、diamonds 全是原词，又借录音 it is unclear if it was an accident or an
attempted robbery（尚不清楚是事故还是抢劫未遂）的联想，把工程师直接坐实成偷窃
者，但录音只说"将被问询"、尚未定性，是过度推断。
借用原文：it is unclear if it was an accident or an attempted robbery

questions.stem: Why does the man have his conversation with the woman recorded?

options.label: A
options.text: For the company's records.

options.label: B
options.text: For future training purposes.

options.label: C
options.text: To follow the company's rule.

options.label: D
options.text: To ensure information security.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） For future training purposes.
【定位】I just want to make you aware that this call is being recorded and may be used in the future
for training purposes.
我想提醒您一下，本次通话正在录音，将来可能会用于培训目的。
【信号】目的状语 for...purposes。答案信号是表目的的短语 used in the future for training
purposes——"录音"这一动作后面紧跟的"for ... purposes"就是它的目的，听到
for...purposes 这种目的状语，落点即在其后那个理由词上。
【替换】used in the future for training purposes ↔ For future training purposes.
几乎原句压缩
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 For the company's records. 里的 records，借自客服后面查单时说的 according to
our records——那是"按我们的记录"，与"为什么录音"毫不相干，是听到 records 就想选
的原词陷阱。
借用原文：according to our records
C) 未提及
选项 To follow the company's rule. 说"为遵守公司规定"，录音里客服只说录音用于培训
目的，从没提"规定/rule"这回事，属原文未提及。
D) 未提及
选项 To ensure information security. 说"为保障信息安全"，虽与客服场景的常识联想很
近，但录音讲录音原因时只字未提"信息安全"，是按常识脑补出来的理由，原文无依据。

questions.stem: What is the woman's purpose of calling the furniture company?

options.label: A
options.text: To check her customer reference number.

options.label: B
options.text: To inquire about the price of office chairs.

options.label: C
options.text: To get her money back for the returned chair.

options.label: D
options.text: To make complaints about its customer service.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （目的题） To get her money back for the returned chair.
【定位】I recently bought an office chair from your company, but I returned it about a week ago. I'm
just calling to inquire when I will be able to get my money back.
我最近从贵公司买了一把办公椅，但大约一周前退掉了。我打电话就是想问问，我什么时候
能拿到退款。
【信号】自报来意 I'm just calling to。答案信号是女方自报来意的句式 I'm just calling to inquire
when I will be able to get my money back——"I'm (just) calling to..."后面接的正是来
电目的，听到这个句式就锁定其后内容。
【替换】get my money back ↔ get her money back for the returned chair
人称改写+补宾语
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 To check her customer reference number. 搬来客服后面要的 customer reference
number——那是客服为查单向她索取编号，不是她打电话的目的，属听到原词就选的原词
陷阱。
借用原文：What's your customer reference number, please?
B) 未提及
选项 To inquire about the price of office chairs. 借了 office chair 的熟悉感（录音确有
office chair），但她从没问价格，全程围绕退款，属未提及。
借用原文：I recently bought an office chair
D) 过度推断
选项 To make complaints about its customer service. 说"投诉客服"，她确实抱怨了退款
超时 it's been five working days and I haven't received anything，但语气是查询而非投
诉，且本题问"来电目的"是退款，把抱怨语气推成"投诉"是过度推断。
借用原文：it's been five working days and I haven't received anything

questions.stem: What does the woman say about her bank card?

options.label: A
options.text: She had to update its information.

options.label: B
options.text: She forgot where she had left it.

options.label: C
options.text: She lost it about three days ago.

options.label: D
options.text: She was issued a new card.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） She was issued a new card.
【定位】Oh, maybe it has something to do with my new card. It was sent to me on Tuesday. Maybe
the bank canceled my old one before you've made the payment.
哦，这可能跟我的新卡有关。新卡周二寄到我这儿了。也许银行在你们付款之前就把我的旧
卡注销了。
【信号】她主动提及 my new card。答案信号是女方自己抛出的新信息 my new card——客服说卡
号有问题后，她解释"可能跟我的新卡有关，新卡周二寄到"，这句关于卡的主动陈述就是答
案句。
【替换】my new card ↔ She was issued a new card.
主被动转换
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 She had to update its information. 里的 update，搬自客服随后的建议 update
your card details——那是客服让她去更新，不是她"说关于卡"的内容，且发生在后面，属
张冠李戴式原词陷阱。
借用原文：update your card details
B) 未提及
选项 She forgot where she had left it. 说她忘了卡放哪，录音里她对卡的陈述只有"换了
新卡、旧卡可能被注销"，从没说"忘了放哪"，属未提及。
C) 原词陷阱
选项 She lost it about three days ago. 拼了两处熟悉感：卡的话题里没说"丢"，three
days 则盗自网站规则 within three working days（退款时限），把"三个工作日"嫁接
成"三天前丢卡"，属原词陷阱。
借用原文：within three working days

questions.stem: What does the man advise the woman to do?

options.label: A
options.text: Reconsider her options for payment methods.

options.label: B
options.text: Make a specific note on the company's system.

options.label: C
options.text: Update her bank card details on the company's website.

options.label: D
options.text: Upload her personal information to the company's website.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Update her bank card details on the company's website.
【定位】Well, you'll need to update your card details directly on our website. Just make sure you're
logged in. And then under the description of your personal information, you should see an
option for updating payment methods.
嗯，您需要直接在我们网站上更新您的卡信息。先确保您已登录。然后在您个人信息那一栏
下面，您应该能看到一个更新支付方式的选项。
【信号】建议句 you'll need to。答案信号是建议句式 you'll need to update your card details
directly on our website——"you'll need to"是客服给出建议的标志，落点就是其后那个
动作"在网站上更新卡信息"。
【替换】update your card details directly on our website ↔
Update her bank card details on the company's website
人称改写+近义等值
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 Reconsider her options for payment methods. 盗用原文 an option for updating
payment methods 里的 option、payment methods，但原文是"看到一个更新支付方式
的选项"，不是"重新考虑支付方式"，reconsider 是凭空换上的动作，属原词陷阱。
借用原文：an option for updating payment methods
B) 张冠李戴
选项 Make a specific note on the company's system. 盗自客服自己说的 I'll make a
note here on the system for you——那是客服"我来做个备注"，不是建议"她"做的，主语
张冠李戴，属原词陷阱。
借用原文：I'll make a note here on the system for you
D) 原词陷阱
选项 Upload her personal information to the company's website. 把原文 under the
description of your personal information 的 personal information 搬来，又把 update
偷换成 upload（更新≠上传），原文只让她更新卡信息、没让她上传个人信息，属原词陷
阱兼偷换概念。
借用原文：under the description of your personal information

questions.stem: Why isn't the man going to cook?

options.label: A
options.text: He is feeling exhausted.

options.label: B
options.text: He is tired of cooking.

options.label: C
options.text: He has to work late.

options.label: D
options.text: He wants to try Asian foods.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） He is feeling exhausted.
【定位】M: No, sorry, I'm actually pretty worn out. Let's just go out somewhere close to eat.
男：不了，抱歉，我其实挺累的。我们就近找个地方出去吃吧。
【信号】被问者对做饭请求的直接应答。上一句女方问 Are you going to prepare a meal for
us?，男方紧接着应答 I'm actually pretty worn out，这句被问者的直接回答就是答案信
号，理由就在他亲口给的这句里。
【替换】worn out ↔ exhausted
worn out 与 exhausted 是同义替换
【排除】B) 未提及
男士只说累，从没说讨厌做饭这件事，He is tired of cooking. 属凭空添加，录音无对应。
C) 未提及
现实里累常因为加班，但录音从头到尾没提工作，He has to work late. 是拿常识替文本，
属未提及。
D) 答非所问
录音后面确实聊到印度、越南等亚洲菜，He wants to try Asian foods. 盗用了这层话题，
但那是点什么外卖，不是他不做饭的原因，答非所问。
借用原文：How about Indian food?

questions.stem: What does the man say he'll do on his phone?

options.label: A
options.text: Book a table.

options.label: B
options.text: Order a delivery.

options.label: C
options.text: Download a menu.

options.label: D
options.text: Locate a restaurant.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Order a delivery.
【定位】M: Yeah, great. I'll use that food delivery app on my phone.
男：好啊，太好了。我用手机上那个外卖配送 app。
【信号】说话人用 I'll 直接表态要做的动作。紧承上句女方问 Can we get a meal delivered?，男方
应答 I'll use that food delivery app on my phone，I'll 后跟的动作就是答案信号，明确说
出他要做叫外卖这件事。
【替换】use that food delivery app ↔ Order a delivery
用外卖 app 等于点外卖配送
【排除】A)
Book a table. 对应出去吃饭订桌，但女方说 I think we should stay in，两人改成在家叫
外卖，订位的方案被放弃，与原文相反。
借用原文：I think we should stay in and save some cash.
C)
选项 Download a menu. 蹭了用手机 app 的场景，听上去和外卖相关，但录音说的是用
app 下单，从没说下载菜单，属未提及的脑补。
D) 答非所问
后文女方查中餐馆说 it's 15 kilometers away，Locate a restaurant. 盗用了查距离这层，
但那是后面挑菜时顺带看位置，不是男士在手机上表态要做的事，答非所问。
借用原文：it's 15 kilometers away

questions.stem: What does the woman think of Indian food?

options.label: A
options.text: It is not tasty.

options.label: B
options.text: It is not healthy.

options.label: C
options.text: It is too oily.

options.label: D
options.text: It is too spicy.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （态度观点题） It is too spicy.
【定位】W: That's not the kind of hot I mean. I'm just not a fan of sauces. That made me sweat and
cry. I need something mild.
女：那不是我说的那种热乎。我就是不喜欢那种酱料，辣得我又出汗又流泪。我需要清淡
点的。
【信号】评价对象后跟出的负面理由与感受。男方提 How about Indian food?，女方应答 made
me sweat and cry，这句对印度菜的具体负面感受就是答案信号——辣得出汗流泪，正是
她嫌它的点。
【替换】That made me sweat and cry ↔ It is too spicy
辣得出汗流泪即太辣
【排除】A) It is not tasty. 听上去像负面评价，但女方嫌的是辣，从没说印度菜难吃，属未提及。
B) 原词陷阱
录音里 healthy 出现在女方说 How about something healthy?，It is not healthy. 盗用了
这个词，但她对印度菜的嫌弃是辣，不是不健康，张冠李戴。
借用原文：How about something healthy?
C) 张冠李戴
录音里油腻感对应的是意大利菜 It's a bit heavy 和后文 too fattening，It is too oily. 把对
别道菜的印象安到印度菜上，张冠李戴。
借用原文：It's a bit heavy

questions.stem: What does the man think of the woman?

options.label: A
options.text: She is too concerned about money.

options.label: B
options.text: She is too weight-conscious.

options.label: C
options.text: She is too picky about food.

options.label: D
options.text: She is too eager to please.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （态度观点题） She is too picky about food.
【定位】M: Oh, you're really difficult to please.
男：哦，你可真难伺候。
【信号】评价者忍不住说出的直接总评。在女方一路否掉沙拉、印度菜、墨西哥菜、意大利菜之后，
男方脱口而出 you're really difficult to please，这句直接总评就是答案信号——他嫌她样
样不满意、太难伺候。
【替换】you're really difficult to please ↔ She is too picky about food
难伺候即对吃太挑剔
【排除】A)
录音里钱对应女方说 save some cash，She is too concerned about money. 盗用了省钱
这层，但那是她的想法，男方对她的评价是难伺候，张冠李戴。
借用原文：save some cash
B)
录音里身材对应女方说 I'm trying to keep a slim figure，She is too weight-conscious.
盗用了这层，但那是她自己的理由，男方的总评是难伺候，张冠李戴。
借用原文：I'm trying to keep a slim figure
D) 原词陷阱
She is too eager to please. 借用了答案句里的 please，却把方向反了：男方说的是她
difficult to please（难被讨好），不是她急着讨好别人，与原文相反。
借用原文：you're really difficult to please

questions.stem: What do we learn from the new study by the University of Lincoln?

options.label: A
options.text: Owners' personalities affect their cats' behaviour and wellbeing.

options.label: B
options.text: Parents' personalities can affect the personalities of their children.

options.label: C
options.text: Parents and cat owners alike experience high levels of anxiety.

options.label: D
options.text: More and more people are treating pet cats like their children.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （主旨题） Owners' personalities affect their cats' behaviour and wellbeing.
【定位】A new study carried out by the University of Lincoln has found a link between the
personalities of cat owners and the behaviour and wellbeing of their cats.
林肯大学开展的一项新研究发现，猫主人的性格与其猫咪的行为和健康状况之间存在关联。
【信号】开头点题句即结论。篇章独白的主结论几乎都在第一句，has found a link between the
personalities of cat owners and the behaviour and wellbeing of their cats 这一"研究
发现了…关联"的句式就是答案信号，开门见山给出研究主发现。
【替换】a link between the personalities of cat owners and the behaviour and wellbeing of their cats ↔
Owners' personalities affect their cats' behaviour and wellbeing.
"关联"被改写成"影响"
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
录音里确实念到 a parent's personality can affect the personality of a child，但那只是
用来打比方说明"猫和主人也一样"，研究本身讲的是猫不是孩子；B 把这个比方当成研究发
现，是典型"听到原词就选"。
借用原文：just as a parent's personality can affect the personality of a child
C) 原词陷阱
录音第 2 段确实念到 high levels of anxiety，C 把"焦虑"这个词捡来，硬说"父母和猫主人
都有高焦虑"，但原文只说某些主人焦虑会影响猫，从没说父母也焦虑，是把原词拼成了一
句没说过的话。
借用原文：individuals with high levels of anxiety, fear, anger, depression and loneliness
D) 偷换概念
录音第 5 段念到 Many owners regard their pets as a family member（很多主人把宠物
当家人），D 偷换成"越来越多人把猫当孩子养"，既加了"越来越多"的趋势，又把"家人"换
成"孩子"，原文并未讲这是个增长趋势。
借用原文：Many owners regard their pets as a family member

questions.stem: What does the passage say most pet owners want to do?

options.label: A
options.text: Give their pets behavioural training.

options.label: B
options.text: Provide their pets with the best care.

options.label: C
options.text: Know their pets' feelings and desires.

options.label: D
options.text: Interact with their pets in novel ways.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Provide their pets with the best care.
【定位】The majority of owners want to provide the best care for their pets and it's therefore possible
that pets could be affected by the way their owners interact with and manage them.
绝大多数主人都想为自己的宠物提供最好的照料，因此宠物很可能会受到主人对待和管理它
们的方式的影响。
【信号】意愿动词 want to 直接应答。信号是题干钩子词 want to 在原文原样出现：The majority
of owners want to provide the best care for their pets，want to 后面紧跟的动作就是
答案，是最直接的细节定位。
【替换】The majority of owners want to provide the best care for their pets ↔
Provide their pets with the best care.
几乎原句保留
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音反复出现 behavioural styles、behaviours 这类"行为"词，A 把它捡成"behavioural
training（行为训练）"，但原文从没说主人想给猫做训练，是听到 behavioural 就想选的陷
阱。
借用原文：more aggressive and anxious behavioural styles
C) 答非所问
原文 the underlying nature of the owner 讲的是主人内在性格驱动宠物状态，C 把它扭
成"主人想了解宠物的感受和愿望"，可原文说的是主人想"照料"宠物，不是想"了解其感
受"，方向被换了。
借用原文：the underlying nature of the owner
D) 原词陷阱
录音第 5 段确有 interact with and manage them，D 借走 interact 拼成"用新颖方式互
动"，但原文只说主人会以某种方式对待宠物，从没提"novel（新颖）"方式，多加了限定
词。
借用原文：the way their owners interact with and manage them

questions.stem: What does the passage say is still needed to understand the effects of owners' personalities on their pets?

options.label: A
options.text: More convincing explanation.

options.label: B
options.text: More extensive sampling.

options.label: C
options.text: Collection of more data.

options.label: D
options.text: Further investigation.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Further investigation.
【定位】Further research is needed to investigate the causal nature of this relationship and to look at
how owners' personalities are directly influencing their pets' behaviour and wellbeing.
还需要进一步的研究，来探究这种关系的因果本质，并考察主人的性格是如何直接影响宠物
的行为和健康的。
【信号】篇末展望句 is needed。信号是篇末的研究展望句式 Further research is needed to
investigate，is needed 与题干 still needed 直接对应，这种"还需进一步研究"的收束句正
是答案落点。
【替换】Further research is needed to investigate the causal nature of this relationship ↔
Further investigation.
research 与 investigate 同义
【排除】A) 未提及
原文说的是还需"进一步研究去探究因果"，并没说现有解释不够可信、需要"更有说服力的解
释"；A 凭"研究、解释"的话题氛围编出一个原文没提的需求。
B) 未提及
原文从未提样本大小，B 的 More extensive sampling.（更大范围取样）是借科普研究的
专业气味硬造的，篇末展望句里根本没有"样本/取样"这层意思。
C) 偷换概念
原文需要的是宽泛的 Further research（进一步研究），C 的 Collection of more data.
（收集更多数据）只是研究的一个具体环节，原文并没单指"收数据"，C 以偏概全、缩小了
范围。
借用原文：Further research is needed to investigate

questions.stem: What did the new review of studies claim?

options.label: A
options.text: People should do more running than mere walking.

options.label: B
options.text: Running is the best exercise for extending one's life.

options.label: C
options.text: People should exercise at least 60 minutes every day.

options.label: D
options.text: Running is the easiest form of exercise for most people.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Running is the best exercise for extending one's life.
【定位】The review concluded that on average runners live three years longer than non-runners and
that running does more to extend life than any other form of exercise.
该综述总结道：平均而言，跑步者比不跑步者多活三年，而且在延长寿命方面，跑步比任何
其他形式的运动都更有效。
【信号】结论动词 concluded 领出的那句就是答案句。录音里 The review concluded that 用
concluded（总结道）这个结论信号词领出综述的正式说法，结论信号后面跟的就是该研究
claim 的内容，正是 19 题要的答案句。
【替换】running does more to extend life than any other form of exercise ↔
Running is the best exercise for extending one's life
比任何其他都强=最好，比较级升级为最高级
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
A 项 People should do more running than mere walking. 借了录音反复出现的 running
来诱选，但综述说的是跑步比其他运动更延寿，从没让人多跑少走，是听到 running 就想勾
的原词陷阱。
借用原文：than any other form of exercise
C) 原词陷阱
C 项 People should exercise at least 60 minutes every day. 偷了开头 One 60-minute
run 里的 60 分钟，但原文只是举例说一次 60 分钟的跑步，从没说每天至少运动 60 分钟，
是把听到的数字硬塞进一个原文没有的主张。
借用原文：One 60-minute run can add seven hours to your life
D) 未提及
D 项 Running is the easiest form of exercise for most people. 听上去像常识，但综述比
的是延寿效果（哪个更长寿），根本没比哪种运动最容易；easiest 是凭印象脑补出来的，
原文未提。

questions.stem: What is one effect that running has on people according to recent research?

options.label: A
options.text: Improving their brain function.

options.label: B
options.text: Regulating their breathing rate.

options.label: C
options.text: Slowing down their ageing process.

options.label: D
options.text: Accelerating their blood circulation.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Improving their brain function.
【定位】Research published in recent years has shown that running changes your brain and mind in
some fascinating ways, from increasing your brain function to regulating your emotions.
近年发表的研究表明，跑步会以一些奇妙的方式改变你的大脑和心智，从提升你的脑功能到
调节你的情绪。
【信号】shown that 引出近期研究结论，且与题干recent research对应。录音 Research
published in recent years has shown that 正对应题干里的 according to recent
research，shown that 这一结论信号后列出的效果就是答案来源；其中 increasing your
brain function 直指本题。
【替换】increasing your brain function ↔ Improving their brain function
increasing≈improving，brain function原义保留
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
B 项 Regulating their breathing rate. 偷了录音里 regulating your emotions 的
regulating，但原文 regulating 后面跟的是 emotions（情绪），不是 breathing rate（呼
吸频率）；它把对的动词配上错的对象，是张冠李戴式的原词陷阱。
借用原文：regulating your emotions
C) 未提及
C 项 Slowing down their ageing process. 蹭了前文延长寿命的话题让人误以为有关衰
老，但讲近期研究效果这句只提了脑功能和情绪，没说延缓衰老；属把别处话题挪过来的混
淆。
D) 未提及
D 项 Accelerating their blood circulation. 是大家凭常识觉得跑步必然会有的效果，但录
音讲的是改变大脑和心智（脑功能、情绪），完全没提血液循环，属常识代替原文。

questions.stem: What did another study find about the participants after they had a 30-minute jog?

options.label: A
options.text: They found it easy to control their emotions.

options.label: B
options.text: They struggled to handle negative emotions.

options.label: C
options.text: They were more eager to enjoy a movie.

options.label: D
options.text: They were less affected by sad movies.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） They were less affected by sad movies.
【定位】Participants who usually struggled to handle negative emotions were more intensely affected
by the sad clips, just as you'd expect. But crucially, this was less so if they had completed the
30-minute jog.
那些平时难以处理负面情绪的被试，正如你所料，会被悲伤片段影响得更强烈。但关键在
于，如果他们完成了那 30 分钟的慢跑，这种影响就会小一些。
【信号】转折But crucially之后才是真结论。录音前半 were more intensely affected by the sad
clips 是铺垫常态，真正的研究发现在转折词后：But crucially, this was less so if they
had completed the 30-minute jog，But crucially 提示这才是关键落点，对应题干问的慢
跑后的发现。
【替换】this was less so if they had completed the 30-minute jog ↔
They were less affected by sad movies
less so指回less affected，sad clips=sad movies
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
B 项 They struggled to handle negative emotions. 几乎照搬录音 struggled to handle
negative emotions 的原话，但那是描述被试平时（usually）的状态，不是慢跑后的发
现；题干问的是慢跑之后，它答的是慢跑之前，是最毒的原词陷阱。
借用原文：Participants who usually struggled to handle negative emotions
A) 过度推断
A 项 They found it easy to control their emotions. 把原文的受影响变小（less
affected）夸成了能轻松控制情绪（easy to control），原文只说影响减弱，没说他们就能
掌控情绪，是把程度推过了头。
借用原文：less vulnerable to the impact of the sad movie
C) 原词陷阱
C 项 They were more eager to enjoy a movie. 借了录音里 movie 这个词，但原文讲的是
被试被悲伤片段影响的程度，从没说他们更想看电影（eager to enjoy）；是借 movie 一
词编出原文没有的内容。
借用原文：showed them clips from a sad movie

questions.stem: What do we learn about the speaker?

options.label: A
options.text: He is a tour guide.

options.label: B
options.text: He is a famous architect.

options.label: C
options.text: He is a local entrepreneur.

options.label: D
options.text: He is the owner of the Hill House.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） He is a tour guide.
【定位】Welcome to the tour of the Hill House.
欢迎参加希尔之屋的参观。
【信号】开场欢迎语暴露讲解员身份。答案信号是录音第一句的开场套话 Welcome to the tour of
the Hill House.——『欢迎来参观』这种带 tour 的欢迎词，只有带队讲解的人才会说，
等于自报家门是导游 / 讲解员。讲解类录音的身份信号常藏在开头的欢迎句里，一开口就
要抓。
【替换】Welcome to the tour of the Hill House. ↔ He is a tour guide.
由动作反推身份
【排除】B) 张冠李戴
录音确实念到 Charles Hill, the famous architect，但 famous architect 说的是设计这栋
房子的查尔斯·希尔，不是正在讲解的说话人。选项 He is a famous architect. 把建筑师的
身份安到了说话人头上，是典型的张冠李戴。
借用原文：Charles Hill, the famous architect
C) 原词陷阱
It was designed and built for a local entrepreneur and his family. 里的 local
entrepreneur（本地企业家）指的是当年请人盖房的客户，与说话人无关。选项 He is a
local entrepreneur. 同样把客户的身份扣到说话人头上。
借用原文：a local entrepreneur and his family
D) 未提及
录音只说房子是为 a local entrepreneur and his family 建的，从头到尾没说说话人是房
主；带队做 tour 的讲解员通常也不是产权所有者。选项 He is the owner of the Hill
House. 属未提及的臆测，原文无对应依据。

questions.stem: What did the architect do before beginning his design?

options.label: A
options.text: He studied the blueprints of other famous buildings.

options.label: B
options.text: He inquired about his client's family background.

options.label: C
options.text: He observed his client's life and habits.

options.label: D
options.text: He took a tour of his client's old home.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） He observed his client's life and habits.
【定位】Prior to beginning his design, the architect spent some time in the client's old home,
observing their life and studying their habits.
在开始设计之前，建筑师在客户的旧居里待了一段时间，观察他们的生活、研究他们的
习惯。
【信号】时间状语 Prior to 对上题干 before。答案信号是时间状语 Prior to beginning his design
——它和题干里的 before beginning his design 几乎一字不差地对应，等于直接告诉你
『答案就在这句』。听到与题干时间限定词同义的标志词（prior to = before），立刻锁定
其后的动作。
【替换】observing their life and studying their habits ↔ He observed his client's life and habits.
两个并列动作概括为一句
in the client's old home ↔ his client's
their 与 client's 指同一对象
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音后文确实出现 all the blueprints for both the building and its contents have been
preserved，blueprints（图纸）这个词被念到了，但那是说『这栋房子自己的图纸被保存
下来』，并非建筑师设计前去研究『别家名建筑的图纸』。选项 He studied the
blueprints of other famous buildings. 盗用 blueprints 一词，却凭空加了 other famous
buildings，答非所问。
借用原文：all the blueprints for both the building and its contents have been preserved
B) 未提及
录音提到 client 和 family（a local entrepreneur and his family），让 family
background 看着眼熟，但建筑师做的是『观察生活、研究习惯』，从没『inquired about
family background（打听家世背景）』。inquire 这个动作录音根本没说，属未提及。
借用原文：a local entrepreneur and his family
D) 原词陷阱
录音说建筑师 spent some time in the client's old home（在旧居里待了一段时间，目的
是观察生活），并不是去 took a tour of his client's old home（参观一下旧居）。选项盗
用 old home 一词，把『常驻观察』偷换成『参观一趟』，重点完全跑偏。
借用原文：spent some time in the client's old home

questions.stem: What did the architect's client mainly want?

options.label: A
options.text: A house made of timber and brick.

options.label: B
options.text: A house with a lot of free space.

options.label: C
options.text: A house of the current fashion.

options.label: D
options.text: A house of a unique design.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） A house of a unique design.
【定位】The client's main desire was to have a home with the unique design, so the architect was
given complete freedom.
客户的主要愿望是拥有一栋设计独特的房子，于是建筑师获得了完全的自由。
【信号】desire 直接点出客户愿望。答案信号是表愿望的词 The client's main desire was——
desire（愿望）与题干的 want 同义，直接领出客户到底想要什么。听到 desire / want /
wish 这类表意愿的词，其后内容往往就是这类需求题的答案。
【替换】a home with the unique design ↔ A house of a unique design.
home 与 house 近义、措辞几乎照搬
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音确实念到 most large homes were constructed of timber and brick，但这是在说
『当时大多数大房子』的普遍做法，紧接着用 however 转折说这栋房子是用混凝土造的。
选项 A house made of timber and brick. 盗用 timber and brick，描述的却是别家房
子，不是客户想要的这栋。
借用原文：most large homes were constructed of timber and brick
B) 未提及
录音说 the architect was given complete freedom（建筑师获得完全的设计自由），
freedom 与选项里的 free space 长得像、听起来也像，但 free space 指『大量空闲空
间』，录音从没说客户想要宽敞空间。选项 A house with a lot of free space. 是利用
freedom / free 的相似制造混淆，属未提及。
借用原文：the architect was given complete freedom
C) 与原文相反
录音明说 The building style is radically different from what was the fashion of the
period（这栋房子的风格与当时的流行式样截然不同）。选项 A house of the current
fashion. 盗用 fashion 一词，却把意思反了过来——客户要的恰恰是不随流行、独一无二，
与原文意思相反。
借用原文：The building style is radically different from what was the fashion of the period

questions.stem: What do we learn about the pieces of furniture in the children's bedrooms?

options.label: A
options.text: They are well preserved and in pretty good shape.

options.label: B
options.text: They are copies built to the architect's designs.

options.label: C
options.text: They were designed by another architect.

options.label: D
options.text: They were badly damaged but restored.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） They are copies built to the architect's designs.
【定位】However, those pieces in the children's bedrooms are copies built to the designs of
the architect.
不过，儿童房里的那些家具是按建筑师的图纸做出来的复制品。
【信号】However 转折锁定儿童房家具真相。答案信号是转折词 However——前一句刚说大多数
家具是原件、状况好，However 一转，专门交代『儿童房那批是复制品』。转折后正是题
目问的那个对象的真相，这类题答案常落在转折之后。
【替换】those pieces in the children's bedrooms are copies built to the designs of the architect ↔
They are copies built to the architect's designs.
措辞几乎照搬，仅语序微调
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
录音说 Most of the furniture you will see is original and in good condition——『状况
好、是原件』讲的是『大多数家具』，紧接着 However 才转到儿童房那批是复制品。选项
They are well preserved and in pretty good shape. 把『大多数家具』的状态安到了题目
问的『儿童房家具』头上，张冠李戴。
借用原文：Most of the furniture you will see is original and in good condition
C) 与原文相反
录音说儿童房家具是 copies built to the designs of the architect（按『这位建筑师』的
图纸做的复制品），设计者就是本建筑师本人。选项 They were designed by another
architect. 却说是『另一位建筑师』设计的，与原文意思相反。
借用原文：copies built to the designs of the architect
D) 原词陷阱
录音确实念到 we've been able to replace badly damaged furniture，badly damaged
这个词被说到了，但那是讲『靠保存下来的图纸去更换严重损坏的家具』，并不是说儿童房
的家具被严重损坏后又修复了。选项 They were badly damaged but restored. 盗用
badly damaged，把它扣到儿童房家具上，对象与意思都错了。
借用原文：we've been able to replace badly damaged furniture
