questions.stem: What does the news report say about United Airlines?

options.label: A
options.text: It found a pet dog on board a plane to a city in Texas.

options.label: B
options.text: It had one of its cargo planes land at a wrong airport.

options.label: C
options.text: It sent two dogs to the wrong destinations.

options.label: D
options.text: It had two of its domestic flights mixed up.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） It sent two dogs to the wrong destinations.
【定位】Both of the dogs had been sent to the wrong destinations on connecting flights from Denver,
with Buddy mistakenly being sent to Japan instead.
两只狗都在从丹佛转机时被送错了目的地，其中 Buddy 被错送到了日本。
【信号】Both…wrong destinations 直陈事故。这句以 Both of the dogs had been sent to the
wrong destinations 正面点出事故核心——两只狗都被送错目的地，是整则新闻交代『航
空公司做了什么』的事实落点；句中 Both 与 wrong destinations 是直接承载答案的信
号词。
【替换】Both of the dogs had been sent to the wrong destinations ↔
It sent two dogs to the wrong destinations.
Both the dogs = two dogs
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项盗用了原文里 Texas 这个地名（their new home city in Texas），但原文是说一家人
本应在得州的新家与狗团聚，并非『在飞往得州的飞机上发现一只狗』；它把真实情节拼凑
改写，属听到 Texas 就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：They were meant to be reunited with the pet in their new home city in Texas.
B) 偷换概念
原文反复说送错的是 dog（shipping an American family's pet dog…in the wrong
direction），是『狗被运错方向』，从没说『一架货机降错机场』；选项把错送对象从狗偷
换成 cargo plane、把『送错目的地』偷换成『降错机场』，与原文不符。
借用原文：United Airlines has apologised for mistakenly shipping an American family's pet dog
thousands of miles in the wrong direction
D) 答非所问
原文是两只狗在转机时被送错（on connecting flights from Denver），出错的是狗的去
向；选项却说是『两个国内航班被搞混』，把出错对象从狗换成 flights，且原文只字未提
『国内航班搞混』，属答非所问。
借用原文：Both of the dogs had been sent to the wrong destinations on connecting flights
from Denver

questions.stem: What did the spokesperson for United Airlines say they would do after the incident?

options.label: A
options.text: Correct their mistake as soon as possible.

options.label: B
options.text: Give the two pets a physical checkup.

options.label: C
options.text: Hire a charter jet to bring the pets back.

options.label: D
options.text: Send another plane to continue the flight.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Correct their mistake as soon as possible.
【定位】We will arrange to return the pets to them as soon as possible.
我们会尽快安排把宠物送还给他们。
【信号】We will 未来承诺。这句出自发言人原话，以 We will arrange to return the pets to
them as soon as possible 的 We will 领头，是典型的官方补救承诺句；will 这个未来时信
号正对应题干 say they would do，故为答案句。
【替换】We will arrange to return the pets to them as soon as possible ↔
Correct their mistake as soon as possible.
送还宠物=纠正错误
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
选项盗用了原文真出现的 physical checkup（Buddy was given a physical checkup），
但那是 Buddy 到东京后已经做过的事，不是发言人承诺『事故后将要做』的动作；时间错
位，张冠李戴到发言人头上。
借用原文：Buddy was given a physical checkup when he arrived at Tokyo's International Airport.
C) 原词陷阱
选项盗用原文的 charter jet（sent back to the U.S. on a private charter jet），但那是叙
述 Buddy 已经被私人包机送回美国的既成事实，不是发言人对今后的承诺；选项把已发生
说成将要做，且 Hire（雇用）也非原文所述。
借用原文：The dog was then sent back to the U.S. on a private charter jet.
D) 未提及
原文从没说要『再派一架飞机继续这趟飞行』；发言人只承诺尽快把宠物送还（return the
pets to them as soon as possible）。选项 Send another plane to continue the flight.
是凭 plane/flight 这类话题词臆造的动作，未提及。
Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.
1 Officials at Reid Park Zoo in Tucson Arizona are celebrating the birth of a baby elephant. Zoo
officials say the baby was born on Monday. It is a female and she weighs nearly 130 kilograms.
亚利桑那州图森市Reid Park动物园的官员们正在庆祝一头小象的诞生。动物园官员表示,这头小象于周一
出生。它是雌性,体重近130公斤。
2 Semba, her mother, is a 30-year-old African elephant. The pregnancy lasted 22 months.
它的母亲Semba是一头30岁的非洲象。怀孕期持续了22个月。
3 Officials describe the baby elephant as "healthy, standing and nursing".
官员们描述这头小象"健康、能站立并在哺乳"。
4 The baby hasn't been given a name yet.
这头小象还没有被命名。
5 Semba has given birth before. Zoo officials said during this pregnancy, she was closely monitored
through physical exams and blood tests.
Semba之前曾生育过。动物园官员表示,在这次怀孕期间,通过身体检查和血液测试对她进行了密切监测。
6 Dr. Sue Tygielski is the zoo's director of zoological operations. She said the elephant's birth went
smoothly and that there were no complications.
Sue Tygielski博士是该动物园的动物运营总监。她表示大象的分娩过程顺利,没有出现并发症。
7 The new baby expands the zoo's elephant herd to six. That includes the baby's parents, a sister, a
brother and an adult female.
这头新生小象使动物园的大象群扩大到六头。其中包括小象的父母、一个姐姐、一个哥哥和一头成年
雌象。

questions.stem: What do we learn about the mother elephant Semba?

options.label: A
options.text: She weighs 130 kilograms.

options.label: B
options.text: She has had babies before.

options.label: C
options.text: She was brought from Africa.

options.label: D
options.text: She has a big family of six.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） She has had babies before.
【定位】Semba has given birth before.
Semba 以前生过孩子（不是第一次生产）。
【信号】直陈母象过往经历。答案句是录音里专门交代 Semba 经历的一句 Semba has given birth
before.，它直接陈述了关于这只母象本身的一项事实，与题干 "关于 Semba 我们了解到什
么" 严丝合缝，是无需转折提示、直接点出的事实句。
【替换】has given birth before ↔ has had babies before
生过=有过孩子
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 She weighs 130 kilograms. 盗用了录音里真实出现的数字 130 公斤，但录音说的是
新生小象 she weighs nearly 130 kilograms，主语是 baby 而非母亲 Semba，把宝宝的体
重安到了母亲头上，对象搞错。
借用原文：she weighs nearly 130 kilograms
C) 偷换概念
选项 She was brought from Africa. 借用了录音里的 Africa 一词，但录音只说 Semba,
her mother, is a 30-year-old African elephant.——她是一头 "非洲象"（品种），并没有
说 "她是从非洲被带来的"，把物种来源偷换成了运输来历。
借用原文：a 30-year-old African elephant
D) 原词陷阱
选项 She has a big family of six. 盗用了录音末尾的数字 six，但录音说 The new baby
expands the zoo's elephant herd to six.——是 "动物园象群扩大到六只"，描述的是整个
园区象群规模，而非 "母亲 Semba 有一个六口之家"，对象与口径都被改了。
借用原文：expands the zoo's elephant herd to six

questions.stem: What does the report say about the birth of the new baby elephant?

options.label: A
options.text: It took 22 hours.

options.label: B
options.text: It had some complications.

options.label: C
options.text: It was smooth.

options.label: D
options.text: It was monitored by Dr. Sue Tygielski.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） It was smooth.
【定位】She said the elephant's birth went smoothly and that there were no complications.
她（动物园动物运营主管 Sue Tygielski 博士）说，这次大象的出生过程很顺利，没有出现
任何并发症。
【信号】对出生过程的直接定性。答案句 the elephant's birth went smoothly and that there
were no complications 是录音里唯一对 "出生过程怎么样" 下定性的句子，went
smoothly 是正面评价词、no complications 是配套补充，直接回答了题干 "出生说了什
么"，靠这个 "定性词" 信号即可锁定。
【替换】went smoothly ↔ It was smooth.
副词转形容词同义
there were no complications ↔ It was smooth.
无并发症佐证顺利
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
选项 It took 22 hours. 盗用了数字 22，但录音里的 22 是 The pregnancy lasted 22
months.——是怀孕 22 个 "月"，且说的是孕期长短不是 "出生过程用了多久"，单位
（hours↔months）和对象（出生过程↔整个孕期）双双被换。
借用原文：The pregnancy lasted 22 months
B) 与原文相反
选项 It had some complications. 直接盗用录音原词 complications，但录音是 there
were no complications——明确说 "没有" 并发症，选项却说 "有一些"，把否定改成了肯
定，极性正好相反。
借用原文：there were no complications
D) 张冠李戴
选项 It was monitored by Dr. Sue Tygielski. 把录音里真实出现的人名 Sue Tygielski 搬来
当出生过程的监控者，但录音说被密切监控的是 during this pregnancy, she was closely
monitored——监控的是 Semba 的 "孕期"，而 Tygielski 博士只是在 Dr. Sue Tygielski is
the zoo's director 里被介绍头衔并转述 "出生很顺利"，并没说出生由她监控，把 "孕期被
监控" 和 "这位博士" 硬拼到一起。
借用原文：during this pregnancy, she was closely monitored

questions.stem: What do we learn about the restaurant?

options.label: A
options.text: It enjoyed great popularity.

options.label: B
options.text: It started business three years ago.

options.label: C
options.text: It was frequented by newly-weds.

options.label: D
options.text: It was built above the sea-water.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） It was built above the sea-water.
【定位】The restaurant was built on a wooden structure above the sea-water.
这家餐厅建在海水之上的一个木质结构上。
【信号】录音里唯一直接描述餐厅本身的句子。全篇只有这一句在正面描述餐厅这个事物本身——
The restaurant was built on a wooden structure above the sea-water.，其余句子讲的
是戒指、经理、服务员的动作；当题问某事物的事实，就锁定录音里主语正是该事物、且在
交代它属性的那句。
【替换】built on a wooden structure above the sea-water ↔ It was built above the sea-water.
选项是原句的压缩概括
【排除】A) 未提及
It enjoyed great popularity. 说餐厅很受欢迎，但录音通篇只讲戒指失而复得，从未评价餐
厅的人气或生意好坏，属于无中生有。
B) 原词陷阱
It started business three years ago. 借了录音开头的 three years ago，但 Three years
ago, a couple was enjoying a meal 里这个时间是指三年前有对夫妇在此用餐、戒指掉
落，根本不是讲餐厅三年前开业；把三年前从用餐时间偷换成开业时间，是典型的原词陷
阱。
借用原文：Three years ago, a couple was enjoying a meal at a beach restaurant.
C) 过度推断
It was frequented by newly-weds. 说餐厅常被新婚夫妇光顾；录音只提到一对夫妇曾来用
餐 a couple was enjoying a meal，既没说他们是新婚、更没说这里常有新婚夫妇来，属
于由一对夫妇过度推断成常客群体。
借用原文：a couple was enjoying a meal at a beach restaurant

questions.stem: What did the restaurant manager decide to do recently?

options.label: A
options.text: Expand his business on the beach.

options.label: B
options.text: Replace the restaurant's wooden deck.

options.label: C
options.text: Post a picture of his restaurant online.

options.label: D
options.text: Celebrate his silver wedding anniversary.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Replace the restaurant's wooden deck.
【定位】Recently, the restaurant manager Ryan Krivoy decided to replace the wooden deck and he
found an old gold coin, some $100 bills and a silver wedding ring while replacing the deck.
最近，餐厅经理 Ryan Krivoy 决定更换那个木质平台，他在换平台时发现了一枚古老的金
币、一些百元钞票和一枚银质结婚戒指。
【信号】decided to 直接给出经理的决定动作。the restaurant manager Ryan Krivoy decided to
replace the wooden deck 里 decided to 后面紧跟的动词短语，就是题目要的决定；听到
decided to 这种表决定的信号词，后面接的动作即是答案落点。
【替换】decided to replace the wooden deck ↔ Replace the restaurant's wooden deck.
几乎同表述，仅补出所属
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
Expand his business on the beach. 里的 beach 借自录音背景中的海边餐厅（beach
restaurant），但录音从没说经理要扩张生意，他决定的是换平台 replace the wooden
deck；把场景词 beach 拿来拼一个原文没有的动作，是原词陷阱加无中生有。
借用原文：a beach restaurant
C) 张冠李戴
Post a picture of his restaurant online. 里发照片到网上这件事，录音里做的人是女服务
员 The restaurant waitress Sasha Formica posted a picture of the ring on
Facebook.，且发的是戒指照片不是餐厅照片；既把动作的人从服务员张冠李戴到经理，又
把戒指换成餐厅，双重偷换。
借用原文：The restaurant waitress Sasha Formica posted a picture of the ring on Facebook.
D) 原词陷阱
Celebrate his silver wedding anniversary. 里的 silver wedding 拼自录音的 silver
wedding ring（银质结婚戒指），但 a silver wedding ring 说的是经理找到的一枚银戒
指，根本不是他要庆祝结婚周年；把 silver wedding ring 截成 silver wedding，是诱人的
原词陷阱。
借用原文：a silver wedding ring

questions.stem: What did the waitress do about the recovered ring?

options.label: A
options.text: She sold it for two thousand dollars.

options.label: B
options.text: She took it to the restaurant manager.

options.label: C
options.text: She posted its picture on Facebook.

options.label: D
options.text: She returned it to its owner right away.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） She posted its picture on Facebook.
【定位】The restaurant waitress Sasha Formica posted a picture of the ring on Facebook.
餐厅女服务员 Sasha Formica 把戒指的照片发到了脸书上。
【信号】主语正是 waitress、动作直接针对 ring。The restaurant waitress Sasha Formica
posted a picture of the ring on Facebook. 这一句主语恰是题目问的 waitress、动作
posted 又直接落在 ring 上，人、物、动作三者齐全；当题目锁定某人对某物的动作，就找
主语是该人、宾语含该物的那一句。
【替换】posted a picture of the ring on Facebook ↔ She posted its picture on Facebook.
几乎原句，仅用 its 回指 ring
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
She sold it for two thousand dollars. 里的两千美元搬自录音结尾 the gold coin was
very rare. It was from 1855 and worth as much as $2,000，但这金额是说那枚稀有金币
值两千美元、并非服务员把戒指卖了两千；既盗用了金额数字，又把对象从金币偷换成戒
指，是原词陷阱加偷换概念。
借用原文：It was from 1855 and worth as much as $2,000.
B) 未提及
She took it to the restaurant manager. 说服务员把戒指交给经理，但录音里其实是经理
先发现戒指 he found ... a silver wedding ring、服务员再去发照片，戒指并非由服务员上
交经理；这是个原文没发生、还把人物关系方向弄反的干扰项。
D) 张冠李戴
She returned it to its owner right away. 借了录音里确有的归还戒指情节，但还戒指的是
餐厅而非服务员 The restaurant mailed the ring back to the happy couple.，而且是失
主三天后来认领 Three days later, the happy wife called to claim the ring 才寄还，并非
right away（立刻）；张冠李戴加篡改时间。
借用原文：The restaurant mailed the ring back to the happy couple.

questions.stem: What does the woman find unbelievable?

options.label: A
options.text: The number of ducks has declined sharply in recent years.

options.label: B
options.text: Climate change has little effect on the lives of wild ducks.

options.label: C
options.text: Duck meat is not eaten in Australia, Canada and the U.S.

options.label: D
options.text: Duck hunting remains legal in many parts of the world.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （态度观点题） Duck hunting remains legal in many parts of the world.
【定位】W: I can't believe that duck hunting is still legal in so many parts of the world.
女：我真不敢相信，在世界上这么多地方猎鸭居然还是合法的。
【信号】“我不敢相信”直接喊出态度。答案信号是开口第一句的强烈表态 I can't believe that——
这正是 unbelievable 的口语版，紧跟其后的内容就是她觉得难以置信的对象，无需再往
下找。
【替换】duck hunting is still legal in so many parts of the world ↔
Duck hunting remains legal in many parts of the world.
is still=remains 的同义替换
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音确实提到 a decline in the birds' numbers，A 用 declined sharply 盗了这个原词。
但她惊讶的是“居然合法”，数量下降只是她用来佐证的事实，答非所问。
借用原文：a decline in the birds' numbers
B) 与原文相反
录音里 It's caused by both in fact. 明确说气候（干旱）是原因之一，B 却说 Climate
change has little effect，与原文相反；climate change 这个词是男士在 climate change
提出的疑问，被借来做诱饵。
借用原文：It's caused by both in fact.
C) 偷换概念
录音说 Their meat is hardly eaten in Western countries.，指“西方国家”。C 把范围偷换
成 Australia, Canada and the U.S. 三个具体国家，且这是后文的细节、不是她开头表态的
“不敢相信”对象。
借用原文：Their meat is hardly eaten in Western countries.

questions.stem: What does the woman say has caused the shrinking of ducks' habitats in Australia?

options.label: A
options.text: Droughts.

options.label: B
options.text: Bushfires.

options.label: C
options.text: Farming.

options.label: D
options.text: Hunting.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Droughts.
【定位】W: We see more droughts in countries like Australia. Ducks are birds that feed and breed in
areas where there is a lot of water, but their habitats have been shrinking in recent decades
because of the droughts.
女：在澳大利亚这样的国家，我们看到了更多的干旱。鸭子是在水多的地方觅食和繁殖的
鸟，但近几十年来，由于干旱，它们的栖息地一直在缩小。
【信号】because of 后面直接点出原因。答案信号是明确的因果短语 because of the droughts
——habitats shrinking 紧跟 because of，连接词后的 droughts 就是栖息地缩小的直接
原因。
【替换】because of the droughts ↔ Droughts.
原文与选项同词直接对应
【排除】B) 未提及
Bushfires. 只是“澳大利亚”这一情境下考生脑补出来的常识，录音从头到尾未提 bushfire，
属凭印象的无中生有。
C) 原词陷阱
录音后面才提到 farming areas、农民毒鸭等，C 用 Farming. 盗了这个原词，但题问的是
“栖息地缩小的原因”，农业与之并无因果关系，答非所问。
借用原文：farming areas
D) 原词陷阱
录音里 hunting 与 a decline in the birds' numbers 相关，D 用 Hunting. 盗了全篇高频
词。但题专问 habitats 缩小，原文把这一项的因明确归给 droughts，hunting 答非所问。
借用原文：It's caused by both in fact.

questions.stem: Why is there no commercial farming of ducks and geese in Western countries?

options.label: A
options.text: They are not easy to domesticate.

options.label: B
options.text: Their meat is not that popular.

options.label: C
options.text: It is not environmentally friendly.

options.label: D
options.text: It is not considered cost-effective.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Their meat is not that popular.
【定位】W: Yet, there's no commercial farming of these birds nowadays. Their meat is hardly eaten in
Western countries.
女：然而，如今并没有对这些鸟类的商业养殖。在西方国家，它们的肉几乎没人吃。
【信号】现象句紧跟的下一句即解释。答案信号是“现象+紧贴解释”的相邻结构：先说 there's no
commercial farming（现象），紧接着 Their meat is hardly eaten in Western
countries. 就是原因——没人吃，自然不必养。
【替换】Their meat is hardly eaten in Western countries. ↔ Their meat is not that popular.
“几乎没人吃”=“不太受欢迎”
【排除】A) 未提及
They are not easy to domesticate. 听着像个合理理由，但录音没说过驯养难易，属凭常
识脑补的无中生有。
C) 未提及
It is not environmentally friendly. 蹭了“环保”这个当下热词，但录音解释“不养”的理由是
肉没人吃，从未提环保，无中生有。
D) 过度推断
It is not considered cost-effective. 看似能从“没人吃→养了不赚钱”推出来，但这是考生自
己多走的一步，原文只说肉没人吃，没说成本不划算。
借用原文：Their meat is hardly eaten in Western countries.

questions.stem: What does the woman say about farmers in her grandfather's time?

options.label: A
options.text: They hunted ducks as a traditional sport.

options.label: B
options.text: They killed wild ducks and geese for food.

options.label: C
options.text: They raised ducks and geese for their eggs.

options.label: D
options.text: They poisoned wild ducks in large numbers.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） They poisoned wild ducks in large numbers.
【定位】W: ducks have never been popular with farmers like my grandfather anyway because they
sometimes destroy crops. In fact, farmers used to poison them in large numbers.
女：反正鸭子从来都不受我祖父那样的农民待见，因为它们有时会毁坏庄稼。事实上，农民
过去常常大量毒杀它们。
【信号】主语为 farmers 的应答句直接点动作。答案信号是女士应答里主语明确为 farmers 的那句
farmers used to poison them in large numbers——题问 farmers，原文恰由 farmers
当主语给出动作，定位即在此。
【替换】farmers used to poison them in large numbers ↔ They poisoned wild ducks in large numbers.
原话与选项近乎逐词对应
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
They hunted ducks as a traditional sport. 蹭了男士那句 duck hunting seemingly
exists as the continuation of a tradition 里的 tradition，但那是讲“如今猎鸭是传统延
续”，主语不是祖父年代的农民，张冠李戴。
借用原文：duck hunting seemingly exists as the continuation of a tradition
B) 张冠李戴
They killed wild ducks and geese for food. 盗用了 a plentifully available food
source，但那讲的是祖父那辈猎人把鸭鹅当食物来源，主语是猎人而非本题问的 farmers，
且农民对鸭子的态度是毒杀而非食用，张冠李戴。
借用原文：a plentifully available food source
C) 未提及
They raised ducks and geese for their eggs. 里的 raised（饲养）和 eggs（蛋）录音从
未念到——原文讲的全是猎杀、毒杀，没有任何“养鸭取蛋”，属无中生有。

questions.stem: What is the woman planning to do?

options.label: A
options.text: Have her house repainted.

options.label: B
options.text: Replace some of her old furniture.

options.label: C
options.text: Move into a newly-painted house.

options.label: D
options.text: Calculate the cost of the paint job.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Have her house repainted.
【定位】W: So, how much would the paint job cost?
女：那么，这次刷漆要花多少钱呢？
【信号】她默认刷漆为前提。整段对话从男方 I estimate you have between 210 and 240 square
meters of walls and ceiling. 量墙面起，到女方追问 how much would the paint job
cost，全程围绕 the paint job 推进——她来咨询、谈价钱，前提就是她正打算把房子刷一
遍。信号是「她把刷漆当作既定要做的事在谈费用」，而非在犹豫要不要刷。
【替换】the paint job ↔ Have her house repainted.
刷漆=请人重刷房子
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
录音确实念到 furniture，但只在 we can't paint the walls without clearing all the
furniture first 里讲「刷漆要先搬开家具」，从没说她要更换旧家具。这一项盗用 furniture
这个原词制造「听到就想选」的诱惑，实则答非所问。
借用原文：we can't paint the walls without clearing all the furniture first
C) 偷换概念
录音里女方说的是 I would have to stay with a friend or check into a hotel，即刷漆那两
天临时去别处住，绝不是搬进一所新刷好的房子。这一项借「新刷好的房子」这一刷漆语境
的联想来误导，与原文意思不符。
借用原文：I would have to stay with a friend or check into a hotel
D) 张冠李戴
录音开头是男方说 I've finished calculating.——计算面积、费用的是这位男技师，不是女
方；女方只是问价。这一项盗用 calculate/cost 这两个原词，又把「算钱」这个动作张冠李
戴到女方身上。
借用原文：I've finished calculating.

questions.stem: What is the woman's chief concern?

options.label: A
options.text: How long the work will take.

options.label: B
options.text: How much the work will cost.

options.label: C
options.text: How the paint job is to be done.

options.label: D
options.text: How many workers are needed.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） How much the work will cost.
【定位】W: So, how much would the paint job cost?
女：那么，这次刷漆要花多少钱呢？
【信号】她主动追问的就是钱。女方主动开口问的第一件事就是 how much would the paint job
cost，随后听到报价 $3,000 又反应 that's more than I expected——她的注意力始终落在
费用上。信号是「她主动发问且事后又对价钱有强烈反应」，这正标记出她的 chief
concern 是钱。
【替换】how much would the paint job cost ↔ How much the work will cost.
the paint job=the work
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音里 the whole task would take two days 确实念到两天工期，但这是男方主动告知
的，不是女方在意发问的。这一项盗用「两天/工期」这一原词信息，却不是她的 chief
concern。
借用原文：the whole task would take two days
C) 答非所问
施工方式由男方在 every time we paint a room, we first have to move the furniture to
another room 主动解释，女方只是问了句 Why?，并未把「怎么刷」当成核心关切。这一
项借「刷漆流程」这段原文诱选，却答非所问。
借用原文：every time we paint a room, we first have to move the furniture to another room
D) 未提及
录音里只在 it requires two people 提到「需要两个人」是抬高费用的原因，而不是讨论
「需要几个工人」这个独立话题，女方更没把人数当关切。选项把 two people 偷换成「需
要多少工人」这个题目，属未提及该问法。

questions.stem: What does the woman have to do while the paint job is being done?

options.label: A
options.text: Cover up her furniture.

options.label: B
options.text: Ask some friends for help.

options.label: C
options.text: Stay somewhere else.

options.label: D
options.text: Oversee the work herself.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Stay somewhere else.
【定位】W: Oh well, that changes everything, I'm afraid. I would have to stay with a friend or check
into a hotel.
女：哦，那这下情况就全变了，恐怕得这样。我就只能去朋友那儿住，或者住进酒店了。
【信号】I would have to 必要性信号。前一句男方确认 That is correct.（指她那两天不能住在自
己家），紧接着女方说 I would have to stay with a friend or check into a hotel，have
to 正是「不得不」的必要性信号。信号是「条件触发后她亲口说出的 have to + 动作」，
这就是答案句。
【替换】stay with a friend or check into a hotel ↔ Stay somewhere else.
住朋友家或酒店=去别处住
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音里和家具有关的是 the price includes moving all the furniture——搬家具由施工方
包办，根本没说要女方去「盖住」家具。这一项盗用 furniture 原词，又把动作安错了执行
人。
借用原文：the price includes moving all the furniture
B) 偷换概念
录音里 friend 出现在 stay with a friend——是去朋友家借住，不是叫朋友来帮忙刷漆。这
一项盗用 friend 这个原词，把「投奔朋友住」偷换成「请朋友帮忙干活」。
借用原文：stay with a friend
D) 未提及
录音通篇没有女方要「亲自盯着施工」的内容，反而她说自己 I would have to stay with a
friend or check into a hotel，两天不在家，更谈不上监工。这一项是凭刷漆场景空想出来
的，原文无据。

questions.stem: What has the woman come to realize at the end of the conversation?

options.label: A
options.text: She could have asked a friend for help with the paint job.

options.label: B
options.text: Painting a house involves more trouble than she thought.

options.label: C
options.text: She should have repainted her house much earlier.

options.label: D
options.text: Moving her furniture is harder than the paint job.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Painting a house involves more trouble than she thought.
【定位】W: I'm starting to realize that painting my house is far more troublesome than I
had anticipated.
女：我开始意识到，给我的房子刷漆远比我原先料想的要麻烦得多。
【信号】realize 引出的结尾总结。这句出现在对话接近尾声处，由 I'm starting to realize 领起，正
是她亲口说出的醒悟；后文男方还附和 Most of our clients go through the same
realization. 加以印证。信号是「结尾处由 realize 引出、且对方附和的总结句」，这就是答
案句。
【替换】painting my house is far more troublesome than I had anticipated ↔
Painting a house involves more trouble than she thought.
more troublesome=more trouble
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音里 friend 只在 stay with a friend（去朋友家借住）出现，从没说「本可以找朋友帮忙
刷漆」。这一项盗用 friend 原词，又用 could have 这个虚拟句式凭空造了个她没说过的懊
悔。
借用原文：stay with a friend
C) 未提及
对话里没有任何「她后悔没早点刷房子」的内容，她的醒悟是刷漆太麻烦，与时间早晚无
关。这一项用 should have repainted 的虚拟语气编了一个原文不存在的后悔。
D) 偷换概念
录音里搬家具是 the price includes moving all the furniture 由公司负责的一个环节，女
方并没有说「搬家具比刷漆本身还难」。这一项盗用 furniture/moving 原词，把她「整件
事很麻烦」的醒悟偷换成「搬家具比刷漆难」这个原文没下过的比较。
借用原文：the price includes moving all the furniture

questions.stem: What is the main aim of homework for primary school kids?

options.label: A
options.text: To cultivate good habits.

options.label: B
options.text: To prepare for secondary school.

options.label: C
options.text: To review what is learned in class.

options.label: D
options.text: To stimulate interest in learning.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） To cultivate good habits.
【定位】At the primary level, the main aim is to cultivate good habits, like learning to plan and
exercising self-discipline.
在小学阶段，主要目的是培养好习惯，比如学会做计划和锻炼自律。
【信号】学段词+main aim原话直给。答案句以 At the primary level 点出学段，紧跟 the main
aim is to cultivate good habits 几乎把题干的 main aim 原样念出——这种『题干关键词
在录音里被复述』的句子就是答案句信号。
【替换】the main aim is to cultivate good habits ↔ To cultivate good habits.
近乎原词对应
【排除】B) 张冠李戴
To prepare for secondary school. 借了录音里 During the secondary school years 的
secondary school 一词，但录音讲 secondary 时说的是『延伸课堂所学』，根本没说小学
是为升中学做准备——把中学段的话错安到了小学目的上。
借用原文：During the secondary school years
C) 答非所问
To review what is learned in class. 像是改写自录音 extending what is learned at
school，但那句讲的是『中学阶段』延伸课堂所学，并非小学目的；且 review（复习）也
不等于 extending（延伸/拓展）。
借用原文：extending what is learned at school
D) 未提及
To stimulate interest in learning. 听起来很合理（作业激发学习兴趣），但录音讲小学目
的只说了 cultivate good habits、learning to plan、self-discipline，全程没提『激发兴
趣』，属于凭常识脑补出来的选项。

questions.stem: What does the passage suggest parents do to help their children?

options.label: A
options.text: Discuss their academic achievements with them.

options.label: B
options.text: Create an ideal study environment for them.

options.label: C
options.text: Allow them to learn independently.

options.label: D
options.text: Check their homework promptly.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Create an ideal study environment for them.
【定位】Creating an ideal working environment will make it easier for them to get down to their
assignments quickly.
营造一个理想的学习环境，会让孩子更容易快速投入到作业中。
【信号】首句建议句直陈做法。第 3 段开头 Creating an ideal working environment 就是一条建
议家长落地去做的具体动作，篇章里这种『动名词/祈使开头、紧跟好处』的句子是典型建
议落点。
【替换】Creating an ideal working environment ↔ Create an ideal study environment for them.
working≈study的同义替换
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
Discuss their academic achievements with them. 借了录音 academic achievement 这
个原词，但那是在讲『中学作业与学业成绩正相关』，根本没让家长去和孩子『讨论成绩』
——听到 achievement 就选正中陷阱。
借用原文：academic achievement
C) 与原文相反
Allow them to learn independently. 看似呼应录音 by the end of primary school it's
second nature（小学末要变成自觉），但录音始终在讲家长要『帮忙、陪在旁边』
（somewhere near you），方向是陪伴而非放手，选独立自学正好反了家长此刻该做的
事。
借用原文：somewhere near you
D) 原词陷阱
Check their homework promptly. 用了话题原词 homework，特别勾人，但录音从没让家
长『及时检查作业』，只说营造环境、陪在旁边答疑鼓励（answer questions and offer
encouragement），check homework 是无中生有。
借用原文：answer questions and offer encouragement

questions.stem: What should children do to deal with multiple assignments?

options.label: A
options.text: Finish them before they get tired.

options.label: B
options.text: Tackle the most difficult task first.

options.label: C
options.text: Start with something they enjoy.

options.label: D
options.text: Focus on the most important ones.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Start with something they enjoy.
【定位】When there are several different assignments, make sure they begin with one they enjoy, so it
seems easy to get started.
当有好几项不同的作业时，要确保孩子从一项他们喜欢的开始做，这样起步就显得轻松。
【信号】情境词+begin with点起手。录音先用 When there are several different assignments 复
述了题干的『多项作业』情境，紧跟 begin with one they enjoy 用次序词 begin with 直
接点出第一步——情境复述+次序词就是答案句信号。
【替换】begin with one they enjoy ↔ Start with something they enjoy.
begin with=Start with的同义替换
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
Finish them before they get tired. 借了录音 before they get tired 的 tired 一词，但原
文 before they get tired 是修饰『第二步做最难的要赶在累之前』，不是说『趁不累把全
部做完』——把限定条件偷换成了总目标。
借用原文：before they get tired
B) 与原文相反
Tackle the most difficult task first. 用了录音原词 the most difficult task，极其诱人，但
录音说的是 take on the most difficult task second——是『第二步』才做最难的，选项
却改成 first，次序被反，与原文相反。
借用原文：take on the most difficult task second
D) 未提及
Focus on the most important ones. 的 most important 听着和 18B 的 most difficult
很像、也很合常理，但录音排序依据是『喜欢的先、最难的第二』，从没按『重要性』排，
important 是脑补出来的。

questions.stem: Who will qualify for the bonus in Mexican oil company?

options.label: A
options.text: Workers who meet its body weight standards.

options.label: B
options.text: Workers who can lose 30 pounds in a year.

options.label: C
options.text: Workers who try the hardest to lose weight.

options.label: D
options.text: Workers who are in the top 10% of the slimmest.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Workers who meet its body weight standards.
【定位】Workers at Mexican oil company will receive a healthy incentive of almost $300 a year if
they meet certain body weight standards. To qualify for the bonus, they must maintain a
healthy weight.
墨西哥这家石油公司的员工，如果达到一定的体重标准，每年可领到将近 300 美元的健康奖
励。要拿到这笔奖金，他们必须保持健康的体重。
【信号】qualify 与 if 引出的资格条件句。录音出现题干同源词 qualify，且紧跟 To qualify for the
bonus, they must maintain a healthy weight 这一明确的资格条件句，加上前句 if they
meet certain body weight standards 的 if 条件，正是承载答案的信号句。
【替换】they meet certain body weight standards ↔ meet its body weight standards
近乎同表，certain→its 的限定替换
they must maintain a healthy weight ↔ meet its body weight standards
保持健康体重=达到体重标准
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
B 借了录音里的减重情节，但录音说的是 reduce their weight by 10%（减重 10%），选
项却写成 lose 30 pounds in a year（一年减 30 磅），数字被偷换，属听到减重就想选的
原词陷阱。
借用原文：reduce their weight by 10% during the year
C) 未提及
C 说奖给 Workers who try the hardest to lose weight（最努力减重的人），录音判定标
准只看体重结果（达标或减 10%），从没提以努力程度评奖，属无中生有。
D) 原词陷阱
D 用了录音里的数字 10%，但录音的 reduce their weight by 10% 是减重幅度 10%，选
项却说成 in the top 10% of the slimmest（最瘦的前 10%），把幅度偷换成排名，属原
词陷阱。
借用原文：reduce their weight by 10% during the year

questions.stem: What do critics think of Mexican oil company's bonus policy?

options.label: A
options.text: Impractical.

options.label: B
options.text: Inconsistent.

options.label: C
options.text: Unmanageable.

options.label: D
options.text: Unfair.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （态度观点题） Unfair.
【定位】But critics say the policy contradicts recommendations by many health experts, who warn
that a person's weight is influenced by genetic and environmental factors. That means weight
can be hard for individuals to control, which makes the bonus unfair.
但批评者说，这项政策与许多健康专家的建议相抵触，这些专家警告说，一个人的体重受遗
传和环境因素影响。这意味着体重对个人来说可能难以控制，这就使得这笔奖金不公平。
【信号】题干主语 critics 出现 + 转折 But + 结论 unfair。录音以 But critics say 直接对上题干的
critics，转折词 But 标示真正的批评态度要来了，段末 which makes the bonus unfair 给
出批评者的定性结论，是答案句。
【替换】which makes the bonus unfair ↔ Unfair
原词直现的评价结论
【排除】A) 未提及
A 说政策 Impractical（不切实际），录音批评者的定性是 unfair（不公平），从未说它不
切实际，属未提及的近义干扰。
B) 张冠李戴
B 的 Inconsistent 确是录音原词，但说它的是第 4 段的 Some experts say the policy is
inconsistent，而本题问的是 critics（批评者）的看法，二者不是同一方，属张冠李戴。
借用原文：Some experts say the policy is inconsistent with the science
C) 偷换概念
C 说政策 Unmanageable（难以管理），录音里批评者谈的是体重难以由个人控制（hard
for individuals to control），讲的是个人控体重难，不是政策难管理，属偷换概念加未提
及。

questions.stem: What do experts propose companies do about workers' wellbeing?

options.label: A
options.text: Offer them much fatter bonuses.

options.label: B
options.text: Improve working environment.

options.label: C
options.text: Encourage healthy behaviors.

options.label: D
options.text: Provide free lunch and snacks.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Encourage healthy behaviors.
【定位】These experts argue that focusing on wage is the wrong approach. A more productive method
of encouraging health among employees is to promote healthy behaviors.
这些专家认为，盯着工资是错误的做法。在员工中促进健康的一种更有效的方法，是推动健
康的行为。
【信号】对比 wrong approach 与 A more productive method 引出的建议句。录音先用
focusing on wage is the wrong approach 否定旧法，紧接 A more productive
method… is to promote healthy behaviors 这个更有效的方法句正面给出专家建议，是
承载答案的信号句。
【替换】to promote healthy behaviors ↔ Encourage healthy behaviors
promote=encourage 的近义替换
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
A 说 Offer them much fatter bonuses（发更肥的奖金），借了全篇核心词 bonus，但专
家明说 focusing on wage is the wrong approach，盯着钱正是被否定的错误做法，属原
词陷阱加与原文相反。
借用原文：focusing on wage is the wrong approach
B) 未提及
B 说 Improve working environment，录音专家给的建议是促进健康行为并举了健身、讲
座、健康饮食等例，没提改善工作环境这一概括，属未提及。
D) 答非所问
D 的 Provide free lunch and snacks 确与录音 provide healthier snacks… and healthier
meals at the company canteen 沾边，但那只是促进健康行为的具体举例之一，题目要的
是上位的建议，拿例子冒充结论，属以偏概全。
借用原文：provide healthier snacks in the office and healthier meals at the company canteen

questions.stem: Why are some people criticizing the British government?

options.label: A
options.text: It has not done enough to help left-handed children.

options.label: B
options.text: It has treated left-handed children as being disabled.

options.label: C
options.text: It has not built facilities specially for the left-handed.

options.label: D
options.text: It has ignored campaigns on behalf of the left-handed.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） It has not done enough to help left-handed children.
【定位】Campaigners have warned that the British government is not doing enough to prevent left-
handed pupils from falling behind their peers.
活动倡导者警告说，英国政府在防止左撇子学生落后于同龄人方面做得不够。
【信号】warned 引出的批评首句。录音开篇即由 Campaigners have warned that 引出批评，
warned(警告)是明确的指责信号，紧随其后的 the British government is not doing
enough 就是被批评的具体内容，是承载答案的那一句。
【替换】the British government is not doing enough to prevent left-handed pupils from falling behind ↔
It has not done enough to help left-handed children
防止落后=帮助，措辞改写
【排除】B) 未提及
treated left-handed children as being disabled 说政府"把左撇子当残疾人对待"，录音从
头到尾没有 disabled 这个说法，是凭"左撇子常被特殊对待"的常识硬推出来的，属未提
及。
C) 偷换概念
not built facilities specially for the left-handed 把批评落到"没建专门设施"。录音批评的
是政府/部长 failed to take any meaningful action\(没采取有意义的行动\)，从未提"设
施"；选项用一个看似具体的硬件方向偷换了"行动不足"这一真正指责点。
D) 张冠李戴
ignored campaigns on behalf of the left-handed 说政府"无视了为左撇子发起的呼吁"。
录音里 Campaigners(活动倡导者)是发出批评的一方，Campaigners have warned；选项
盗用了 campaign 这个原词，却把"倡导者在批评"反说成"政府无视呼吁"，是把发声方和被
批方混在一起的张冠李戴，且"无视呼吁"不等于首句明指的"做得不够"。
借用原文：Campaigners have warned that the British government is not doing enough

questions.stem: What do studies in recent years show about left-handed children?

options.label: A
options.text: They are as intelligent as other children.

options.label: B
options.text: They have a distinctive style of handwriting.

options.label: C
options.text: They sometimes have psychological problems.

options.label: D
options.text: They tend to have more difficulties in learning.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） They tend to have more difficulties in learning.
【定位】Studies in recent years show that left-handed children are more likely to suffer with learning
difficulties and their scores are lower on IQ tests.
近年的研究表明，左撇子孩子更可能存在学习困难，他们在智商测试中的得分也更低。
【信号】Studies show 引出的结论句。录音 Studies in recent years show that 与题干用词几乎重
合，是明显的定位信号；其后 more likely to suffer with learning difficulties 就是研究给
出的结论，承载答案。
【替换】more likely to suffer with learning difficulties ↔ tend to have more difficulties in learning
更可能有=更倾向有，近义改写
【排除】A) 与原文相反
as intelligent as other children\(和别人一样聪明\)与录音相反：录音说 their scores are
lower on IQ tests\(智商测试得分更低\)，恰恰是"不一样/更低"，选项把极性反了过来。
借用原文：their scores are lower on IQ tests
B) 原词陷阱
a distinctive style of handwriting\(独特的书写风格\)盗用了录音多处提到的
handwriting。录音里 handwriting 是 poor handwriting\(糟糕的书写\)、是困难，绝
非"独特风格"这种中性/褒义说法；本题问的又是 studies 的结论，与书写无关，属答非所
问。
借用原文：poor handwriting
C) 未提及
psychological problems\(心理问题\)在 studies 那句里没有对应，录音 P3 只说了
learning difficulties 和 IQ 得分低，没提心理；"左撇子有心理问题"是听起来合理的常识联
想，但录音没念到。

questions.stem: What do the campaigners demand the department of education do?

options.label: A
options.text: Punish teachers discriminating against left-handed students.

options.label: B
options.text: Lay more emphasis on improving children's mental health.

options.label: C
options.text: Encourage students to develop various professional skills.

options.label: D
options.text: Keep track of left-handed children's school performance.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Keep track of left-handed children's school performance.
【定位】They want the department of education to record which children are left-handed and what
their educational attainments are.
他们希望教育部门记录哪些孩子是左撇子、以及他们的学业成绩如何。
【信号】want 引出的诉求句。录音 They want the department of education to 用 want 直接给
出诉求，want 后面接的 record which children are left-handed and what their
educational attainments are 就是要求做的事，是答案句。
【替换】record which children are left-handed and what their educational attainments are ↔
Keep track of left-handed children's school performance
记录学业成绩=追踪学业表现
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
Punish teachers discriminating against left-handed students 借了录音末段的
teacher(出现在 a lack of teacher training\)。录音说的是"缺乏教师培训"，从没要求"惩罚
老师"；Punish 这一强硬动作是录音没有的，属原词陷阱。
借用原文：a lack of teacher training
B) 未提及
improving children's mental health 把诉求引向"心理健康"。录音的诉求只在"记录左撇子
身份与学业成绩"，全篇没提 mental health；本项用一个貌似教育部门该管的方向偷换了真
正的诉求。
C) 答非所问
develop various professional skills\(发展各种职业技能\)在录音诉求句里没有对应。录音
P2 虽提到 reduced career prospects\(职业前景受损\)，但那是描述后果，不是"要求教育
部门去发展技能"，本项答非所问。
借用原文：facing reduced career prospects

questions.stem: What do the campaigners want to know about left-handed prisoners?

options.label: A
options.text: How they can be reduced in number.

options.label: B
options.text: Why their numbers are so high.

options.label: C
options.text: What percentage they account for.

options.label: D
options.text: If their percentage keeps increasing.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Why their numbers are so high.
【定位】They say that these prison numbers are unusually high and ask why it is the case.
他们说这些监狱里的人数高得反常，并追问为什么会这样。
【信号】ask why 的追问信号。录音末句 ask why it is the case 里的 ask why 是明确的"追问原
因"信号；前半 these prison numbers are unusually high 交代了他们想弄清的对象\(数量
为何反常地高\)，整句承载答案。
【替换】these prison numbers are unusually high and ask why it is the case ↔
Why their numbers are so high
追问数量为何反常高=问为何这么高
【排除】A) 偷换概念
How they can be reduced in number\(如何减少其数量\)录音没说。录音只是追问"为什
么高"，并未谈"怎么把它降下来"；本项把"问原因"偷换成"找办法"。
C) 原词陷阱
What percentage they account for 借了录音里 a high percentage of the prison
population is left-handed 中的 percentage 一词。但录音用 percentage 是为了铺垫"人
数反常高"、进而追问原因，呼吁者想知道的是"为什么高"而非"占多少比例"；本项用一个真
念到的数字词诱你选偏。
借用原文：a high percentage of the prison population is left-handed
D) 过度推断
If their percentage keeps increasing\(比例是否持续上升\)同样盗用 percentage 一词，
但录音从未说"在不在增长"，只说 unusually high\(反常地高\)；"持续上升"是录音没有的
延伸。
借用原文：these prison numbers are unusually high

questions.stem: What did the old age pensioner plan to do?

options.label: A
options.text: See the Pope.

options.label: B
options.text: Go to Newcastle.

options.label: C
options.text: Travel to Germany.

options.label: D
options.text: Tour an Italian city.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） See the Pope.
【定位】The old age pensioner was on a mission to see the Pope, who is head of the Catholic Church,
and decided to make his way there by car.
这位领养老金的老人肩负着去见教皇（天主教会的领袖）的使命，并决定开车前往那里。
【信号】表目的的 on a mission to + decided to。答案信号是表 "目的 / 决意" 的措辞：on a
mission to see the Pope（肩负见教皇的使命）和 decided to make his way there（决定
前往）。听力里 "on a mission to / decided to / plan to" 后面跟的就是主人公的目标，一
听到就锁定，这正是 plan 类题的落点。
【替换】on a mission to see the Pope ↔ See the Pope.
去修饰语后核心动作不变
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
录音里 trying to get from Newcastle 确实念到了 Newcastle，但那是他的 "出发地"，不
是要 "go to" 的目的地。选项 Go to Newcastle. 盗用这个原词，把起点说成终点，听到
Newcastle 就选必中招。
借用原文：trying to get from Newcastle, Great Britain, to Rome, Italy
C) 答非所问
Germany 是他 "误打误撞最后到达" 的地方（ended up in Germany by accident），并非
他 "打算" 去的地方。选项 Travel to Germany. 把 "意外结果" 安到 "计划" 头上，正是本题
问 plan 时最阴的干扰。
借用原文：ended up in Germany by accident
D) 偷换概念
罗马（Italian city）虽是他的真正目的地，但 Tour an Italian city. 把目的说成 "游览一座意
大利城市"，与录音 on a mission to see the Pope（去见教皇）这一明确目的不符——他
不是去观光，是去见教皇。选项借意大利城市这层背景来诱选。
借用原文：on a mission to see the Pope

questions.stem: What finally happened to the old man?

options.label: A
options.text: He was taken to hospital in an ambulance.

options.label: B
options.text: His car hit a sign and was badly damaged.

options.label: C
options.text: His GPS system went out of order.

options.label: D
options.text: He ended up in the wrong place.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） He ended up in the wrong place.
【定位】An 81-year-old man ended up in Germany by accident after trying to get from Newcastle,
Great Britain, to Rome, Italy.
一位 81 岁的老人在试图从英国纽卡斯尔前往意大利罗马的途中，意外地落到了德国。
【信号】结果词 ended up + by accident。答案信号是表 "最终结果" 的措辞 ended up in
Germany by accident：ended up（最终落到…）+ by accident（出于意外）直接点出
"跑错了地方" 这个结局。问 finally happened 的题，就抓 ended up / finally / in the end
这类收束词。
【替换】ended up in Germany by accident ↔ He ended up in the wrong place.
具体地名概括成 wrong place
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音 an ambulance was called to check on the pensioner 是 "叫了救护车来查看"，并
没说把他送进医院。选项 He was taken to hospital in an ambulance. 盗用 ambulance
这个原词，再加码成 "被送往医院"，听到 ambulance 就选必错。
借用原文：an ambulance was called to check on the pensioner
B) 与原文相反
车确实 hit a sign（撞了路牌），但录音明说 did not appear to be seriously damaged
（看起来没严重损坏）。选项 His car hit a sign and was badly damaged. 前半句盗用原
词为真、后半 badly damaged 与原文相反，是典型 "半真半假" 陷阱。
借用原文：did not appear to be seriously damaged
C) 张冠李戴
录音里 GPS 一直正常工作（his GPS system told him he had arrived），错的是老人把目
的地 "Rom" 输错了，不是 GPS 坏了。选项 His GPS system went out of order. 盗用 GPS
这个高频原词，硬安一个 "故障" 给它，把人为输错说成机器失灵。
借用原文：his GPS system told him he had arrived
Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.
1 Glasgow has pledged to become the first carbon neutral city in the UK. The city's council and
ScottishPower have announced a range of strategies in an attempt to reduce carbon emissions ahead of
the new national target of 2045.
Glasgow承诺成为英国首个碳中和城市。该市议会和ScottishPower宣布了一系列战略，试图在2045年这
一新的国家目标之前减少碳排放。
2 First Minister Nicola Sturgeon welcomed the pledge, and said: "Today's announcement between
ScottishPower and Glasgow City Council—to make Glasgow the UK's first net-zero city—is a very
welcome step. Reaching our goals will need exactly this kind of partnership approach—with government,
business, local authorities and citizens all playing their part."
首席大臣Nicola Sturgeon对这一承诺表示欢迎，并说："今天ScottishPower与Glasgow市议会之间的宣
布——使Glasgow成为英国首个净零排放城市——是非常值得欢迎的一步。实现我们的目标需要正是这
种伙伴关系方式——政府、企业、地方当局和公民都发挥各自的作用。"
3 Speaking ahead of the All Energy Conference being held in Glasgow, ScottishPower chief executive
Keith Anderson said: "We have a large supply of renewable energy on our doorstep and one of the only
two low emission zones in action across the UK. Now, we need to invest in the technologies and
programmes that transform the rest of Glasgow's economy and make us net zero before anyone else."
在Glasgow举行的全能源大会之前发言时,ScottishPower首席执行官Keith Anderson说："我们家门口有
大量的可再生能源供应，并且拥有全英国仅有的两个低排放区之一。现在，我们需要投资于技术和项目，
以转变Glasgow经济的其他部分，使我们比其他任何人都更早实现净零排放。"

questions.stem: What do we learn from the news report?

options.label: A
options.text: Scotland will reach the national target in carbon emissions reduction ahead of schedule.

options.label: B
options.text: Glasgow City Council has made a deal with ScottishPower on carbon emissions.

options.label: C
options.text: Glasgow has pledged to take the lead in reducing carbon emissions in the UK.

options.label: D
options.text: First Minister Nicola Sturgeon urged ScottishPower to reduce carbon emissions.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （主旨题） Glasgow has pledged to take the lead in reducing carbon emissions in the UK.
【定位】Glasgow has pledged to become the first carbon neutral city in the UK.
格拉斯哥已承诺要成为英国第一个碳中和城市。
【信号】新闻首句即点题。信号是「新闻第一句」：英文短消息几乎都把最重要的事放在开头第一
句。Glasgow has pledged to become the first carbon neutral city in the UK. 正是全篇
核心事件，主旨题答案就藏在这句里。
【替换】pledged to become the first carbon neutral city in the UK ↔
pledged to take the lead in reducing carbon emissions in the UK
「第一个碳中和」=「带头减排」
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
A 盗用了录音 the new national target of 2045 里的 national target 一词，编出「苏格兰
将提前达成全国减排目标」。但录音只说格拉斯哥要「赶在 2045 全国目标之前（ahead
of）」实现零碳，是这一座城市立下承诺，并非「苏格兰整体将提前达标」，属听到 target
就想选的陷阱。
借用原文：the new national target of 2045
B) 答非所问
B 盗用了录音多次出现的 ScottishPower 和 Glasgow City Council，说成「市议会与
ScottishPower 就碳排放达成一桩交易」。录音里二者确有合作（announced a range of
strategies），但新闻主旨是「格拉斯哥承诺成为英国首个零碳城市」这件大事，B 把主旨
缩成一个次要的「达成 deal」细节，以偏概全。
借用原文：The city's council and ScottishPower have announced a range of strategies
D) 张冠李戴
D 盗用了录音里的 First Minister Nicola Sturgeon 和 ScottishPower 两个专名，编成
「Sturgeon 敦促 ScottishPower 减排」。但录音里 Sturgeon 是 welcomed the pledge
（对承诺表示欢迎），并没有「敦促」ScottishPower，方向与事实都不符，是把人名拼凑
成假信息的张冠李戴。
借用原文：First Minister Nicola Sturgeon welcomed the pledge

questions.stem: What did ScottishPower's chief executive say ahead of the All Energy Conference?

options.label: A
options.text: Glasgow needs to invest in new technologies to reach its goal.

options.label: B
options.text: Glasgow is going to explore new sources of renewable energy.

options.label: C
options.text: Stricter regulation is needed in transforming Glasgow's economy.

options.label: D
options.text: It's necessary to create more low-emission zones as soon as possible.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Glasgow needs to invest in new technologies to reach its goal.
【定位】Now, we need to invest in the technologies and programmes that transform the rest of
Glasgow's economy and make us net zero before anyone else.
现在，我们需要投资于那些能够改造格拉斯哥其余经济、让我们比任何人都更早实现净零排
放的技术与项目。
【信号】主张句 we need to… 是落点。信号是说话人亲口的主张句 we need to invest in the
technologies and programmes：题问「他说了什么」，答案就在他原话里 we need to
（我们需要）这个表态结构后面，这是观点的直接落点。
【替换】we need to invest in the technologies and programmes ↔
Glasgow needs to invest in new technologies to reach its goal
「投资于技术」原意保留，仅换措辞
make us net zero before anyone else ↔ to reach its goal
「率先实现净零」概括成「达成目标」
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
B 盗用了录音 a large supply of renewable energy 里的 renewable energy。但说话人说
的是「我们已经拥有大量可再生能源」，是现状陈述，并非主张「去探索新的可再生能源来
源（explore new sources）」。听到 renewable energy 就选 B 正中圈套。
借用原文：We have a large supply of renewable energy on our doorstep
C) 未提及
C 说「改造格拉斯哥经济需要更严格的监管（Stricter regulation）」。录音里说话人主张
的是 invest in the technologies and programmes（投资技术与项目），从头到尾没提
regulation 或加强监管，C 属录音根本没说的内容。
D) 原词陷阱
D 盗用了录音 one of the only two low emission zones in action 里的 low emission
zones。但说话人是把「已经在运行的低排放区」当作格拉斯哥的现有优势来陈述，并没有
主张「有必要尽快多建低排放区（create more … as soon as possible）」，是把现状包装
成主张的陷阱。
借用原文：one of the only two low emission zones in action across the UK

questions.stem: What do we learn from the news report about the Japanese IT firm?

options.label: A
options.text: It donates money to overpopulated animal shelters.

options.label: B
options.text: It permits employees to bring cats into their office.

options.label: C
options.text: It gives 5,000 yen to employees who keep pet cats.

options.label: D
options.text: It allows workers to do whatever their hearts desire.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） It permits employees to bring cats into their office.
【定位】Hidenobu Fukuda, who heads the firm, introduced the pet policy, upon request from one of
his employees, allowing staff to bring their own cats to work.
公司负责人福田秀信应一名员工的请求，推出了这项宠物政策，允许员工把自己的猫带来
上班。
【信号】政策核心句直陈。这句用 allowing staff to bring their own cats to work 直接点明政策内
容"允许员工带猫上班"，是新闻开头交代"政策是什么"的核心陈述句，无需转折，顺听
到"allowing staff…"即可锁定。
【替换】allowing staff to bring their own cats to work ↔
It permits employees to bring cats into their office
allowing≈permits、staff≈employees
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
原文确实提到 shelters，也提到给钱，但给钱的对象是"救猫的员工"而非"收容所"。本项 It
donates money to overpopulated animal shelters. 把"给员工"偷换成"给收容所"，盗用
了原文 overpopulated shelters 这个词来骗你。
借用原文：rescue cats from overpopulated shelters or streets
C) 原词陷阱
原文的 5,000 yen 是发给"救助了猫的人"，不是发给"养宠物猫的员工"。本项 It gives
5,000 yen to employees who keep pet cats. 照搬了 5,000 yen 这个醒目数字，却把领钱
条件从"rescue a cat"换成"keep pet cats"，属听到数字就想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：He gives 5,000 yen, about 45 US dollars a month to those who rescue a cat
D) 原词陷阱
原文 do whatever their little hearts desire 的主语是猫（furry friends），形容猫在办公
室自由活动。本项 It allows workers to do whatever their hearts desire. 几乎原句照抄，
却把主语从"猫"偷换成"workers（员工）"，是典型原词陷阱。
借用原文：do whatever their little hearts desire

questions.stem: What does Fukuda encourage his employees to do?

options.label: A
options.text: Keep cats off the street.

options.label: B
options.text: Rescue homeless cats.

options.label: C
options.text: Volunteer to help in animal shelters.

options.label: D
options.text: Contribute to a fund for cat protection.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Rescue homeless cats.
【定位】Not only does Fukuda encourage bringing cats to the job, but he also encourages his
employees to rescue cats from overpopulated shelters or streets.
福田不仅鼓励员工把猫带来上班，还鼓励他们去救助来自爆满的收容所或街上的流浪猫。
【信号】encourages领起的鼓励句。题干问 encourage 什么，原文里正好两次出现 encourage，
answer 落在 he also encourages his employees to 后面跟的动词 rescue cats from
overpopulated shelters or streets，听到"encourages…to rescue"即可锁定。
【替换】rescue cats from overpopulated shelters or streets ↔ Rescue homeless cats
from shelters or streets≈homeless
【排除】A) 与原文相反
原文说的是把街上的猫"救回来（rescue from streets）"，本项 Keep cats off the street.
借用了"街"这个意象，却说成"让猫别上街"，动作方向正好相反。
借用原文：rescue cats from overpopulated shelters or streets
C) 原词陷阱
本项 Volunteer to help in animal shelters. 盗用了原文出现的 shelters，但原文只说"从收
容所救猫"，从没说鼓励员工"去收容所做义工"。听到 shelters 就选 C，正中原词陷阱。
借用原文：rescue cats from overpopulated shelters or streets
D) 偷换概念
原文是"公司给救猫的员工 5,000 日元"，钱是公司发出去的；本项 Contribute to a fund
for cat protection. 却说成"员工往护猫基金捐钱"，把给钱方向倒置，且"基金"原文从未出
现。
借用原文：He gives 5,000 yen, about 45 US dollars a month to those who rescue a cat

questions.stem: What does the news report say about the firm's policy?

options.label: A
options.text: It has contributed tremendously to the firm's fame.

options.label: B
options.text: It has helped a lot to improve animals' well-being.

options.label: C
options.text: It has led some other companies to follow suit.

options.label: D
options.text: It has resulted in damage to office equipment.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） It has led some other companies to follow suit.
【定位】Still, cats in the workplace have been a tremendous success for the company. The policy has
led to various other companies doing the same.
尽管如此，办公室养猫对这家公司而言已是巨大的成功。这项政策还促使其他多家公司纷纷
效仿。
【信号】结尾Still转折后的总评。末段以 Still 转折，把前一段的"小麻烦"翻过去，落到对政策的总
评"a tremendous success"，紧接 The policy has led to various other companies
doing the same 是结果句——新闻结尾的转折+收束，正是答案所在。
【替换】The policy has led to various other companies doing the same ↔
It has led some other companies to follow suit
doing the same≈follow suit
【排除】A) 过度推断
原文只说政策是 a tremendous success（巨大成功），并未说提升了公司"名气"。本项 It
has contributed tremendously to the firm's fame. 盗用了 tremendous 这个词，把"成
功"擅自推成"出名"，属听到 tremendous 就想选的原词陷阱叠加过度推断。
借用原文：cats in the workplace have been a tremendous success for the company
B) 未提及
本项 It has helped a lot to improve animals' well-being. 听着与"救助流浪猫"沾边，但
新闻评价政策结果时讲的是"对公司的成功"和"被别家效仿"，并没有评价它"改善了动物福
祉"，这句结论原文未提。
D) 原词陷阱
原文确有猫踩电话、踩关机键的内容，但那被归为 some obstacles（一些小障碍），且被
末段 Still 转折掉，并非对政策的总体评价。本项 It has resulted in damage to office
equipment. 盗用了"电脑/电话"这段细节冒充总评，属原词陷阱。
借用原文：they shut down the computers by walking onto the off switch

questions.stem: What does the man want to do?

options.label: A
options.text: Find out where Jimmy is.

options.label: B
options.text: Borrow money from Jimmy.

options.label: C
options.text: Make friends with Jimmy.

options.label: D
options.text: Ask Jimmy what is to be done.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Find out where Jimmy is.
【定位】But I need to see him, because my friends and I lent him some money last month. We
haven't heard from him since. I heard he comes here a lot, so I thought I'd come in and check
with you.
可我得见到他，因为上个月我和朋友们借给了他一些钱，之后就一直没他的消息。我听说他
常来这儿，所以想着进来跟你打听一下。
【信号】I need to see him 直陈来意。答案信号是男士直接道出目的的句子 I need to see him，
加上 I thought I'd come in and check with you——"来打听、确认他的下落"。这是说话
人主动交代意图的应答，听到 need to / I thought I'd 就该锁定。
【替换】I thought I'd come in and check with you ↔ Find out where Jimmy is.
check with you=find out where
【排除】B) 原词陷阱
录音里钱是男士他们"借给"Jimmy（lent him some money），不是向 Jimmy 借。选项
Borrow money from Jimmy. 盗用了"money"和借钱情节，却把方向倒过来，答非所问。
借用原文：lent him some money
C) 未提及
男士只想找到 Jimmy 把欠款的事说清，全程没有"和 Jimmy 交朋友"之意；Make friends
with Jimmy. 是凭空添加的。
D) 偷换概念
男士是来"打听 Jimmy 在哪"，不是要"问 Jimmy 该怎么处理"；Ask Jimmy what is to be
done. 借用了"找 Jimmy、解决问题"的氛围，却把"找到他"偷换成"向他请教对策"。

questions.stem: What do we learn about the man who came to see the woman yesterday?

options.label: A
options.text: He was unsure what kind of fellow Jimmy was.

options.label: B
options.text: He was working on a study project with Jimmy.

options.label: C
options.text: He wanted to make a sincere apology to Jimmy.

options.label: D
options.text: He wanted to invite her to join in a study project.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） He was working on a study project with Jimmy.
【定位】Some other fellow came in asking for Jimmy just yesterday, a real nervous, pushy type of
fellow, saying he needed Jimmy for some study project they were working on.
就在昨天，另有一个家伙进来打听 Jimmy，一个特别紧张、咄咄逼人的家伙，说他需要
Jimmy 一起做他们正在搞的一个学习项目。
【信号】some other fellow 引入新角色。答案信号是引入新人物的标志句 Some other fellow
came in asking for Jimmy just yesterday，紧接着 saying he needed Jimmy for some
study project they were working on 就是对他的正面交代。听到"another/some other
fellow"就知道题目问的人来了。
【替换】he needed Jimmy for some study project they were working on ↔
He was working on a study project with Jimmy.
几乎直述，仅换说法
【排除】A) 张冠李戴
对 Jimmy 是个什么人拿不准的是男士本人（后文 I did think it was a bit weird），不是昨
天来的那个人；He was unsure what kind of fellow Jimmy was. 把感受安错了人头。
借用原文：a real nervous, pushy type of fellow
C) 原词陷阱
"道歉"出现在女士对 Jimmy 撞车一事的猜测里（if you still wanted to give money as
some sort of apology），与昨天来的这个人无关；He wanted to make a sincere
apology to Jimmy. 盗用了 apology 一词错接到他身上。
借用原文：some sort of apology
D) 偷换概念
录音说他需要 Jimmy 来做项目（he needed Jimmy for some study project），不是邀请
女士加入；He wanted to invite her to join in a study project. 借用 study project 却把
对象从 Jimmy 偷换成 her。
借用原文：he needed Jimmy for some study project

questions.stem: What did Jimmy say happened to him one day?

options.label: A
options.text: He got a ticket for speeding.

options.label: B
options.text: He got his car badly damaged.

options.label: C
options.text: He was involved in a traffic accident.

options.label: D
options.text: He had an operation for his injury.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） He was involved in a traffic accident.
【定位】He told us he'd got into an accident. Nothing serious, mind you, but he damaged someone's
car and wanted to get some money together to make up for the damage he'd caused.
他跟我们说他出了一场事故。不严重，注意啊，但他撞坏了别人的车，想凑点钱来赔偿他造
成的损失。
【信号】He told us he'd got into an accident 转述。答案信号是男士转述 Jimmy 原话的句子
He told us he'd got into an accident——"told us"标明这是 Jimmy 说自己遇到的事，正
对题干"Jimmy say happened to him"。听到"He told us…"就锁定。
【替换】he'd got into an accident ↔ He was involved in a traffic accident.
got into=be involved in
【排除】A) 未提及
Jimmy 只说出了事故、撞坏别人车，从没提"超速被开罚单"；He got a ticket for
speeding. 是凭空添加的情节。
B) 原词陷阱
录音是 he damaged someone's car，撞坏的是"别人的车"；He got his car badly
damaged. 盗用 damaged/car，却把"别人的车"偷换成"他自己的车"，所属关系反了。
借用原文：he damaged someone's car
D) 过度推断
录音明说 Nothing serious，受伤动手术更无从谈起；He had an operation for his injury.
借"accident"联想到受伤手术，属过度推断。

questions.stem: Why did Jimmy borrow money according to the man?

options.label: A
options.text: He needed to make some donations to charity.

options.label: B
options.text: He found the 60 pounds in his pocket missing.

options.label: C
options.text: He wanted to buy a gift for his mother's birthday.

options.label: D
options.text: He wanted to conceal something from his parents.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） He wanted to conceal something from his parents.
【定位】But I thought maybe he doesn't want his parents to know about what happened. So he'd rather
come to us and keep things quiet.
但我当时想，也许他是不想让父母知道这件事，所以他宁愿来找我们，把事情悄悄了结。
【信号】But I thought…So… 男士给出原因。答案信号是转折 But 之后男士自己的推断 But I
thought maybe he doesn't want his parents to know about what happened，加因果
So。题干限定 according to the man，而这正是男士（the man）给出的原因，转折+因
果信号双重锁定。
【替换】he doesn't want his parents to know about what happened ↔
He wanted to conceal something from his parents.
not want parents to know=conceal from parents
【排除】A) 未提及
全程没有"捐款给慈善"之说；He needed to make some donations to charity. 是凭空添
加。
B) 原词陷阱
录音里 just 60 pounds between the three of us 说的是三人借出的总额，不是 Jimmy"口
袋里丢了 60 镑"；He found the 60 pounds in his pocket missing. 盗用数字 60 pounds
编造"丢钱"情节。
借用原文：just 60 pounds between the three of us
C) 未提及
借钱缘由是赔偿撞车、瞒着父母，从无"为母亲生日买礼物"；He wanted to buy a gift for
his mother's birthday. 凭空捏造。

questions.stem: What did the woman want to ask Max about?

options.label: A
options.text: Shopping delivery.

options.label: B
options.text: Shopping online.

options.label: C
options.text: Where he goes shopping.

options.label: D
options.text: How often he does shopping.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） Shopping online.
【定位】I wanted to ask you about ordering shopping online.
我想问问你关于网上下单购物的事。
【信号】开场"I wanted to ask you about…"直接点题。女方开口的 I wanted to ask you about
ordering shopping online 用 "I wanted to ask you about…" 这一典型的挑明话题句式，
直接交代了她来请教的事，是开场点题信号。
【替换】ordering shopping online ↔ Shopping online
ordering shopping online压缩为Shopping online
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
下文 I love getting my shopping delivered 反复出现 "送货" 一词，Shopping delivery
正是盗这个原词。但女方开口请教的话题是 "网购"（online），送货只是网购的一个环节、
是男方后面才展开的内容，并非她问的主题，答非所问。
借用原文：I love getting my shopping delivered
C) 答非所问
录音结尾女方才问 which supermarket do you think is the best to order from（去哪家
订），Where he goes shopping 像是套这处 "where/哪家"，但那是对话末尾她自己抛出
的新问题，而非她一开始来请教的主题；且问的是 "哪家超市" 不是 "他在哪买"，方向也
偏。
借用原文：which supermarket do you think is the best to order from
D) 未提及
How often he does shopping 问购物频率，但全篇没有任何关于 "多久买一次" 的内容，
是利用选项里 shopping 一词凑出的无中生有项。

questions.stem: What does the man think is a problem with shopping in supermarkets?

options.label: A
options.text: Searching in the aisles.

options.label: B
options.text: Dealing with the traffic.

options.label: C
options.text: Driving too long a distance.

options.label: D
options.text: Getting one's car parked.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） Getting one's car parked.
【定位】It makes life so much simpler—no carrying heavy shopping bags in the rain, or trying to park
the car on those huge supermarket car parks then not being able to find it again after you
come out of the shops.
（送货上门）让生活简单多了——不用在雨里拎沉甸甸的购物袋，也不用费劲把车停进超市
那些巨大的停车场、逛完店出来又找不到车。
【信号】他用"再也不用……"反衬出实体购物的麻烦。男方夸网购好时，用一串 "no…"、"trying
to… then not being able to…" 反衬实体购物的烦恼，其中 trying to park the car on
those huge supermarket car parks then not being able to find it again 把 "停车难、停
完找不到车" 当成最具体的一桩麻烦点出，这处对比式抱怨就是答案信号。
【替换】trying to park the car on those huge supermarket car parks then not being able to find it again ↔
Getting one's car parked
把停车找车的长句概括为Getting one's car parked
【排除】A) 未提及
Searching in the aisles（在超市货架通道里找东西）是实体购物常见的麻烦联想，但录音
里男方只抱怨了拎袋子和停车，从没提过 "在货架间找东西"，属凭常识补出来的未提及项。
B) 偷换概念
录音出现 park the car on those huge supermarket car parks，满是 car、car parks 等
开车相关词，Dealing with the traffic 借这股 "开车" 气味把麻烦偷换成 "应付交通/堵车"，
可录音说的是 "停车找不到车"，不是路上交通，概念被换了。
借用原文：trying to park the car on those huge supermarket car parks
C) 张冠李戴
Driving too long a distance（开太远）像是搭后文 I live quite far away from my local
supermarket 的 "住得远"，但那是男方在第6段讲网购更省钱时提的省油背景，并非他这里
点名的实体购物麻烦；本题问的麻烦是停车，不是开车距离，张冠李戴了。
借用原文：I live quite far away from my local supermarket

questions.stem: What is the woman's concern about shopping online?

options.label: A
options.text: The after-sales service.

options.label: B
options.text: The replacement policy.

options.label: C
options.text: The quality of food products.

options.label: D
options.text: The damage to the packaging.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） The quality of food products.
【定位】But there must be some problems. I mean, how do you know that you won't get bad fruit, or
that the eggs won't be broken?
但肯定有些问题吧。我是说，你怎么知道不会收到坏掉的水果，或者鸡蛋不会碎呢？
【信号】转折But+反问how do you know引出疑虑。女方用 But there must be some problems
的转折先表态有顾虑，再用 how do you know that you won't get bad fruit 的反问点出
具体担心，转折 But 加反问句是她抛出 concern 的双重信号。
【替换】bad fruit, or that the eggs won't be broken ↔ The quality of food products
坏水果\碎鸡蛋上升为食品质量
【排除】A) 答非所问
The after-sales service（售后服务）像是搭男方后文 they will give you the money back
or replace the item 的处理措施，但那是男方解释 "出问题怎么办"，不是女方的担心；况
且女方担心的是收到坏东西本身，不是售后，答非所问。
借用原文：they will give you the money back or replace the item
B) 原词陷阱
录音男方说 replace the item（换货），The replacement policy（退换政策）正是盗
replace 这个原词。但那是男方的解决办法，不是女方的担心；女方的 concern 是食物质
量，不是退换政策，原词陷阱。
借用原文：they will give you the money back or replace the item
D) 偷换概念
女方提到 the eggs won't be broken（鸡蛋别碎），The damage to the packaging（包
装破损）借这个 broken 把 "食物本身坏/碎" 偷换成 "外包装破损"。可她担心的是水果坏、
蛋碎这种食物质量，不是包装，概念被悄悄换了。
借用原文：the eggs won't be broken

questions.stem: What does the man find about shopping online?

options.label: A
options.text: It saves money.

options.label: B
options.text: It offers more choice.

options.label: C
options.text: It increases the joy of shopping.

options.label: D
options.text: It is less time-consuming.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） It saves money.
【定位】I actually found that it was cheaper for me, as I live quite far away from my local
supermarket. So with the deliveries, I'm actually saving on petrol.
我其实发现对我来说（网购）更便宜，因为我住得离本地超市挺远的。所以靠送货上门，我
其实省下了油钱。
【信号】I found that+cheaper\saving的结论评价句。男方用 I actually found that it was
cheaper for me 直接下结论，又用 I'm actually saving on petrol 点明省的是油钱，"I
found that…" 加比较级 cheaper、saving 是给网购下正面结论的答案信号。
【替换】it was cheaper for me ↔ It saves money
cheaper等于saves money
I'm actually saving on petrol ↔ It saves money
saving on petrol是saves money的具体落点
【排除】B) 未提及
It offers more choice（网购选择更多）是网购公认的好处之一，但录音里男方只讲了省
钱、省力、食品一样好，从没提过 "选择多"，属凭常识补的未提及项。
C) 过度推断
男方开头说 I love getting my shopping delivered，It increases the joy of shopping
（增加购物乐趣）像是顺着这个 "love" 推出来的，但 "喜欢送货上门" 不等于 "购物变得更
快乐"，且本题问的是他 find 的好处，他明确 find 的是省钱，把喜好夸大成乐趣属过度推
断。
借用原文：I love getting my shopping delivered
D) 偷换概念
录音说网购 makes life so much simpler，It is less time-consuming（更省时）像是从
"生活更简单、不用拎袋停车" 推出的省时，但 "省力、简单" 不等于 "省时间"，而他明确
find 的好处是 cheaper（省钱），把省力偷换成省时了。
借用原文：It makes life so much simpler

questions.stem: What did a recent study find about some British children?

options.label: A
options.text: They have little talent for learning math.

options.label: B
options.text: They need medical help for math anxiety.

options.label: C
options.text: They need extra help to catch up in the math class.

options.label: D
options.text: They have strong negative emotions towards math.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） They have strong negative emotions towards math.
【定位】A recent study found that 10 percent of British children suffer from math anxiety. This means
they have overwhelming negative emotions towards the subject, ranging from rage to despair.
最近一项研究发现，10% 的英国孩子受数学焦虑困扰。这意味着他们对这门学科怀有压倒
性的负面情绪，从暴怒到绝望不等。
【信号】found 后接结论加 This means 解释。信号有两层：先是 A recent study found that 直
接打出「研究发现」的旗号，这后面就是答案区；紧接着 This means they have
overwhelming negative emotions towards the subject 用 This means 把「数学焦虑」
翻译成大白话——正是这句「换种说法解释」给出了答案。听到 found 锁定区域、听到
This means 锁定那一句。
【替换】overwhelming negative emotions towards the subject ↔ strong negative emotions towards math
overwhelming=strong、the subject=math
ranging from rage to despair ↔ strong negative emotions
rage 到 despair 是 negative emotions 的具体化
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
little talent for learning math 借了话题词 math 来制造熟悉感，但录音通篇讲的是「情
绪」，从没说这些孩子「缺乏天赋」——恰恰相反，后文还强调他们能力中上。这是把「焦
虑」想当然地等同于「没天赋」的常识误判。
借用原文：suffer from math anxiety
B) 原词陷阱
medical help for math anxiety 原样搬来录音的 math anxiety，又把后文的身体症状 a
racing heart or struggling to catch breath 误读成「需要医疗帮助」。但录音只是描述症
状，从没说这些孩子需要看病求医，属于借原词、推过头。
借用原文：a racing heart or struggling to catch breath
C) 未提及
extra help to catch up in the math class 蹭了 math 这个话题，但「需要额外帮助跟上数
学课」在录音里完全没有对应——录音讲的是情绪，不是学业进度落后。属于无中生有的干
扰。

questions.stem: What is the widespread misunderstanding about math anxiety?

options.label: A
options.text: It will gradually pass away without teachers' help.

options.label: B
options.text: It affects low performing children only.

options.label: C
options.text: It is related to a child's low intelligence.

options.label: D
options.text: It exists mostly among children from poor families.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） It affects low performing children only.
【定位】There's a widespread misunderstanding that only low performing children suffer from math
anxiety. People automatically assume children are anxious about math because they are
poor achievers.
存在一种普遍的误解：认为只有成绩差的孩子才会有数学焦虑。人们想当然地以为孩子焦虑
是因为他们成绩差。
【信号】widespread misunderstanding that 直接引出误解内容。信号词是 a widespread
misunderstanding that——它和题干用词几乎一模一样，that 后面那句就是误解的具体内
容。紧跟的 People automatically assume 再用「人们想当然地以为」把同一误解复述一
遍，进一步坐实。听到 misunderstanding that 就锁后半句。
【替换】only low performing children suffer from math anxiety ↔
It affects low performing children only
suffer from 换成 affects，主被动对调
【排除】A) 未提及
It will gradually pass away without teachers' help. 说焦虑会在没有老师帮助下自行消退
——录音从没这么说，反而强调 in the long term their performance is negatively
affected（长期看会损害成绩）。属于录音没提、且与原意相悖的编造。
C) 偷换概念
It is related to a child's low intelligence. 借了录音 low performing 里的 low，把「成绩
差（low performing / poor achievers）」偷换成了「智力低（low intelligence）」。录
音谈的是学业表现，从没说焦虑跟智商有关，是典型的偷换概念。
借用原文：only low performing children
D) 原词陷阱
It exists mostly among children from poor families. 蹭了话题词 children，又把录音的
poor achievers（成绩差的人）误读成 poor families（贫困家庭）——poor 一词两义被混
用。录音从未把焦虑和家庭贫富挂钩，属误读原词。
借用原文：they are poor achievers

questions.stem: What does the passage say about British students with math anxiety?

options.label: A
options.text: Most of them have average to strong math ability.

options.label: B
options.text: Most of them get timely help from their teachers.

options.label: C
options.text: They will regain confidence with counselling.

options.label: D
options.text: They are mostly secondary school students.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） Most of them have average to strong math ability.
【定位】But importantly—and surprisingly—this new study suggests that the majority of students
experiencing math anxiety have normal to high math ability.
但重要而且令人意外的是，这项新研究表明，大多数有数学焦虑的学生其实拥有正常到较高
的数学能力。
【信号】But 加 importantly 加 surprisingly 三重强调收尾。信号极强：But importantly—and
surprisingly 同时用了转折 but、强调 importantly、反直觉 surprisingly 三个标记叠在一
起，等于作者在大喊「这句才是重点」。篇章独白里这种结尾的强调句几乎必是考点。听到
but 加 surprisingly，立刻把后面整句记下。
【替换】the majority of students experiencing math anxiety ↔ Most of them
the majority of=Most of
have normal to high math ability ↔ have average to strong math ability
normal=average、high=strong
【排除】B) 与原文相反
Most of them get timely help from their teachers. 录音恰恰相反：their math anxiety
will go unnoticed because their performance is good——因为成绩好，焦虑往往被忽
视、得不到关注，谈何「及时得到老师帮助」。这是与原文相反的干扰。
借用原文：their math anxiety will go unnoticed
C) 未提及
They will regain confidence with counselling. 里的 counselling（心理咨询）在录音里
从头到尾没出现过，「靠咨询恢复信心」完全是编造。录音只提到 a subsequent lack or
loss of confidence（信心丧失），但从没说怎么靠咨询找回。
D) 原词陷阱
They are mostly secondary school students. 借了录音 in both primary and secondary
school 里的 secondary school，却偷偷把「小学和中学都有」缩成「主要是中学生」。录
音明说两个学段都受影响，选项却用 mostly 把范围卡死，属范围偷改。
借用原文：both primary and secondary school

questions.stem: What conclusion has the World Health Organization come to recently?

options.label: A
options.text: Social media addiction is a threat to our health.

options.label: B
options.text: Too many people are addicted to smartphones.

options.label: C
options.text: Addiction to computer games is a disease.

options.label: D
options.text: Computer games can be rather addictive.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） Addiction to computer games is a disease.
【定位】And now, the World Health Organization has recognized addiction to computer games as
a disease.
而如今，世界卫生组织已经把电子游戏成瘾认定为一种疾病。
【信号】主语复现 + now 标志新结论。录音里 And now, the World Health Organization has
recognized addiction to computer games as a disease. 同时出现了题干要找的主
语"World Health Organization"和时间标志"now"（如今、最近），这正是题干 recently
对应的那处"新结论"，是典型的答案句信号。
【替换】recognized addiction to computer games as a disease ↔
Addiction to computer games is a disease.
"认定…为疾病"="…是疾病"
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
录音第 1 段确实提到 social media、第 2 段提到这是健康相关的话题，A 就把"social
media"和"health"拼成"社交媒体成瘾威胁健康"，但 WHO 下结论的对象是电子游戏成瘾、
不是社交媒体，听到熟词就选会掉进这个坑。
借用原文：text messages and social media
B) 原词陷阱
录音开头说 People spend a lot of time using phones and computers.，B 就顺势说"太
多人沉迷智能手机"，可录音的结论针对的是"游戏成瘾"而非"手机成瘾"，且"太多人"是它没
下过的数量判断，属于借原词制造的干扰。
借用原文：People spend a lot of time using phones and computers.
D) 与原文相反
D Computer games can be rather addictive. 只是说游戏"挺容易让人上瘾"，这是第 2 段
开头家长老师的担忧口吻 these games might be addictive，远没到 WHO"认定为疾
病"的硬定性；问的是 WHO 的结论，就必须取那句最重的定性，故 D 程度偏轻、被排除。
借用原文：these games might be addictive

questions.stem: What is said of people with addictive behavior?

options.label: A
options.text: They prioritize their favored activity over what they should do.

options.label: B
options.text: They do their favored activity whenever and wherever possible.

options.label: C
options.text: They are unaware of the damage their behavior is doing to them.

options.label: D
options.text: They are unable to get rid of their addiction without professional help.

questions.explanation:
【答案】A （细节题） They prioritize their favored activity over what they should do.
【定位】Such people make computer games a priority over their responsibilities.
这类人把电子游戏看得比自己的责任更重要。
【信号】指示词"Such people"领起对该类人的刻画。录音用 Such people make computer
games a priority over their responsibilities. 中的"Such people"（这类人）回指上文的
成瘾者，正是题干"people with addictive behavior"指向的对象，这句对其行为的概括就
是答案句信号。
【替换】make computer games a priority over their responsibilities ↔
They prioritize their favored activity over what they should do.
"把游戏看得比责任重"="把爱做的事置于该做的事之上"
【排除】B) 未提及
B They do their favored activity whenever and wherever possible. 说成瘾者"随时随地
都玩"，但录音从头到尾没说过"whenever and wherever（任何时间任何地点）"，它只说
这些人拿游戏顶替了上学、工作、社交 They may play games instead of attending
school, or work, or socializing.，"随时随地"是凭常识脑补出来的。
C) 原词陷阱
C They are unaware of the damage their behavior is doing to them. 说成瘾者"意识不
到自己受的伤害"，录音确实提到这种行为会 damage a person's relationships or
performance（损害关系或表现），但只说"有危害"，从没说成瘾者"没意识到"，C 把"有危
害"偷换成了"本人不自知"。
借用原文：damage a person's relationships or performance at school or work
D) 未提及
D They are unable to get rid of their addiction without professional help. 说成瘾
者"离了专业帮助戒不掉"，录音通篇在讨论"算不算病"，从未提及"professional help（专
业帮助）"或"戒不掉"，这是套用对"成瘾"的刻板印象添加的内容。

questions.stem: What do some behavior experts think of addiction to computer games?

options.label: A
options.text: It may be less damaging than previously believed.

options.label: B
options.text: There will never be agreement on its harm to people.

options.label: C
options.text: It may prove to be beneficial to developing creativity.

options.label: D
options.text: There is not enough evidence to classify it as a disease.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （态度观点题） There is not enough evidence to classify it as a disease.
【定位】Still not all behavior experts agree. Some argue that there's not enough research on the
subject. Thus, they claim it is too early to call computer game addiction a disorder.
不过，并非所有行为专家都赞同。有些专家认为这方面的研究还不够。因此，他们声称现在
就把电子游戏成瘾称作一种障碍还为时过早。
【信号】转折词 Still 领出反对声音。录音用 Still not all behavior experts agree. 中的"Still"（不
过、然而）把语气从前文 WHO 的定论转向反方，紧接着的 Some argue that there's not
enough research 才是这"某些专家"的真实立场——转折之后才是落点，这正是态度题最典
型的答案信号。
【替换】there's not enough research on the subject ↔
There is not enough evidence to classify it as a disease.
"研究不够"="证据不足以定性为疾病"
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
A It may be less damaging than previously believed. 说"危害可能比以前认为的小"，录
音里反方专家质疑的是"研究够不够、能不能现在就定性"，从没比较过"危害大小"，
damaging 一词虽在第 3 段出现过 damage a person's relationships，但"less damaging
（危害更小）"是录音没有的比较。
借用原文：damage a person's relationships or performance at school or work
B) 过度推断
B There will never be agreement on its harm to people. 说"永远不会就其危害达成一
致"，录音只说现在"not all…agree（并非都同意）"、还需要更多研究，是"暂时未达成一
致"，绝不是"永远不会一致"，never 把话推到了录音没有的极端。
借用原文：Still not all behavior experts agree.
C) 未提及
C It may prove to be beneficial to developing creativity. 说游戏成瘾"可能有益于培养创
造力"，录音通篇在争论"算不算病"，从未出现 beneficial（有益）或 creativity（创造力）
任何相关内容，这是凭空添加的好处。

questions.stem: What do we learn about most European passports?

options.label: A
options.text: They are relatively uniform in color and design.

options.label: B
options.text: They appear more formal than other passports.

options.label: C
options.text: They are a shade of red bordering on brown.

options.label: D
options.text: They vary in color from country to country.

questions.explanation:
【答案】C （细节题） They are a shade of red bordering on brown.
【定位】Switzerland's passport is dark red, for example, while most European countries prefer a shade
of red. That's almost brown.
举例来说，瑞士护照是深红色，而大多数欧洲国家偏爱一种红色，那种红几乎接近棕色。
【信号】听到题干对象就锁定。录音念到 most European countries prefer a shade of red，正好
对应题干的 most European passports，这就是答案句的信号——题干问什么对象，录
音里点到这个对象的那一句即是答案句。紧接其后的 That's almost brown 补出近棕色的
细节。
【替换】most European countries prefer a shade of red ↔ They are a shade of red bordering on brown.
原话原词搬进选项
That's almost brown ↔ bordering on brown
almost 与 bordering on 同义
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
relatively uniform in color and design 借了原文反复出现的 color、design 话题词制造熟
悉感，但录音说欧洲护照偏爱某种红色，并未说各国颜色与设计相对统一，属于听到原词就
想选的原词陷阱。
借用原文：slight variations
B) 张冠李戴
more formal than other passports 把后文第 4 段讲深色封面显得正式 they appear
more official 张冠李戴到欧洲护照颜色这题上，且 formal 与 official 近义诱人，但本题问
的是欧洲护照颜色，不是封面为何显正式。
借用原文：they appear more official
D) 与原文相反
vary in color from country to country 与录音相反——录音强调 most European
countries prefer a shade of red，即多数欧洲国家偏爱同一种红色，是趋同而非各国不
同，选项把意思反了。
借用原文：most European countries prefer a shade of red

questions.stem: What does the passage say about the design of passports?

options.label: A
options.text: They must endure wear and tear.

options.label: B
options.text: They must be of the same size.

options.label: C
options.text: They must be made from a rare material.

options.label: D
options.text: They must follow some common standards.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） They must follow some common standards.
【定位】There are no official rules regarding passport colors, but countries follow a certain set of
norms when designing them.
关于护照颜色并没有官方规定，但各国在设计护照时会遵循一套特定的规范。
【信号】转折 but 后是真意。There are no official rules 先说没有官方规定，but 之后才转到
countries follow a certain set of norms when designing them，转折 but 后面才是设计
这一问的落点——前半的没有规定是干扰铺垫。
【替换】follow a certain set of norms ↔ follow some common standards
norms 与 standards 同义
countries follow ↔ They must follow
动词 follow 对应
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
endure wear and tear 里的磨损来自第 4 段 hide dirt and wear，录音确实念过 wear，但
那是讲深色封面能藏脏污磨损，不是回答护照设计要遵守什么，听到 wear 就选即落入原词
陷阱。
借用原文：hide dirt and wear
B) 原词陷阱
of the same size 看似与第 2 段 size 沾边，但录音只说建议各国采用合适的类型、尺寸与
样式，从未说护照必须大小相同，属借 size 一词的原词陷阱兼未提及。
借用原文：size
C) 原词陷阱
made from a rare material 借了第 3 段 made from a material 的 material 一词，但录音
只要求材料能弯折，从未说稀有，rare 是凭空加上去的，属原词陷阱。
借用原文：made from a material that bends

questions.stem: Why are dark colors chosen for passport covers?

options.label: A
options.text: They look more traditional.

options.label: B
options.text: They look more official.

options.label: C
options.text: They are favored by airlines.

options.label: D
options.text: They are easily identifiable.

questions.explanation:
【答案】B （细节题） They look more official.
【定位】Simply put, countries stick to darker and more conservative colors because they appear
more official.
简单说，各国坚持用更深、更保守的颜色，是因为这些颜色显得更正式、更官方。
【信号】because 引出原因。录音 Simply put 提示要给结论，紧接 because they appear more
official 用 because 直接交代原因——这正是 Why 题的答案信号，because 后面那句即是
答案。
【替换】they appear more official ↔ They look more official.
appear 与 look 同义
【排除】A) 原词陷阱
look more traditional 与正确项 look more official 仅一词之差，traditional（传统）与
official（官方）近义易混，但录音 because 后说的是 more official，从未说 traditional，
命题人就靠这对近义词诱你听岔。
借用原文：more conservative colors
C) 张冠李戴
favored by airlines 蹭了第 2 段提到的国际民航组织 The International Civil Aviation
Organization 这一航空背景，但录音从没说深色封面受航空公司青睐，把民航组织硬扯成
airlines 偏好，属张冠李戴。
借用原文：The International Civil Aviation Organization
D) 答非所问
easily identifiable 是另起的一个特征，录音讲深色封面的原因是显官方、还能藏脏污磨损
hide dirt and wear，从未说深色是为了易于辨识，与本题原因不符，属答非所问。
借用原文：hide dirt and wear

questions.stem: What is one special function of the images inside many passports?

options.label: A
options.text: For beauty.

options.label: B
options.text: For variety.

options.label: C
options.text: For visibility.

options.label: D
options.text: For security.

questions.explanation:
【答案】D （细节题） For security.
【定位】The passports of many countries can take images of their well-known geographical features
and wildlife, which also function as security features as some are only visible under a
special light.
许多国家的护照内页印有本国著名的地理风貌和野生动物图案，这些图案还起到防伪作用，
因为有些图案只在特殊光线下才能看到。
【信号】function as 点出作用。录音 which also function as security features 用 function as 直
接点明图案的作用是安全防伪——这正是问 function 一题的答案信号，function as 后面的
security features 即答案落点。后半的 only visible under a special light 是对这一安全功
能的解释。
【替换】function as security features ↔ For security.
security 原词即功能
【排除】A) 过度推断
For beauty. 看似与内页印著名地理风貌、野生动物图案 images of their well-known
geographical features and wildlife 沾边，会让人觉得图案是为好看，但录音说的功能是
安全防伪，从未说为了美观，属过度推断兼未提及。
借用原文：images of their well-known geographical features and wildlife
B) 答非所问
For variety. 蹭了录音讲各国内页图案不同、内页比封面有变化这层意思 the same cannot
be said for the pages，但那是说内页设计较多样，不是图案的功能，把内页多样性误当成
图案功能，属答非所问。
借用原文：the same cannot be said for the pages
C) 原词陷阱
For visibility. 直接盗用录音 only visible under a special light 里的 visible 一词，且与正
确项 For security 拼写相近极易混，但原文说的是图案只在特殊光下可见、这恰恰服务于安
全防伪，可见只是手段、安全才是功能，听到 visible 就选即落入原词陷阱。
借用原文：only visible under a special light
